jobs.title: Senior Principal Engineer, Docker and Ecosystem
jobs.description:
ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________




THE OPPORTUNITY

Docker is seeking a Senior Principal Engineer to serve as the technical visionary and architect for how software gets built, verified, and trusted.



Every day, millions of developers pull images, install dependencies, and ship builds to production. Each of those steps is a place where something can go wrong, or be made to go wrong. Compromised base images, malicious packages, tampered build steps, unsigned artifacts moving through pipelines nobody is watching. The industry calls this the software supply chain, and it has become one of the most consequential unsolved problems in software engineering.



This role sits in Docker and Ecosystems, the group that owns Docker’s most well known products and our emerging content and SDLC business. You will own the technical strategy for secure software delivery across all of it, defining what verifiable, tamper-resistant software delivery looks like at Docker's scale, then driving the architecture that makes it real for every developer and every enterprise customer using our products.

TECHNICAL VISION AND STRATEGY

BUILD SECURITY ARCHITECTURE

Architect systems to detect and prevent build-process threats like compromised dependencies, malicious steps, tampered artifacts, and untrusted images.

 - Design provenance and attestation infrastructure ensuring Docker artifacts carry verifiable build history.

 - Define artifact signing, verification, and policy enforcement across local workflows and CI/CD pipelines.

 - Architect SBOM generation, dependency analysis, and vulnerability intelligence for complete software visibility.

 - Align with and help shape emerging supply chain security standards.

 - Ensure security controls remain fast and unobtrusive so developers keep them enabled.


SDLC AND DEVELOPER WORKFLOW INTEGRATION

 - Design the interfaces and contracts that let Docker's tooling embed into the pipelines, registries, and platforms customers already run, rather than asking them to rebuild around us

 - Define the developer experience for security tooling, where the secure path is the fast path and the default path

 - Architect policy and enforcement models that satisfy enterprise security and compliance requirements without fragmenting the developer workflow

 - Drive convergence of security capabilities across Docker products, replacing product-specific implementations with shared platform primitives


TECHNICAL EXCELLENCE AND INFLUENCE

jobs.title: IT Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Role Summary

We’re seeking an IT Systems Engineer to join our growing IT team. You’ll own the architecture and automation behind the systems our employees rely on every day: identity, device management, endpoint security, and the tooling that ties them together. You’ll work closely with IT, Security, Engineering, and People teams to design, build, and scale the platforms that keep a fast-growing company productive and secure. You’ll also be the onsite IT presence in San Francisco, supporting our executive team and running the technology in our new office. You’ll be expected to set technical direction within your domain, lead multi-team initiatives, and make sound decisions without close supervision.



This role is based in San Francisco, with regular onsite presence at our new San Francisco office, which you’ll manage day to day.



What You’ll Do

 - Own and deploy the architecture, reliability, and roadmap for core IT platforms (identity and access, device management, endpoint security, or IT automation)

 - Design and build automation and internal tooling that eliminates manual work: onboarding and offboarding workflows, access lifecycle management, device enrollment and posture enforcement, and self-service for employees. Use AI and LLM-based tools (such as AI agents and MCP integrations) where they make IT work faster, more consistent, and more reliable

 - Lead multi-team technical initiatives end to end, from architecture and design docs through rollout and communication, partnering with Security, Engineering, and People teams

 - Set technical standards and patterns for the IT team, and write clear design documentation and runbooks others can build on

 - Evaluate tools and vendors, weigh build-vs-buy tradeoffs, and make recommendations to IT leadership with clear reasoning on cost, risk, and scale

 - Partner with Security to implement and maintain the technical controls behind our security and compliance requirements

 - Serve as the technical escalation point for the hardest problems, and apply lessons from incidents to fix root causes rather than symptoms

 - Mentor IT Support Specialists and raise the team’s technical bar

 - Own technology for our San Francisco office end to end, including network and internet connectivity, Wi-Fi, A/V, and equipment, and coordinate with ISPs and vendors

 - Design, deploy, and support network-connected video conferencing and meeting room systems (for example Zoom Rooms, Neat, and Cisco Meraki networking), and make sure every meeting space works reliably for in-person and remote participants

 - Provide white-glove support to executives: proactive and responsive with a high bar for reliability before and during important meetings and events

 - Occasional travel to company events and other Temporal locations



What You’ll Bring

 - 8+ years of experience in IT, systems engineering, or a similar role, with a track record of owning platforms rather than only operating them

 - Deep expertise in at least one of: identity and access management (Okta, Entra ID), device management (MDM for macOS and Windows), or endpoint security and zero trust tooling

 - Strong scripting and automation skills (for example Python, TypeScript, Bash, or PowerShell), including working with APIs and integrating SaaS systems, and hands-on experience using AI coding assistants and LLM-based tools to build and ship automation faster

 - Experience leading cross-functional projects to completion, including scoping, stakeholder alignment, and rollout

 - Ability to communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including executives

 - Hands-on experience with enterprise networking (switching, Wi-Fi, firewalls, ISP circuits) and with conference room and video conferencing systems

 - Comfort supporting senior executives: polished, discreet, and calm under pressure, with the ability to build trust quickly

 - A bias to action and a history of self-education



Nice to Have

 - Experience with identity governance and access lifecycle automation (for example Okta Identity Governance, group rules, access certifications)

 - Experience with zero trust networking (for example Cloudflare Zero Trust) and endpoint detection and response tooling

 - Infrastructure-as-code experience (for example Terraform) applied to IT systems

 - Experience building AI-powered workflows or agents for IT operations (for example MCP servers, or LLM-driven ticket triage and onboarding automation)

 - Experience supporting security and compliance programs from the IT side

 - Experience at a fast-growing, remote-first company, or one that serves developers

 - Experience standing up or opening a new office, including vendor and circuit coordination

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Observability
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

The Infrastructure & Productivity team builds the technical foundation that enables Airwallex’s global engineering organisation to scale. Our customers are fellow engineers, and we make their work faster, safer, and more effective through reliable platforms, automation, and observability systems.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Observability team, you’ll build and operate the platforms that give engineering teams clear, timely, and actionable insight into the health and performance of Airwallex’s distributed systems. You’ll help reduce time to detect and resolve incidents, improve system reliability, and establish scalable observability practices across the company.

 - Build and operate highly scalable observability platforms covering metrics, logs, traces, events, alerting, dashboards, and service health.

 - Develop reliable software and platform capabilities that enable engineering teams to instrument, monitor, and troubleshoot their services with minimal friction.

 - Establish and evolve observability standards, including telemetry collection, instrumentation, alert quality, SLOs, SLIs, service ownership, and operational readiness.

 - Improve incident detection, diagnosis, and response through actionable alerts, intelligent correlation, service dependency visibility, and effective runbooks.

 - Build self-service tools and paved paths that make best practices the easiest way for engineers to adopt observability.

 - Partner closely with application, infrastructure, SRE, security, and product teams to understand operational challenges and deliver durable solutions.

 - Improve the scalability, reliability, performance, and cost efficiency of observability systems across multiple regions and environments.

 - Participate in design reviews, technical planning, code reviews, incident response, and post-incident learning.

 - Mentor engineers and contribute to a culture of ownership, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

This role is based in SG or South Korea


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


ESSENTIALS

 - 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of building and operating production systems.

 - Strong proficiency in at least one backend programming language, such as Go, Java, Python, or Kotlin.

 - Hands-on experience designing and operating distributed systems at scale.

 - Practical experience with observability platforms and technologies such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, ELK, or equivalent solutions.

 - Strong understanding of metrics, logs, traces, alerting, service-level indicators, service-level objectives, and incident management.

 - Experience with cloud-native environments, Kubernetes, containers, and public cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

 - Experience with infrastructure as code and automated software delivery, using tools such as Terraform and CI/CD pipelines.

 - Strong system design and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make sound technical decisions in complex and ambiguous environments.

 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to work effectively with globally distributed engineering teams.

 - An ownership mindset and a commitment to improving systems rather than simply treating symptoms.


PREFERRED

 - Experience building observability platforms or internal developer platforms used by multiple engineering teams.

 - Experience with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger, Loki, Tempo, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, Kafka, or similar technologies.

 - Experience designing high-volume telemetry ingestion, storage, querying, aggregation, and retention systems.

 - Familiarity with SRE practices, including on-call operations, incident response, postmortems, runbooks, and error budgets.

 - Experience with service meshes, Kubernetes operators, or large-scale microservice platforms.

 - Contributions to observability, cloud infrastructure, reliability, or open-source projects.

 - Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.


YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

 - You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

 - You’re comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA.

 - You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

 - You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.


LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

The Infrastructure & Productivity team at Airwallex builds the technical foundation that allows our global engineering organisation to scale. Our customers are our fellow engineers, and our mission is to make their daily work faster, safer, and more effective by managing the core platforms everyone relies on, from Kubernetes and Kafka to CI/CD pipelines

jobs.title: Security Engineer, Corporate Security
jobs.description: About Flexport: At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us. All security disciplines work under the umbrella of the combined PSI (Platform, Security & Infrastructure) team: we build the paved path and tooling that hundreds of engineers around the world rely on every day to ship. Corporate Security owns the estate everyone at Flexport actually touches — the laptops, the identity provider, the SaaS sprawl, the browser. Get it right and nobody notices. Get it wrong and it's the fastest way into everything else we're trying to protect. This is a security engineering role, not an IT support role. You'll spend your time writing code and shipping automation, not administering a helpdesk queue or babysitting a ticket tray. What you'll do Identity & access Advance our identity posture: SSO coverage, phishing-resistant MFA rollout, SCIM lifecycle automation, and least-privilege access across the SaaS and cloud estate. Build the detections and guardrails that catch account takeover, MFA fatigue attacks, and session token theft before they turn into incidents. Endpoint & device lifecycle Write and ship device policy as code — configuration profiles, remediation scripts, and enforcement rules across macOS and Windows — with staged rollout and rollback built in from day one. Maintain and improve our EDR stack's detection and response coverage across the fleet. SaaS posture Reduce SaaS risk at scale through SSPM tooling and automation , including detection of risky OAuth grants, shadow IT, and configuration drift across our critical SaaS applications. Own security configuration for the SaaS tools hundreds of Flexporters use daily (Google Workspace, Slack, and similar), and keep pace as we add AI agents and MCP integrations to that surface. Automation & enablement Automate the parts of corporate security that don't need a human — device provisioning, access reviews, vendor security questionnaires — so the team scales with headcount instead of straining against it. Write runbooks and documentation that make the rest of the team more capable , and partner with IT and People teams to ship controls that don't create the friction that drives people to workarounds. You should have Typically 2–5 years of experience in corporate, enterprise, or IT security engineering — we care more about what you've shipped than the exact number. If you meet most of this, apply; we'd rather see your work than filter you out on a résumé line. Hands-on experience with modern endpoint management and EDR tooling (Jamf, Kandji, Intune, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, or similar). Working knowledge of identity protocols (SAML, OIDC, SCIM) and a major identity provider (Okta, Entra, Google Workspace, or similar). Comfort writing real code or scripts (Python, Go, or similar) to replace manual, ticket-driven work with automation. Clear, practical communicator who can explain a control tradeoff to an engineer, a salesperson, and a VP without changing the facts. Nice to have Experience with SSPM tooling and OAuth-grant governance. Exposure to DLP or insider-risk tooling. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) for managing security configuration. A point of view on how agentic AI tools and MCP integrations change what corporate security needs to watch for Interest in growing into a broader corporate security or detection engineering scope over time. How we work We're in the San Francisco office regularly to work through incidents and detection design in person. We stay closely aligned with teammates on other continents via Slack, video, and async docs. We have the latest hardware and software, including frontier AI models on day one. We're agile, but not dogmatic. Teams decide how they work best. Why this role is special Broad, real ownership: at this level elsewhere you might own a slice of a control; here you'll own well-defined projects end to end, from design through rollout, with support scoping the ambiguous parts. Every device policy or identity control you ship protects every Flexporter, immediately — no six-month rollout to a subset of customers. You're part of PSI: security is treated as infrastructure to build, not policy to enforce, and platform and infrastructure engineers are a Slack message away. Where you'll work This role is based in San Francisco, and we have a strong preference for candidates who are there or willing to relocate — we're deliberately building this team in one place. Relocation support is available for the right candidate. Investing your time with Flexport means having immediate impact, all over the world. You're empowered to do what's best for everyone and trusted to make the right decisions when and where you need them. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Analytics | Canada | Remote
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we are looking for candidates from the U.S. or Canada. Residents of Quebec are not eligible for this role.

At Grafana Labs, we build observability tools that help users understand, respond to, and improve their systems – regardless of scale, complexity, or tech stack. We recently started a skunkworks initiative with a mission to bring observability to the rest of the business. Our goal is to make Grafana the single best place where humans and AI agents understand and act on real-time data from across the enterprise. As part of this initiative, we are building an AI-native data intelligence system that gives agents reliable, governed access to enterprise context. This system helps agents retrieve the right data, metadata, definitions, lineage, quality signals, and institutional knowledge without every agent builder having to maintain their own brittle context files. The principle is simple: the context system retrieves, agents decide, and data teams maintain the intelligence.

The new team is a mix of seasoned Grafanistas and new hires. We operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, both as individuals and as a team. Engineers are empowered to make decisions, move quickly, and validate ideas early – while being supported by a deeply collaborative culture that values curiosity, feedback, and cross-functional partnership.

We’re looking for a Senior-level Backend Engineer to help build the first production services for this context layer management system. You will design and ship the core backend architecture that powers ingestion, context storage, retrieval APIs, and agent-facing integrations. This is an early-stage role on a high-autonomy team, so you should be comfortable working through ambiguity, making pragmatic architectural decisions, and building systems that can evolve from internal dogfooding to production-grade SaaS. As the team matures, there’s a broad opportunity to expand or redefine this role based on impact and initiative.

Key responsibilities:

  • Build the core backend services: Design, implement, test, and operate the first services for context ingestion, context indexing, retrieval orchestration, API access, source configuration, and system administration.
  • Create a scalable SaaS foundation: Help define and build the architecture for a multi-tenant service, including tenant isolation, usage tracking, quotas, audit logs, background jobs, and reliable service boundaries.
  • Power agent-facing retrieval workflows: Build APIs and service interfaces that allow AI agents, MCP tools, CLIs, and internal applications to retrieve relevant context, provenance, confidence signals, and warnings.
  • Work across product and infrastructure: Partner with the team to make practical tradeoffs between fast experimentation and long-term reliability, especially as the project moves from prototype to production.
  • Operate what you build: Instrument services with metrics, logs, traces, alerts, and dashboards. Use observability tools to understand system behavior and improve reliability.
  • Contribute to technical direction: Help shape the architecture, service boundaries, storage choices, API contracts, deployment patterns, and engineering practices for a new product area.
  • Effective communication: You’ll be working in a highly dynamic and collaborative environment, so we need someone who can communicate effectively and contribute across teams.
  • Ownership and impact: Take full ownership of the AI solutions you develop, ensuring they are not only innovative but also scalable, maintainable, and aligned with real user workflows. 

What we re looking for:

  • Strong engineering skills: Solid experience building production-grade, user-facing software systems. You’re a self-starter, capable of tackling complex engineering problems and making UI design decisions with minimal supervision.
  • AI experience with a practical mindset: You’re familiar with AI technologies and frameworks, and you focus on delivering high-quality solutions that work in the real world, not just in theory. 
  • Quick iterat

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Lakehouse Infra)
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Data and Storage Services team is responsible for Affirm s data infrastructure across OLTP and OLAP systems, spanning critical online checkout databases, batch orchestration, streaming infrastructure, event-driven frameworks, BI, analytics tooling, large-scale data platforms, and agentic data tools such as semantic layers and internal platform data applications. Our mission is to provide trustworthy, intuitive, and cost-efficient solutions for Affirmers to secure, store, analyze, and transform data at exceptional scale.

The vision for the Lakehouse Infra team is to provide reliable, scalable, self-serve and Affirm-optimized offline data access to enable ML, Product, and Financial Engineering success. Our team is responsible for hosting the data infrastructure that serves as a backbone for processing various business critical money and loan movement workloads at Affirm across our batch and analytics ecosystems. Affirm is growing rapidly and so is the need for reliable and high availability frameworks. If solving data lake challenges at scale excites you, come join us!

What you’ll do

  • You will be responsible for owning and delivering quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers on your team through ambiguity to solve open-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery.
  • You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.
  • You will proactively identify project, process, technology or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them.
  • You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.

jobs.title: Operations Engineer, Tech Foundations
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

BizTech fosters culture and connection at Airbnb by providing reliable corporate tools, innovative products, and technical support for all teams. We drive technical breakthroughs and strategies that redefine what it means to belong anywhere, delivering greater value for the business and our people. The Global Operations team at BizTech manages production services across Airbnb’s corporate environment, delivering reliable operations through Observability, Incident Management, Core Operations, and AI-enabled automation. We partner across BizTech to scale service quality, efficiency, and resilience.

The Difference You Will Make:

As an Operations Engineer, you ll apply AI at the forefront of BizTech s operational health: using LLM-powered triage and intelligent automation to resolve tickets, speed up incident response, and build self-healing observability that catches problems before they escalate. AI fluency is core to this role, not an add-on. You ll prototype agentic workflows, embed AI into runbooks and diagnostics, and continuously look for repetitive work automation can take over. Success looks like a shrinking backlog of recurring ticket categories through AI-assisted automation, faster MTTR powered by intelligent alerting and root-cause suggestions, and dashboards/reporting enhanced with AI-driven insights that give stakeholders clear, trustworthy visibility into service health and data quality.

A Typical Day: 

  • Manage the ticket queue prioritizing and resolving requests while identifying recurring categories to automate or deflect
  • Participate in a rotating on-call and incident response schedule, including weekends, troubleshooting and documenting issues in real time
  • Build and maintain monitoring dashboards (Tableau, Superset, Grafana) that track service health, availability, and data quality, flagging gaps as they emerge
  • Use AI-assisted tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to speed up triage, root-cause analysis, scripting, and documentation — while knowing when a problem needs hands-on judgment instead
  • Write and maintain code in general-purpose languages (Python, Go, JavaScript, TypeScript, Bash) to automate operational workflows
  • Partner with global stakeholder teams to drive issues to resolution

Your Expertise:

  • 3+ years of experience with observability and metrics tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ElasticSearch)
  • 3+ years working with data querying and pipelines (e.g., SQL, Airflow, Trino, SQS)
  • Working knowledge of network fundamentals and hardware (e.g., Cisco, Palo Alto)
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD and automation tooling (e.g., Jenkins, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions) across AWS, GCP, or Oracle Cloud
  • Comfort working in ticket/workflow-driven environments using Jira and Confluence
  • Experience supporting enterprise SaaS tools (e.g., Salesforce, Workday) and SSO/identity integration (e.g., Okta) is a plus

Your Location:

This position is India - Remote (Eligible anywhere within India). The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

 

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

jobs.title: IT Systems Engineer, M&A
jobs.location: Boston, MA; Remote-Friendly (Travel-Required) | San Francisco, CA | Seattle, WA | New York City, NY; Washington, DC
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic s Corporate Systems team runs the core collaboration platforms everyone here works in and builds the tooling and automation behind IT. That responsibility extends to the companies we acquire. Their people, devices, and systems have to come into Anthropic securely.

You ll own the IT side of Anthropic s acquisitions: due diligence, integration planning, and integration. Before close, you ll assess a company s IT environment and give the deal team a clear read on risk and effort. You ll define the technical integration plan and its requirements: what moves, where it lands, in what order, what has to be ready on day one, and how each security gap gets closed. After close, you ll carry out that plan and bring the company s people, devices, and systems onto our stack. This is a hands-on engineering role. You ll hold admin, write code, build automation, run the cutovers yourself and bring in other teams when the work calls for their expertise or support. You ll lead this work for IT Engineering and partner with Security, Corporate Development, Legal, People, and Finance at every stage.

M&A will be your primary focus and responsibility, but you ll be a full member of the Corporate Systems team;  taking part in planning and reviews, using and contributing to the team’s tooling, and contributing to the roadmap. Early on, M&A will be most of your work, including using Claude to automate the repeatable parts of diligence and integration. As that automation matures, and when M&A load is light, you ll contribute to other parts of the team’s roadmap.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical IT due diligence: assess a company s identity, applications, endpoints, and infrastructure, and brief the deal team on risk and effort before close
  • Find the gaps between an acquired environment and Anthropic s security model, rate them, and build the mitigations into the integration plan
  • Define the technical integration plan and its requirements: what moves, where it lands, in what order, and what has to be ready on day one
  • Run the integration: take over administration, migrate people, devices, and data, and retire what s no longer needed, with support from other IT Engineering teams as required.
  • Work with Business Technology, Client Platform, Corporate Network, IT Operations, and Security on their parts of each integration
  • Keep Corporate Development, Legal, People, Finance, and the acquired company s team clear on where IT stands
  • Build a repeatable IT M&A playbook and automate as much of it as possible with Claude
  • When M&A work is light, contribute to core Corporate Systems projects

You may be a good fit if you have

  • 8+ years as a hands-on engineer in corporate IT. You have designed and shipped systems, carried out migrations or integrations yourself, and owned at least one area end-to-end, with experience supporting other areas: identity, applications, endpoints, or corporate infrastructure
  • Experience administering enterprise identity and collaboration platforms such as Google Workspace, Slack, and an SSO provider, and working code in Python or similar against their SaaS APIs
  • Working knowledge of endpoint management and security concepts, enough to lead diligence on an unfamiliar fleet
  • A proven ability to understand an unfamiliar IT environment quickly and deliver a prioritized view of risk to non-specialists
  • A record of leading technical projects that span several teams and run to a fixed date, while doing much of the engineering yourself
  • Comfort working autonomously, with ambiguity and confidential information
  • Clear communication with executives, legal and corporate development teams, and engineers at acquired companies

Strong candidates may also have

  • Prior M&A, carve-out, or company-to-company migration experience
  • Experience across the full stack: endpoints, systems, applications, and infrastructure
  • Hands-on experience managing a device fleet or running an MDM
  • Experience working in or alongside a security team
  • A record of building tooling that replaces manual IT work
  • Using Claude or similar tools as a core part of how you work

Representative projects

  • Assess an acquired company s IT environment that nobody here has seen and produce a prioritized integration plan within days
  • Design a way to size integration effort and risk for a company of any shape or size
  • Automate bringing acquired people and devices onto Anthropic s identity and device management
  • Write the IT risk memo for a live deal and present it to Corporate Development and Security leadership

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

$325,000—$360,000 USD

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. Join the AI-Native Authoring team and help shape how data scientists, analysts, engineers, and AI developers build on Snowflake. From SQL to python, and from Workspaces to our VS Code extension, our team owns the highest impact workloads and surfaces across Snowflake. We even own Snowflake Notebooks end to end, including the notebook service backend, container runtimes, and interactive, Jupyter-based experience our customers work in every day.



Our team is at the center of delivering a profound AI and application-development platform, delivering secure, reliable, reproducible compute environments with a delightful and intuitive editing experience layered on top.  These serve all of our customers, including our most critical security-sensitive customers running in regulated and air-gapped deployments.

AS A TECH LEAD/MANAGER YOU WILL:

STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER – FILE INGESTION (CUSTOMER-FACING SERVICES)


BUILD THE FUTURE OF THE AI DATA CLOUD

Snowflake’s File Ingestion team owns the core engines behind COPY INTO and Snowpipe — the primary arteries landing customer data into the AI Data Cloud at hundreds of petabytes per quarter.

We are expanding our core mission to build next-generation, external-facing ingestion services that directly expose file-ingest capabilities to external platforms, partner ecosystems, and customer applications. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will lead the architectural vision and execution for these mission-critical, customer-facing services. You will operate at the intersection of high-throughput distributed systems, API platform design, and direct customer feature delivery, defining how enterprise data seamlessly flows into Snowflake at global scale.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Drive Technical Vision & Architecture: Define the multi-year architecture and technical strategy for high-throughput, external-facing ingestion services and APIs across multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

 - Deliver Customer-Facing Innovations: Lead the end-to-end execution of enterprise-grade external features, ensuring low-latency data landing, high availability, and seamless ecosystem integration (e.g., Snowpark Connect, partner connectors).

 - Set Technical Direction: Author foundational design documents, establish technical standards for reliability, security, and scalability, and lead high-stakes architectural reviews across engineering orgs.

 - Lead Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with Principal Architects, Product Management, Security, and external developer platforms to translate customer requirements into resilient system architecture.

 - Elevate Engineering Excellence: Mentor and sponsor Senior, Mid-level, and Junior engineers; raise the bar for system design, code quality, testing methodologies, and operational maturity.

 - Direct Customer & Strategic Impact: Engage with enterprise customer engineering teams to solve complex integration challenges, debug production edge cases at scale, and turn direct customer feedback into core platform capabilities.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 10+ years of experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems or cloud-native infrastructure in production.

 - Proven track record of architectural leadership, having successfully taken complex, customer-facing services or external APIs from initial concept to General Availability (GA) and global scale.

 - Expert proficiency in Java or C++ (strong preference for engineers comfortable working across both systems-level C++ and managed service Java frameworks).

 - Deep expertise in external API design, cloud service orchestration, and building resilient, multi-tenant customer-facing endpoints.

 - Deep domain knowledge in at least one of the following: high-throughput ingestion pipelines, distributed query execution engines, messaging/streaming systems (e.g., Kafka, Pulsar), or database internals.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a demonstrated ability to drive technical consensus across cross-functional leadership, product partners, and external technical stakeholders.

 - BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.


BONUS POINTS

 - Experience building and scaling external developer platforms, SDKs, or public SaaS APIs serving external consumers.

 - Deep expertise with open table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) and integration with ecosystems like Apache Spark or Ray.

 - Advanced performance engineering expertise: memory management, SIMD, vectorization, lock-free data structures, or I/O optimization at PB-scale.

 - Strong background in metadata management, transactional state machines, or consensus protocols (e.g., Raft, Paxos).

 - Active contributor to open-source data infrastructure, cloud-native compute systems, or query engines.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Foundational Storage
jobs.description:
ABOUT SENTRY

Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building.

Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Sentry’s Foundational Storage team builds and supports the stateful storage systems that all our products rely on: object storage, relational databases, key-value stores, and caches. We help Sentry engineers store and access data consistently, durably, securely, and efficiently as our products and traffic grow.

We develop storage services like our open-source Objectstore https://github.com/getsentry/objectstore and build libraries and APIs that make existing storage systems easier to use. In our own services, we design storage protocols that keep data consistent across backends, even through concurrent updates and failures. Our abstractions let other engineering teams use storage without worrying about which cluster or instance holds their data.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the team, you’ll work on both the systems and the code that makes them easy to use. You’ll tackle questions of data consistency, availability, performance, and cost-efficiency, and work with product teams to turn their needs into practical solutions. The goal is simple: make the right way to store data the easy and obvious way.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

 - Design and operate storage systems used across Sentry, including their configuration and performance tuning.

 - Create APIs and abstractions that make storage easy for product teams to use, with best practices for correctness, security, and scale built in.

 - Solve storage challenges at scale, including consistency under concurrent access, sharding and rebalancing, and routing reads and writes across storage backends as workloads grow.

 - Work with product engineers to choose storage approaches, plan safe migrations, and help teams adopt the tools you build.

 - Plan and build with other Platform and Infrastructure teams, including analytical storage and streaming, to deliver a complete, fault-tolerant platform for product teams. Align roadmaps and standards, and design for failures and recovery.

 - Improve storage performance and cost efficiency by making better use of backends and resources, while keeping the platform simple for product teams.

 - Write code primarily in Rust and Python, with clear user-facing documentation. Develop advanced testing scenarios, such as production-scale chaos tests covering backend and infrastructure outages.

 - Own latency and availability SLOs for your services, improve monitoring and incident response, and participate in the team’s on-call rotation.




YOU’LL LOVE THIS JOB IF YOU

 - Enjoy digging into the internals of storage systems and understanding how they behave when traffic grows, requests race, or a dependency has a bad day.

 - Care about a useful, easy-to-use API as much as what happens behind it.

 - Like working with other engineers to understand their needs and make their day-to-day work easier.

 - Want to follow your work from design and code through rollout and production for millions of developers.

 - Want open-source contributions to be at the center of your day job.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years of software engineering experience building and operating distributed, stateful systems in production.

 - Hands-on experience with object storage, relational databases, and caching systems at production scale. Experience with key-value or wide-column stores is a plus.

 - An understanding of distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency, concurrency, and what happens when requests fail or need to be retried.

 - Proficiency in a systems language such as Go, C++, Java, or Rust, and comfort working in Python. We primarily use Rust and Python, and welcome engineers who are new to Rust.

 - Experience running services on Kubernetes in a cloud environment, including observability, SLOs, and incident response. Familiarity with Terraform is a plus.

 - Good written and spoken English, especially in explaining technical choices and writing documentation.

 - Nice to have: experience building shared libraries or internal APIs, migrating data between systems, or improving system performance and cost.

jobs.description:
About Teleport

Don't wait for the future of infrastructure. Be part of it.

Teleport is the AI Infrastructure Identity Company. We're solving one of the hardest problems in security: giving every human, machine, workload, and AI agent a cryptographically secured identity, improving engineering velocity while maintaining security. We make trusted computing simple. This gives you the freedom, power, and autonomy to build and innovate with confidence.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we work with companies like Nasdaq, DoorDash, and Elastic to secure infrastructure for an AI world.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are adding a Senior Financial Analyst to the Strategic Finance team to expand our FP&A capacity and give us deeper coverage across the business. You will own corporate FP&A and the consolidated three-statement view, partner directly with Customer Success and G&A leaders, and provide a perspective on go-to-market (GTM) planning. You will also help us stress-test the assumptions behind our plans and key metrics.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Corporate FP&A: Own the three-statement financial consolidation (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow), including forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis. Sync the long-range plan with the detailed financial operating plan and monthly actuals load.

 - Monthly close: Participate in and review the monthly close, working with Accounting to make sure the numbers tie out and the story behind them is clear.

 - Business partnering: Serve as the finance partner to Customer Success and to G&A functions (HR, Recruiting, Finance, Legal, IT, Biz Ops), supporting budget owners with planning, headcount, spend tracking, and decision support.

 - Board and investor reporting: Build and maintain board decks, investor updates, and other leadership deliverables.

 - Equity plan forecasting: Forecast equity plan usage and dilution, and support related analysis.

 - Corporate valuation support: Support valuation work, including model inputs and analysis.

 - Team coverage: Provide backup and redundancy across the team's workstreams so that no process depends on a single person.

 - Tools and process improvement: Help implement and optimize FP&A and AI tools, and look for ways to automate and improve how the team works.

 - Executive partnership: Work directly with senior leadership and budget owners as a trusted, independent finance voice.




WHAT YOU WILL BRING

 - 8+ years of progressive finance experience, most recently with 5+ years in FP&A and 2+ years owning P&L forecasting and executive reporting at a growth-stage SaaS company.

 - 3-statement financial planning, including integrated P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow forecasting.

 - SaaS GTM motion, including how pipeline, bookings, and IARR/ARR connect.

 - Pricing and margin analysis, such as modeling how pricing and packaging changes affect bookings, gross margin, and unit economics.

 - Lead-to-cash process, including how billing, collections, and revenue recognition flow into ARR, deferred revenue, and cash forecasts.

 - CFA charterholder, investment banking, venture capital, private equity, or Big 4 audit experience is a plus but not required.




TECHNICAL SKILLS

 - Deep working knowledge of standard SaaS metrics (CAC payback, burn multiple, magic number, Rule of 40, net and gross retention), including how to calculate them, what drives them, and how plan assumptions move them.

 - Advanced financial modeling skills, ideally in Google Sheets as well as Excel. You design driver-based models from scratch, with assumptions you can trace and defend, rather than only updating existing ones.

 - Hands-on experience pulling and reconciling data across systems (ERP, CRM, planning tools), and a track record of using or testing AI tools to speed up finance work.




HOW YOU WORK

 - You possess a strong sense of intellectual curiosity and professional ethics.

 - Demonstrated self-initiative: you spot problems and fix them without being asked.

 - You operate independently, with a continuous improvement mindset.

 - You communicate clearly with non-finance partners and senior leaders.

 - You fit Teleport's culture and behaviors, and you do well in a fast-moving startup environment.



Why Teleport

You're joining a company where the problem is real, the team is small, and your work shows up directly in the product. We're not a big company, you won't get lost in a crowd. You'll have the freedom and autonomy to do what you're great at, alongside teammates who care about doing it right and want to see you succeed. The work is collaborative, there's real room to grow, and the mission is one worth showing up for.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we're genuinely passionate about what we're building.



The Benefits

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer- Site Reliability Platform
jobs.description:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?



Your mission

We see boundless potential in the way we live. It drives the way we work. Our culture is our most valuable asset. It acts like a compass for us. We are fast, immersed, humble and bold. And thatʼs not just words on the walls.
Eliminating time-consuming tasks means people get to do more of what they love. Itʼs an inspiring, high stakes challenge that motivates us, and this common passion bonds UiPath employees globally. We all strive every day to be better and to accelerate human achievement. We make software robots, so people donʼt have to be robots. Would you like to be part of this journey?

At UiPath's Site Reliability team, we build the platforms and systems the entire company depends on to deliver on our compliance and SLA promises to customers. These span services and tools that enforce cloud access policies, cost governance, observability, operational excellence, and reliability across UiPath. We are scaling each of these pillars, and building the next generation of capabilities on each, powered by AI.

This is a software engineering role. You will not be the person who identifies a reliability gap and files a ticket for another team to fix. You are the engineer who identifies the gaps across teams, designs the system that closes it, builds it, ships it, and drives its adoption — often by doing the integration work yourself rather than asking other teams to come to you. You build platforms that other engineers depend on in their critical path, and you hold yourself accountable to outcomes, not outputs.

You treat every system you ship as a product: you put it in front of users early, seek feedback aggressively, and iterate until it delivers real results. If adoption is slow, you donʼt blame the docs — you sit with the team, understand the friction, and remove it.

What you will be doing at UiPath 
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will 

 - Design, engineer, and build SRE platform systems and capabilities with cutting-edge AI, treating them as products that other engineering teams depend on in their critical path.

 - Participate in livesite monitoring rotations, handle escalations, and drive effective mitigations — aggressively reducing customer impact through broad, detailed, and effective postmortems.

 - Drive availability, scalability, and performance improvements based on livesite learnings. Generate (or codify existing) best practices and ensure they are followed widely across UiPath — not by publishing guidance, but by embedding them into the systems you build.

 - Ensure technical deliverables meet or exceed expectations on reliability, scalability, quality, and performance. Identify and drive architectural changes that significantly move the needle on these dimensions.

 - Onboard other teams onto your platforms by driving outcomes yourself — writing the integrations, pairing with their engineers, removing friction — rather than handing off documentation and waiting.

 - Ship early, seek feedback relentlessly, and iterate fast. Treat every user complaint as a design input, not a support ticket.

 - Drive task planning, estimation, scheduling, and staffing.

 - Participate in and influence process improvements and best practices across the engineering organization.
   
    
   
   What youʼll bring to UiPath

 - Proven track record (6+ years) of architecting and engineering world-class, large-scale, distributed commercial applications and services, and ensuring customer success. 

 - Experience building large-scale, complex internal platforms adopted by multiple teams in their critical path at a large company — systems that have stood the test of time, not prototypes that were handed off or abandoned. 

 - Demonstrated ability to drive adoption of your systems by doing the hard work yourself: writing integrations, removing friction for other teams, and measuring success by outcomes delivered — not features shipped. 

 - Experience building and maintaining complex AI-powered applications in production. 

 - Proficiency in one or more object-oriented languages (such as C#, C++, Go, or Python), backed by solid computer science fundamentals. 

 - Deep understanding of data structures, algorithms, multithreading, synchronization, asynchronous patterns, and cloud programming. 

 - Experience with service-oriented and microservice-based architectures, HTTP applications, and web services development. 

 - Familiarity with modern engineering practices including agile development, CI/CD, and DevOps. Ability to work with globally distributed teams. 

 - Experience working with or managing production Kubernetes infrastructure is a plus. 

 - Experience with any of the cloud providers (Azure, AWS, GCP) and managed services (AKS, GKE, etc.) is a must. 

 - Experience with database backends (e.g., Azure SQL, CosmosDB, Azure Data Lake, Power BI, MongoDB, MySQL, DynamoDB, etc.)

jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are seeking candidates in US and Canada. 

The Opportunity: 

We build Tempo, the open-source distributed tracing backend behind Grafana Cloud Traces and Grafana Enterprise Traces (GET). Tempo makes it easy to search traces, generate metrics from spans, and connect tracing data with logs, metrics, and profiles across the Grafana stack.

2026 is an inflection point for Tempo. After a major architectural upgrade and the launch of TraceQL metrics, we are shifting from foundational work to product and operational excellence, and evolving Tempo from a SaaS database into a platform that powers Grafana’s next generation of observability products (App Observability, Asserts, Traces Drilldown, and AI-driven assistants).

Over the next year, you will help us:

  • Make Grafana Cloud Traces “just work” for customers by eliminating rough edges, confusing limits, and hidden failure modes.
  • Achieve operational excellence at scale as we grow from close to 50 cells today into triple digits this year, with autoscaling, parameterized rollouts, and aggressive toil reduction.
  • Evolve Tempo into a platform enabler: higher-density APIs, trace aggregation, TraceQL metrics math, and machine/LLM-friendly interfaces that downstream products and agents can build on.
  • Push performance further: faster query latency at hundreds of MB/s ingestion and performant 30-day query ranges to match competitors.
  • Prepare Tempo for an agent-driven world: larger, burstier, higher-cardinality workloads, and new categories of AI-powered workflows, such as assistant-driven triage and “why is this slow?”- style investigations.

What You’ll Be Doing: 

As a Senior Engineer on Tempo, you will own technical direction on the hardest problems in our roadmap and raise the bar across the team.

  • Deliver significant technical projects. Take well-scoped, multi-month initiatives from problem framing through rollout, e.g., trace aggregation APIs, Limitless Tempo, autoscaling cells and customer limits, or query engine improvements. Partner with Staff engineers and the tech lead on broader, cross-team direction.
  • Own major components of Tempo. Contribute to and own parts of ingestion, storage, query, and metrics generation. Write and present design docs, participate in design reviews, make sound trade-offs on performance, cost, and complexity, and document the “why” for the team.
  • Build APIs for humans and agents. Help shape the next generation of Tempo’s interfaces (structured, deterministic, discoverable) so that Act 3 products, LLM-driven assistants, and external integrators can build on Tempo reliably.
  • Contribute to operational excellence. Own outcomes for the areas you build against concrete SLOs (P99 write latency, incident recurrence, TCO per ingested GB), and help move the team toward Zero Ops through automation, parameterized rollouts, and actionable alerts.
  • Collaborate with Product and sibling teams. Work with PMs and with App Observability, Asserts, Drilldown, and Grafana Assistant teams to understand how Tempo gets consumed and to ship what unblocks them.
  • Mentor and support engineers. Raise the bar through thorough code review, constructive design feedback, and pairing, especially with junior and mid-level engineers.
  • Participate in on-call for the services you help build, and contribute to incident response and post-incident learning.
  • Contribute to open source. Tempo is OSS. You will engage the community, review external contributions, and contribute to the project in the open.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. This is a remote opportunity and we re interested in candidates based in the US or Canada. Residents of Quebec are not eligible for this role.

Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer, Grafana Data Source Plugins

The Opportunity:

As a Senior Full-Stack Engineer in the Grafana Data Source Plugins squad, you will take a leading role in developing and enhancing a diverse portfolio of data source plugins that retrieve the data powering Grafana dashboards used by teams worldwide. 

Our team focuses on continuously improving data source plugins, ensuring seamless experience for human and agent users alike. A key aspect of this role is guaranteeing the smooth operation and reliability of our plugins in the Grafana Cloud, helping us deliver on our commitment to world-class observability tools. 

What You’ll Be Doing: 

  • Some data source plugins we own: 
    • Prometheus, Loki, Infinity, MySQL, PostgreSQL, AWS Cloudwatch, and Clickhouse.  The full catalog is listed here.
  • A typical “day in the life” could include: 
    • Building or improving Grafana plugins to integrate third party services or databases into Grafana 
    • Supporting the operations and reliability of our plugins in Grafana Cloud
    • Coming up with suggestions for process improvements
    • Integrating data sources with agentic workflows such as Grafana Assistant
    • Providing technical support in customer escalations 
    • Working closely with the rest of the Grafana Division

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • You know how to transform ideas into working code, you are able to design a solution, get feedback and deliver large projects.
  • You are a self-driven individual who understands the power of feedback loops in making roadmap decisions and driving our product forward.
  • You are a motivated self starter with a bias towards action, and willing to take on any challenge
  • You are customer focused. We build everything with our users in mind. You have a passion for creating intuitive products that fit customers’ needs.
  • You are an excellent communicator and you enjoy collaboration
  • You are comfortable working in a remote-first company

Requirements:

  • Solid experience with Golang & Typescript
  • Experience with Kubernetes & microservices
  • Experience writing clean, robust, and performant software that is easily maintained by others
  • Experience participating in an on-call rotation and performing operations/SRE tasks

Bonus Points For:

  • You have been a user of Grafana and Grafana Data Sources
  • You have expertise in one of the underlying databases we support
  • You have strong experience working with a Product Manager or external stakeholders

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer I (Remote Eligible)
jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Are you looking to solve challenging engineering problems impacting Enterprise customers with 10,000+ employees? How about building a platform that contributes to mission-critical projects such as launching a rover to Mars, reducing carbon footprint by launching energy-efficient warehouses, launching critical life-saving medicines in International markets, or planning a brick-and-mortar store deployment?

The Smartsheet Portfolio Management Pillar is looking for curious and passionate Frontend and Fullstack Software Engineers. You will help us build enterprise-grade applications within the Portfolio Collaborative Work Management space, an area that grew 4x year-over-year. Our applications manages three areas that serve our customers: A feature-rich config management tool that allows power users the ability to create their business processes; A fast and reliable orchestration engine that runs millions of distributed transactions per day; A global management service that alters the attributes of Project assets and ensures the state of the Portfolio is running and updates are managed at-scale.

Our Engineering team members are passionate about working on multiple projects using several technologies. We are a self-operating service team and use a diverse set of Frontend (JavaScript, TypeScript, React), Backend (Ruby/Java), and Cloud-native services(AWS).

In 2005, Smartsheet was founded on the idea that teams and millions of people worldwide deserve a better way to deliver their very best work. Today, we deliver a leading cloud-based platform for work execution, empowering organizations to plan, capture, track, automate, and report on work at scale, resulting in more efficient processes and better business outcomes.

You will report to our Sr. Manager, Engineering, and may work remotely from anywhere in the US where Smartsheet is a registered employer.

You Will:

  • Design, implement, and deliver production complete solutions.
  • Promote best practices in Software development and Software methodologies.
  • Automate repetitive tasks to increase productivity and efficiency.
  • Contribute concise documentation.
  • Promote Agility as much as Reliability and Scalability.

You Have:

  • 5+ years of engineering experience in a team environment.
  • 3+ years of experience in service-oriented architecture, deployment systems, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Proficient in at least one high-level programming language, such as Ruby, Java, Go, Python, and TypeScript.
  • Experience with modern client JS libraries, like React, and Redux.
  • Experience in application migration patterns and tradeoff scenarios.
  • You have a knowledge of OOP and REST design principles.
  • Clear and objective writing and in-person communication.
  • Curiosity to learn new technologies and systems.
  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent practical experience.
  • Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis.

Current US Perks & Benefits:

  • Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
  • 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
  • Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
  • Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
  • US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
  • US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
  • Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
  • Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
  • Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
  • Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

$145,000—$210,000 USD

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. jobs.title: Director, Product Management - Data Transformation (Frontier Engineering)
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Data Transformation is the foundational product portfolio that makes enterprise Agentic AI possible. Our mission is to transform the full enterprise data estate. We build the product that guides customers through every layer of a modern AI architecture: from Platform Foundation & Migration, through Data Ingestion & Engineering, to Semantic, Context, Ontology, & Governance layers. By unlocking each layer, we enable customers to deploy Agentic AI with full, governed access to their complete Snowflake data estate. The Data Transformation workflows are some of the most complex enterprise challenges and the most impactful for our customers and for Snowflake.



FRONTIER ENGINEERING

Sitting within Snowflake’s Frontier Engineering organization—a specialized team of Engineers, Product Managers, Solutions Architects, and AI Experts—you will own Snowflake’s Data Transformation product portfolio. Your scope spans intelligent migration products that understand and rewrite legacy application logic, multi-source ingestion pipelines, legacy data warehouse modernization, ETL/ELT transformation, and data platform rationalization. In this role, you will set product vision, lead a team of PMs, and deliver the tooling that turns fragmented legacy infrastructure into an AI-first enterprise platform.



AS A DIRECTOR OF PRODUCT MANAGEMENT, YOU WILL:

 - Define Vision & Strategy: Own the strategic roadmap across the full transformation stack—from platform migration to semantic and context layers—ensuring every initiative moves enterprises closer to an AI-ready Snowflake platform.

 - Lead & Scale a High-Performing PM Team: Build, mentor, and manage a team of product managers, fostering a culture of high velocity, accountability, and technical rigor.

 - Partner with Engineering Leadership: Deeply engage with technical leaders to shape execution strategies, balancing engineering effort and long-term architectural scalability across complex pipeline and query transformation workloads.

 - Drive Execution with an MVP Mindset: Champion speed and clarity, setting precise roadmap milestones, prioritizing ruthlessly, and ensuring seamless cross-functional alignment.

 - Own GTM & Customer Adoption: Partner with Marketing, field teams, and executive customers to position transformation capabilities, accelerate migrations, and drive platform adoption.

 - Drive Thought Leadership: Serve as an external voice for Snowflake, helping shape the industry narrative around legacy modernization, automated pipeline refactoring, and AI-first data architecture.




OUR IDEAL DIRECTOR OF PRODUCT MANAGEMENT WILL HAVE:

 - 12+ Years in Data Infrastructure: Proven track record delivering enterprise-scale data platforms, migration tooling, query engines, or pipeline infrastructure.

 - Proven PM Leadership: Strong experience building, managing, and mentoring high-performing product management teams.

 - Deep Technical Foundation: Hands-on familiarity with modern data ecosystems—including SQL execution, ETL/ELT patterns, declarative pipelines, and workflow orchestration.

 - Applied GenAI Exposure: Practical understanding of AI-assisted capabilities, such as automated code translation, developer co-pilots, semantic validation, and LLM-driven refactoring.

 - Strategic & Analytical Execution: Ability to navigate technical ambiguity, make sound decisions using data and instincts, and reduce time-to-value for enterprise customers.

 - Executive Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex architectural capabilities into clear, compelling narratives for customers, field leadership, and executives.





Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact.
