At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.



We are hiring a Principal Software Engineer for our Anti-Abuse team. The Anti-Abuse team sits at the core of protecting Snowflake and our customers from abuse on the Snowflake Platform. We strive to see the complete picture, leading platform-wide abuse and fraud detection while designing and deploying proactive controls for Snowflake's highest-risk capabilities: Snowpark, Data Sharing, Cortex AI, and the next generation of cloud engineering challenges as Snowflake rapidly scales. In this role, you will be the lead technical architect responsible for defining and driving our technical strategy for abuse prevention, detection, and response across the entire Snowflake ecosystem.




AS A PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER, ANTI-ABUSE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

 - Define and drive the long-term technical vision for abuse and fraud detection across the Snowflake platform, serving as the chief architect for platform-wide anti-abuse strategy

 - Partner directly with product and engineering teams building Snowflake's newest and highest-risk surfaces (Snowpark user code execution runtimes, Data Sharing and Marketplace, AI/LLM services) to design and deploy robust anti-abuse controls from day one

 - Architect and scale high-throughput, low-latency telemetry pipelines and risk-scoring engines capable of analyzing millions of queries, sessions, and data transactions across multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP)

 - Continuously model emerging abuse techniques, including trial compute abuse, cryptocurrency mining, bot-driven account creation, credential stuffing, and illicit network traffic routing

 - Design intelligent mitigation systems that automatically throttle, challenge, or isolate abusive workloads and malicious actors with near-zero false-positive impact on legitimate enterprise workloads

 - Raise the technical bar across the engineering organization through mentorship of staff and senior engineers, and influence architectural standards across adjacent platform teams




OUR IDEAL PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER, ANTI-ABUSE WILL HAVE:

 - 12+ years of software engineering experience in distributed systems, cloud platform infrastructure, or security engineering, with significant time dedicated to anti-abuse, fraud detection, platform trust, or threat mitigation

 - Proven track record architecting mission-critical, large-scale distributed services in Java, C++, or Python

 - Deep experience designing controls for code-execution runtimes, multi-tenant compute environments, cloud APIs, or data platforms (e.g., mitigating compute hijacking, sandbox escapes, abuse of serverless functions, or network egress abuse)

 - Demonstrated ability to build streaming event processing, anomaly detection, behavioral heuristic engines, or graph-based syndicate detection systems at enterprise scale

 - Strong intuition for attacker economics and mechanics, with experience modeling threat vectors across account lifecycles (signup, trial, payment, execution, sharing)

 - Exceptional ability to partner with product managers, infrastructure teams, and security researchers to embed safety controls into high-velocity product roadmaps

 - B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or equivalent practical experience




BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

 - Experience building anti-abuse systems for multi-tenant cloud platforms or SaaS-at-scale environments

 - Familiarity with AI/LLM abuse vectors (prompt injection, model extraction, automated content generation for fraud)

 - Track record of designing zero-trust or defense-in-depth architectures for compute runtimes

 - Published research or industry contributions in fraud detection, adversarial ML, or platform trust and safety

 - Experience operating detection and response systems across multiple cloud providers simultaneously




WHY JOIN OUR ANTI-ABUSE TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

The Anti-Abuse team works at the intersection of platform security, distributed systems, and adversarial thinking. You will own the technical strategy for protecting one of the world's fastest-growing cloud platforms from novel and evolving threats. This is not a compliance checkbox role: you will architect real-time detection systems, embed native guardrails into new product primitives before they reach production, and partner directly with engineering leaders across the organization to anticipate threats no one else is seeing yet. If you want to build the immune system for the agentic enterprise, this is the role.



Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Developer Tools
jobs.description:
ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________



Docker is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to set the technical direction for key parts of our AI Developer Tools team. You will work at the intersection of AI, developer experience, and platform engineering, building the AI-powered tools and the platform that let teams across Docker prototype, deploy, and scale their own AI developer tools.

As a Staff Engineer you will own the technical design and delivery for two areas:

AI-Powered Developer Tools. Design and build AI agents and tools that accelerate developer productivity, surface observability insights, and automate operational reviews. You will help teams adopt an AI-native way of working and speed up adoption of tools such as Claude Code and Codex. Examples include AI-powered code review and refactoring assistants, automated test generators and local environment setup tools, deployment pipeline diagnostic agents, and agents that simplify on-call work during incidents.

Self-Service AI Developer Tools Platform. Design and build the platform infrastructure that lets product and platform teams across Docker unblock themselves by prototyping, building, and deploying their own AI developer tools. You will set the patterns and standards that let teams experiment, iterate quickly, and graduate successful prototypes into production-ready services.

You will report to the Senior Manager, AI Developer Tools, and work closely with the team's Principal engineers, engineering leadership, product engineering teams, and platform teams across Docker.




WHAT WOULD MAKE SOMEONE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE

You are a hands-on technical leader who works well at the intersection of AI, developer experience, and platform engineering. You have shipped production systems built on LLMs and AI agents, and you can explain what worked and what did not. You think in platforms: you design something once so that several teams can move faster. You have clear opinions about what makes a developer tool good, and sound judgment about when to build, when to integrate, and when not to do either. You are comfortable in a fast-moving AI landscape and balance technical quality with shipping iteratively. Before you design, you ask about scale, users, and constraints rather than assuming them. You lead through influence and mentorship, and the engineers around you get better because you are on the team.




RESPONSIBILITIES

Technical Leadership and Architecture

 - Set technical direction and own the architecture for AI-powered developer tools and the self-service platform within the team's roadmap

 - Turn ambiguous problems into clear requirements, plans, and staged decisions. Ask about scale, users, and constraints before designing, and write down your assumptions

 - Establish patterns, standards, and best practices for LLM integration, agent development, and production AI systems that the team and partner teams adopt

 - Shape platform capabilities including deployment frameworks (ArgoCD/GitOps), observability integration (Grafana), security controls, and operational tooling for AI developer tools

 - Design reliable, scalable infrastructure for hosting AI agents and developer tools

 - Recommend AI technology choices, LLM provider strategies, and agent orchestration approaches, and make the trade-offs explicit

 - Work with the Senior Manager and the team's Principal engineers to align technical decisions with business goals

Systems Design and Implementation

 - Design, build, and operate production AI agents for developer productivity, including code review assistants, test generators, deployment diagnostics, and incident response automation

 - Build self-service platform capabilities that reduce time-to-production for new AI tools from weeks to days

 - Build systems that speed up adoption of AI-native development tools (Claude Code, Codex) across Docker's engineering organization

 - Set and meet reliability, security, and performance standards for AI systems, including SLOs, monitoring, incident response, and cost management

 - Design integrations between AI developer tools and existing developer infrastructure such as CI/CD pipelines, observability platforms, and deployment systems

 - Take part in the team's on-call rotation and use what you learn to improve alerts, runbooks, and tooling

Strategic Impact and Innovation

 - Evaluate emerging AI/LLM technologies, developer tooling trends, and agent frameworks, and recommend what Docker should adopt and what it should not build

 - Define how we measure AI tool effectiveness, including adoption, productivity gains, and developer satisfaction

 - Improve AI tool performance, cost efficiency, and developer experience through architectural improvements

 - Contribute to the technical approach for hardening proven internal tools so other teams across Docker can adopt them

 - Lead cross-team technical delivery, surface risks early, and work with Infrastructure, Security, and Data on shared standards

Leadership and Mentorship

 - Mentor senior engineers on AI/LLM integration patterns, agent development, and platform engineering practices

 - Lead design reviews and raise the quality of design and code reviews across the team

jobs.title: Engineering Lead, Growth
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

Growth Engineering at Airwallex is building an AI-native platform that powers customer acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, and expansion. We're developing scalable infrastructure, intelligent decision systems, and automation capabilities that connect product, sales, and marketing to drive measurable business outcomes.

As an Engineering Lead, you'll lead a team of engineers to design, build, and scale the platforms and experiences that power Growth at Airwallex. You'll combine technical leadership, hands-on problem-solving, and strong execution to turn ambitious growth opportunities into reliable products and measurable business impact.

 - Lead engineering execution, owning the delivery of complex Growth initiatives from technical planning and architecture through implementation, launch, and continuous improvement.

 - Drive technical direction, guiding the design of scalable backend services, frontend applications, event-driven systems, and AI-native platform capabilities that enable experimentation, personalization, and growth automation.

 - Build and develop a high-performing engineering team, providing technical mentorship, coaching, clear expectations, and a culture of ownership, collaboration, and engineering excellence.

 - Partner across functions, working closely with Product, Design, Data Science, Marketing, Sales, and other engineering teams to translate ambiguous business problems into actionable roadmaps and technical solutions.

 - Drive measurable business outcomes, leveraging experimentation, customer insights, and data to prioritize high-impact opportunities, accelerate iteration, and improve growth performance.

 - Raise the engineering bar, establishing strong practices for system design, code quality, performance, reliability, security, observability, and operational excellence.
   
   

US: You'll work from our San Francisco office three days a week.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


ESSENTIALS

 - 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including experience leading engineering teams or complex technical initiatives, and a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

 - Strong technical expertise in backend, frontend, or full-stack engineering, with experience designing, building, and operating scalable production systems using technologies such as Python, Java/Kotlin, React, or TypeScript.

 - Proven technical leadership and execution skills, with a track record of leading complex engineering projects, making sound architectural decisions, managing technical tradeoffs, and delivering high-quality solutions.

 - Demonstrated ability to lead and develop engineers, through mentorship, technical guidance, effective delegation, and fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

 - Strong ownership, product judgment, and cross-functional collaboration, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, influence stakeholders, prioritize effectively, and translate business objectives into measurable engineering outcomes.


PREFERRED

 - Experience building growth platforms, experimentation systems, customer segmentation engines, marketing automation, or product-led growth experiences.

 - Experience developing AI-powered applications or agentic workflows, including LLM integration, tool orchestration, evaluation, and production observability.

 - Experience with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure such as AWS or GCP.

 - Experience leading cross-functional engineering initiatives involving Product, Design, Data Science, Marketing, Sales, or Revenue Operations.

 - Experience establishing engineering processes, improving delivery predictability, and scaling team execution in fast-moving environments.

 - Experience in high-growth technology companies, fintech, payments, or regulated environments.
   
   


YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You have high agency and ownership. You proactively identify high-impact opportunities, take accountability for outcomes, and empower your team to deliver.

 - You're a technical leader who builds. You stay close to architecture and implementation, make sound technical decisions, and lead by example.

 - You're pragmatic and outcome-oriented. You balance engineering quality, delivery speed, and business impact, prioritizing what moves the needle.

jobs.title: Client Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

OpenAI’s Client Platform Engineering team builds and operates the platforms that make employee devices secure, reliable, and easy to use. Our work spans device posture and trust, onboarding, application delivery, operating-system updates, fleet telemetry, and employee-facing remediation. We partner with Security, IT, Research, Applied, and specialized engineering teams to reduce friction while protecting OpenAI’s systems and data.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Client Platform Engineer, You will build and own agentic solutions that automate OAI fleet operations and reduce employee friction, with measurable outcomes and reliability. You will develop first-party software, integrate commercial and open-source tools, and own changes from design and testing through deployment and production operations. Your work will improve security, reliability, and the employee experience.

We’re looking for people who are passionate about automation, endpoint security, and building scalable solutions that improve employee experience. You should have deep experience securing and managing Linux fleets at scale, with strong software engineering skills to automate security controls and fleet operations across environments with different compliance requirements. Your problem-solving mindset and attention to detail will be key to success in this role.

In this role, you will:

Build the platforms that help employees do their best work on devices they can trust.

 - Own the design, development, deployment, and operation of secure Linux endpoint management systems across environments with different compliance requirements.

 - Create magical employee experiences by building agentic workflows with OpenAI products and models that use fleet telemetry to anticipate issues, guide remediation, and design friction out of everyday work.

 - Make new hires productive from day one, using OpenAI products to simplify device setup, software delivery, and onboarding support.

 - Build secure, reliable workflows with scoped access, human review for sensitive changes, traceable actions, and tested recovery.

 - Partner with IT, Security, Research, and Engineering to deliver consistent Linux provisioning, updates, and support alongside macOS and Windows.

 - Develop first-party software and integrate commercial and open-source tools for software packaging, deployment, and application management.

 - Manage fleet configuration as code through GitOps, version control, peer review, and automated validation.

 - Build and operate CI/CD pipelines for fleet infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and GCP, with staged deployments and tested rollback.

 - Use fleet telemetry to proactively improve performance and reliability, detect configuration drift, and verify deployment outcomes.

 - Participate in engineering on-call, own incident resolution, and turn operational lessons into lasting improvements that reduce recurring failures and manual work.


YOU MAY BE A FIT FOR THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE: 

 - Proficiency in Python, Go, or another modern programming language.

 - Deep experience securing and managing Linux fleets with configuration management, MDM, device enrollment, policy enforcement, and cloud identity integration.

 - Demonstrated success with open-source endpoint tools for configuration, device and application management, and telemetry.

 - Experience delivering secure, reliable, scalable systems across different compliance requirements.

 - Deep experience managing infrastructure at scale with IaC and GitOps, using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, and Chef.

 - Experience integrating and operating fleet infrastructure with CI/CD and DevOps workflows.

 - A track record of deploying and operating fleet infrastructure in public cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).

 - Initiative, analytical judgment, and the ability to turn problems into practical improvements.


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE:

 - Deep experience with open-source fleet management tools and frameworks.

 - Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

 - Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, and NIST.

 - Strong soft skills, including stakeholder communication and cross-functional collaboration.

 - Relevant professional certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, CCSP.

 - A security thought leader with contributions to CPE open-source projects or technical communities.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

Help us build the next generation of authentication services at GitLab. As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Authentication team, you ll build authentication features across the Rails monolith and GATE. GATE is our new service for issuing and validating tokens and managing identities, designed to support every GitLab deployment model.

You ll expand authentication mechanisms, including support for identities used by artificial intelligence (AI) agents. You ll also help keep GitLab and its customers secure by building access management tooling and addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.

GATE will become the foundation for token issuance, validation, and identity services across GitLab.com multi-tenant software as a service (SaaS), Self-Managed, Dedicated, and air-gapped environments. Your work will affect core components that customers, users, and GitLab teams rely on.

Some of our projects include:

  • Building GATE as the centralized service for token issuance and validation
  • Consolidating tokens and migrating authentication paths out of the Rails monolith
  • Building passkeys and passwordless authentication
  • Developing composite identities that combine machine and human authorization for AI
  • Improving service accounts and secure automation
  • Enhancing Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) capabilities for automated user provisioning and single sign-on (SSO)

What you ll do

  • Shape the roadmap for GATE and GitLab s authentication services with the team.
  • Design and implement token issuance, validation, and identity services in Go and Ruby across the Rails monolith and GATE, including new authentication mechanisms such as Workload Identity Federation.
  • Migrate authentication and token management paths from the monolith into GATE while maintaining reliability across all deployment models.
  • Build authentication mechanisms from the ground up, such as Workload Identity Federation.
  • Strengthen security for users and organizations through access management tooling and by addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.
  • Define and improve standards for style, maintainability, and engineering practices in a high-scale environment, and advocate for them through code review.
  • Communicate publicly about GitLab initiatives, projects, and contributions from people not working for GitLab Inc. Reflect GitLab s values in these communications.
  • Ship moderately sized features and improvements with moderate guidance and support from other team members, and collaborate on larger projects, including the build-out of GATE.
  • Participate in the maintainer trainee program at your own comfortable pace while working toward becoming a project maintainer.

What you ll bring

  • Professional experience with Go and/or Ruby in scaling or mission-critical SaaS products.
  • Familiarity with authentication and authorization technologies or techniques, such as OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SSO, SCIM, LDAP, JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), role-based access control (RBAC), or identity and access management (IAM).
  • Knowledge of token systems, cryptographic signing, and key management.
  • Experience building or contributing to a service from concept to production, including proposal, discussion, and execution.
  • Proficiency in written and verbal English, with the ability to communicate complex problems and solutions clearly in a remote, largely asynchronous work environment.
  • Experience diagnosing, preventing, and resolving performance and optimization problems.
  • Experience working in an iterative software development process, managing your work effectively, staying organized, and following through on priorities.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We re all in on this mission. If you are too, let s talk.

The Principal Software Engineer Opportunity

The team that built Jeeva AI is building Digital Workers, a new suite of autonomous agents for identity operations and security inside Okta. The team works directly with Todd McKinnon, Okta s co-founder and CEO, with the opportunity to bring this product to Okta s 20,000+ customers. You will help shape the product with the ownership and pace of a startup and the resources of a public company.

You will build the harnesses and evaluations that make these workers reliable. They investigate risk, use tools, wait for approvals and complete tasks across enterprise systems. Bring depth in agent execution or model quality and help turn it into working software customers can trust.

About You

Production builder: You have shipped AI software and know what changes when real users depend on it.

Careful evaluator: You investigate failures and use evidence to judge quality.

Strong owner: You follow an improvement through code, evaluation, release and customer use.

What you will be doing

  • Build the agent harness for planning, tool use, memory, context compaction, interruption and recovery during long-running work.
  • Integrate OpenAI and Anthropic model APIs. Select models using measured quality, latency and cost, with clear failure handling.
  • Evaluate existing harnesses and build only the missing pieces. Keep the harness connected to AWS workflow execution and approval state.
  • Keep authorization and sensitive writes behind application policy checks. Require evidence of the resulting state before marking work complete.
  • Build evaluation datasets and replay tests for valid findings, access decisions, app setup and AI agent onboarding.
  • Measure false positives, missed risks, unsafe actions, completion rate and cost. Turn production failures into regression tests.
  • Test prompt injection, stale evidence, conflicting instructions and unsafe tool use. Protect tenant boundaries in retrieval and memory.
  • Improve prompts, retrieval, tools and model routing. Evaluate fine-tuning or other post-training methods when results justify them and data use is approved.

What you will bring to the role

  • Strong Python engineering skills and experience shipping an LLM application that uses tools.
  • Hands-on experience building agent workflows or evaluation systems for tool-using LLM applications. For harness work, relevant experience includes Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Codex SDK, Strands Agents, LangChain Deep Agents, LangGraph or a custom implementation.
  • Experience integrating model APIs, structured outputs and asynchronous services. Experience with OpenAI or Anthropic is especially relevant.
  • Depth in agent execution or evaluation systems, with working code and failure analysis you can explain.
  • Ability to distinguish a plausible model response from a supported finding or verified action.

Scope by level

Principal: Set product engineering direction across workflows and implement the shared components that help the team ship faster.

Our stack

Our core stack is Python FastAPI, AWS Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, PostgreSQL on Amazon RDS and pgvector. OpenAI and Anthropic model APIs are part of the integration plan.

We plan to add an agent harness and a dedicated analytics layer using ClickHouse or BigQuery. The harness choice is open. Experience with equivalent tools also counts.

And extra credit for

  • Open-source contributions, agent observability, security evaluations or synthetic evaluation data.
  • Fine-tuning, preference data, post-training evaluation or model distillation using approved datasets.
  • Identity and security workflows. Foundation-model research experience is optional.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Alloy Integrations
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

In this role, you d be joining the Alloy Integrations team. We own how Metronome s customers collect payments and recognize revenue. We build and run the integrations that connect Metronome s usage-based billing platform to the systems businesses depend on to get paid: Stripe invoicing and payments, cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud), ERP systems like NetSuite and QuickBooks, and CRM systems like Salesforce. We also bring Stripe products such as Checkout into Metronome, so customers can move from contract to cash in one place.

Our team helps Stripe increase the GDP of the internet by making sure every invoice reaches the right system and every payment is collected and accounted for correctly, at scale. We focus on two areas:

  • Invoicing: collection, dunning, and invoice delivery
  • Quote-to-cash automation: connecting the full journey from a signed deal to recognized revenue

What you ll do

You ll build and operate distributed systems that move billing data between Metronome and the platforms our customers use to run their finances. The work combines product engineering and reliability. You ll ship features that customers ask for directly, and you ll strengthen the event-driven pipelines that handle large invoicing spikes every month-end.

You ll work closely with our product manager, with partner engineering teams that own contracts, usage rating, and invoice finalization, with solutions architects who build ERP integrations with customers, and with technical support engineers who work with customers every day. In your first few months, you ll ship a customer-facing improvement to one of our integrations, join the on-call rotation, and take ownership of one of our core systems.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain integrations between Metronome and external billing, payments, marketplace, ERP, and CRM platforms
  • Build reliable, event-driven systems for invoice delivery, payment workflows, and status sync, with safe retries, rollbacks, and reconciliation
  • Ship features that help customers control how they invoice, collect, and account for revenue, from design through launch
  • Improve observability and automated repair across our systems so problems are caught and fixed before customers notice them
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and lead incident response, root-cause analysis, and follow-up work for the systems the team owns
  • Plan and carry out migrations and changes to existing integrations without disrupting customer billing
  • Partner with product, support, solutions architecture, and other engineering teams to scope work and represent customer needs

Who you are

We re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • This is a Staff level role, so we typically target 10+ years of professional experience building and operating backend systems in production
  • Experience designing and integrating with third-party APIs, including handling failures, retries, and data consistency across systems
  • Experience with distributed or event-driven systems, such as message queues, streams, or workflow engines
  • Experience owning services in production, including monitoring, on-call, and incident response
  • Ability to communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to engineers and to people outside engineering

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with billing, invoicing, payments, tax, or other financial systems where correctness matters
  • Experience with AWS serverless and data services such as Lambda, Kinesis, SQS, or Step Functions
  • Familiarity with ERP or CRM platforms such as NetSuite, QuickBooks, or Salesforce, or with cloud marketplace billing
  • Experience with GraphQL APIs and relational databases such as Postgres
  • Experience leading cross-team projects or large migrations

You ll make key technical decisions, drive platform reliability and scalability improvements, and lead cross-functional initiatives that directly impact how millions of customers move money on Coinbase.

At Gusto, we re on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer to join our People Technology team as the dedicated architect and hands on engineer behind PeopleOS — our AI-native internal HR platform — and the broader suite of custom tools and integrations that power our People tech ecosystem. In this role, you will design, build, and ship software that directly shapes how every Gustie experiences HR, from recruiting and onboarding to performance and offboarding.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on full-stack engineer and problem solver who thrives in ambiguity, cares about the employee experience, and wants to see their work used every day by real people.

About the Team:

The People Solutions team is transforming how Gusto supports its people by pairing cutting-edge AI with smart automation. We build — not just configure — the systems that power People programs and processes. We optimize workflows, enhance service delivery, and free up teams to focus on meaningful, high-impact work to support a more responsive, efficient, and future-ready people experience.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

Product Engineering — PeopleOS

  • Be the technical owner for PeopleOS, our internal AI-powered HR platform that was built with the purpose of enhanced Gustie experiences for people programs and a more efficient People team with features like the Offer Workflow Engine, People Home Base portal, Celebration tools, and automated Talk Track generation
  • Partner directly with People Ops stakeholders to translate workflows into working software driving technical design, implementation, UAT support, and release

Integration & Systems Development

  • Design, build, test, and maintain integrations across Workday, Greenhouse, Lattice, Slack, and Google Workspace
  • Build and maintain custom MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that give AI agents structured access to People Systems data where no native tool MCP exists

AI-Powered Tooling

  • Integrate the Anthropic API (Claude) to build intelligent internal tools including QPR coaching agents, HR front door chatbots, and ticket deflection workflows
  • Design prompts, handle structured outputs, and build safe, reliable AI-assisted workflows for People Ops use cases

Collaboration & Quality

  • Document integration specs, data mappings, and system configurations in Notion
  • Participate in Jira sprint planning and demo work to stakeholders bi-weekly
  • Troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and proactively implement corrective actions across the portfolio

Here’s what we re looking for:

  • 7+ years of full-stack software engineering experience, with production-quality work in Python, TypeScript/Node.js, or both
  • Strong experience building and consuming REST APIs — including OAuth flows, rate limiting, pagination, and error handling
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate SaaS platforms (bonus: Workday, Greenhouse, Slack, or Google Workspace)
  • Comfort with AI/LLM API integration — Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or equivalent — including prompt design and response parsing
  • Experience shipping internal tools or developer tooling with real end users and feedback loops
  • Strong written communication: you can document your own APIs, write a clear tech spec, and explain trade-offs to non-engineers
  • An understanding of sensitivity of HR data and familiarity with implications of labor law and data retention guidelines

Preferred

  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) server architecture
  • Experience with HR Tech ecosystems: HRIS, ATS, LMS platforms
  • Background in People Ops, HR Systems, or internal tools engineering at a high-growth tech company
  • Experience with XML, XSLT, JSON, and related integration technologies

To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.


ABOUT SNOWFLAKE

Snowflake is building the AI Data Cloud, enabling organizations around the world to mobilize data and develop applications at global scale. The Engineering Systems organization builds the infrastructure, tools, and platforms that help Snowflake engineers develop, test, and deliver high-quality software efficiently.

The Continuous Integration team is responsible for the systems that power builds, tests, validation, and developer workflows across Snowflake’s engineering organization. As a Staff Software Engineer on this team, you will help define the technical direction of critical CI infrastructure used by thousands of engineers across a rapidly growing, multi-cloud codebase.


AS A STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER, YOU WILL

 - Lead the development of CI capabilities that improve build reliability, test execution, developer productivity, and release velocity.

 - Partner with engineering leadership, product managers, and teams across Snowflake to define quarterly and long-term technical roadmaps.

 - Drive architectural decisions across build systems, test orchestration, resource scheduling, workflow execution, and developer tooling.

 - Identify systemic bottlenecks in the software delivery lifecycle and develop solutions that improve engineering efficiency at scale.

 - Establish high standards for design, code quality, testing, observability, reliability, and operational readiness.

 - Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative problem-solving.

 - Lead complex projects involving multiple teams and cross-functional dependencies.

 - Participate in incident response, root-cause analysis, and long-term reliability improvements.

 - Evaluate emerging technologies and industry practices to keep Snowflake’s developer platform scalable and effective.


OUR IDEAL STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE

 - 7+ years of industry experience designing and building production software systems.

 - A track record of technical leadership across complex, multi-team engineering initiatives.

 - Deep experience designing and operating distributed systems at scale.

 - Experience building or significantly evolving enterprise-grade Continuous Integration or Continuous Delivery systems.

 - Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and systems design.

 - Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, C++, Python, or Go.

 - Experience making architectural decisions involving scalability, reliability, performance, security, and maintainability.

 - A strong understanding of developer productivity and the software development lifecycle.

 - Excellent problem-solving skills and sound technical judgment.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly.

 - A collaborative mindset and a demonstrated ability to mentor and influence engineers across teams.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience with CI/CD and build systems such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bazel, ArgoCD, or comparable platforms.

 - Experience with build optimization, caching, parallel execution, incremental builds, or distributed test scheduling.

 - Experience designing multi-tenant systems with strong isolation, reliability, performance, and security requirements.

 - Experience with Kubernetes, containers, or public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

 - Experience operating large-scale developer platforms or engineering infrastructure.

 - Experience with observability, monitoring, alerting, and production operations.

 - Experience authoring technical roadmaps, architecture documents, project plans, postmortems, and root-cause analyses.

 - Experience working with data systems, distributed storage, or cloud-based services.

 - A history of improving engineering practices and multiplying the effectiveness of teams.

 - Solve challenging distributed systems and developer productivity problems at significant scale.

 - Help improve the speed, reliability, and quality of software delivery across Snowflake.

 - Work with experienced engineers across a multi-cloud data platform.

 - Influence the technical direction of critical engineering infrastructure.

 - Grow your impact through architecture, mentorship, and cross-team technical leadership.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Gateway
jobs.description:
ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________



Docker AI Gateway is our answer to the complexity of taking AI agents from prototype to production. It’s a powerful, intelligent, and secure control point that eliminates the toil of model orchestration, tool management, observability, and governance—so developers can focus on building incredible AI agents, not gluing together infrastructure.

The Gateway sits at the center of modern AI applications, offering:

 - A model and tool routing layer with built-in security and cost optimization

 - A familiar OpenAI-compatible interface and MCP server

 - Unified observability and policy enforcement

 - Auto-RAG, tool injection, session summarization, and more

We’re just getting started—and we need exceptional engineers to help us build the backbone of the future of agent-based development.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design and implement core systems powering the AI Gateway, including the model router, MCP gateway, and control plane

 - Build infrastructure that supports dynamic model selection/routing, auto-failover, cost-based routing, and policy enforcement

 - Own critical capabilities such as secure credential storage, session summarization, caching, and rate limiting

 - Develop APIs for developers building with OpenAI-compatible interfaces and the Model Context Protocol

 - Build the underlying infrastructure to support evaluation, telemetry, replay, and backtesting for agents and LLM workflows

 - Lead architectural decisions and mentor engineers as the team scales

 - Performance tuning - caching, session summarization, and rate limiting that keep the gateway fast under real production load

 - Contribute to roadmap planning, technical strategy, and cross-functional alignment




KEY PROBLEMS YOU’LL HELP SOLVE

 - Building a unified abstraction over fundamentally different model and tool providers without leaking their differences into the developer experience

 - Making credential and identity handling for tool access both airtight and fast

 - Giving developers real-time and historical visibility into what their agents are doing, with policy enforcement that can't be bypassed

 - Keeping latency low and reliability high as traffic scales from early adopters to production fleets




WHO YOU ARE

Required Qualifications:

 - 6+ years of backend engineering experience with production-grade systems

 - Deep knowledge of distributed and highly scalable systems, cloud-native infrastructure, and API design

 - Experience building secure, high-throughput services (e.g., gateways, proxies, load balancers, policy engines)

 - Fluency in Go, and/or Rust (both preferred)

 - Familiarity with AI/ML platforms or model serving infrastructure

 - A strong product mindset—you're excited about building developer-facing tools

 - Ownership mentality with a bias for shipping, learning, and iterating

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Bonus Qualifications:

 - Prior experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar LLM APIs

 - Familiarity with RAG architectures, vector databases, or agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGPT, CrewAI)

 - Experience with policy engines (e.g., OPA), observability frameworks (e.g., OpenTelemetry), or API gateways

 - Understanding of OAuth2.1, secret management, and cloud IAM systems

 - Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and microservices architecture




WHY JOIN US?

 - Work on what’s next: The agent era is just beginning. Help define the infrastructure stack for the next generation of software.

 - Own mission-critical infrastructure: Be part of a small team building the backbone of secure, intelligent agent applications.

 - Impact at scale: Your work will touch tens of thousands of developers building AI-first applications.

 - Engineering excellence: Join a world-class engineering team that values simplicity, code quality, and deep technical thinking.

 - Remote-first culture: Work from anywhere with a team that trusts and empowers you.



Docker considers visa sponsorship on a case-by-case basis based on business needs.

 

Compensation & Equity

United States: $160,900 – $260,700 + equity

______________________________________________________________________




POSTING INFORMATION

 - Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.

 - AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.

 - Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

______________________________________________________________________




PERKS & BENEFITS

 - Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.

 - Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.

 - Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.

 - Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.

 - Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.

 - Act as the go-to expert for secure credential storage, session summarization, caching, and rate limiting - the capabilities everything else depends on

 - Build the infrastructure that lets us, and our customers, evaluate, replay, and backtest agent and LLM behavior with confidence

 - Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, and raise the technical bar for the team through code, design review, and example

 - Partner with product, design, and leadership to shape not just what the control plane UI does, but where the product goes next




KEY PROBLEMS YOU’LL HELP SOLVE

 - Define the unified abstraction layer across diverse model and tool providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, AWS Bedrock) that the rest of the org builds on

 - Architect secure, scalable identity and credential vaulting for tool and model access, trusted enough to run at enterprise scale

 - Build the infrastructure for real-time and historical analytics of AI agent behavior that leadership and customers both rely on

 - Guarantee that policy enforcement and logging work end-to-end - from prompt to tool to response - with no gaps an auditor (or attacker) could find

 - Set the bar for developer experience through intuitive APIs and first-class observability




WHO YOU ARE

Required Qualifications

 - 8+ years of backend engineering experience, with a track record of owning production-grade systems at significant scale

 - Deep specialization in distributed systems, cloud-native infrastructure, and API design - recognized by peers and cross-functional partners as a go-to expert, not just experienced

 - Experience building secure, high-throughput services (gateways, proxies, load balancers, policy engines), and a history of making judgment calls other engineers rely on

 - Fluency in Go and/or Rust

 - A track record of identifying systemic gaps - in architecture, process, or tooling-— and driving the fix across team boundaries, not just within your own

 - A strong product mindset, with real experience shaping technical direction rather than only executing against it

 - Comfortable operating with wide latitude: given a problem and significant autonomy in how to solve it, including when and who to pull in

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience




BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

 - Prior experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar LLM APIs

 - Familiarity with RAG architectures, vector databases, or agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGPT, CrewAI)

 - Experience with policy engines (e.g., OPA), observability frameworks (e.g., OpenTelemetry), or API gateways

 - Understanding of OAuth 2.1, secret management, and cloud IAM systems

 - Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and microservices architecture

 - A track record of setting technical standards that other teams or engineers went on to adopt
   
   


WHY JOIN US?

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Agentic AI
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

You’ll design and deploy intelligent systems that automate complex, multi-step financial workflows. You’ll turn agentic frameworks, orchestration layers, and pragmatic model selection into reliable production systems at scale.

 - Architect intelligent systems that automate complex, multi-step financial workflows

 - Apply prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, fine-tuning, or training models from scratch as appropriate to the problem

 - Design and optimize agent architectures for reasoning, tool use, and workflow automation

 - Build systems that improve with usage and create compounding AI flywheels

 - Partner with backend and frontend engineers to integrate AI reasoning into secure, production systems

You’ll work from our San Francisco office three days a week.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


ESSENTIALS

 - 5+ years of experience in applied AI/ML engineering, including production deployments

 - Strong Python skills and experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow

 - A track record of building and deploying AI agents, orchestration frameworks, or multi-step reasoning systems

 - Experience designing monitoring, evaluation, and iteration practices for production AI systems

 - Ability to balance innovation with reliability, scalability, and compliance




PREFERRED

 - Experience architecting and deploying intelligent systems that automate complex, multi-step financial workflows

 - Experience using agentic frameworks, orchestration layers, and pragmatic model selection to build production systems

 - Experience designing AI systems for reasoning, tool use, and workflow automation

 - Experience building systems that improve with usage and create compounding AI flywheels

 - Experience partnering with backend and frontend engineers to integrate AI reasoning into secure, production systems




YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

 - You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

 - You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching. Quality and accountability aren't external expectations, they're internal ones.

 - You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

 - You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.




LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

T:0's mission is to make finance run itself. We're building an AI-native accounting platform that closes the books, reconciles, and reports continuously, so founders can stop managing their finances and start using them to run the business. The hard part isn't adding AI to accounting. It's making AI you can trust with the books. We use AI to understand how a business works, then run the actual accounting on strict, checkable rules, and no black box deciding the numbers. That's why customers pick us over both the legacy tools they've outgrown and the AI wrappers they don't trust. And bookkeeping is just the start: we're building toward a full financial operating system for how companies account, plan, and operate. The team is small, elite, and builder-focused, led by operators with a track record of shipping AI products at scale. We sit inside Airwallex, which means startup speed with a scaled company's infrastructure, distribution, and capital behind us. You'll work directly from real customer pain, own outcomes end to end, and ship fast.




APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer (Back-End), Inference
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!


WHY THIS ROLE?

This role is for a highly experienced Back-End Software Engineer who wants to work on core systems that shape how the platform (Model Vault) operates. You will help define the architecture of the platform where reliability, security, performance, and simplicity all matter, and where many of the problems do not have off-the-shelf solutions.

Model Vault is Cohere’s inference platform for deploying and operating models securely at enterprise scale. The team owns the systems between a customer and the underlying AI infrastructure, including identity, deployments, metering, billing, security, privacy, and confidential computing. We are strengthening these systems as Model Vault grows, with the goal of scaling to millions of users and supporting some of the world’s most demanding enterprise workloads.



AS A SENIOR/STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER, YOU WILL:

 - Evolve and scale the backend systems that power Model Vault, including authentication and authorization, deployment management, billing, metering, and customer lifecycle.

 - Lead major architectural initiatives across identity, payments, usage systems, platform scalability, and other core product foundations.

 - Build highly reliable control-plane services for provisioning, configuring, scaling, and operating model deployments across clouds and hardware platforms.

 - Design APIs and distributed systems with strong guarantees around correctness, consistency, isolation, failure recovery, idempotency, and observability.

 - Build security and privacy into the platform architecture, including tenant isolation, least-privilege access, auditability, secrets management, encryption, and confidential computing boundaries.

 - Solve complex problems that span backend systems, cloud infrastructure, security, and AI inference, where conventional SaaS patterns are often not enough.

 - Drive projects end-to-end, from architecture and threat modeling through implementation, rollout, production operations, and iteration based on real customer workloads.


YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF:

 - You are a strong backend engineer with excellent fundamentals in distributed systems, databases, networking, operating systems, and security.

 - You have strong programming fundamentals and experience building production systems in languages such as Go, Python, Java, C++, Rust, or similar. You write clean, maintainable, well-tested code and make thoughtful tradeoffs between simplicity, performance, and correctness.

 - You have designed and operated production systems where correctness, availability, security, and performance mattered at significant scale.

 - You can take ambiguous, high-impact technical problems, define the right architecture, and drive them through to reliable production systems.

 - You have strong systems-design instincts and understand concepts such as concurrency, consistency, caching, queues, rate limiting, backpressure, failure domains, idempotency, and graceful degradation.

 - You think deeply about security boundaries and understand authentication, authorization, identity, cryptography, secrets, tenant isolation, and how small implementation choices can create significant security risks.

 - You are comfortable reasoning across backend services, APIs, databases, distributed systems, and the cloud infrastructure they run on.

 - You are comfortable diving into unfamiliar codebases and debugging complex problems that cross service or system boundaries.

 - You care about the details of production engineering, including instrumentation, capacity planning, migrations, backwards compatibility, incident response, and safe rollouts.

 - You are comfortable challenging existing architecture and evolving foundational components when the system’s needs change.

 - You have a track record of taking technically difficult projects from an unclear starting point to systems that other engineers and customers depend on.




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer, Partner | US | Remote
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

Grafana Labs is seeking a Senior Partner Solutions Engineer to join its high growth startup environment and help scale cloud partnerships, with a dedicated focus on joint go to market activities with Cloud Service Providers (CSP) including Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud (GCP). The successful candidate will be instrumental in enabling partner success through education, enablement, direct engagement, support of events, and build content that helps our CSP’s position and demonstrate Grafana capabilities.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Partnering with Channel Sales and Field Sales to convey Grafana’s vision, value, and technical strategy to cloud partners
  • Leading technical engagement with partners to drive deal progression and close opportunities
  • Delivering product demos, technical presentations, and hands-on enablement sessions
  • Develop and deliver training, onboarding, and ongoing education for solutions architects, and technical teams
  • Represent Grafana Labs through technical presentations, live demos, webinars, conference sessions, and regional partner events
  • Create reference architectures, demo environments, solution guides, and presentations that explain the value of Grafana Cloud alongside cloud provider services.
  • Track partner readiness, reuse of technical assets, and progress of joint opportunities, and bring partner insights back to product and GTM teams
  • Shaping and expanding the reach of Grafana Partner University across multiple partner personas
  • Collaborating with internal teams to provide product and competitive feedback
  • Support selling motions like Sell-To, Embedded, and PoweredBy, either directly or jointly with partners
  • Run high impact workshops and 1:1 training to generate and progress pipeline
  • Travelling up to 50% to support cloud partner events, workshops, and field activities

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Located: United States (Remote)
  • 6+ years in pre-sales or solution architecture, ideally within the observability space
  • Strong experience selling SaaS software across the NORAM region
  • Proven use of MEDDIC or similar qualification frameworks
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, especially in remote, global teams
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in a fast-paced, ambiguous, startup environment
  • Strong judgement, leadership, and problem-solving abilities
  • Passion for education, enablement, and helping others succeed technically

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience with CSP’s and a strong understanding of their core infrastructure services.
  • Experience with cloud marketplaces, co-selling, or joint solution launches.
  • Solid understanding of observability and cloud native tooling
  • Background in OSS first companies
  • Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, and Loki
  • Hands-on experience deploying and operating Kubernetes
  • Bachelor’s degree in CS, IT, Math, or related field (or equivalent experience)

Compensation & Rewards:

In the United States, the OTE (On-Target Earnings) compensation range for this role is $204,000 - $244,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

jobs.title: Manager, Software Engineering (Loans Lifecycle)
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Ledger Engineering team enables rapid financial product innovation by providing an audit-grade ledger platform that ties ambitious company growth to a highly regulated industry s real-world accounting controls. We are passionate about building robust, fault-tolerant, highly scalable systems that enable us to be on-time and precisely accurate in every financial interaction we have both with our consumers and institutional finance partners.

Ledger Engineering works with our finance partners to support everything from closing our monthly books to annual audits. We bridge the technical gap between data, strategy, and the thorough level of accounting detail required to operate a publicly-traded company. Outside of accounting, we partner with the Capital Markets team to help open our business to investors who require a similar forensic level of reporting.

What you ll do

  • You will be responsible for setting technical strategy for your team on a year-long time scale, and help your team tie it together with critical, business-impacting projects.
  • You will collaborate across teams in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics to ensure technical sustainability, risks and trade-offs are well understood and managed.
  • You will act as a force-multiplier for your team through your definition and advocacy of technical solutions and operational processes.
  • You take ownership of your team’s operations and availability by ensuring you have the right monitoring, triage rotations, playbooks, policies, testing and alerting in place to support “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
  • You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
  • You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.

What we look for

  • You have 8+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin, and 2+ years of experience managing a software team.
  • You have an extensive track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL, Spark and Kubernetes.
  • You have experience in financial systems, ledgering, treasury or adjacent domains where data accuracy and system reliability are critical.
  • You understand how to manage a high performance team, delivering successfully by growing the team, coaching engineers, and aligning stakeholders.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Base Pay Grade - P
Equity Grade - 13

Remote-first with flexibility built in
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for you
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn t a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you re ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on the CX Intelligence Engineering team within Coinbase s Customer Engagement and Experience org, you ll design and build the AI-powered systems that connect our Help Center, chatbots, and agent workflows. This team owns the multi-agent platform powering Coinbase chat, Help Center, and agent tooling surfaces, partnering with Conversation Design, CX, and Engineering teams to deliver secure, compliant, and scalable AI support. You ll drive key CX automation initiatives, including multi-agent framework development, agent assist capabilities, and LLM-powered secure actions that help customers get answers faster while enabling human agents to resolve cases more effectively.

What you ll do:

  • Architect and deploy the multi-agent framework for agent assist, internal SOP execution, and secure LLM-powered actions, building scalable systems that handle millions of customer interactions.
  • Own end-to-end project execution for complex ML initiatives, managing priorities, technical trade-offs, and cross-functional dependencies from design through production delivery.
  • Build and optimize AI-driven concierge chat and agent copilot experiences that improve automated resolution rates and reduce case handling time.
  • Develop systems to detect and manage bad actors and adversarial inputs, ensuring the multi-agent platform maintains high confidence and safety at scale.
  • Establish best practices for system design, coding standards, and evaluation frameworks for ML/AI systems, mentoring team members on architectural decisions and modern ML development workflows.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in machine learning and software engineering, with a track record of shipping production-grade ML services at scale.
  • Hands-on expertise with large language models, deep learning architectures, and the generative AI ecosystem (LangGraph, LangSmith, Google ADK, Vertex AI, or AWS Bedrock), with demonstrated ability to build multi-agent or LLM orchestration systems.
  • Proficiency in Python with the ability to write clean, maintainable, and highly tested production code for ML applications.
  • Specialized depth in at least one domain: NLP, information retrieval, conversational AI, or advanced statistical modeling, with the ability to ramp quickly on adjacent areas.
  • Proven ability to write technical design documents and communicate complex ML concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders across product, design, and CX teams.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.
  • Demonstrates the ability to responsibly use generative AI tools and copilots (e.g., LibreChat, Gemini, Glean) in daily workflows, continuously learn as tools evolve, and apply human‑in‑the‑loop practices to deliver business‑ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in efficiency, cost, and quality.
