jobs.title: Senior Staff Engineer, Expansion Experiences
jobs.description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we re on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

Most small businesses on Gusto are only using a fraction of what could actually help them run their business: the right plan tier, the right benefit, the right feature at the right moment. We re investing in building more of that expertise directly into the product itself, through recommendations, nurture journeys, and self-serve conversion paths that work alongside the support our Sales team already provides.

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer on Expansion Experiences, you ll own outcomes across that whole funnel, from the moment a customer s need surfaces through to the ongoing value of what they adopt. That means real autonomy: shaping the technical approach, partnering with Product, Design, and Data Science to decide what s worth building, calling the shots on what to test now versus later, and flagging the technical investments the team will need before they become urgent.

If you want your work to move retained and expansion revenue for a company serving 500,000+ small businesses, this is the team.

Here s what you ll do day-to-day:

  • Own outcomes across the full expansion funnel, not just a single surface or feature within it.
  • Shape the technical approach and architecture behind recommendations and conversion journeys so it holds up as a foundation other initiatives can build on.
  • Make sharp scoping calls under a time box: ship the simplest version that proves or disproves an idea, then iterate based on what you learn.
  • Design experiments and use ambiguous or noisy data to decide what s worth scaling versus cutting.
  • Partner independently with Product, Design, and Data Science to help shape the roadmap, not just execute it.
  • Raise the engineering bar through pragmatic technical direction, strong code review, and mentoring engineers around you, scoping out work and delegating it to other engineers on the team once it s ready to hand off.

Here s what we re looking for:

  • Successful applicants typically have 10+ years of software development experience, including building and shipping full-stack, customer-facing products at scale.
  • A product-minded engineer who starts from the customer problem and the metric that matters, not just the ticket, and can operate independently across product, design, and data partners.
  • Experience in a growth, lifecycle, or conversion-focused context (onboarding, upsell flows, personalization, or recommendations) is ideal — or a demonstrated ability to think this way even without the exact domain background.
  • Demonstrated ability to move quickly and execute with high quality — someone who ships, measures, and iterates rather than waiting for perfect certainty.
  • Experience owning multi-quarter initiatives end to end, from early concept through measurable business impact.
  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and leading peers through influence, without relying on formal authority.
  • Experience with large-scale refactors, performance and reliability work, and a strong sense of technical ownership over your product area.
  • A track record of mentoring engineers and helping teams scale their impact, including knowing when to delegate scoped work to other engineers rather than carrying it yourself.
  • A track record of spotting technical or product opportunities before being asked, and building the case to prioritize them.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools or systems to accelerate development, improve testing, and deliver new product capabilities.
  • Ability to build well-structured, maintainable, well-documented code.
  • Ability to effectively communicate across engineering teams and with business stakeholders.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in, or interest working in, Ruby on Rails, React, GraphQL, and TypeScript.

Please note that travel to Gusto s office for onboarding is required for this position. If you have any questions regarding this requirement, please share with your recruiter.

Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). Sentry already sees the moment software breaks: the error, the trace, the replay, the commit that caused it. Seer, our AI debugger, uses all of that to figure out what went wrong and how to fix it. ROLE SUMMARY

We're at an inflection point. We started with core durable execution and are now evolving with the world as it transitions to AI. What it takes to get from where we are today to a world where Temporal underpins all software – including and especially agents – is going to be different. It will require unprecedented speed, iteration, market and customer focus, and invention.

As an Agent Connectivity PM, you’ll help the world makes its transition to AI on Temporal. Without any effort, the market has already identified Temporal as a good substrate for agent workloads. But what makes agents powerful is connecting them to services and data. We are in the infancy of building out our connectivity layer, called Nexus, which has been the brainchild of our founder, Maxim, for many years. We now need to realize the full vision of Nexus by continuing to build out foundational capabilities like xyz and importantly, building agent-specific features and integrations, e.g., MCP connector, tool registry. You’ll identify the highest leverage areas for us to invest, and work closely with the founder/CTO and engineering team to get them to market.




 WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Deeply understand problems faced by agent builders and identify opportunities where our products can make building agents faster, more intuitive, more reliable, and more powerful.

 - Define and build what’s next for Temporal. Own strategy and roadmap for agent connectivity. Turn ambiguous signals into clear product theses. How should we prioritize new capabilities like identity propagation or rate limits? How do we bootstrap an ecosystem of connectors?

 - Perform up-front discovery and translate customer, field, and open-source community signals into small tweaks, brand new abstractions, or platform bets.

 - Help engineers and designers deeply understand user needs, empowering them to make great product decisions.

 - Craft messaging around upcoming features that resonates with users.

 - Enable sales and marketing teams to effectively communicate with and win customers.

 - Strong technical depth. Ability to reason about distributed systems, workflow orchestration, service-to-service communication, APIs, SDKs, identity, and authorization.

 - Developer-platform experience. Experience with infrastructure, platforms, integrations, APIs, SDKs, service mesh, API gateways, or cloud developer products.

You’ll build new things with a massive tailwind behind you: a proven technology, a large and growing customer base, and a market moving toward problems Temporal is uniquely equipped to solve. The opportunity is to turn that momentum into what comes next—not simply scale what already works. You’ll be expected to move fast, work across boundaries, and do what it takes to make it happen.

 


WHO YOU ARE

 - You're ambitious. You want to win big. You don’t need someone else to set the pace. You get impatient when good ideas stay in slide decks, Slack, or meetings.

 - You're an owner. You are accountable to results over the process. You’re less focused on your swim lane and more focused on making the company successful. You have exceptional product and operational judgement.

 - You're resilient. Building at a high-growth company in 2026 is not for the faint of heart. You see the challenges and change as not just normal, but actually desirable.

 - You want to grow, and help others grow. You self-reflect often. You give feedback, and you seek it out. You have shameless curiosity and a propensity to question things deeply.

 - You prioritize the customer above all else. You want to understand our users' world and prioritize solving their problems above everything else.
   


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - You have 8+ years of product management experience

 - You have technical depth, with experience working on platform, infrastructure, developer tools, or other technical products

 - You have worked at a startup, high-growth company or in a similarly intense and ambiguous environment




WHAT YOU’LL OWN

 - Nexus product strategy and roadmap. Prioritize the work that makes Nexus the durable connectivity layer across teams, namespaces, services, and AI systems.

 - Current execution. Drive completion of in-flight work such as the new Nexus developer experience, Standalone Nexus Operations, connector foundations, caller identity, rate limits, and payload encryption.

 - Customer discovery and evidence. Stay close to design partners and strategic customers like Netflix, Duolingo, and Miro.

 - Developer and operator experience. Balance SDK ergonomics, schema-first contracts, codegen, service discovery, security, visibility, and control-plane needs.

 - Cross-functional launch and enablement. Make sure everyone in the company understands the problems Nexus solves and knows how to sell / deploy / support it.

 - Success metrics. Define adoption and momentum measures: activated accounts, completed Nexus operations, shared-service usage, SDK coverage, design-partner progress, and field readiness.



WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

 - Nexus is past GA and entering breadth. Adoption is real, but the next challenge is expansion across more teams, accounts, and use cases.

 - The foundation is landing now. Developer experience, connector foundations, and operator controls are the near-term unlocks.

 - The next wave is strategically important. Connector Ecosystem, Service Hub, and Agentic Communication Fabric could define how Temporal participates in the modern AI and service-connectivity stack.

 - You’ll shape an important product category. Nexus sits between durable execution, service-to-service communication, platform engineering, and AI systems.

jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Financial Systems Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the financial systems and integrations that support critical accounting processes across Oracle Fusion Cloud and OpenAI’s broader finance technology ecosystem. You’ll partner with Corporate Accounting, Accounts Payable, Revenue Accounting, Supply Chain, Engineering, Data, Tax, and other cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and auditable solutions.

This role requires deep Oracle Financials expertise, strong accounting process knowledge, and an engineering mindset. You will work across corporate accounting processes including equity, payroll, accruals, leases, mergers and acquisitions, intercompany, and close; transform Accounts Payable processes; and design solutions for complex supply chain accounting, cost accounting, ASC 606 revenue recognition, and compute and data-center accounting. You’ll help redefine how finance teams work by applying automation, AI, and agentic approaches to reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, and accelerate accounting and close processes.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Own the solution design, delivery, and continuous improvement of Oracle Fusion Financials and connected finance platforms, acting as both a hands-on engineer and a trusted functional partner.

 - Partner with Corporate Accounting to improve processes for equity, payroll, expense accruals, lease accounting, mergers and acquisitions, reconciliations, and the month-end and quarter-end close.

 - Work with Accounts Payable to deliver transformation initiatives across invoice intake, validation, matching, approvals, accounting, payments, supplier experience, exception management, and operational reporting.

 - Design accounting solutions for complex supply chain initiatives across procurement, receiving, inventory, Supply Chain Financial Orchestration, costing, intercompany flows, logistics, and the lifecycle from acquisition through sale.

 - Apply strong cost-accounting knowledge to standard cost, landed cost, purchase price variance, inventory valuation, manufacturing and logistics costs, cost of goods sold, and related financial controls.

 - Partner with Compute and Infrastructure Accounting to design systems solutions for data-center and compute operations, including asset capitalization, construction-in-progress, placed-in-service, depreciation, lease accounting, reconciliations, and close.

 - Partner with Revenue Accounting, Supply Chain, and Engineering to architect scalable Oracle-integrated solutions for hardware and other complex or nonstandard revenue arrangements under ASC 606, translating contract terms and operational events into accounting rules, data flows, controls, reconciliations, and a timely revenue close.

 - Translate complex accounting requirements and operational events into system architecture, accounting rules, data models, controls, test scenarios, and integrations with Oracle.

 - Architect integrations between Oracle and upstream or downstream product, revenue, payroll, treasury, data, and operational systems using REST APIs, events, middleware, and governed data pipelines.

 - Design and implement Oracle Financial Accounting Hub solutions from scratch for multiple upstream subledger applications, including event models, accounting rules, mappings, integrations, controls, reconciliations, and end-to-end traceability.

 - Resolve complex intercompany accounting issues involving foreign exchange, balancing, reconciliations, netting, settlement, and multi-entity operations.

 - Build AI-enabled and agentic finance solutions—including assistants, model context protocols, automated workflows, dynamic dashboards, and conversational access to enterprise data—to reduce manual work and improve decision-making.

 - Create monitoring, exception handling, reconciliation, regression-testing, and control frameworks so automated processes remain reliable, auditable, and supportable during close.

 - Triage critical production issues, lead root-cause analysis, and deliver permanent fixes that improve both system design and finance operations.

 - 8+ years of hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Financials and experience with several of the following: General Ledger, Payables, Fixed Assets, Lease Accounting, Intercompany, Cash Management, Cost Accounting, and Financial Accounting Hub.

 - Experience delivering at least two full-cycle Oracle Fusion implementations or comparably complex enterprise finance programs.

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you ll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own the experience for your product as well as its roadmap and competitive positioning, and you will collaborate with company leadership on setting your product s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. Product Managers are the bridge that connects R&D to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

It also includes Grafana Cloud Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC), which delivers the full Grafana Cloud experience while the customer pays the infrastructure bill directly to their cloud provider, saving them significantly at scale.

Your mission is to make Grafana Labs the obvious choice for organizations that can t use standard SaaS because of compliance, data, or cost-at-scale constraints. Deployment choices change the product: features that are simple in standard SaaS can be hard, expensive, or impossible in a regulated or customer-owned environment. You’ll be responsible for adapting existing Grafana Cloud capabilities to these environments, deciding which features come in, which wait, and which stay out, and occasionally building something specific to BYOC or Federal Cloud. You ll also help shape which deployment models we offer next.

Along the way, you’ll use AI tools daily to speed up research, analyze product signals, and develop positioning, applying strong judgment to the results.

As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you will:

jobs.title: Principal Engineer Capacity/Compute
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

Anthropic manages one of the largest and fastest-growing infrastructure fleets in the industry — spanning multiple accelerator families, cpu families and clouds. The Capacity Engineering team is responsible for making sure all our infrastructure resources are accounted for, well-utilized, and efficiently allocated. We own the data, tooling, and operational systems that let Anthropic plan, measure, and maximize utilization across first-party and third-party compute.

As an engineer on Capacity Engineering, you will build the production systems that power this work: data pipelines that ingest and normalize telemetry from heterogeneous cloud environments, observability tooling that gives the org real-time visibility into fleet health, and performance instrumentation that measures how efficiently every major workload uses the hardware it’s running on. You will be expected to write production-quality code every day, operate alongside Kubernetes-native infrastructure at meaningful scale, and directly influence decisions around one of Anthropic’s largest areas of spend.

You’ll collaborate closely with research engineering, infrastructure, inference, and finance teams. The work requires someone who can move between data engineering, systems engineering, and observability with comfort — and who thrives in a high-autonomy, high-ambiguity environment.

This is a pipeline role feeding four areas. Depending on your background and business priority, you’ll focus primarily in one, but the boundaries are fluid and the problems overlap:

  • Data platform Pipelines that ingest occupancy and utilization telemetry from Kubernetes clusters, normalize billing and usage across cloud providers, and serve the BigQuery tables the rest of the org queries against. Correctness, completeness, and latency are the job, not a footnote. Consumers range from research engineers to finance to leadership, so it s product work as much as engineering: defining schema contracts, making data discoverable, and figuring out what people actually need.
  • Planning Knowing what the fleet has, where it s going, and what s in the way. Making the state of the fleet legible and actionable in real time: cluster health tooling, capacity planning platforms, alerting on occupancy drops and allocation problems, and systemic fixes to scheduling and fragmentation. Kubernetes operations on one side, cross-team coordination on the other.
  • Efficiency Measuring and improving how effectively every major workload uses the hardware it runs on. Instrumenting utilization across training, inference, and eval systems, building benchmarking infrastructure, establishing per-config baselines, and working directly with system-owning teams to close the gaps. The metric has to be good enough that the team on the hook for it agrees with the number.
  • Attribution and forecasting Connecting what the fleet costs to what the business is doing with it. Reconciling CSP billing exports against vendor telemetry and internal systems with mismatched schemas, attributing spend to the workloads and teams that generate it, and turning inference demand signals and research roadmaps into a defensible compute plan. Efficiency metrics have to survive contact with finance: stripped of pure demand and unit-price effects, reproducible month over month, and legible to a CFO.

Key responsibilities

  • Build the planning and allocation stack — the tools leadership uses to allocate capacity, teams use to plan against their allocations, and the scheduler enforces. Cross-region and cross-provider placement, guardrails, queueing, occupancy KPIs.
  • Drive the efficiency programs: stranding and rightsizing, unused capacity recovery, and job-level utilization across training, inference, and eval. Establish per-config baselines and work with system-owning teams to close the gaps. Utilization improvements are worth enormous sums at our scale.
  • Own attribution and forecasting — reconcile billing across ten-plus providers against telemetry and internal systems, attribute spend to the workloads that generate it, and turn demand signals and research roadmaps into a defensible compute plan and supply pipeline.
  • Build the data platform underneath all of it: pipelines ingesting occupancy, utilization, and cost from a rapidly diversifying fleet into BigQuery, with real ownership of completeness, latency SLOs, and gap detection. Every new provider is a net-new integration.
  • Operate Kubernetes-native systems at scale — collection agents, workload labeling, and the taint/reservation/scheduling behavior that determines what capacity is actually usable.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Security Assurance | Germany | Remote
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates in the UK, Ireland, Spain, Germany or Sweden.

Senior Software Engineer - Security Assurances

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Security Assurance to join our GRC engineering team. We are building a security system that’s automated at scale, rigorously data-driven, and built from the ground up with defense-in-depth and self-healing in mind. We support a highly autonomous, remote-first, cloud-native organization. We are a technical team that can build any tool we need, while knowing when to buy to improve velocity.

To support our growth and ambitious vision, we embrace agile principles and values, share openly, apply context-driven security mechanisms, default to action, and have an OSS-first mindset. We are a 100% remote company. We believe in high-velocity but sustainable expectations and timeframes, giving people the room to do great work.

The Opportunity:

You will work to build out our security observability, compliance, and control management systems and tools. You will develop services and tools to proactively defend our systems, provide visibility to our security state, and give engineers and stakeholders guardrails and paved roads to behave securely. You will collaborate across your team, the security department, and wider Grafana to write and deploy security policies across all of our SDLC, applications, and infrastructure.

This is a very technical, hands-on keyboard software engineering, so development experience is critical. You will ideally have some experience building, implementing and improving the maturity of security programs in Cloud-based SaaS organizations. Knowledge of security standards and frameworks (ISO, FedRAMP, PCI-DSS, GDPR, etc) is useful, but the disposition to quickly learn new things is more important than rote knowledge. You will work alongside other security engineers, full-stack developers, and customer-facing teams. Experience guiding and negotiating with peers, stakeholders, customers, and auditors is a plus. 

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Be a technical contributor on our GRC team covering a range of areas, including certifications, application, build, cloud, and supply chain security, and internal security tooling development
  • Develop, implement, and maintain highly automated security assurance programs to ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, NIST, PCI-DSS, TISAX, whatever else our customers eventually throw at us)
  • Develop systems, automations, and methods of security observability to push the GRC engineering organization beyond just meeting certification requirements
  • Deploy security and compliance checks in an employee-enabling way (guardrails and paved roads) in their daily workflows and build pipelines
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate security controls into the software development lifecycle and operational processes.
  • Respond to customer security issues, security alerts, and potential incidents

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Experience developing in a production environment with at least one programming language. We primarily use Go, TypeScript, and Python but most languages translate well. You will take a code screen and be expected to discuss programming principles such as algorithms, data structures, and optimization
  • Knowledge of using and securing containerized, cloud-native applications, ideally with Kubernetes. Experience with multiple cloud providers is a strong plus
  • Experience in automating security and compliance processes using tools, scripts, and frameworks while enabling developer and employee workflows
  • Strong interpersonal skills, as this position will require communication with peers, stakeholders, auditors, and customers
  • Understanding of industry-recognized security frameworks, standards, and certifications, such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, NIST, or GDPR, and how to apply them without added operational burden. You can gain this by reading the st

About the Engineering team

The Engineering team builds systems that power Affirm’s mission. We take pride in our craft, building reliable, performant, and scalable solutions that touch every part of the business. Whether we’re enabling new ways to pay, ensuring our platforms can scale to the most demanding levels in the industry, or developing seamless servicing experiences, our focus is on solving complex problems through exceptional engineering.

About the team

Affirm’s Communications team builds and modernizes the highly available platform that delivers billions of customer messages reliably and on time across the customer journey. As a senior backend engineer, you will shape multi-region, multi-tenant infrastructure, APIs, and vendor integrations that help product teams communicate with customers at scale.

What you’ll do

  • You will own and deliver quarterly technical goals for the Communications area, collaborating with teammates to solve ambiguous, open-ended problems across messaging infrastructure.

  • You will design and evolve reliable backend services for high-volume communications across multi-region, multi-tenant environments, including orchestration, delivery, preferences, templates, and observability.

  • You will collaborate with product management, design, analytics, security, and engineering partners throughout the product lifecycle, articulating technical constraints and balancing customer impact, risks, and trade-offs.

  • You will design, implement, and operate resilient integrations with external messaging vendors, balancing reliability, latency, cost, and compliance.

  • You will proactively identify and solve project, process, technology, or business issues that affect scalability, developer experience, and operational resilience.

  • You will support the operations and availability of your team’s services by defining service-level objectives and metrics, improving alerting and incident response, and participating in on-call efforts.

  • You will foster quality and ownership by improving design, testing, code review, rollout, and operational standards, and advocating for them through writing and tech talks.

  • You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback, mentorship, and technical direction, and leading by example.

  • On-Call Rotation - There would be an on-call rotation for this role as a requirement.

What we look for

  • You have 5+ years of experience in software development or engineering, with a deep understanding of system design and architecture.

  • Proficiency in modern programming languages such as Python, Kotlin, or similar.

  • You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL, DynamoDB, and Kubernetes.

  • You have experience designing multi-region, multi-tenant platforms with strong isolation, scalability, failure recovery, and data-consistency guarantees.

  • You have experience integrating with third-party communications or messaging vendors and designing abstractions that account for different capabilities, rate limits, and failure modes.

  • You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.

  • You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely.

jobs.description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we re on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role

Gusto’s Finance team is rebuilding planning, forecasting, and analysis with AI at the center. As Staff FP&A AI Architect, you’ll design and lead the technical and process architecture that turns FP&A from a manual, spreadsheet-driven cycle into an automated, insight-generating function. You’re a hybrid: deep enough in finance to understand driver-based planning, variance analysis, and board reporting, and deep enough in data and AI to design the systems that automate them. You’ll partner with the CFO org, FP&A, Accounting, Data, and Engineering.

About the Team

This is a new role on the Enterprise AIT team, which drives the intelligent transformation of Gusto’s enterprise systems by integrating AI, automation, and advanced analytics across internal applications. The team works closely with Finance, Business Ops, IT, and Security, and this role brings dedicated AI architecture capacity to FP&A and the CFO org.

What You’ll Do

  • Set the strategy: Define the multi-year architecture and roadmap for AI-enabled planning, forecasting, and reporting, prioritizing use cases by value, feasibility, and risk.
  • Build forecasting systems: Architect driver-based, ML-assisted forecasts for revenue, headcount, opex, and cash, combining statistical models with LLM workflows and benchmarking against human forecasts.
  • Automate analysis: Build agentic workflows for variance commentary, flux analysis, scenario modeling, board and QBR narratives, and ad-hoc “ask the numbers” questions.
  • Own the finance data foundation: Work with Data Engineering on governed data models connecting the GL, billing, CRM, HRIS, and planning tools, so AI outputs are traceable and auditable.
  • Embed controls and trust: Establish evals, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, lineage, and audit trails that meet SOX, security, and privacy requirements.
  • Evaluate and select tools: Drive build-vs-buy decisions across planning platforms, LLM providers, and orchestration frameworks.
  • Lead through influence: Mentor analysts and engineers, create reusable patterns and templates, and drive AI adoption across Finance.
  • Measure impact: Report on cycle-time reduction, forecast accuracy, analyst capacity freed, and decision latency.

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 10+ years in FP&A, corporate finance, finance systems, data science, or finance engineering, including 3+ years designing or leading AI/ML or advanced automation for finance
  • Strong FP&A fundamentals: driver-based modeling, operating plans, rolling forecasts, SaaS or fintech metrics, variance analysis
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs and agentic systems (prompting, RAG, tool use, evals) and classical forecasting (time series, regression, ensembles)
  • Proficiency in SQL and Python, a modern data stack (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, dbt), and BI tools
  • Experience with enterprise planning platforms and ERP/GL systems
  • Track record shipping production-grade solutions under SOX, data governance, and security review
  • Exceptional communication: able to explain model behavior to a CFO and system design to an engineer

Nice to have

  • Payroll, HR tech, fintech, or SaaS finance experience
  • Experience building internal tools with Engineering
  • Familiarity with MCP-style integrations and AI governance frameworks
  • CPA, CFA, or an advanced quantitative degree

Ideal Attributes

Finance-fluent builder, systems thinker, rigorous about trust (evals, lineage, and human-in-the-loop as design requirements), pragmatic on build vs. buy, influencer and teacher, and outcome-driven.

AI Fluency Expectations

Expert/Transformer level, expected to set AI standards for Finance. Advanced in LLM platforms (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini), agent frameworks and MCP, and Python/SQL; proficient in Snowflake/Databricks/dbt, planning platforms (Anaplan, Adaptive, Pigment), ERP/GL (NetSuite), and BI tools.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Query and Access Control
jobs.description:
We re looking for a staff software engineer to work on how data is queried and who is allowed to see it. Every read in Asana passes through this layer: it resolves what a user is asking for and enforces, on every object, whether that user is permitted to see it. You will help us keep those guarantees correct and fast as our largest customers grow their domains, their permission structures get more intricate, and AI agents become a significant new class of caller.

The Query and Access Control team owns the query execution path over the Work Graph and the permissioning model that governs it. As a staff engineer on the team, you will take on our hardest technical problems and drive the work that spans several teams, bringing depth to the design decisions that shape this layer for years. We work closely with other teams in the core infrastructure area to build and retain customer trust in Asana as the platform for their critical workflows.

This role is based in our Reykjavik office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you re interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you ll achieve

  • Design and implement a query layer over the Work Graph that stays correct and performant as customer domains and permission structures grow
  • Evolve our access control model so that permission checks remain sound, auditable, and fast on every read path
  • Define how new classes of caller, including AI agents acting on a user s behalf, are authorized, without weakening the guarantees customers depend on
  • Drive large, multi-quarter projects that cut across team boundaries, from design and implementation through deployment and iteration
  • Build alignment on the design with engineers and leaders in other teams before the code is written, and keep that alignment as the work lands
  • Share what you know through design review, code review, and mentorship
  • Partner with infrastructure teams across Asana to define how user data in the Work Graph is accessed
  • Support framework and product engineers to build new product functionality at scale, quickly

About you

  • 8+ years of engineering experience building and operating reliable backend services at scale, with 3+ years driving large-scale projects
  • You have driven large technical initiatives spanning multiple teams, and perhaps organizations, from early design to adoption
  • You go deep on hard problems and can carry a design from first principles through to production
  • You enjoy sharing what you know with other engineers and helping them build production-quality infrastructure
  • You are skilled at communicating technical concepts and constraints to cross-functional partners in product
  • You bring care and rigor to systems where correctness is not negotiable, and can reason about the blast radius of a change before it ships

Desirable

  • You have experience with authorization systems, permission models, or multi-tenant data isolation at scale
  • You have worked on query engines, query planning, caching layers, or graph-shaped data access
  • You are familiar with infrastructure-as-code and container orchestration technologies like Terraform and Kubernetes

At Asana, we re committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you re interested in this role and don t meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we’ll offer

Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we re committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.

For this role, the estimated base salary range is between 1 600 000 - 1 800 000 ISK monthly. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.

In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. jobs.title: IT Systems Engineer, Client Platform Engineer, ChromeOS
jobs.location: Boston, MA; Remote-Friendly (Travel-Required) | San Francisco, CA | Seattle, WA | New York City, NY; Washington, DC
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

The Endpoint team (Client Platform Engineering) manages the devices Anthropic’s people work on, plus the infrastructure underneath them. We treat the fleet as a distributed platform, not a collection of devices, and configuration ships as code through pull requests, CI, staging, and a canary group. Today the fleet is mostly macOS, with a growing mobile footprint.

Anthropic also works with vendor and business process outsourcing (BPO) partners whose teams need access to Anthropic systems. Those programs are growing, in more countries and with more vendors. Anthropic-owned Chromebooks issued to vendor staff are becoming the default device for vendor teams. This role exists to make ChromeOS a supported platform with a dedicated owner. You will own ChromeOS end to end, from how devices are bought and enrolled to how they are locked down, monitored, and retired, and help bring Android in as a second platform.

The team is deliberately lean and runs with high autonomy. You’ll define what ChromeOS looks like at Anthropic and own the platform decisions that get it there.

Responsibilities

  • Own ChromeOS as a platform at Anthropic: device standards, Google Admin console and Chrome Enterprise setup, organizational unit design, and policy
  • Manage ChromeOS policy as code through the Chrome Policy API, GAM, and Terraform, in the team s config-as-code pipeline, so changes are reviewed, tested, and progressively rolled out like the rest of the fleet
  • Build zero touch enrollment through resellers, so a Chromebook arrives enrolled and works the first time in every country our vendor partners work from
  • Work with IT Operations and procurement partners on buying and shipping devices internationally, including regions our current partners don’t reach
  • Design device models for vendor teams (kiosk, managed guest sessions, shared devices, and assigned devices) and pick the right one for each program
  • Lock devices down to what the work needs: copy and paste, downloads, printing, USB, and app and extension controls
  • Own the device lifecycle for vendor fleets, from enrollment to wipe, lock, and retrieval when an engagement ends
  • Feed ChromeOS device data into our fleet telemetry, tracking which devices are checking in, OS version, and drift between expected and actual state
  • Partner with Corporate Security on hardware standards (such as Verified Access attestation and minimum AUE date), device trust signals, and access decisions
  • Work with Security on the contractor access model and on keeping Anthropic data off vendor devices
  • Run data loss controls through Chrome Enterprise Premium
  • Work with Security on the vendor identity model: which accounts vendor staff use and in which tenant
  • Support Android as a second platform, working with the corporate mobile program on Android Enterprise and zero-touch enrollment
  • Write the runbooks IT Operations and vendor partners use to stand up a new program

You may be a good fit if you

  • Have owned ChromeOS as a platform for a fleet of thousands of devices
  • Know the Google Admin console and Chrome Enterprise well: OU design, device and user policy, enrollment, and reporting
  • Have automated ChromeOS policy through the Chrome Policy API or GAM
  • Have run kiosk, managed guest, or shared device programs for frontline, contact center, or outsourced teams
  • Have set up zero touch enrollment with resellers and shipped devices across several countries
  • Have worked with Android device management and can hold your own in a mixed fleet
  • Excel at ambiguous problems that touch several teams at once
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to any audience, including vendor partners
  • View IT Engineering as requiring product engineering rigor
  • Write clear documentation as a natural part of your workflow

Strong candidates may also

  • Manage device configuration as code (pull requests, CI, staged rollout) instead of clicking in consoles
  • Have managed ChromeOS alongside macOS or mobile fleets
  • Have used VDI or browser-based access to keep data off the device for outsourced teams
  • Have supported BPO or vendor programs through fast growth into new regions
  • Have built automated, progressive rollout systems with promotion gated on telemetry
  • Have used LLMs to automate operational work, or are excited to make Claude a teammate

Technical Skills

  • Python and shell scripting
  • ChromeOS management through the Google Admin console and Chrome Enterprise
  • Google Admin SDK, Chrome Policy API, and GAM for automating policy and reporting
  • Android Enterprise management (working knowledge)
  • Querying live device state at fleet scale
  • GitOps and CI for configuration management
  • Endpoint security fundamentals

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more. We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA. Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era. About the role We’re looking for an exceptional Full Stack Engineer to help us build, optimize, and expand the foundation of the platform. We’ve kept our hiring standards exceptionally high since we expect engineers to tackle a broad range of challenges on a day-to-day basis. Examples of past engineering initiatives include developing strategies for secret rotation and dynamic secrets, a gateway to provide secure access to private resources, protocols like EST and KMIP , integrations for syncing secrets across cloud providers, and entire new product lines such as Infisical PKI and Infisical PAM. You’ll be working closely with our CTO and the rest of the engineering team to: Develop and maintain features whilst communicating directly with enterprise customers. Expand our newer Infisical PKI , Infisical PAM , and Infisical KMS product lines. Experiment with novel approaches for applying AI to secrets management and more broadly security infrastructure. Requirements Deep technical mastery of the JavaScript ecosystem, particularly React.js, Node.js, and TypeScript. Exceptional attention to detail and eager to learn. A bias toward action—able to make decisions with incomplete information, iterate quickly, and take calculated risks. Based in the Americas (US or Canada), Brazil, India, UK, or EU. Must work US hours. Nice to have Expertise in Go. Has some understanding of devops/developer tools. Previous founder or startup experience. Previous experience building in open source or developer tools in either a professional or personal setting. Excellent written and oral communication skills to interact with customers directly. Team, values & benefits Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings. At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page .

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Position overview

SingleStore is seeking a Principal Cloud Network & Reliability Engineer to lead the architecture, reliability, and automation of the network foundations supporting our engineering organization.

This is a senior hands-on technical role spanning cloud networking, site reliability engineering, infrastructure automation, and platform architecture across AWS, GCP, Azure, and internal infrastructure.

The ideal candidate combines deep networking expertise with strong software and infrastructure engineering skills. They should be comfortable operating across organizational boundaries, driving technical decisions, improving reliability, and identifying adjacent problems that need ownership rather than limiting themselves strictly to a predefined scope.

This role also provides senior technical coverage during U.S. business hours and acts as a key architecture partner to Platform Engineering, Systems Engineering, IT, InfoSec, and product engineering teams.

What you’ll do:

  • Define cloud networking architecture and standards across AWS, GCP, Azure, and internal infrastructure.
  • Design and evolve routing, segmentation, firewalls, NAT, ingress/egress, DNS, VPN, private connectivity, and cloud-to-data-center networking.
  • Lead technical direction for private-access technologies such as Tailscale, Headscale, WireGuard, bastions, and related access patterns.
  • Establish SLOs, monitoring, alerting, recovery procedures, and operational standards for critical network services.
  • Lead diagnosis and mitigation of significant networking, connectivity, and infrastructure incidents, and drive permanent remediation.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure using Terraform, OpenTofu, Terragrunt, Python, Go, or comparable technologies.
  • Build reusable infrastructure patterns and automation that enable safe self-service for platform and engineering teams.
  • Improve infrastructure change safety through automated validation, required review, observability, change logging, and rollback practices.
  • Partner with Cloud Platform, Developer Platform, Systems Engineering, IT, InfoSec, and SRE teams on architecture that crosses networking, infrastructure, identity, security, and reliability domains.
  • Serve as a senior technical escalation point during U.S. business hours.
  • Create architecture standards, decision records, runbooks, and operational practices that reduce dependency on individual subject-matter experts.
  • Mentor engineers and raise networking, infrastructure, and reliability expertise across the organization.
  • Identify architectural and operational gaps beyond the immediate networking domain and help drive them to resolution.

Your Experience:

  • Deep experience designing and operating complex production cloud networks in at least one major cloud provider, with meaningful experience in a second.
  • Strong knowledge of routing, subnetting, segmentation, firewalls, NAT, DNS, VPN, ingress/egress, and private connectivity.
  • Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex production network and infrastructure failures.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, OpenTofu, Terragrunt, or comparable infrastructure-as-code technologies.
  • Experience building infrastructure automation using Python, Go, or a comparable programming language.
  • Strong SRE experience including observability, incident response, root-cause analysis, recovery engineering, and reliability improvement.
  • Experience operating Kubernetes or adjacent cloud-platform infrastructure.
  • Experience designing safe infrastructure change and deployment practices.
  • Ability to lead architecture decisions across multiple engineering organizations without formal authority.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including architecture documents, standards, runbooks, and incident reviews.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers, distribute technical knowledge, and influence technical direction at Principal level.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience across AWS, GCP, and Azure.
  • AWS Transit Gateway, Cloud WAN, Direct Connect, PrivateLink, Route 53, or equivalent cloud-network technologies.
  • GCP Cloud Router, Interconnect, Shared VPC, Private Service Connect, or equivalent technologies.
  • Azure Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute, Private Link, or equivalent technologies.
  • BGP and hybrid cloud/data-center networking.
  • Tailscale, Headscale, WireGuard, or comparable private-access technologies.
  • NetBox or other IPAM/DCIM platforms.
  • Kubernetes CNI or advanced Kubernetes networking experience.
  • Grafana, Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, CloudWatch, PagerDuty, Pingdom, or comparable observability tools.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, IAM Control Plane
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The IAM Control Plane team’s mission is to empower Stripe users to easily and securely manage their access to Stripe products and data. As part of Stripe s Organizations and Auth Platform, we own the platform for API keys, user roles, and access auditing, ensuring the right people have the keys to the kingdom - and no one else. We are a team of around 10 engineers with an ambitious roadmap, blending deep platform work with direct product impact.

What you’ll do

You will design, build, and maintain the critical systems that control our user’s access to Stripe.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build the next generation of IAM primitives to securely power AI-driven agentic experiences on Stripe
  • Develop new user-facing permission models, including custom roles and granular access controls
  • Architect and implement platform features like Account Groups to simplify access management for large organizations
  • Own and operate mission-critical, highly-available backend services that are fundamental to every Stripe user s experience
  • Work across the stack to ship end-to-end features, from API design and database modeling to frontend components
  • Improve engineering standards, tooling, and processes as well as mentor team members

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

 

Airbnb is a mission-driven company dedicated to helping create a world where anyone can belong anywhere. It takes a unified team committed to our core values to achieve this goal. Airbnb s various functions embody the company s innovative spirit and our fast-moving team is committed to leading as a 21st century company.

The Client and Identity Engineering team is accountable for establishing the user identity and endpoint security infrastructure in Airbnb s corporate environment. Client and Identity Engineering encompass corporate zero trust deployments. Our systems enable all Airbnb employees and partners to have secure access to the data they need at the right time and in the right context. We provide Airbnb employees and partners with the best-in-class experience, enabling them to effectively build our platform.

 

The Difference You Will Make

 

The team works on systems which have higher reliability and security requirements than most backend systems or services. Our products are critical services, downtime across these services can result in downtime for Airbnb employees and partners. In addition, the team collaborates closely with our security engineering teams to design new features and evolve the platforms to meet the engineering challenges as business needs present themselves.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build and maintain robust, scalable, and secure systems that underpin the entire Airbnb Zero Trust ecosystem. You will play a pivotal role in the execution for these critical platforms. This is an opportunity to be a part of impactful work, and contribute to the safety and trust of the Airbnb community.

 

A Typical Day

 

  • Work with open source products to build the next generation client platform for all Airbnb corporate endpoints. 
  • Build on our zero trust back end suite, supporting security services, network paths, and user and device signaling, with a mind for enabling value for the business for their best work. 
  • Support executive level Airbnb staff with endpoint and identity solutions.
  • Work with product and engineering teams to optimize endpoints and identity flows for Airbnb employees and partners.

 

Your Expertise

 

  • Bachelor s and/or Master/PhD s degree, preferably in CS, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in test driven software development.
  • Extensive experience with Go, Python, or Java (Go strongly preferred).
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and infrastructure as code deployments.
  • Experience developing and deploying services in a Kubernetes environment.
  • Solid understanding of software architecture and design patterns.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills and the ability to work well within engineering organization and cross functions
  • Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Experience leading technical projects and mentoring junior engineers.
  • Show motivation for personal growth and learning new technologies to support the team s needs.

 

Bonus Points

 

  • Experience with microservices architecture.
  • Familiarity with Apple MDM spec and its implementation in modern MDM deployments. 
  • Understanding of authentication and authorization principles and technologies, such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID, SAML, ABAC, and related Zero Trust security protocols.

 

Your Location

 

This position is based in California - ideally San Francisco. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. jobs.title: Senior Value Engineer - Asset & Wealth Management
jobs.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI s operational blind spots into operational clarity. World s leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there s a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

As a Senior Value Engineer specializing in Banking, you are at the forefront of solving business-critical problems for some of the world s largest financial institutions. You will work intimately with strategic enterprise clients to understand their complex objectives—ranging from accelerating Loan Origination and Client Onboarding to optimizing Capital Markets Operations and Regulatory Reporting.

You will build Celonis solutions using the world’s leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with top AI and ML technology partners. By feeding operational context to AI, you help banks understand the intricate realities of their massive transactional ecosystems. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to Banking Executives (COOs, CROs, and Heads of Digital Transformation), and ensure successful implementation and value realization to solidify and expand the Celonis footprint across the global financial landscape.

Key Responsibilities:

  • AI Discovery & Solutioning: Understand the clients overarching AI strategies and the distinct challenges inherent to Banking (e.g., fraud detection, credit risk assessment, and automating KYC/AML). Translate complex financial workflows into innovative AI solutions that drive measurable ROI.
  • Pre- and Post-Sales Execution: Actively drive the customer lifecycle. Lead technical discovery and capability demonstrations during the expansion cycle. Remain deeply involved post-sale to guide implementation, ensuring efficiency and adoption thresholds are met.
  • Hackathons & Prototyping: Think creatively to tackle heavily siloed legacy core-banking systems. Leverage cutting-edge AI to rapidly build prototypes in client hackathons, solving pain points across Settlements, Reconciliations, and Payments.
  • Agentic Process Transformation: Support enterprise clients in shifting from rule-based automation to autonomous AI agents. Enable "intelligent" banking processes, such as autonomous exception handling in Trade Ops or automated Complaints Management.
  • Proof Projects: Execute end-to-end Business-critical Proof-of-Value projects. Architect secure, scalable LLM/agent systems (with RAG and guardrails) that integrate with complex enterprise stacks like SAP Banking, Salesforce FINS, or core-banking ledgers.
  • Domain Practitioner Leadership: Serve as a functional subject matter expert for the Banking value chain, scaling knowledge across the organization regarding the nuances of financial operations and transaction lifecycles.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience leading technical pre-sales and post-sales engagements specifically within complex Banking or Financial Services environments. This includes building ROI business cases and guiding technical implementations.
  • Strong Domain Knowledge: Deep familiarity with the banking value chain, with the ability to translate operational needs into AI use cases across:
    • Lending & Onboarding: Loan Origination, KYC/AML, and Banking & Lending.
    • Capital Markets: Sales & Trading Ops, Settlements, Reconciliations, and Custody Services.
    • Support & Governance: Finance, Risk & Controls, and Regulatory/Transaction Reporting.
  • Expertise in Generative AI Techniques: Knowledge of RAG, prompt engineering, and multi-agent orchestration used to build high-impact use cases (e.g., intelligent compliance assistants or automated data extraction from complex trade documentation).
  • Technical Fluency: Solid knowledge of Python and common ML/Data libraries (e.g., pandas, LangChain) as well as SQL for handling massive, high-velocity transactional datasets.
  • Communication: Strong presentation skills to both internal and external stakeholders, from technical whiteboarding with IT to formal demos for Banking Directors.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
ABOUT HEX

Hex is growing our team of builders on a mission to make everyone a data person. Our platform solves key pain points with today’s data and analytics tooling, and empowers anyone to explore data using natural language, with or without code, on trusted context. Thousands of customers like Ramp https://hex.tech/customers/ramp/, Figma https://hex.tech/customers/figma/, Stubhub https://hex.tech/customers/stubhub/, Anthropic, and Gamma love Hex https://www.g2.com/products/hex-tech-hex/reviews for our beautiful UI, agentic superpowers, and boundless flexibility.

Hex has raised over $100M from leading investors like Sequoia, a16z, Snowflake and Amplify. With office hubs in San Francisco and New York, as well as remote team members throughout the US and UK, we’re a high-agency team that ships fast and has fun doing it. Check out our Intro to Hex video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qAXsnrNlavk and employee handbook https://www.notion.so/hexhq/Hex-Handbook-9fff0d42860e4f70815c599e0d1664d6 to learn more about what it’s like to work at Hex.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Hex's infrastructure team owns all of our cloud infrastructure (compute, networking, datastores) along with CI/CD and observability, across a multi-tenant platform and single-tenant environments. Every engineer at Hex depends on what the infrastructure team builds.

We're growing in customers, in users, and in the kinds of data workflows our workload compute backend has to support. That growth has opened up a set of projects that would meaningfully change how fast the rest of engineering ships, and we're hiring to take them on.

We're looking for someone who will pick up one of those projects, own it start to finish, and leave it better than they found it. Bring your opinions, including the ones that disagree with ours. Infrastructure tooling is changing quickly right now, and we want someone who's paying attention to that as we improve the foundational components that power Hex.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

Your first few months, we'll pick two or three of these together based on where you're strongest and where we're looking to invest:

 - CI/CD. Hex’s CI/CD pipelines need a glow-up: optimizing for speed, cost, and providing more flexibility.

 - Stack lifecycle. Setup, teardown, partial teardown, and updates for single-tenant stacks, today too much of this is manual and runs through our team.

 - Postgres at scale. Performance, migrations, and capacity for our multi-tenant production database.

 - Cost. Infrastructure spend visibility and reduction.

 - Security posture. Workload and container isolation, plus compliance work as we move upmarket.

 - Platform features. Customer-facing infrastructure capabilities: private connectivity, customer defined networking, and making single-tenant deployments easier to operate.


ABOUT YOU

 - 5+ years building and operating production infrastructure, including on-call

 - You make the people around you better, whether or not you've had the title

 - Strong Kubernetes operations: you can reason about scheduling, networking, and failure modes, not just apply manifests

 - Solid AWS fundamentals (EKS, RDS, VPC networking, IAM)

 - Infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform

 - Comfortable writing and reading enough application code to change a pipeline, a controller, or a service

 - You can take a vague, long-standing problem and turn it into something shippable without waiting to be told how

 - You write clearly, design docs and runbooks that engineers outside infra can follow

Plus depth in at least one of

 - Networking — VPC design, private connectivity (PrivateLink, peering), DNS, TLS and certificate management, agentic sandboxing

 - Databases — Postgres at scale: replication, tuning, connection pooling, major version upgrades, migrations under load

 - Deployment systems — CI/CD platform ownership, build performance and cost, release and artifact management




OUR STACK

 - Cloud: AWS (EKS, RDS, ElastiCache)

 - Databases: PostgreSQL (RDS), Redis, LanceDB, DynamoDB, MSK

 - Languages: TypeScript (Node.js), Python, Rust, Go

 - Infrastructure-as-code: Terraform

 - Monitoring: Datadog

The salary range for this role is: $214,000 - $285,000



In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary & equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off.

The salary range shown may be a reflection of additional factors such as geographical location and skill ranges/levels we’re open to. Placement in the salary range will be decided upon completion of the interview process, taking into account factors like leaving room for growth, internal fairness & parity, your demonstrated skills, and the depth of your experience. Our Recruiting team will be able to provide more details during the interview process.



By submitting an application the candidate consents to the use of their personal information in accordance with the Hex Privacy policy: https://learn.hex.tech/docs/trust/privacy-policy.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, AI Gateway
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA or Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________




ABOUT THE ROLE

Docker helps developers build, share, and run software with confidence. As AI agents take on more of the development workflow, we’re extending that mission: giving developers the freedom to work with powerful agents in sandboxed environments, with the isolation and controls organizations need to adopt them safely.

We’re looking for a Product Manager, AI Gateway to help make secure model access a seamless part of that experience. Sandboxes establish boundaries around where agents execute; the gateway addresses how those agents connect to AI models. You’ll shape experiences that make it easy to get started while giving organizations control over model access, credentials, sensitive data, and usage.

This role is about making safety and developer productivity reinforce each other. You’ll partner closely with the Sandboxes team, engineering, design, and customers to turn complex infrastructure and security requirements into intuitive workflows, from a developer’s first sandboxed agent session to organization-wide adoption. You’ll own the gateway’s product direction, balancing choice and interoperability with governance, reliability, and cost.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own product strategy and prioritization. Define the vision, roadmap, and success measures for the gateway, balancing developer adoption with enterprise requirements.

 - Understand developers and enterprise customers. Work directly with developers, AI teams, platform engineers, and security stakeholders to uncover needs, validate solutions, and guide investment.

 - Make secure onboarding simple. Improve the journey from launching a sandbox and authenticating to connecting an agent, selecting a model, and completing the first useful task.

 - Build a cohesive developer experience. Partner with engineering and design on APIs, CLI tools, administration experiences, documentation, and integrations with AI coding tools.

 - Shape model access and interoperability. Work directly with inference providers to evaluate model capabilities, plan integrations, and align on capacity, reliability, and pricing. Prioritize model discovery and compatibility so customers can adopt new models without unnecessary integration work.

 - Define enterprise safety and governance experiences. Translate requirements for identity, access management, credential protection, policy enforcement, and auditability into clear, usable capabilities.

 - Guide reliability and cost-management decisions. Define traffic balancing, routing, and fallback strategies across multiple inference providers, balancing model quality, latency, availability, and cost. Own inference cost-management priorities, including usage visibility, budgets, and spend optimization.

 - Drive execution and launches. Write focused product requirements, make explicit tradeoffs, and partner with customer-facing teams on positioning, onboarding, release readiness, and continuous learning.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 10+ years of product management experience, with experience building developer tools, infrastructure, security, or platform products.

 - Demonstrated success taking a product from concept to launch, including validating customer demand, defining the initial scope, and driving adoption after release.

 - Strong technical background, through software engineering experience or ownership of deeply technical products. You can evaluate API designs, understand system architecture, and make informed tradeoffs with engineering.

 - Hands-on experience with AI tools and agent workflows, and an informed perspective on the challenges of giving agents secure access to models, tools, and data.

 - Strong product judgment and analytical skills, with examples of using customer research and product data to prioritize investments and measure results.

 - Excellent written communication and cross-functional leadership, with a track record of aligning engineering, design, and go-to-market teams around a clear strategy and delivering in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.



Docker does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

 

Compensation & Equity

United States: $280,000 – $300,000 + equity

______________________________________________________________________




POSTING INFORMATION

 - Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.

 - AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.

 - Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

______________________________________________________________________




PERKS & BENEFITS

 - Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.

 - Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.

 - Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.

 - Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.

 - Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.
