jobs.title: Senior GTM Systems AI and Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the Role: Camunda's Revenue Operations organization is looking for a Senior GTM Systems AI and Automation Engineer to design, build and operate the AI-powered infrastructure that connects our go-to-market systems and removes manual work across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships and Account Development. You will join the GTM Systems team – a small group of builders who own a Salesforce-centric revenue stack – and take ownership of its AI and automation layer: agents, LLM integrations, MCP servers, retrieval pipelines, backend services and workflow orchestration. You will partner with GTM leaders to find high-impact problems, scope them, and ship reliable, well-governed solutions iteratively. This is a fully remote role and can be based anywhere we are eligible to hire. What You Will Do: Design, build and operate AI agents, LLM integrations and automations that connect Salesforce, Gainsight, Slack, Salesloft, Clari, HubSpot, Impartner and the rest of the GTM stack – reducing manual work across Sales, CS, Marketing, Partners and ADR teams. Own the architecture of the GTM Systems AI layer: MCP servers, APIs, retrieval and context pipelines, reusable agent tools and skills, and serverless or containerized services on Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions). Ship production-grade LLM capabilities – prompt engineering, RAG, function calling, structured outputs, automated evaluations – with the guardrails to match: validation, fallback logic, confidence thresholds, human escalation paths, access controls, audit logging, and cost and latency management. Partner with Revenue Operations, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships and SDR/ADR leaders to identify and prioritize automation opportunities, translate ambiguous requirements into maintainable solutions, and deliver incrementally with clear documentation. Raise the engineering bar for the GTM Systems team: code review, automated testing, CI/CD, security governance, observability and technical documentation; mentor teammates on responsible AI-assisted development. Design and deploy workflows on orchestration platforms such as Camunda and Clay, and create playbooks and enablement so GTM teams can use and operate automations independently. What You Will Bring to the Role: Must Haves: 5+ years of software engineering experience (backend development, systems integration, data or analytics engineering, or automation), including at least 2 years shipping LLM or AI capabilities into production business workflows or internal tools. Strong proficiency in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript (Node.js), with mature Git-based development habits: code review, automated testing, CI/CD. Hands-on command of LLM patterns – prompt engineering, RAG, function/tool calling, structured outputs, model evaluation – and of their failure modes and mitigations (validation, fallback logic, confidence thresholds, human review, cost and latency control). Experience integrating with Salesforce (REST/Bulk/Streaming APIs, data model, platform limits; Apex or Flow a plus) and other business systems via APIs and event-driven patterns, and with a cloud platform (GCP preferred: BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, IAM). Ability to own a problem end-to-end with minimal guidance – scope, design, deliver, operate – and to communicate clearly with engineering and business stakeholders in a remote, asynchronous environment. Nice to Haves: Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar standards for connecting AI systems to tools and data; agent frameworks; vector databases or retrieval pipelines (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB). Exposure to AI observability and evaluation tooling (LangSmith, Weights & Biases, or custom eval frameworks). Familiarity with orchestration platforms such as Camunda or Clay, and prior work in Revenue Operations, GTM Systems, Sales Operations or Marketing Operations in B2B SaaS. Building lightweight interfaces for AI tools (React, Slack Block Kit, dashboards); Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, Integration Architect). jobs.title: Golang Backend Engineer, Financial Product Fraud
jobs.description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person. We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform. This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch. We are now looking for a Backend Engineer (Golang) to build that protection. You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one. This role will be based in London , UK as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin. What you'll do: Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers. Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout. Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times. Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer. Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter. Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decisions as we establish the fraud infrastructure baseline for financial products, with support from senior engineers on the team. Write well-tested, observable code and help the team hold a high quality bar. In fraud, a silent failure is a loss event. Our expectations: 3 to 6 years of professional software engineering experience, including backend services you have shipped and owned in production. 1+ years of production experience in Golang, or strong experience in another backend language and real enthusiasm for picking Go up quickly. A working understanding of low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems. Real-time decisioning comes with a latency budget, and you are keen to learn to build inside one. Hands-on experience with SQL and/or NoSQL databases, and some exposure to event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar). Willingness to operate what you build, including a share of on-call, with a pragmatic approach to reliability. Uses AI tooling in day-to-day development and can critically evaluate its output for correctness and quality. Nice to have Experience in fraud, risk, payments, lending, or financial crime, especially money movement fraud, bank account linking fraud, payout abuse, or lending fraud. Experience with rules engines, real-time feature stores, or ML model serving in a decisioning path. Background in Kotlin, Java, Python, or Node.js alongside Go. Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP). Experience working across multiple brands, regions, or regulatory regimes. What we value A product-oriented mindset. You think beyond the ticket, understand the "why" behind the work, and take a high level of responsibility for outcomes rather than output. Comfort with ambiguity. This is a new team on a new surface; parts of the charter are still being drawn, and you will help draw them. A track record of owning a project or feature end to end, especially in fast-paced environments. Clear and proactive communication, with a collaborative spirit. We work across three companies and several time zones, so we move fast, but we succeed together. An adversarial instinct. The best fraud engineers enjoy thinking like the attacker. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description: About Payflows At Payflows, we build software that helps large companies manage and automate their payment workflows. It’s not the flashiest part of a business, but it’s one of the most critical: invoices, approvals, payments, and controls. When these things slow down, the whole company feels it. But our ambition goes further than just building a better workflow tool. We believe the future of finance operations is not faster clicking: it’s no clicking at all 🫳 🎤 Finance teams shouldn’t spend their days moving data from one screen to another. Software should do the operational work, and humans should focus on reviewing, approving, and making the decisions that matter. That’s the direction we’re building toward: an agent-driven finance platform , where intelligent agents handle the repetitive tasks, and users stay in control. We started in 2022 with a small team and a rough first version of the product. Three years later, we’re working with major companies across France, the UK, and the US while choosing to keep our team small and human-sized. We moved fast, shipped a lot, and not everything was built in a perfect way. But it helped us learn quickly, sign real customers, and prove that the problem we’re solving truly matters. In 2024, investors trusted us with a $25M Series A. That gives us the chance to keep growing while also strengthening our foundations and building the system that will power this agent-driven future. Today, we’re about 35 people from many different countries, and we’re looking for a few amazing humans to join the next chapter. 🤗 🚀 What you’ll actually do You’ll help build a product that real finance teams rely on every day. For us, engineering is not just about clean code, it’s about reliability, clarity, and trust, especially when money and automation are involved. In a typical week, you might: Design and implement new services for a product feature. Refactor an early service to make it more robust. Investigate a performance or production issue. Work with product and frontend to shape a new feature. Review code and help teammates improve. Build backend tools that our AI agents use to perform real finance operations. Design safe, deterministic workflows where agents propose actions and humans review them. Your time will be split between building new features and improving what already exists . Both matter. You won’t just build endpoints. You’ll help shape the execution layer that our agents rely on: the APIs, data models, and workflows that let them act safely in production. You’ll work closely with product, frontend, and customer-facing teams. We expect engineers to take ownership of parts of the system and help make them more reliable over time. 💻 Our current tech reality Our stack evolves based on our challenges, but we care more about good design than trendy tools 🙏 Python is our core language. It helps us move fast, keep the code readable, and fits naturally with our AI-driven approach. A growing part of the system is built around agents that use our backend as a set of reliable, deterministic tools. Core language: Python Backend: FastAPI + Pydantic Data: PostgreSQL Infra: AWS, serverless when it makes sense Performance: some Rust for critical paths Architecture: multi-service backend, simple enough to reason about Some parts of the system are clean and well-tested. Others were built quickly and need love. That’s the phase we’re in. Over the next year, we’ll focus on: Turning core workflows into reliable tools for our agents Simplifying services Improving tests and observability Making performance more predictable Cleaning up early code We know we’re not perfect, but we care a lot about improving step by step. ✨ Who’s going to thrive with us You’ll probably feel comfortable here if: You like building products people actually use. You are autonomous and take ownership of what you ship. You take initiative and lead by example. You’re curious and enjoy figuring things out. You’re pragmatic about trade-offs. You communicate with kindness and clarity. This role is a great fit if you’re excited by the idea of: Building systems that are used by AI agents, not just humans. Designing reliable, safe automation in production. Working on a product that is still early and evolving quickly. You don’t need to know everything about AI. But you should be curious about it and excited to work in a system where agents are part of the core product 🤖 🧩 What you’ll get from this role Real ownership over parts of the system. Direct impact on customers and product decisions. A small, human team where your work is visible and meaningful 🤝 A mix of feature work, system design, and technical improvements. Exposure to real scaling and production challenges. The chance to help build an agent-driven product from the inside. We offer: Competitive salary and equity. Flexible remote setup (we prefer people to come into Paris or London office twice per week. At a minimum we’d ask you to be at an office 3 days per month, onboard in Paris for your first few weeks, and work CEST timezone). A high-autonomy environment where you have real ownership and space to make an impact. Plenty of room to grow, take responsibility, and shape parts of the product. A culture based on trust, ownership, and clear communication. This isn’t a huge corporate environment. In exchange, you get autonomy, responsibility, and the chance to shape a product that’s still early in its story—and help build what finance operations will look like in the next decade 🚀 Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: DevOps / Infra Lead
jobs.description: 🌍 Our Vision & Mission At Payflows, we give finance teams the tools to reclaim their time and energy. Our platform weaves together banking connectivity, payments, AI, and procurement so they can ditch the busywork and focus on what really moves the needle. 🤝 Why Join Us? We’re a small, mighty team who’ve earned our stripes at Airbnb, Luko, BNP Paribas, and Facebook. It’s not always easy—things move fast, and we expect a lot—but if you’re hungry for impact, you’ll find it here. 🛠️ We’re builders at heart. We move fast, think deeply, ship often — and we’re always hungry to learn more. You'll collaborate closely with product and tech to craft elegant backend systems that scale as fast as we do. 🚀 What You’ll Do You'll own the infrastructure for a product that real finance teams rely on every day. For us, infrastructure is not just about uptime; it's about reliability, security, and trust - especially when money and automation are involved. The platform has to be boring in the best possible way: predictable, observable, and safe to deploy to. In a typical week, you might: Evolve our infrastructure-as-code to add a service, a queue, or a whole new environment. Improve our CI/CD pipelines so engineers ship safely and fast, dozens of times a day. Investigate a production issue: a latency spike, a failing deploy, a database under load. Strengthen observability with dashboards, alerts, and traces, so we catch problems before customers do. Harden our security, secrets management, and access controls. Tune cost and performance across our AWS footprint. Your time will be split between building new platform capabilities and making what already exists more reliable . Both matter. You'll help shape the foundation that everything else stands on: the pipelines, environments, and guardrails that let engineers and our AI agents act safely in production. You'll work closely with backend, frontend, and the AI team. We expect you to take ownership of the platform and make it more reliable over time, not wait for tickets. 💻 Our current tech reality Our stack evolves based on our challenges, but we care more about good design than trendy tools We're an AWS shop, and we lean on managed services and infrastructure-as-code so the system is reproducible and easy to reason with. A growing part of our world is making the backend a set of reliable, deterministic tools that AI agents can call, which raises the bar on reliability even further. Cloud: AWS Infra-as-code: Pulumi (Python) Compute: ECS + Lambda, serverless when it makes sense Data: PostgreSQL on RDS/Aurora CI/CD: GitLab CI Orchestration: Airflow (MWAA) Observability: Grafana Cloud, CloudWatch, Sentry Auth & identity: Cognito, IAM Edge & frontend: API Gateway, ALB, AWS Amplify for the web app Some of this is clean, version-controlled, and reproducible. Other parts grew fast and live a little too much in people’s heads instead of in code. Closing that gap is a big part of why this role exists. Over the next year, we'll focus on: Making every environment reproducible from code Better observability and alerting, fewer surprises Tightening the security and compliance posture that comes with handling enterprise finance data Faster, safer deploys Keeping AWS costs sane as we scale 🧑‍💻 What we’re looking for 5+ years of experience with Python or any other OOP language Backend expertise : APIs, microservices, architecture best practices Databases & SQL : Data modeling, query optimization Git lover : Comfortable with version control and code reviews Pragmatic engineering mindset : Build, test, refine, simplify—smart shortcuts when time is tight 🧩 Bonus points if you’ve worked on: B2B SaaS or finance/ERP tools BaaS APIs or payment infra Serverless, AWS, event-driven architecture exposure ✨ Who's going to thrive with us You'll probably feel comfortable here if: You think in systems and instinctively automate yourself out of repetitive work. You treat infrastructure as code, not as pets. You stay calm during incidents and are genuinely good at root-causing. You care about security, because you're handling other people's money. You are autonomous and take ownership of what you ship. You take initiative and lead by example. You're pragmatic about trade-offs. You communicate with kindness and clarity. You don't need to know everything about AI - but you must be curious about it and excited to build the reliable foundation that agents run on 🤖 🧩 What you'll get from this role Real ownership over the platform the whole company runs on. Direct impact on reliability, security, and how fast every engineer can ship. A mix of platform building, system design, and reliability work. Exposure to real scaling and production challenges. Your job will be to: a. Build the Databricks data platform — Design data pipelines (Kafka → Flink -> GCS Iceberg → Databricks) following medallion architecture using Databricks notebooks and Spark Declarative Pipeline. jobs.description: Company Description About Mirantis Mirantis is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy. You will develop the control-plane services, drivers, and tooling that connect enterprise and scale-out storage systems to Kubernetes-based workloads across hybrid, edge, and air-gapped deployments built on the Mirantis K0rdent stack. About the Role We are looking for a software engineer who thinks in systems and data paths — someone who can reason about throughput, latency, consistency, and failure across a storage stack, then express that understanding as clean, testable Go. The right candidate has built production software against real storage systems (whether enterprise NAS, scale-out, or object), understands what makes storage fast and reliable at scale, and prefers declarative automation over manual operations. You should be self-directed, comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end, and effective communicating technical decisions across teams. Responsibilities 1. Storage Software & Integration Design and build control-plane services, drivers (e.g., CSI), and tooling that provision, configure, and operate storage for Kubernetes-based AI/compute workloads. Integrate high-performance storage platforms — Dell PowerScale, VAST, and comparable systems — into automated, declarative provisioning workflows. Build data-path, telemetry, and observability tooling to diagnose and resolve performance, reliability, and scaling issues. 2. Software & Automation Write production-quality software — primarily in Go — with strong testing, code review, and operational rigor. Deliver infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/OpenTofu) and GitOps-driven pipelines (ArgoCD or Flux) for storage configuration and lifecycle. Support bare-metal and hybrid provisioning where storage intersects host and cluster bring-up. 3. Platform & Hybrid Delivery Deliver storage integration for k0s-based Kubernetes via Cluster API (CAPI) and K0rdent management/child cluster topologies. Architect storage software for fully disconnected (air-gapped) environments, including local artifact/mirror connectivity (Harbor) and PKI/TLS considerations. Qualifications 5+ years of software development, including production systems, with Go as a primary language. 5+ years building or integrating storage systems (distributed, scale-out, NAS, or object) at scale. Hands-on experience with high-performance storage platforms such as Dell PowerScale, VAST, or comparable technologies. Solid understanding of storage fundamentals: file/block/object models, throughput and latency behavior, caching, consistency, and failure modes. Experience with Kubernetes storage (CSI, persistent volumes, storage classes) and infrastructure-as-code. Strong written and verbal communication with technical audiences. Preferred Proficiency in Python and/or Rust in addition to Go. Experience with the Mirantis K0rdent stack (K0rdent Enterprise, K0rdent AI, k0s, MKE) and Cluster API. Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future. This is the most senior individual-contributor role on our AI engineering team: you will architect the systems that turn LLMs, machine learning models, and agentic workflows into production capabilities that thousands of enterprise revenue teams depend on. This is deep, ambiguous, frontier work. You will make the foundational architectural decisions for AI at Salesloft — how we serve models at scale, how we build reliable systems on top of non-deterministic components, how we evaluate and guardrail agentic behavior, and how we keep pace as the underlying foundation models evolve. Keep the platform at the frontier by evaluating and integrating advances in foundation models, agent frameworks, and the modern AI stack. You lead through technical credibility and make the engineers around you better. Depth in the modern AI stack — retrieval-augmented generation, vector stores, agent frameworks, model orchestration, or evaluation tooling. You'll partner directly with internal teams like Marketing, Sales, Support, Operations and Finance to find high-leverage processes, then design, ship and iterate on agents that take real work off their plates. This is a chance to define how a 400+ person company runs on AI. You'll see the impact of your work every day, while shaping the patterns, tools and standards for how we build agents at Wrapbook. What You’ll Do: Design and build production-grade AI agents with LangGraph that automate multi-step workflows for internal teams across Wrapbook Deploy, run and scale agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, using its runtime, memory, identity and gateway capabilities to make them secure and reliable, while tracking what they cost to run and keeping it efficient as usage grows Partner with internal teams to find high-impact workflows, draw out requirements from people who can't hand you a spec, and turn them into agent-driven solutions, explaining clearly what each agent can and can't reliably do Integrate agents with Wrapbook's internal systems, APIs and third-party tools so they can take real actions, not just answer questions Build evaluation, observability and guardrail frameworks to measure agent quality, catch failures and keep humans in the loop where it matters Establish reusable patterns, shared tools and best practices that let the Agentic Systems team ship new agents quickly and consistently Own agents end to end, from prototype to production, measuring their impact on the teams they serve and iterating based on usage data and feedback Drive adoption through clear documentation, training and enablement, so teams understand what each agent does, trust it and know how to get the most from it What You’ll Have: 6+ years of back-end development experience with Python, TypeScript/Node.js or Java, with a track record of delivering systems built for security, scalability, availability and performance Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM-powered agents or workflows (with models such as Claude, GPT, Llama or Mistral), including prompting, tool use and structured outputs. jobs.description: Joining Collibra 's Sales Compensation team Collibra is the global leader in data intelligence, helping organizations find, understand, trust, and access data at scale. You'll join the Sales Compensation team, which sits within Finance and works alongside Sales Operations and Total Rewards to design, calculate, and pay commissions for quota-carrying Collibrians across North America and EMEA. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Sales Compensation you will be the hands-on owner of sales comp operations, plan logic in Xactly, monthly close, dispute resolution, and the annual plan cycle. Because every seller sees the output of this work each month, the team lives our value of being open, direct, and kind : we explain how a number was calculated, we say when something is wrong, and we fix it in the open. This is a hybrid role based in our Raleigh office or remote US. Our hybrid model means you’ll work from the office at least two days each week. This setup helps us stay connected, work more closely together, and keep making progress as a team. The Senior Sales Compensation Analyst at Collibra is responsible for Running the monthly commission close end to end data intake, credit validation, reconciliation against Salesforce and Finance ledgers, accrual submission, and payroll handoff, so that sellers are paid accurately and on the close calendar. Administering incentive plan logic in our ICM platform , including quotas, rates, accelerators, SPIFFs, and overlay rules, and supporting rep data feeds from Salesforce and Workday, in order to keep the system aligned to approved plan documents. Owning the compensation inquiry and dispute queue by tracing data from booking to payout and applying structured exception handling, so that sellers receive a documented root-cause answer within SLA. Partnering with Accounting and FP&A on commission expense accruals, quarterly true-ups, and variance explanations, in order to support journal entries and a defensible close. Making the function repeatable through SOPs, data maps and dictionaries, audit-ready documentation, and automation of manual workarounds, so that sales comp scales with the go-to-market organization. You Have 6+ years in an analytical role, with at least 4 years in a dedicated sales compensation function at a B2B SaaS or high-growth technology company. Demonstrated ownership of monthly commission close payroll handoff, accrual submission, and variance reconciliation plus hands-on administration of an enterprise ICM platform (Xactly, CaptivateIQ, Varicent, or Spiff) Experience managing a compensation inquiry and dispute queue with defined SLAs and structured exception handling. Advanced Excel and equivalent Google Sheets proficiency: multi-sheet financial models, named ranges, array formulas, XLOOKUP and INDEX-MATCH, pivot tables, and dynamic charts, built without hardcoded cell references. Working experience with Salesforce, including opportunity objects, field mappings, report builder, and the data pipeline that feeds commission calculations. A bachelor's degree or equivalent related working experience is required. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. You Are Rigorous about accuracy: treats each payout cycle as a zero-defect process and self-audits before submission so errors don't reach sellers. Able to manage several concurrent workstreams against fixed close-calendar deadlines without trading off quality. Able to explain complex plan mechanics to a seller in plain English and present attainment analytics to a VP in a single well-structured slide. Comfortable diagnosing ambiguous crediting scenarios from first principles and documenting a defensible conclusion. Inclined to ask how a process can be made repeatable and scalable, including by applying AI and automation tools to routine comp work, rather than accepting manual workarounds. Familiar with SaaS revenue metrics (ARR, ACV, TCV, bookings versus revenue recognition), quota coverage ratios, and commission accrual mechanics under ASC 340-40 and 606, or willing to learn them. Within your third month, you will run monthly close independently with Senior Manager spot-checks, deliver the payroll file on time, and contribute to ICM implementation testing and reconciliation including parallel-run discrepancy work, with go-live sign-off remaining a shared decision. Within your sixth month, you will hold SLA compliance above 95% on all inquiries, have zero payroll correction cycles attributable to calculation errors, and have documented SOPs for the team's top ten processes. jobs.title: Sr. Staff Software Engineer, AI Native Web Platform
jobs.description:
Sr. Staff Software Engineer, AI-Native Web Platform

P-1579

About Us:

The Web Platform team at Databricks builds and owns the public-facing web experiences that represent Databricks to the world. We are rebuilding the platform from the ground up, AI-native from the start, and pioneering an agentic SDLC as our operating model.

The Role:

As Sr. Staff Software Engineer on the Web Platform team, reporting to the Director of Engineering, you will own the platform layer that the rest of the team builds on: web framework, design system, CMS, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, AI-enabled translation, and SDLC agents. 

This is a rare opportunity to design a web platform for an AI-native world from the ground up. The north star architecture is being defined now and you will be a primary author of it. You will partner with technical leaders across web and marketing engineering, and set the standard for what AI-native platform engineering looks like in practice.

The impact you’ll have:

  • Define the technical roadmap for the web platform: component systems, rendering architecture, CMS, CI/CD pipelines, and developer tooling, built AI-native from the start. 
  • Influence technical leaders across the organization on shared architectural decisions and contribute to the broader north star for AI-native engineering at Databricks. 
  • Pioneer an AI-native SDLC by applying agentic unlocks across code generation, testing, review, deployment, and production monitoring. 
  • Define the evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and feedback loops that make agentic workflows reliable and production-grade. 
  • Mentor and grow engineers on the team, setting the standard for what AI-native thinking and execution looks like in practice.

What we look for:

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong track record of technical leadership and impact.
  • 3+ years of engineering leadership experience, serving as the technical owner for the software systems owned by your team.
  • Proven track record as a technical leader of a web platform, with direct ownership across design systems, rendering frameworks, and understanding of edge delivery, CI/CD and infrastructure
  • Deep hands-on expertise across the full web stack like React, TypeScript, Node.js.
  • Demonstrated ability to make and execute multi-layer architectural decisions on a live production platform
  • Experience sequencing and executing frontend framework migrations without disrupting production 
  • A clear point of view on AI-native software development and a track record of building toward it
  • Familiarity with agentic systems or LLM-powered tooling is a strong plus.
  • Strong ability to influence technical leaders and drive alignment across engineering and business stakeholders
  • History of driving technical transformation with rigor and execution discipline: stack consolidation, or platform-level standards adoption at scale

 

Pay Range Transparency

Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected salary range for non-commissionable roles or on-target earnings for commissionable roles.  Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and training, and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipates utilizing the full width of the range. The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above. For more information regarding which range your location is in visit our page here.

jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are seeking candidates in US and Canada.

The Opportunity

Application Core Services (AppCore) is a group within Platform, in the Foundations department. We build and operate systems that support Grafana’s business operations and customer experience, working closely with product teams and internal business partners.

The Usage squad works on billing, rates, usage calculations, usage visibility and cloud marketplace integrations. Our software helps customers understand their consumption and costs, and helps internal teams operate accurate, reliable billing processes.

We are looking for a Staff Fullstack Engineer with strong backend experience who enjoys making complex business systems reliable, understandable and easier to operate. You will help deliver new capabilities while improving existing services, reducing repetitive manual work and addressing edge cases that affect customers and internal stakeholders.

This is a hands-on Staff engineering role within the AppCore Usage squad. You will lead complex technical work, contribute directly to implementation and share ownership with the squad’s other Staff and Senior engineers. Your primary focus will be Usage’s systems and outcomes, collaborating with adjacent teams when the work requires it.

Our ownership includes application code, data stores, deployment configuration and the cloud infrastructure supporting our services. You should be comfortable following a problem across those boundaries and making improvements with the appropriate platform teams.

We are remote-first and global. For this role, we prefer candidates in NASA’s Eastern Time zone to provide more overlap with our EMEA colleagues.

What You’ll Be Doing

Your initial focus will be approximately 75% backend and 25% frontend. This balance will evolve with the squad’s priorities. You should be comfortable delivering across the stack, from business logic and APIs through to the interfaces customers and internal teams use.

  • Design, build and operate backend services and APIs supporting billing, rates, usage calculations, usage visibility and marketplace workflows.
  • Build and maintain backend services primarily in Go, with Node.js also present in our stack, and contribute to TypeScript/React applications to deliver complete features.
  • Improve the correctness and reliability of billing and usage workflows, including validation, reconciliation, error handling and recovery.
  • Identify recurring manual tasks and replace them with maintainable automation, clear operational workflows and appropriate controls.
  • Maintain and evolve the infrastructure supporting our services, including Kubernetes workloads, scheduled jobs, cloud resources and deployment configuration.
  • Use infrastructure as code and automated delivery pipelines to make changes repeatable, reviewable and safe across environments.
  • Investigate production issues across application code, databases and infrastructure, including resource exhaustion, failed jobs, slow queries and replication delays.
  • Plan and execute service deployments, database changes and infrastructure migrations, including validation, monitoring and recovery plans.
  • Build and maintain integrations with cloud marketplaces and external business systems where required by the squad’s work.
  • Deliver projects from understanding requirements and proposing an approach through implementation, testing, rollout and production support.
  • Make changes traceable and testable, supporting audit requirements and clear explanations of system behaviour.
  • Collaborate with product management, Support, DealOps, GTM, infrastructure teams and adjacent AppCore squads to clarify requirements and resolve dependencies.
  • Share technical leadership through design discussions, code reviews, mentoring and practical improvements.
  • Participate in the squad’s on-call rotation after onboarding. Improve dashboards, alert quality, runbooks and recovery procedures, and follow through on incident findings.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Identity & Access Management
jobs.description:
Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world s best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Engineering at Brex

Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration, own outcomes end to end, and push for excellence from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft and builders grow by solving meaningful technical problems.

What you’ll do

The Identity and Access Management team builds and maintains secure, user-friendly authentication and authorization systems that protect users, safeguard company assets, and provide a seamless access experience for developers. The team owns critical platform capabilities including login methods, step-up authentication, our custom authorization platform, account delegation flows like Copilot, Pro Access login, embedded partnerships authentication, and core vendor integrations.

As a Staff Engineer on IAM, you will lead projects and initiatives to improve the security, reliability, and developer experience of our authentication, authorization, and identity platforms for customers, partners, and internal systems. You will scope and drive projects with clear impact, work cross-functionally with the broader engineering organization, help define the team’s technical quality, and help evolve the identity platform as Brex invests in signed identity propagation, delegated and agent identity, fine-grained authorization, stronger auditability, and enterprise-ready customer authentication experiences.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our Seattle office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require Monday, Wednesday and Thursday to be designated in office days. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate backend systems and APIs for authentication, authorization, identity context, and audit-related workflows.
  • Lead engineers across the organization on initiatives end to end, from technical design and implementation through rollout, measurement, and operational support.
  • Improve login and access experiences across SSO, MFA, step-up authentication, delegated access, and enterprise identity flows.
  • Build and extend authorization systems that support custom roles, resource-aware access control, and secure defaults for product teams.
  • Lead creation of durable, identity-aware audit trails and attribution for user, service, delegated, and agent-driven actions.
  • Partner closely with engineers across Brex to make IAM integrations secure by default and easier to adopt through clear patterns, tooling, and shared libraries.
  • Mentor engineers on the team to deliver high-quality code and produce operational improvements that raise the bar for reliability and maintainability across the team’s systems.

Requirements

  • You have strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building reliable production backend systems.
  • You have experience leading complex projects and mentoring other engineers.
  • You have strong API design fundamentals, rigor around testing, code quality, and documentation.
  • You understand core IAM concepts such as authentication, authorization, sessions, tokens, MFA, SSO, OAuth, SAML, OIDC, or RBAC.
  • You communicate clearly, collaborate well across teams, and are effective in cross-functional technical discussions.
  • You care about operational excellence and know how to improve system reliability, reduce toil, and maintain high-quality services over time.
  • You have strong product and engineering judgment and can balance security, usability, and developer experience.

Bonus points

  • You have worked on identity and access management, authentication, authorization, or audit systems in a production environment.
  • You have hands-on experience with Okta, Oso, SSO, SAML, OIDC, OAuth, or WebAuthn.
  • You have experience building enterprise-facing admin controls, authorization platforms, delegated access flows, or audit trails.
  • You have worked on platform teams that provide shared infrastructure, paved roads, or secure-by-default frameworks for other engineering teams.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (AI Platform)
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Affirm s engineering team is building a large-scale, fault-tolerant, and global infrastructure that is shared across multiple financial products, merchants, and vendors. Ensuring that our infrastructure is transparently available to all engineers is critical to the success of the business. We pride ourselves on our culture across engineering of writing blameless postmortems as well as writing detailed tech specs and gathering feedback before large changes to systems.

The AI Platform team owns Affirm s paved path for building, running, evaluating, and governing AI systems. Our customers are not only Affirm users, but also every engineer and a growing set of production workloads at Affirm. As a team, we are responsible for building and exposing simple, governed interfaces to models, tools, and agents, with identity, cost attribution, reliability, and security built in. Examples of components we own include the LLM Gateway that fronts every approved model (Claude, ChatGPT, and open-weight models across AWS Bedrock and other providers), the MCP Gateway that mediates and audits tool calls, the Agent Runtime that gives agentic workloads bounded execution, and the evals and observability layer that tells teams whether an AI change is better, cheaper, or safe to ship. We are early: the gateway is in daily use across engineering, the first production agent is live, and the next year takes us from developer productivity to production inference and agents.


What You ll Do

  • Plan, execute, and own technical decisions and projects within the AI Platform team, from design through launch and on-call.
  • Design and build the gateway, runtime, and evaluation services that take AI workloads at Affirm from pilot to production, securely scaling across millions of users and their transactions.
  • Make AI spend attributable and governable: build the identity, quota, routing, caching, and failover controls that let teams adopt new models and tools without re-solving the same platform problems.
  • Partner with security, infrastructure, and product engineering teams to set the guardrails for agentic workloads and the on-behalf-of identity model for tool access.
  • Create and monitor metrics for your team s systems, and own the operational health of what you ship: monitoring, alerting, runbooks, and on-call.
  • Set and improve code review and design standards, and advocate for them beyond your team through writing and tech talks.
  • Use AI tools and agentic workflows every day as a multiplier for your own code, design review, and operations, and push the team on what a small AI-native team can deliver. 
  • Educate, mentor, and grow engineers in the team, and drive best practices around design, coding, and testing.


What We Look For

  • You have 4+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
  • You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes.
  • You have practical experience building with LLMs, agents, or AI frameworks in production: inference APIs, LLM gateways (LiteLLM or similar), MCP, tool calling, evals, or agent runtimes.
  • You understand AI usage and the infrastructure needed to support and leverage AI workloads across different disciplines.
  • You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
  • You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely.
  • Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Pay Grade - N
Equity Grade - 9

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $195,000 - 255,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $173,000-233,000

jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Data and Storage Services team is responsible for Affirm s data infrastructure across OLTP and OLAP systems, spanning critical online checkout databases, batch orchestration, streaming infrastructure, event-driven frameworks, BI, analytics tooling, large-scale data platforms, and agentic data tools such as semantic layers and internal platform data applications. Our mission is to provide trustworthy, intuitive, and cost-efficient solutions for Affirmers to secure, store, analyze, and transform data at exceptional scale.

The Online Storage team provides a set of managed databases as a platform, used to persist data for all Affirm services. Our platform enables self-service access to OLTP storage systems, including Relational DB(MySQL), DynamoDB, Distributed SQL, Cache(Redis). As a team, we are responsible for various data and access patterns, including but not limited to mission-critical financial transactional data, data science models, and any new persistence use case. These responsibilities require us to learn and gain deep expertise in various database systems. 

We are looking for a highly skilled and detail-oriented Staff Software Engineer who can drive the technical roadmap for our Databases (Relational and KeyValue) identifying opportunities to improve how we build, productize, operate and improve this mission-critical infrastructure to unlock substantial value within our business. You’ll have the opportunity to directly influence your team’s roadmap in close collaboration with your peers, share your knowledge and expertise with others and learn from some of the best on our shared mission to deliver honest financial products that improve lives.

What You ll Do

As an integral member of the Online Storage team, 

  • You will be responsible for setting technical strategy for your team on a year-long time scale, and help your team tie it together with critical, business-impacting projects.

  • You will work closely with and contribute to other teams - including product, infrastructure, and site reliability engineering (SRE).

  • You will design and build components of a scalable datastore platform, contributing to the overall Affirm s goals, and leveraging experience in creating multi-region, horizontally scalable, globally available, and high-performance datastore solutions. 

  • You will develop control planes for management, self service of hundreds of databases at scale automating schema/data migrations, disaster recovery, sharding and performance tuning.

  • You will collaborate across teams in the product development lifecycle, focusing on database solutions, by collaborating with product management, design & analytics to ensure technical sustainability, risks and trade-offs are well understood and managed.

  • You will act as a force-multiplier for your team through your definition and advocacy of technical solutions and operational processes.

  • You take ownership of your team’s operations and availability by ensuring you have the right monitoring, triage rotations, playbooks, policies, testing and alerting in place to support “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.

  • You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.

  • You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.


What We Look For

  • You have 8+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.

  • You have an extensive track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL, Spark and Kubernetes.

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on Database Expertise, leveraging your deep knowledge of Relational and/or Distributed SQL such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, TiDB/Vitess  to optimize database performance, ensuring data integrity, and implementing efficient data access patterns. Should possess deep understanding of Database fundamentals including schema design, query optimization, scaling, partitioning, sharding and performance tuning in multiple functional environments. Strong background and expertise in building and operating databases in cloud environments. Expertise in database benchmarking, load testing, and capacity planning. Familiarity with connection poolers and proxies such as ProxySQL, RDS Proxy, Pg Bouncer, etc.

  • You have experience delivering major features, system components or deprecating existing functionality in a system through the definition of a technical and execution plan. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.

  • You thrive in ambiguity, and are comfortable moving from low level language idioms all the way to the architecture of large systems to understand how they work.

  • Your growth and impact trajectory demonstrates that you have mastered gathering and iterating on feedback from your engineering and cross-functional peers.

  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.

  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

jobs.description:
ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________



Docker Hardened Images (DHI) is Docker's catalogue of security-hardened, enterprise-grade container images and Helm charts, built to be minimal, up-to-date, and safe to deploy in regulated and security-conscious environments. We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to set the long-term technical direction for this catalogue and shape how the broader container security ecosystem evolves inside and beyond Docker.



At this level, you'll work across organizations, not just within one team. You'll set direction for major domains, resolve the highest-ambiguity problems in container supply chain security, and grow your impact through architectural leadership, cross-functional alignment, and influence on industry standards. This is a pure individual contributor role; influence comes through technical vision, design, and the ability to move organizations.

 - Define and drive multi-quarter technical roadmaps for the container hardening domain, balancing upstream velocity, supply chain security posture, customer compliance requirements, and long-term catalogue scalability.

 - Identify systemic patterns from customer, operational, and upstream signals and translate them into architectural changes that span the catalogue, not just individual images or charts.

 - Build alignment across teams and executives on technical strategy, tradeoffs, and sequencing, including product, security, infrastructure, and customer-facing functions.

 - Represent Docker as a trusted technical voice in escalations, key enterprise customer engagements, and upstream OSS communities on issues that shape the future of secure container delivery.

 - Set conventions and standards at scale, defining the patterns others build within for image definition, Helm chart adaptation, hardening strategy, and supply chain tooling (Sigstore, SBOM, SLSA), and evolving those standards as the ecosystem changes.

 - Drive the hardest, most ambiguous packaging problems where the right answer requires reasoning across upstream dynamics, security tradeoffs, multi-arch constraints, and customer impact simultaneously.

 - Shape the integration test infrastructure and developer tooling strategy so that DHI's engineering platform scales with the catalogue and raises quality across the team.

 - Mentor and raise the technical ceiling for staff and senior engineers across the org, through review, design, and well-chosen architectural decisions that create durable leverage.

 - Take part in the paid on-call rotation; respond to incidents, debug production issues, and drive systemic improvements in reliability.

 - 10+ years of backend engineering experience, including extensive work on production-grade, distributed systems at scale.

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Ability to set multi-quarter technical roadmaps and align stakeholders (engineering, product, and executives) on strategy and tradeoffs.

 - Deep expertise in the container and Kubernetes ecosystem: you have strong, grounded opinions about cert-manager, kyverno, grafana, istio, and similar projects, and you can reason about tradeoffs at the ecosystem level, not just the image level.

 - Mastery of container supply chain security concepts (provenance, attestation, SBOM, signing, SLSA) and experience driving posture decisions across an organization rather than implementing them on a single project.

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals: code review, testing, source control, CI/CD, and Go sufficient to shape infrastructure and harness design.

 - Track record of technical influence without authority across multiple teams or organizations, raising quality through design docs, standards, review, and mentorship.

 - Experience navigating upstream OSS communities as a decision-maker, representing a downstream organization's requirements and shaping upstream direction on security-relevant issues.

 - Comfort working across remote, distributed teams and communicating complex technical strategy clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.



Bonus but not required

 - Experience as a package maintainer at a Linux distribution, Homebrew, or comparable ecosystem.

jobs.title: Staff Solutions Engineer - AI Specialist
jobs.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply.  Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.



About the Role:



Are you ready to sit at the epicenter of the API and AI connectivity revolution? As a Staff Solutions Engineer at Kong, you won’t just be selling a platform — you’ll be a trusted technical advisor helping the world’s most innovative enterprises architect secure, scalable API ecosystems while navigating the transition into the agentic AI era. Kong sits at the intersection of API management and AI connectivity, and you’ll be the person who makes that story real for customers.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

 - Support field sales in helping customers understand the value of the Kong API and AI connectivity platform.

 - Conduct discovery conversations to understand customer requirements and map them to Kong solutions, from initial product reviews through to production.

 - Support POCs throughout the entire evaluation process, owning technical validation and stakeholder alignment.

 - Ensure customer satisfaction across your assigned set of accounts.

 - Collaborate with support, product, and engineering teams to advocate for customer needs.

 - Create technical documentation for DevOps, implementations, and services engagements.

 - Lead and support API Management and AI Goverance evaluations, including scoping API/AI use cases, LLM traffic management, and governance requirements.

 - Deliver demonstrations of Kong’s API & AI governance and agentic connectivity capabilities, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) governance, semantic caching, prompt guardrails, and shadow AI detection.

 - Run API & AI-focused Technical Feasibility Workshops (TFWs) to validate Kong’s fit for modern and/or AI/agentic architectures.

 - Own the technical strategy for complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals from qualification through close.

 - Mentor and coach junior SEs on technical skills, discovery methods, and deal strategy.

 - Drive thought leadership by authoring technical blogs, hosting webinars, speaking at industry events and conferences such as AWS re:Invent, Google Next, API & AI summit, and regional events

 - Influence product direction by synthesizing customer feedback and market signals into actionable input for the product team.

 - And any additional tasks required by manager.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

 - 7+ years of software engineering and/or solutions engineering experience at a SaaS, open source, or enterprise software company.

 - Proven track record owning complex, enterprise-level deals with multiple technical and executive stakeholders.

 - Experience mentoring or coaching other SEs or technical team members.

 - Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native platforms.

 - Experience with REST and GraphQL APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and API security patterns (OAuth2, OIDC, mTLS).

 - Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tooling — Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, or equivalent is required.

 - Working knowledge of AI/LLM architectures, including model routing, rate limiting, semantic caching, and prompt governance.

 - Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agentic AI patterns.

 - Solid understanding of cloud computing trends and open source business models.

 - Strong listener and communicator — you can confidently lead discussions with engineers, architects, and executives.

 - Enthusiasm for working in a high-profile, fast-paced environment at the intersection of API and AI connectivity.



About Kong: 

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com http://www.konghq.com.

About the role:

On the Konnect Metering & Billing team at Kong, you’ll design, build, and maintain the backend services behind two products: usage metering and billing, and AI Cost Management (Tokenomics), which gives customers visibility and control over what their AI usage costs. As a Backend Engineer, you’ll work closely with Engineering and Product to build scalable services and APIs that process millions of events per second and have a direct, measurable impact on our customers.

What you’ll do:

 - Design, implement, and maintain microservices and APIs for usage metering, billing, invoicing, and analytics at scale.

 - Build AI Cost Management capabilities that help customers track, attribute, and control LLM token usage and spend, including cost attribution, budgets, and usage limits.

 - Architect backend systems that process millions of events per second in real time.

 - Work with Product and Engineering to define system requirements and ship high-quality, customer-focused solutions.

 - Optimize database performance and ensure data integrity, reliability, and security across distributed systems.

 - Integrate with third-party services (e.g., Stripe, CRMs) to support billing and reporting needs.

 - Support production services through monitoring, troubleshooting, and on-call rotation to keep them highly available.

 - Apply best practices for DevOps, CI/CD, and cloud-native development.

 - Write automated tests to validate system behavior and prevent regressions.

 - And any additional tasks required by your manager.

What you’ll bring:

 - Experience with Go, Node.js.

 - Contributions to open source projects.

 - Familiarity with cloud-native technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker).

 - Exposure to big data systems (e.g., ClickHouse), streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka), and event-driven architectures.

 - 5+ years of professional software development experience.

 - Proven experience building scalable backend services.

 - Demonstrated ability to deliver and maintain production systems at scale.

 - Solid understanding of distributed systems, APIs, and database optimization.

 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Bonus points:

 - Familiarity with LLM APIs, token-based pricing, or AI gateway and observability tooling.

 - Experience working on developer-focused products.

 - Experience working on developer-focused products.

jobs.description:
ROLE SUMMARY

We’re looking for a Software Engineer II to join the Cloud Applications team. This team builds and operates critical parts of the Temporal Cloud customer experience, including Namespaces https://docs.temporal.io/cloud/namespaces, Audit Logs https://docs.temporal.io/cloud/audit-logs, and Export https://docs.temporal.io/cloud/export.

Namespaces are the core unit of isolation within Temporal Cloud, providing security boundaries, workflow management, unique identifiers, and dedicated gRPC endpoints. Audit Logs and Export give customers reliable access to the operational and compliance data they depend on.

We're looking for an engineer who is excited to learn these systems and contribute to their scalability, reliability, and developer experience. This is a hands-on role where you'll collaborate with experienced engineers, product managers and partner teams to design, build, and operate backend services and data pipelines while growing your distributed-systems expertise.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design, implement, test, and ship well-scoped features and improvements for Temporal Cloud with support from teammates.

 - Build and improve services that support namespace provisioning, configuration, scalability, and reliability.

 - Develop data pipelines that process high-volume usage and operational data across multiple tenants.

 - Make thoughtful engineering tradeoffs with guidance, balancing data freshness, query cost, tenant isolation, reliability, and operational complexity.

 - Improve service operability through tests, instrumentation, dashboards, alerts, runbooks, and documentation.

 - Participate in code reviews, design discussions, incident response, and production debugging.

 - Collaborate across engineering, product, and customer-facing teams to understand requirements and deliver scoped projects safely.

 - Improve developer and customer experience through automation, better tooling, and incremental product improvements.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Experience building and operating production backend systems in a cloud environment.

 - Proficiency in Go or another applicable backend or systems language, with the ability to ramp up in an existing codebase.

 - Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, concurrency basics, testing, and debugging.

 - Working knowledge of distributed-systems concepts such as reliability, fault tolerance, consistency, scaling, and failure handling.

 - Experience with databases, data pipelines, messaging systems, or object storage.

 - The ability to take a scoped problem, break it into smaller tasks, implement a solution end to end, and incorporate feedback.

 - An operational mindset, including familiarity with logging, metrics, tracing, deployment, and production troubleshooting.

 - Comfort collaborating across teams and communicating progress, risks, and technical tradeoffs clearly.

 - A commitment to correctness, maintainability, and leaving systems better than you found them.


NICE TO HAVE

 - 3+ years of work experience

 - Experience with Go.

 - Experience with PostgreSQL, Redshift, Kinesis, Firehose

 - Experience with S3, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob Storage, or other object-storage systems.

 - Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure.

 - Experience supporting on-call rotations, investigating incidents, or improving production observability.

 - Familiarity with Temporal concepts—or a strong interest in learning the platform.


TECHNOLOGY STACK

 - Primary language: Go

 - Data storage: PostgreSQL, Redshift, S3,Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob Storage, ClickHouse

 - Data processing: Kinesis, Firehose

 - Infrastructure: Kubernetes

 - Core framework: Temporal

You do not need experience with every technology in our stack. We value strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer - Enterprise Integration & Data Platform (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Mission Brief

At Isar Aerospace, we are building the technology and infrastructure needed to make access to space more affordable, sustainable, and scalable.

We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on Senior Data Engineer to help design and build the foundation of our enterprise data platform.

As our organization grows, so does the complexity of our systems and the data they generate. You will play a key role in connecting our enterprise applications, engineering systems, and operational data sources, enabling reliable data exchange and creating a unified foundation for analytics, automation, and internally developed software applications.

You will work with systems such as SAP, Siemens Teamcenter, and other enterprise platforms to design scalable data pipelines, integration services, and a modern data lake architecture.

This is a foundational engineering role with significant technical ownership. You will have the opportunity to help define our data architecture, establish engineering standards, and build the infrastructure that enables our teams to access and utilize data across the organization.

We are looking for someone who enjoys solving complex integration challenges, is comfortable working with heterogeneous data sources, and combines strong engineering fundamentals with a pragmatic, hands-on approach.


Your role in our Space Mission...

Data Platform Architecture & Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines connecting enterprise applications, engineering systems, and operational data sources.
  • Help establish the architecture and technical foundation of a centralized enterprise data lake or lakehouse.
  • Independently build reliable ingestion, transformation, and data processing workflows supporting both batch and event-driven use cases.
  • Design data storage and processing layers that enable efficient access to structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data.
  • Define data models, transformation patterns, and data organization standards to ensure consistency across systems.
  • Implement monitoring, error handling, logging, and automated recovery mechanisms to maintain pipeline reliability.
  • Evaluate and recommend appropriate data technologies, frameworks, and architectural patterns.

Enterprise Systems Integration

  • Develop and maintain integrations with enterprise applications, including SAP ERP, Siemens Teamcenter PLM, and other internal platforms.
  • Work with APIs, databases, file-based interfaces, messaging systems, and enterprise integration technologies to enable reliable data exchange.
  • Extract, transform, and harmonize data from heterogeneous systems while preserving data integrity and traceability.
  • Develop reusable connectors, integration components, and data services to accelerate future integrations.
  • Collaborate with enterprise application owners to understand underlying data models, interfaces, and business processes.
  • Support appropriate data synchronization and interoperability between enterprise systems while respecting system-of-record ownership.

Data Engineering & Accessibility

  • Build data pipelines and curated datasets supporting internal applications, analytics, dashboards, and operational reporting.
  • Develop reusable data models and services that allow teams to access information across multiple systems.
  • Establish data quality checks, validation rules, lineage tracking, and metadata management practices.
  • Support the development of a consistent enterprise data foundation connecting engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, finance, and business operations.
  • Enable downstream use cases including business intelligence, advanced analytics, AI/ML, and process automation.
  • Optimize data processing performance, storage efficiency, and pipeline reliability as data volumes and organizational needs grow.

Engineering Excellence & Collaboration

  • Establish best practices for data engineering, including version control, automated testing, CI/CD, documentation, and infrastructure automation.
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers developing internal applications and platforms.
  • Work directly with enterprise systems, engineering, manufacturing, and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into technical solutions.
  • Apply appropriate security, access control, and data governance principles to enterprise data.
  • Leverage modern development tools, including AI-assisted coding, to accelerate implementation, testing, and troubleshooting.
  • Contribute to the evolution of our long-term enterprise data strategy and architecture.

What you´ll need to thrive...

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering, software engineering, or enterprise data integration.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, including the ability to develop production-quality data pipelines and services.
  • Extensive experience integrating heterogeneous data sources, including relational databases, APIs, and enterprise applications.
  • Strong knowledge of relational database technologies such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, or comparable systems.
  • Experience developing ETL/ELT pipelines and implementing data transformation, validation, and orchestration workflows.
  • Experience with modern data platform architectures, including data lakes, data warehouses, or lakehouses.
  • Good understanding of data modeling, data quality and metadata management
  • Experience with workflow orchestration, scheduling, monitoring, and automat
