jobs.title: Principal Engineer
jobs.description:
Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we re building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn t a buzzword, it s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we re looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You re in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Speed is something we fight for every day at Fin, and we believe Berlin is built for people who share that instinct. We are drawn to Berlin by its rare blend of deep technical talent and rich creative culture – all within a vibrant, globally connected city that’s close to our R&D hubs in Dublin and London. It’s a place where the best of the best technical talent thrive, and where people from around the world are eager to relocate and build ambitious products.

Our ambition is to hire 100 people in Berlin over the year ahead across engineering, AI, data science, product, and design. We believe this is the most exciting time to join, be the founding R&D talent in the region and make a lasting impact as we build the world s number one customer agent!

What s the opportunity? 

Principal Engineers at Fin have the opportunity to lead the definition and execution of key strategic initiatives. You will work autonomously and be accountable for strategic execution in part of the engineering organization. You will build both back-end and front-end systems, and work closely with designers, product managers, researchers, and data analysts. You will coach and mentor other engineers and partner closely with the Group Engineering Managers on technical strategy and leadership.

Learn more about our engineering culture at intercom.engineering

What will I be doing? 

As an experienced engineer you will:

  • Have a mastery of domain knowledge and work as a leader within the R&D org to drive key strategic projects.
  • Provide assessments of project progress, risks and challenges to engineering leadership to help guide resource allocation and prioritisation.
  • Contribute to our technical architecture as we grow. We scale to service requests from all our customers’ customers. We’re growing and so are they.
  • Care about agility as much you care for scalability and availability. Continuous deployment keeps us focused on incremental releases. Even our biggest technical achievements roll out piece by piece, feature flagged out of sight.
  • Contribute to all phases of software development including ideation, prototyping, design and implementation. This role has a mix of both hands-on development as well as lead/architecture work.
  • Build using the best tools in the industry. We invest heavily in AI-powered developer tools that remove friction and help you focus on solving meaningful problems.
  • Play an active role in hiring, mentoring and career development of other engineers
  • Raise the bar for technical standards, performance, reliability, and operational excellence

What skills do I need? 

  • Ideally, you’ve built an exciting SaaS product in your previous roles and loved the satisfaction that comes with knowing that people around the world are using something you’ve created
  • Significant, demonstrated impact that your work has had on the product and/or the teams
  • Deep knowledge of a high-level programming language (for example, Ruby, Python, Perl etc.) but it doesn’t need to be a language that we use here! Great people are effective and learn what we use quickly (or introduce us to better ways of working)
  • You will have experience with Distributed systems
  • 2+ years of experience as the primary technical leader for a team
  • Experience collaborating directly with technical leaders, product teams and designers, and a proven track record of delivering value to customers or users. Engineers at Fin are pragmatists who work closely with others on cross-disciplinary teams and have a strong sense of product strategy.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, EU Infrastructure
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Team

Our Infrastructure teams build the foundation that engineers at Wolt, Deliveroo, and DoorDash build on: the compute, cloud, and networking capabilities that enable Engineering teams to develop, deploy, and run services at global scale. The EU Compute team has a specific focus on provisioning, scaling, and the efficient operation of GPU infrastructure for AI and ML workloads. This is an emerging space with plenty of greenfield opportunities.

We re looking for a Staff Engineer to be a hands-on technical leader for this infrastructure work that crosses team and brand boundaries. You ll set direction for the platform, turn complex problems into deliverable plans, write and review production code, and help other engineers make sound decisions. It s an exciting time to join: we re building a global platform and the choices made now will shape how engineers across the company ship for years.

What you’ll be doing

You ll own some of the hardest infrastructure problems in the company and make the platform easier to operate and safer to build on. We’re determined to build great platform products and user experiences, and you’ll be pivotal in making this reality.

Day-to-day in this role you’ll:

  • Set technical direction for shared AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure, balancing reliability, security, developer experience, and cost.
  • Lead substantial initiatives from design through rollout and operation, coordinating dependencies and decisions across Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash, focusing on workloads targeting GPUs.
  • Evolve Kubernetes clusters, cloud networking, identity, and infrastructure provisioning to support growing and varied workloads.
  • Build reusable Terraform patterns and self-service tooling that help teams provision infrastructure safely and consistently.
  • Improve deployment and operational practices, including GitOps, observability, capacity planning, incident response and recovery.
  • Use production signals and developer feedback to find platform friction, choose where to invest and measure whether changes actually help.
  • Assist with supporting the platform, with deep focus on GPU infrastructure, as well as broad focus on compute in general.
  • Gracefully sunset legacy infrastructure and tooling, and create strategies to reduce toil.
  • Mentor engineers through design reviews, implementation and incidents, raising the quality of infrastructure work across teams.

Our humble expectations

  • Deep experience building and operating Kubernetes and AWS infrastructure in production. Familiarity with GPU workloads and orchestration is a plus.
  • Strong software engineering skills: you use Go, Python or a similar language to build maintainable tools and automation.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (we use Terraform) and with designing systems that other engineering teams depend on.
  • A track record of leading complex technical work across teams, including architectural decisions, delivery, and operational follow-through. You have the breadth to collaborate and design across team and domain boundaries, and the depth to have hands-on impact.
  • Strong judgment on trade-offs in distributed systems, networking, security, reliability, and cloud cost.
  • Clear communication, and the ability to bring people together around a practical technical direction.

What we offer

  • Scope and influence. Shape infrastructure used globally, while staying close to the engineering. Your work will help product teams ship services with greater ease and confidence.
  • Real problems at global scale. Multi-cluster Kubernetes, AI / ML workloads, cloud networking, GitOps, and progressive delivery across a global company.
  • Autonomy and ownership. Set direction and see it through from design to operation, with the backing of a global engineering organisation spanning Europe and the US.
  • Growth. Room to expand your scope, whether through deeper technical leadership or broader cross-domain influence.
  • Great people. Work with talented engineers and leaders in a diverse, international environment, mentoring and learning from others.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Loft Orbital flies other people's payloads and software on standardized satellites, and we are building the first marketplace for space-based AI applications: the store where partners publish, deploy, and monetize AI solutions that run on satellites in orbit. jobs.title: Applied Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer (Decision Intelligence)
jobs.description: We are looking for a product-minded Applied Data Scientist or Machine Learning Engineer to help build, ship, and scale ML-powered products that directly improve how our customers make decisions, operate their businesses, and serve their own users. This is not a research-only role, nor is it a service-oriented internal analytics position. We want someone who has taken machine learning from problem definition through experimentation, production deployment, measurement, iteration, and long-term ownership. You understand that great models are not just accurate in notebooks—they are usable, explainable, measurable, scalable, and valuable inside a real product. Whether your background leans heavily toward Data Engineering/ML Ops or Applied Data Science, you have a strong bias toward shipping and an interest in bridging both worlds to bring AI to life. WHAT YOU'LL DO: Engineering & AI Enablement End-to-End ML Ownership: Drive the development of machine learning capabilities (forecasting, recommendation, ranking, optimization, or decision intelligence) powering customer-facing SaaS products. Pipeline & Model Development: Design reliable data and feature pipelines alongside models from discovery through experimentation, validation, deployment, and monitoring. Product Integration: Partner with Product Managers and Software Engineers to embed ML directly into product workflows, user experiences, and decision-making tools. Pragmatic Prototyping: Move quickly from prototype to production while balancing accuracy, interpretability, latency, maintainability, and business impact. Ecosystem Ownership & Strategy Evaluation & Experimentation: Define offline and online evaluation strategies, including model quality, drift, and reliability. Design A/B tests and causal measurement frameworks to prove ML features improve customer outcomes. Data Health & Feedback Loops: Collaborate with Data teams to ensure models are supported by high-quality features, while building feedback loops so product experiences improve over time. Platform & MLOps Support: Help manage and optimize cloud data infrastructure, ensuring trustworthy insights and proactively managing data health before it impacts users. Product & Technical Direction Strategic Judgment: Bring strong judgment around when to use traditional ML, statistical modeling, LLMs, heuristics, or simpler product logic. jobs.title: Staff / Principal Software Engineer – Cloud Platform & SaaS
jobs.description:
We are looking for a high-impact Staff or Principal Software Engineer to drive the architecture, reliability, and scaling of our managed cloud offering, SingleStore Helios. In this role, you will lead the evolution of our multi-cloud SaaS control and data planes, manage high-density Kubernetes deployments across major hyperscalers, and partner directly with our AI Platform initiatives.

As a senior technical leader, you will balance greenfield architecture with hands-on systems programming and operational resilience. You will also allocate approximately 10–20% of your bandwidth toward high-priority Tier-3 operational escalations, identifying root causes in production distributed systems to inform durable platform architecture.

Note: Final leveling (Staff vs. Principal) will be calibrated during the interview loop based on demonstrated depth of organizational influence, architectural scope, and system design experience.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect Distributed SaaS Infrastructure: Design, implement, and scale multi-tenant Kubernetes operators, custom controllers, and orchestration workflows managing thousands of customer database clusters globally.
  • Write Resilient Systems Code: Develop performant, fault-tolerant backend services and control planes using modern Go language & Python.
  • Lead Cloud Networking Design: Own cross-cloud networking topology, ingress/egress controls, multi-region routing, VPC peering/PrivateLink topologies, DNS architectures, and service mesh performance (Envoy, Cilium, or Istio) across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
  • Support AI Platform Capabilities: Collaborate across business units to build scalable compute, vector indexing pipelines, and ingestion infrastructure supporting real-time GenAI and vector workloads on Helios.
  • Production Operations & Tier-3 Escalations: Dedicate 10–20% of your bandwidth to diagnosing complex production issues, acting as the final escalation point for deep infrastructure failures, performance bottlenecks, and kernel/networking anomalies.
  • Security & Compliance by Design: Build infrastructure that upholds our strict enterprise compliance posture, maintaining automated controls for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS environments.
  • Technical Force Multiplier: Author clear RFCs/architectural design records (ADRs), mentor senior engineers, lead cross-functional reviews, and partner with Product and SRE teams to align roadmap priorities.

What We’re Looking For

  • 8–12+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, deploying, and operating distributed enterprise SaaS platforms at scale.
  • Deep Kubernetes Expertise: Hands-on mastery of Kubernetes internals, CRDs, custom controller development (client-go/controller-runtime), scheduling dynamics, and container networking/runtime internals.
  • Strong OO / Systems Proficiency: Expert proficiency in Go and Python with an emphasis on concurrent programming, low-latency I/O, and distributed state management.
  • Cloud Provider Networking: Deep operational literacy in cloud networking constructs (e.g., Transit Gateways, DirectConnect/ExpressRoute, Private Service Connect, CIDR subnetting, MTLS, and load balancing).
  • AI Platform Awareness: Practical familiarity with the compute, caching, and storage dynamics needed for real-time AI/ML pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and vector embeddings.
  • Diagnostic Acumen: Proven ability to debug complex, non-deterministic bugs in production across network layers, memory allocations, and distributed consensus.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Outstanding written and oral communication skills, with a track record of driving cross-team alignment and influencing executive-level technical strategy.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience building managed database-as-a-service (DBaaS) or data-intensive streaming infrastructure.
  • Active open-source contributions within the CNCF or cloud-native container ecosystem.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code tooling (Terraform, Pulumi, Crossplane).

With a distributed SQL database that introduces simplicity to your data architecture by unifying transactions and analytics, SingleStore empowers digital leaders to deliver exceptional, real-time data experiences to their customers. SingleStore is venture-backed and headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Sunnyvale, Raleigh, Seattle, Boston, London, Lisbon, Bangalore, Dublin and Kyiv.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Security Engineering
jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We re all in on this mission. If you are too, let s talk.

Staff Software Engineer, Security Engineering

Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology, anywhere, on any device or app. Our flexible and neutral products, Okta Platform and Auth0 Platform, provide secure access, authentication, and automation, placing identity at the core of business security and growth.

 

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences. 

 

Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.

 

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer that will join the Auth0 Security Engineering organization. In this role, you will join a team of Software Engineers dedicated to building and managing services that secure the platform that Auth0 runs on. You will be instrumental in expanding our platform security controls and architecting custom workflows in a scalable, reliable manner. 

What You Will Do

  • Service Development: Build, maintain, and operate platform security services and controls using Python, Node.js, or Golang.
  • Security Data Pipelines: Design, build, and optimize custom workflows to ingest, process, and distribute security data to downstream systems at scale.
  • Scalable System Architecture: Architect maintainable, secure, and resilient microservices and platform integrations that protect our infrastructure without adding friction for engineering teams.
  • Engineering Quality: Write clean, testable, and well-documented code while driving technical designs and participating in code reviews to maintain high engineering standards.
  • Mentorship & Influence: You raise the bar for the entire organization by mentoring junior engineers and influencing senior leadership on critical security decisions.

What You Bring

  • Software Development Experience: 8+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining production-grade software services.
  • Core Language Proficiency: Hands-on mastery of Python, Node.js, or Golang.
  • System Design Expertise: Strong track record of designing scalable, maintainable, and secure software architectures.
  • Cloud & Containers: Solid experience with cloud-native environments (AWS or Azure) and container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Security Mindset: Practical experience building platform security controls, managing service permissions, and applying secure coding practices.
  • Education: A Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Systems Engineering, or a related field.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with high-throughput streaming platforms or log processing tools (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub, Vector).
  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) and Policy-as-Code tools.
  • Familiarity with compliance standards (FedRAMP, SOC2) and security frameworks in multi-cloud environments.
  • Experience or interest in applying AI/ML tools to automate security workflows and analysis.

jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the InfoSec team
The InfoSec team protects Affirm’s systems and data from evolving threats. We manage security risk, monitor vulnerabilities, and enforce protective controls across the company. The team leads incident response, compliance, identity and access management, and employee training. Our goal is to ensure that security is built into every system and decision at Affirm. We maintain a secure, trustworthy environment so the business can operate and grow with confidence.

About the role
We are building the next generation of enterprise Identity and Access Management at Affirm. This role combines hands-on IAM operations, automation, and production software engineering to make identity services more reliable, scalable, and easier to operate.

You will help run core access lifecycle processes, troubleshoot production issues, and automate repetitive work. You will also build and maintain backend services, APIs, and integrations that connect identity platforms with internal systems.

Software engineering is a must-have. You will work primarily with SailPoint and enterprise identity integrations, with CIAM-adjacent Auth0 work where enterprise systems intersect with customer identity. This is a strong opportunity for an engineer who wants to develop deep IAM expertise without stepping away from hands-on coding.

What you’ll do

  • Run and improve IAM operations, including access lifecycle work, requests, certifications, and issue resolution

  • Automate repetitive processes with scripts, services, and workflow improvements

  • Build and maintain production backend software, APIs, tests, and integrations

  • Connect SailPoint and workforce identity events with internal systems

  • Build a paved path that enables Affirm employees to create modern internal tools with Auth0

  • Partner with Security, IT, and Engineering on secure, auditable changes

  • Maintain runbooks, operational metrics, and escalation support

Example problems you may work on:

  • Fixing a provisioning workflow and adding monitoring or retries

  • Reconciling access between source systems and SailPoint

  • Building an API integration for identity lifecycle events

  • Creating reusable Auth0 patterns, tooling, and documentation for internal applications

What we look for

  • 2+ years of software engineering experience or equivalent internship/co-op experience with strong projects

  • Ability to write, test, and operate production-quality backend code in Python or a similar language

  • Strong foundations in APIs, debugging, logging, error handling, and distributed systems

  • Experience with GitHub, CI/CD, testing, and code review

  • Comfort owning operational work and troubleshooting production issues

  • Familiarity with cloud environments; AWS preferred

  • Strong written communication and documentation skills

    • Exposure to IAM, IGA, SSO, SAML, OIDC, SCIM, RBAC, or identity governance

    • Experience with SailPoint, Auth0, Okta, OneLogin, or similar platforms

    • Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools

    • Familiarity with audit or compliance environments

Affirm values information security as a critical part of the company’s continued success. Our mission is to make information security programmatic and cultural in Affirm, enabling the company to succeed in building honest financial products.   • Deep understanding of web application architecture and design principles

  • Experience using modern software development and delivery techniques to develop cloud-based services. Python, Kotlin, Java, AWS, and Azure experience preferred.

  • Experience with PCI or other regulated environments. 

  • Experience conducting threat models for complex, distributed products using standard threat modeling techniques and methodologies.

  • Experience with standard authentication mechanisms, including SAML and OAuth2.

  • Experience with Workday Studio, Salesforce Apex, or NetSuite SuiteScript
  • Knowledge of AWS services such as S3, Lambda, and SQS
  • A background in implementing or maintaining SOX/ITGC controls, as well as mentoring engineers and establishing shared engineering standards

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It s the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. Alerts are an important part of the Verkada ecosystem and our customers rely on alert notifications to stay on top of live events such as persons of interest entering buildings, if a door was forced open after hours or simply knowing when to let the delivery person in. Our systems process real-time events from Verkada s global device fleet, delivering intelligent, actionable alerts through multiple channels including email, SMS, push notifications, and webhooks.

In 2025, we launched Operations, a suite of features designed for customers monitoring critical infrastructure with dedicated security teams, starting with enhanced collaboration tools and expanding integration capabilities.

We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Visit Careers at Netskope to learn more. Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Netskope Cloud Firewall provides Firewall as a Service (FWaaS) for egress network traffic within SASE architectures. jobs.title: Tech Lead Manager, Developer Platform Product Data Scientist
jobs.location: New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As part of our growing Data Science and Analytics team, you will play an instrumental role in our company’s mission of building safe and beneficial artificial intelligence by driving data-informed decision making across our organization. You bring experience from high-bar teams and are eager to help shape the norms and best practices of a growing data science team as Anthropic continues to scale. In this unique company, technology, and moment in history, your work will be critical to informing our strategy as we deploy safe, frontier AI at scale to the world.

You’ll be the senior data science leader embedded in our Developer Platform product team and a strategic thought partner to its product leads. You’ll help set product direction for the Claude Developer Platform, spanning our core API, agent orchestration, tool and MCP integrations, and knowledge management capabilities. You’ll bring a point of view on where to invest, how to grow our platform business, and how to deliver more value for the developers and enterprises building on Claude. As a tech lead manager, you’ll also manage a small team of Product Data Scientists, setting their agenda and raising the bar for how data shapes product decisions.

Responsibilities:

  • Act as a strategic thought partner to Developer Platform product leads, helping shape product strategy, roadmap priorities, and the major bets the team makes
  • Set the data science agenda for Developer Platform, deciding where the Product Data Science team can have the most impact and what it should deprioritize
  • Manage and develop a small team of Product Data Scientists, coaching them to move from answering questions to shaping decisions
  • Frame the most important and ambiguous questions facing the platform, from how developers and enterprises adopt it to how AI agents are being built and deployed at scale, size the opportunities, and make clear recommendations, including when they challenge the current direction
  • Define how Developer Platform measures success, establishing the core metrics and measurement frameworks that align teams and leadership on what matters
  • Set the standard for experimentation and causal inference across Developer Platform, including where API and B2B products make clean experiments hard, and personally lead the highest-stakes analyses
  • Turn complex analyses into clear narratives and recommendations that drive decisions with senior leadership and cross-functional partners, including go-to-market teams
  • Establish foundational data practices and shape the analytics infrastructure Developer Platform needs to support rapid iteration and decision-making as our products grow

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Have extensive experience in data science, including leading analytics for a product area at significant scale
  • Have 3+ years managing data science teams, including setting team direction and developing senior data scientists
  • Have been a trusted partner to senior product and business leaders on API or developer-facing products, with clear examples of changing a roadmap or high-stakes decision
  • Bring strong product sense and business judgment for developer and B2B products, including the ability to frame the right question and take a position with incomplete information
  • Have deep expertise in experimental design, causal inference, and statistical modeling at high scale, with enough fluency in Python and SQL to stay hands-on and guide others’ technical work
  • Communicate clearly in writing and in presentations, including to executive audiences
  • Have a bias for action and thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where you must create clarity and drive progress
  • Care about the company’s mission of building helpful, honest, and harmless AI
  • Strong candidates may also have:
  • Experience with AI/ML products, large language models, or developer tools in the AI/ML ecosystem

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

$285,000—$380,000 USD

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Why Kong?
Every enterprise building microservices, cloud-native architectures, and generative AI workloads runs on APIs. Kong is the cloud-native API and AI connectivity company, trusted by Fortune 500s and millions of developers worldwide.

If you sell infrastructure, dev tools, or data platforms, you know what developer mindshare is worth. At Kong, you aren’t evangelizing unproven tech from scratch. You’re monetizing an existing open-source groundswell and partnering with enterprise architecture, security, and engineering leaders to power mission-critical API traffic.

What makes this role high-leverage

 - A proven land-and-expand engine: Convert open-source and developer adoption into strategic, multi-year enterprise platform commitments (Kong Konnect, AI Gateway, Service Mesh).

 - High-impact deals: Run complex, multi-threaded enterprise cycles (100k–1M+ ACV) across CTO, VP of Platform/Architecture, and CISO personas.

 - Modern AI and cloud relevance: Put Kong at the center of the enterprise stack, securing, managing, and routing LLM traffic alongside traditional microservices.

 - True cross-functional support: Backed by world-class Solutions Engineers, dedicated SDRs, Customer Success, and an active developer community.

 - Full-cycle ownership: Your territory, your pipeline, your deals. You run everything from first outreach through negotiation to close.

 - A voice in the product: What you hear from customers goes straight to product and marketing, and it shapes what we build and how we take it to market.

 - Visibility: Represent Kong at industry events, conferences, and customer meetings.
   
   

What you bring

 - Enterprise software track record: 5+ years of full-cycle closing with mid-market and enterprise logos (>1,000 employees), and consistent quota overachievement.

 - Ecosystem literacy: Direct experience in modern B2B SaaS or infrastructure, ideally across commercial open source (COSS), developer platforms, cloud/networking, APIs, Kubernetes, or observability.

 - Multi-persona discovery: You can work bottoms-up with technical champions (engineers, architects) and top-down with executive economic buyers (CTO, VP Eng, CISO).

 - Strategic territory ownership: A disciplined MEDDPICC or Command of the Message approach to pipeline generation, accurate forecasting, and deal execution.

 - Consultative selling: You find the customer’s actual problem, tie the solution to a business outcome, and tailor every demo to match.

 - Negotiation under pressure: You’re comfortable in high-stakes conversations and build relationships that last past the signature.

 - Account planning and CRM discipline: You research accounts and industry trends before you call, and you keep Salesforce (or similar) current enough to forecast from.

 - Builder mindset: You thrive in a fast-moving, early-stage environment, take ownership of your territory, and adjust when the market shifts.
   
   

Why top sellers join us

 - Clear category winner: Gartner Leader with top-tier adoption metrics and continuous product momentum.

 - Uncapped upside: Highly competitive base/variable structure, accelerators, and equity.

 - Culture of execution: Autonomous, fast-moving, and low on bureaucracy. Built for builders and closers.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Admin
jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

Enterprise admins are among the most important users Harvey serves. At the world's largest law firms and legal departments, IT and security teams are part of every buying decision and every rollout, and they hold Harvey to the most stringent access requirements of any industry, from ethical walls to matter-level permissions. At most companies, admin capabilities are checklist items. At Harvey, they're in the spotlight.

The Senior Product Manager, Admin will own the product vision and roadmap for identity and access on Harvey's admin platform, the operational control surface where enterprise administrators manage users and access, govern permissions, and steer their organization's deployment of Harvey at scale. That spans SSO and login, SCIM and user lifecycle, MFA, permissions and RBAC, external users, and global identity across workspaces. You will also help define a brand-new problem space. As agents become part of how legal work gets done, you'll work with product managers across Harvey to define what agent identity means: how agents authenticate, how admins grant them permissions, and how customers govern them.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone with strong product judgment who can turn complex, high-stakes enterprise problems into a clear strategy and shipped product: running several platform projects at once, moving with urgency, and owning outcomes end to end. You'll partner closely with Engineering, Design, Security, Legal Engineering, and Go-to-Market, and your work will directly shape whether the world's most demanding enterprises trust Harvey with their most sensitive work.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the product vision, roadmap, and execution for identity and access at Harvey, taking problems from discovery through launch and iteration.

 - Partner with Engineering, Design, and GTM to deliver scalable, secure, and intuitive admin experiences that meet the operational needs of large enterprise customers.

 - Engage directly with enterprise customers, customer success, and sales teams to deeply understand admin pain points, access and governance requirements, and integration needs, and translate those insights into high-impact product investments.

 - Define agent identity with product managers across Harvey: how agents authenticate, how admins assign them permissions, and how customers govern them.

 - Make feature access provisioning seamless between our go-to-market systems and the product, so customers reach Early Access and GA capabilities without manual work.

 - Build the permission and identity primitives other Harvey teams build on, and partner with Security and Legal Engineering on the controls enterprise buyers require.

 - Establish and track key metrics for provisioning coverage, admin efficiency, and governance, using data to inform prioritization and measure success.

 - Drive alignment across stakeholders on trade-offs, sequencing, and scope, communicating clearly at both the executive and working-team levels.




WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 5+ years of hands-on product management experience building enterprise B2B products, with deep familiarity in identity and access: SSO, SCIM, MFA, RBAC, permissions, and audit logging.

 - A track record of shipping high-quality products end to end in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, running several projects at once, ideally at a startup or growth-stage company that moved upmarket into large enterprises.

 - Platform and systems thinking: you have built something other teams depend on, and you understand how a change in one system ripples through the rest.

 - Experience working directly with security, compliance, and IT stakeholders, such as security reviews or procurement, and shipping products that pass their scrutiny.

 - Strong analytical and communication skills, with experience using data to drive decisions and the ability to articulate a clear product vision to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Enough technical depth to partner with engineers on architecture and tradeoffs, with a strong desire to go deeper.

 - A hungry, curious, ownership-driven approach, with strong attention to detail.




COMPENSATION

$177,700 - $266,500 USD

jobs.title: Embedded Staff Engineer
jobs.description: Embedded Staff Engineer - Help us build the Control System that the world can rely on. About Priva Your Future Ecosystem Located between Rotterdam and The Hague, in the heart of the world’s leading greenhouse region, lies Westland, home to Priva’s modern campus in De Lier. This innovative region has been the foundation of our family-owned company since the 1950s. What started as a hardware business has grown into a global leader in horticulture and building automation. Today, Priva develops advanced hardware, software, and digital services for climate control, energy efficiency, and water optimization. Our solutions support horticulture, indoor and city farming, as well as offices, hotels, hospitals, and retail environments worldwide. Our next ambition? Becoming a leading digital service provider with “Climate as a Service” solutions that help customers operate more sustainably. With over 600 colleagues, 16 international offices, and more than 400 installation partners, we deliver smart, sustainable solutions in over 100 countries. If you want your work to have impact on sustainability, food security, and the way cities grow, then this is where you belong. Why this role matters At Priva, we are building the next generation of IoT-enabled building automation systems: cloud-connected, security-first, and designed for long-term reliability. As a Staff Embedded Software Engineer (C++ / Linux), you will play a key role in shaping a scalable platform that combines embedded controllers, edge gateways, and cloud services. Your work ensures that buildings operate safely, efficiently, and reliably for 10-15 years with minimal maintenance. This role goes beyond implementation. You will drive technical direction, influence software architecture, and support complex system design decisions across our platform. Your role as Staff Engineer You act as the bridge between software architecture and implementation, guiding teams in building a service-oriented, event-driven IoT platform consisting of 15+ services running on embedded devices. You bring deep expertise in modern C++ (20+) and embedded Linux, and you help ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability across the system. Your team You will join our Alpha team, a group of highly experienced embedded software engineers and test engineers, working on cutting-edge building automation technology. What you’ll do Design and develop embedded software in modern C++ (C++17 or later) on Linux Build scalable, modular, and configurable control components Implement deterministic and real-time control strategies Develop robust 24/7 runtime systems for real-world environments Create simulation environments and automated test frameworks Contribute to software architecture and design decisions Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and quality gates Support application lifecycle management (ALM) Collaborate with cross-functional teams (hardware, cloud, QA) What you bring 10+ years of experience in Embedded Software Engineering (C++ / Linux) Strong expertise in modern C++ (C++17 or later) Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and SOLID principles Experience with multithreading, concurrency, and performance optimization Experience with distributed or service-oriented systems Knowledge of communication protocols such as MQTT, CAN, Serial Experience working in resource-constrained environments (real-time systems) Ability to review, challenge, and improve architectural decisions Strong debugging and system-level problem-solving skills Experience working in cross-functional and international teams Nice to have Experience in IoT, building automation, or industrial systems Familiarity with Node-RED or control systems Experience with Yocto, Docker, or containerized environments Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices Experience with test strategies, automated testing, and system validation What you get In numbers A competitive salary based on your experience; We find a healthy work-life balance important: working flexible hours combined with 30 vacation days a year and the option to buy more; 8% holiday allowance; Travel allowance of € 0,23/km with a daily maximum of 150 kilometers. For your own sustainability Be secured with our pension plan; Feel engaged and join our participation plan; Keep on learning with your personal education possibilities and budget; Be happy and fit by using our healthy cafeteria, our free on-premises fitness where you can participate in CrossFit, Pilates and Spinning classes or play table tennis or table football. Our values Priva's mission is to create an optimal environment where people can work, grow and develop. We offer worldwide solutions for horticulture and building automation. Our ambition is to be known as the leading technology and service provider for sustainable urban deltas. We are proud that our solutions result in lower consumption of natural resources and contribute to some of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Our culture is built around our core values; sustainable, innovation, make it happen and human. In our latest employment survey, our colleagues mainly described our culture as: open, ambitious, innovative, friendly, committed, informal, flexible and down to earth. We aim to be a dynamic, fast-paced, flat and informal organization, where our colleagues have the space to grow and develop. We believe that to be successful, it is important to include people with different perspectives, backgrounds and cultures. Every day, we continue to build our open culture with people who are driven to turn our vision into reality, regardless of who they love, where they are from, or what they believe in. jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Agentic AI
jobs.description: Principal Product Manager, Agentic AI REMOTE, United States JOB OVERVIEW Legion is building AI agents that carry out workforce management work, not agents that describe it. Much of what is presented as AI in workforce management today is a conversational layer over an existing scheduling screen. The more substantial problem — software that reasons over demand, labor regulation, and employee preferences, then acts, with a person in the loop wherever the stakes require one — remains unsolved across the category. Legion intends to solve it, and this role leads the product work to get there. You will take an agent surface from operational research through specification, prototype, evaluation, and enterprise deployment, working hands-on throughout. You will work closely with Legion's AI Lab engineers and with our CEO, who is engaged in this work daily. RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES Agent definition. Determine what an agent is responsible for, which tools it may call, what it must escalate, what it must never do, and what a manager sees when it acts. These decisions affect employee pay and legal compliance. Much of this work is pre-launch, so you will shape the direction rather than inherit it. Problem selection. The hardest judgment in agentic product work is identifying which workflows suit an agent and which do not. You will spend substantial time inside customer operations — district managers, store managers, labor operations, frontline employees — and return with a ranked, defensible view of where an agent creates measurable value and where it does not. The human-in-the-loop contract. Scheduling decisions affect income, childcare arrangements, and legal protections. For each agent action you will define where autonomy is appropriate, the escalation thresholds, how a manager overrides the system, what is logged, and how a compliance team audits the outcome. Legion treats this as a first-class design problem. Build quality. You are accountable for what ships, not for what was specified. That means staying engaged through implementation: reviewing the build against the specification as it comes together, using the product yourself before anyone else is asked to, joining bug triage and design review, catching drift from intent while it is still cheap to correct, and holding a release when the quality is not there. Our customers experience the build, not the document. A well-written specification that produced a product managers do not trust is failed product work, and we assess it that way. Evaluation. Build and maintain the evaluation sets that determine whether an agent is ready to ship and whether it is degrading in production — writing the cases, reviewing failure traces, setting the pass criteria. You will be the person who holds a release when the demonstration is persuasive and the evaluation is not. Specifications. Legion uses Functional Requirements Documents as its ground-truth specification layer; release notes, enablement material, and sales content are generated from maintained specifications rather than reconstructed from code or institutional memory. Write FRDs that meet that standard and keep them accurate after release. A specification is where the work begins, not where your responsibility ends. Commercialization. Partner with go-to-market on packaging, metering, pricing inputs, and field readiness. Agentic products raise difficult commercial questions — what unit to meter, what a customer is paying for when software performs work a person previously did — and you will be expected to hold a considered position on them. Design-partner delivery. Lead agent deployments with large enterprise design partners: scoping the pilot, establishing success criteria before it begins, joining failure reviews, and determining what becomes generally available and what remains bespoke. TECHNICAL EXPECTATIONS Legion is looking for a product manager who builds, rather than one who directs others who build. In a typical week, this role involves: Writing and iterating on prompts and system prompts directly, and explaining why a change improved a behavior Standing up a working prototype of a proposed agent — tool definitions, structured outputs, retries, guardrails — before engineering is asked to build anything Using agentic coding tools (Claude Code or equivalent) daily: prototyping, data analysis, specification work, and reading the codebase behind your specifications Reviewing an execution trace and diagnosing whether a failure originates in a tool description, a retrieval gap, a context-window constraint, an under-specified output schema, or a genuine model limitation Building and running evaluation sets, and interpreting the results without a data scientist to translate them Holding an informed position on retrieval design, tool-use patterns, structured output, model routing, latency and cost trade-offs, and multi-tenant safety in enterprise SaaS Opening pull requests against our codebase — a prototype, a prompt change, an evaluation fixture, a specification stub. Pushing code is permitted and actively encouraged for product managers who want to work that way. It is not a requirement of the role, and the same review standards apply to everyone. Following model releases, agent frameworks, and protocol changes, and translating them into roadmap implications within days rather than quarters We recognize that this is a demanding technical bar for a product role. It reflects what the work actually requires. jobs.description: 1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that. But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens. We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. WHAT YOU LL DO

● AI agent development: Building and refining AI agents (e.g., Glean or custom agents) to automate knowledge retrieval, extract intelligence, and support decisions.

  • Experience using Claude Code or similar AI coding assistants to build or configure MCP servers
  • Experience integrating third-party systems through APIs and webhooks

Professional Competencies

jobs.title: Staff Engineer - Netsuite Business Systems
jobs.location: New York City; Palo Alto; United States
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Staff NetSuite Engineer with deep expertise in Order-to-Cash(O2C) & Record-to-Report (R2R) processes and accounting best practices. This role will serve as the technical and functional bridge between Finance and Technology, driving automation, process optimization, and scalability within our NetSuite environment.The successful candidate will lead the design, enhancement, and support of accounting systems that power our General Ledger (GL), Record-to-Report (R2R), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), including credit card process, Tax, and Treasury operations. As a senior member of the Finance Technology team, you will design and implement solutions that streamline accounting workflows, ensure compliance, and enhance financial reporting accuracy.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in New York City, NY or Palo Alto, CA or remotely in the United States.

Key Responsibilities

System Architecture & Development

  • Lead the design, configuration, and customization of NetSuite to support R2R and accounting processes (GL, journals, allocations, consolidations, fixed assets, intercompany eliminations)
  • Architect scalable NetSuite solutions that integrate seamlessly with upstream and downstream systems (e.g., procurement, billing, expense management, data lake)
  • Develop and maintain SuiteScript, SuiteFlow, SuiteTalk (Web Services), and RESTlets to support automation and integrations

Process & Accounting Alignment

  • Partner with Finance, Accounting, and Audit teams to translate accounting policies into system-enforced controls within NetSuite
  • Act as the primary point of contact for Finance teams including Accounting, Tax, Treasury and RevOps
  • Ensure compliance with SOX, GAAP, and audit requirements through configuration of role-based security, approvals, reconciliations, and audit trails
  • Optimize financial close processes (journals, reconciliations, accruals, consolidations) to reduce close cycle time
  • Build and enhance reporting frameworks (saved searches, financial reports, dashboards) to support accurate and timely financial reporting
  • Support compliance and audit requirements through appropriate controls and documentation

Technical Leadership

  • Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for NetSuite R2R and OTC processes, guiding engineers, administrators, and analysts
  • Serve as the primary technical advisor for business stakeholders
  • Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions with clear documentation
  • Establish engineering best practices in NetSuite development, including coding standards, testing, version control, and deployment
  • Drive system performance, scalability, and reliability improvements
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide architectural oversight for NetSuite-related initiatives

Integration & Data Management

  • Oversee integrations with external systems (e.g., payroll, banking, consolidation tools, CRM platforms like Salesforce, Coupa, Concur)
  • Partner with Data Engineering teams to ensure accurate data flow into finance data lake/warehouse for analytics and compliance reporting
  • Support data governance, master data management (chart of accounts, dimensions, entity hierarchy) in alignment with accounting standards

Qualifications

Required

  • 10+ years of NetSuite development/engineering experience with a focus on General Ledger and accounting modules
  • Strong knowledge of OTC and R2R processes including journal entries, close cycle, reconciliations, consolidations, and intercompany accounting
  • Proficiency in SuiteScript 1.0/2.0, SuiteFlow, SuiteTalk, REST APIs, and NetSuite integration patterns
  • Demonstrated experience implementing system-enforced financial controls and supporting SOX compliance
  • Solid understanding of US GAAP and accounting workflows
  • Experience with role-based security design, segregation of duties, and audit requirements

Preferred

  • Experience with global accounting operations (multi-entity, multi-currency, consolidations)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Familiarity with modern finance data stacks and BI/reporting tools
  • Prior experience in a high-growth, SaaS or technology company
  • Exposure to AI/automation in Finance (e.g., reconciliations, anomaly detection)

Soft Skills

  • Strong problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration abilities
  • Excellent communication skills, able to translate technical details into business terms
  • Leadership mindset with the ability to mentor and influence stakeholders
  • Detail-oriented with a commitment to accuracy and compliance

Why Join Us?

  • Impact at Scale: Play a strategic role in modernizing Finance Technology for a growing global organization
  • Innovation: Work at the intersection of Finance, Technology, and Compliance to deliver scalable impact
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with senior leaders in Finance, Procurement, and Technology to deliver systems that enable smarter decisions
  • Opportunity to lead technical strategy and influence how core accounting processes are automated and optimized

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend (Observability)
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Observability team builds the platform every Affirm engineer relies on to understand the behavior and performance of our systems. Our platform ingests 200+ TB/day of metrics, logs, and traces from hundreds of services across 80+ Kubernetes clusters, and when a user s checkout fails, our data is how engineers find out why. Over the next year, we’re moving to wide events, with one context-rich event per request, improving the signal-to-noise ratio to make debugging faster. We’re also introducing log sampling and building observability best practices into agentic development and code review, so that AI-assisted code is well instrumented by default.

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to be the technical lead for Observability. You’ll spend most of your time hands-on while defining the roadmap, driving cross-functional projects, mentoring a team of six engineers, and partnering closely with infrastructure and product teams.


What You ll Do

· You will own the architecture of Affirm’s telemetry pipeline, balancing reliability, query performance, and cost at 200+ TB/day.
· You will design log sampling strategies that significantly reduce volume and cost without losing the signal engineers need during incidents.
· You will shape how observability fits into agentic development, so that AI coding agents and code review catch instrumentation gaps before code ships.
· You will be responsible for setting technical strategy for your team on a year-long time scale, and help your team tie it together with critical, business-impacting projects.
· You will collaborate across teams in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics to ensure technical sustainability, risks and trade-offs are well understood and managed.
· You will act as a force-multiplier for your team through your definition and advocacy of technical solutions and operational processes.
· You take ownership of your team’s operations and availability by ensuring you have the right monitoring, triage rotations, playbooks, polcities, testing and alerting in place to support “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
· You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
· You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.


What We Look For

· You have 8+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
· You have an extensive track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL, Flink and Kubernetes.
· You have built or operated high-volume telemetry systems (metrics, logs, and/or traces) using technologies like OpenTelemetry, Kafka, and Terraform.
· You have a well-informed point of view on modern observability practices such as structured and wide events, sampling, cardinality management, and SLOs.
· You have driven adoption of a platform standard across many engineering teams, through both tooling and engagement.
· You have experience delivering major features, system components or deprecating existing functionality in a system through the definition of a technical and execution plan. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
· You thrive in ambiguity, and are comfortable moving from low level language idioms all the way to the architecture of large systems to understand how they work.
· Your growth and impact trajectory demonstrates that you have mastered gathering and iterating on feedback from your engineering and cross-functional peers.
· You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
· This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn t a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you re ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer on the Compliance Automation team within the Platform group, you ll build the AI systems that are reimagining how Coinbase executes compliance operations at scale. This team designs and ships Agentic AI solutions that automate compliance processes, from investigation workflows to decision support, replacing manual operations with intelligent, auditable, and measurable automation. You ll own the ML architecture for production compliance agents, driving technical decisions on model selection, grounding, guardrails, and evaluation while partnering with Compliance stakeholders to ensure every automated output meets regulatory standards.

What You ll Do:

  • Architect and build production Agentic AI systems for compliance automation, including LLM-powered agents, orchestration pipelines, and decision support workflows that replace manual compliance processes
  • Own the ML technical direction for compliance agents, driving model selection, prompt engineering, grounding strategies, and guardrail design that ensure agent outputs are accurate, auditable, and regulatorily defensible
  • Design and implement evaluation and measurement frameworks that quantify agent performance, detect hallucinations and drift, and provide the auditability compliance teams and regulators require
  • Partner with Compliance, Legal, and Operations stakeholders to translate complex regulatory workflows into automatable technical specifications, identifying which processes are candidates for full automation vs. human-in-the-loop augmentation
  • Mentor engineers on ML system design, LLM application patterns, and responsible AI practices, raising the team s technical bar for production AI systems

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 8+ years in machine learning and software engineering, with demonstrated experience shipping LLM-based or Agentic AI applications to production
  • Deep expertise in LLM application development, including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), grounding techniques, hallucination reduction, and agent orchestration frameworks
  • Proven track record building evaluation and measurement systems for ML models in production, including monitoring for drift, accuracy degradation, and output quality at scale
  • Strong Python proficiency with hands-on experience in GenAI frameworks and ML infrastructure (e.g., LangChain, vector databases, Airflow, Spark, or equivalent orchestration and data processing tools)
  • Experience in compliance, regulatory technology, financial crimes, or similarly regulated domains where auditability, explainability, and correctness of automated decisions are critical
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality

jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world s biggest financial problems. We re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn t a place for complacency, it s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Capacity & Efficiency Engineering team builds the software that manages, governs, and reduces Robinhood s AWS cloud spend across compute, databases, and storage, operating at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, data engineering, and FinOps. We own the full lifecycle of cloud cost, from attribution and forecasting to automation that rightsizes infrastructure at fleet scale and keeps a bursty, latency-sensitive trading platform both reliable and cost-effective. Our work carries CEO-level visibility, has already driven millions of dollars in annualized savings, and is delivered in close partnership with Infrastructure, Finance, and product engineering teams across Robinhood.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the team, you will own capacity and efficiency for Robinhood s storage and database fleet, from Aurora clusters to S3 and the caches and volumes in between. You will build the systems that size this fleet to demand: Aurora reader counts and writer sizes set from market hours, declared events, and live load instead of fixed schedules; databases, caches, and volumes rightsized to what they actually use; and S3 data kept in the right storage class, with lifecycle rules that keep growth in check. You will take each from recommendations the Storage team validates to automation that safely applies its own changes in production. This is a 0-to-1 build with measurable impact on reliability at market peaks and on the AWS bill.

 

This role is based in our Bellevue, WA office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Build forecast-driven capacity planning for the storage and database fleet, turning traffic history, load tests, and known events (market open, earnings, IPOs, promotions) into plans that scale up ahead and back down after, with an expiry on every temporary capacity hold
  • Design and build a capacity planner for Aurora that sets reader counts and writer instance sizes from demand and load signals (IOPS, CPU, connections, replica lag), replacing fixed scaling schedules
  • Rightsize databases, caches, and block storage (RDS, ElastiCache, DynamoDB, EBS) on instance size, provisioned IOPS and throughput, and idle capacity, and keep them right-sized as load changes
  • Own S3 efficiency at scale: storage class and Intelligent-Tiering strategy, lifecycle and retention policies, noncurrent versions and incomplete uploads, and request costs, using Storage Lens and inventory data
  • Take every recommendation to closed-loop automation with guardrails, progressive rollout, and rollback, in partnership with the Storage infrastructure team, handling constraints such as AWS capacity shortages, fallback instance types, and connection pooling
  • Measure outcomes in cost and reliability (savings against baseline, forecast error, utilization, capacity left behind after events) and share our forecasts with the pod rightsizing system so compute and storage scale together

What you bring

  • Deep hands-on experience operating AWS storage and databases at scale, especially Aurora or RDS (MySQL or PostgreSQL) and S3, including replication, read scaling, storage classes, and lifecycle management
  • Capacity planning and forecasting experience: modeling time-series demand, load testing, and translating traffic into instance counts, sizes, and storage growth
  • A track record of rightsizing infrastructure from utilization data (CPU, memory, IOPS, throughput, bytes stored) without hurting latency or availability
  • Strong Python or Go engineering, with experience building automation that safely modifies production infrastructure (guardrails, progressive rollout, and rollback built in), not just systems that observe and report
  • Familiarity with AWS storage and database pricing (S3 storage classes and requests, Aurora I/O-Optimized vs. Standard, Reserved Instances) is a strong plus
  • Experience with bursty, event-driven workloads (trading, payments, ticketing) or with Spark, Airflow, or Kubernetes is a plus

  • Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.

jobs.description:
Join the Future of Security at Netskope

Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK) is a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era. We secure and accelerate cloud, data, and AI in real time, everywhere. Thousands of customers, including more than 30 of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and the powerful NewEdge network to gain full visibility and control without performance trade-offs.

At Netskope, our technology is driven by our greatest strength: our people. We believe that belonging powers innovation, and success is both personal and organizational. We embrace differences in gender, ethnicity, beliefs, ability, and identity, creating an environment where every voice is heard and respected. We empower our employees to bring their authentic selves to work, grow their careers through continuous education and mentorship, and lead with transparency and curiosity. Join a team where you belong, where you are encouraged to be an entrepreneur, and where together, we continue to redefine the landscape of security.

Visit Careers at Netskope to learn more. Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

About the team

We are seeking an exceptional  Engineer to build next-generation security analytics and AI-powered capabilities within Netskope s platform. This is a high-impact individual contributor role for an engineer who excels at solving complex technical problems at the intersection of artificial intelligence, large-scale data systems, and cybersecurity.

As a Sr.Staff Engineer, you will own the architecture and delivery of cloud services that handle large volumes of data and traffic for enterprise customers. You’ll set technical direction, raise the engineering bar for the team, and ship.

What s in it for you

This is your chance to work at the absolute intersection of Artificial Intelligence, large-scale Data Systems, and Cybersecurity. You won t just use existing tools; you will be designing and implementing sophisticated, cutting-edge systems that fundamentally change how enterprises detect and respond to threats.

What you will be doing

  • Design, build, and operate scalable, high-performance backend services in Python on AWS
  • Architect distributed systems with sound tradeoffs across consistency, availability, latency, cost, and operational complexity
  • Provide technical leadership across the full project lifecycle, from discovery and design through delivery and operations
  • Use AI-native development workflows (Claude Code) to accelerate design, implementation, testing, code review, and debugging, and help the team develop effective practices for doing so
  • Partner with product and customers to turn requirements into well-scoped, well-designed features
  • Investigate and resolve production issues, and drive improvements to observability, reliability, and incident response
  • Improve engineering processes, CI/CD, and developer tooling

Required skills and experience

  • 12+ years of software development experience, including building enterprise-grade backend systems
  • Expert-level Python, with strong experience building production backend services and REST APIs
  • Deep experience with AWS and cloud architecture (e.g., compute, storage, networking, messaging, IAM, managed data services)
  • Strong distributed systems fundamentals: scalability, fault tolerance, concurrency, data consistency, and event-driven or asynchronous architectures
  • Solid knowledge of databases and data stores, both relational and NoSQL (OLTP and OLAP)
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes
  • Demonstrated fluency with AI-native development, including daily, hands-on use of Claude Code or similar agentic coding tools. You can describe how you decompose work for an AI agent, review and validate its output critically, and maintain quality, security, and maintainability while moving faster.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced environment where you might lead a design one week and fix a critical bug or improve CI the next

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience building production LLM agents, including orchestration frameworks like LangGraph, ReAct-style reasoning and tool-use loops, and deep agent patterns (planning, sub-agents, long-running tasks)
  • Experience with observability tooling and SLO-driven operations
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CDK, CloudFormation)
  • Experience with streaming and messaging systems (Kafka, Kinesis, SQS/SNS)

Education

  • BSCS or equivalent required, MSCS or equivalent strongly preferred
