jobs.title: Staff+ Software Engineer, Deployment
jobs.location: Remote-Friendly (Travel-Required) | San Francisco, CA | Seattle, WA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Every change to Anthropic s software has to reach production somehow: new code, runtime configuration, feature flags, infrastructure changes. Our team builds the systems those changes travel through. Our mission is to give every team at Anthropic a fast, safe, and predictable path from change to production.

We sit within Anthropic s Infrastructure organization and own pipelines, staged rollouts, health-gated promotion, and rollback, along with runtime configuration, feature flags, and the systems that deliver code and artifacts to machines across a very large fleet. You ll own a meaningful part of this end to end, from design through operating it in production.

If you want your work to shape how fast and how safely Anthropic ships, this could be a great fit.

Key responsibilities

  • Set technical direction for major parts of the deployment platform and own them end to end: design, implementation, and operations
  • Build rollout safety into the platform, including progressive delivery, health-gated promotion, automatic pause and rollback, and deploy controls that teams manage themselves
  • Design APIs and abstractions that work equally well for engineers and for AI agents
  • Extend the platform to new workload types and runtimes, from Kubernetes to serverless and edge platforms
  • Build and operate runtime configuration and feature flag systems with validation, gradual rollout, and fast rollback
  • Build infrastructure-as-code workflows that many teams rely on for safe, routine changes
  • Scale artifact distribution so code and configuration reach machines quickly and efficiently
  • Partner with Security so that the path to production is secure by default, with verifiable builds, least-privilege access, and auditable changes
  • Work directly with teams across Anthropic to understand their deployment needs and bring their workloads onto the platform
  • Take part in on-call and incident response, and turn what you learn into guardrails that prevent the same problem from recurring

Minimum qualifications

  • Proficiency in at least one backend or systems programming language, such as Rust, Go, C++, or Java
  • Experience leading the design, building, and operation of distributed systems or infrastructure in production, including technical direction across teams
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and containerized workloads, such as Kubernetes on AWS or GCP
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building deployment, release, or change management systems at large scale
  • Experience with production on-call and incident response
  • Experience with Rust in production
  • Experience with progressive delivery and GitOps tooling, such as Argo CD or Argo Rollouts
  • Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, including controllers and operators
  • Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code systems at scale, including state management and locking
  • Experience building feature flag, experimentation, or dynamic configuration systems
  • Experience with artifact or package distribution, such as OCI registries, Nix, or content-addressed storage
  • Experience with software supply chain security, such as signed build provenance
  • Experience building high-throughput workflow engines or control planes backed by relational databases
  • Experience building internal developer platforms and leading adoption across many teams
  • Experience using AI agents in your own engineering work, or building systems that agents operate

Representative projects

  • Build operator controls for progressive rollouts, including pause and resume that preserve rollout state
  • Design a deployment engine built on fine-grained targets and their dependencies, so each change rolls out exactly where it needs to
  • Build cluster-health-aware rollouts that steer around unhealthy clusters
  • Add a new workload type to the platform, including its rollout, verification, and rollback behavior
  • Design a deployment control plane that handles sharp bursts of agent-driven traffic
  • Design a distribution system that delivers configuration and artifacts to every machine in the fleet as demand grows

jobs.title: Revenue FP&A Director
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?
Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


Position description
We are seeking a Revenue Finance Director to join our FP&A team and own how Sonar forecasts, plans, and prices its revenue. You will drive forecast accuracy, partner cross-functionally to optimize revenue, and give executives clear recommendations on revenue strategy. This is a hands-on role for a self-starter who pushes back with data, builds their own solutions, and leads our AI-first approach to FP&A.
 
What you will do
Own the Revenue Forecast and Raise Its AccuracyOwn Sonar’s revenue forecast end to end (bookings, billings, and revenue) across monthly and quarter-end cycles, with a clear view of where we will land and why.Treat forecast accuracy as your personal scorecard. Track misses by segment, motion, and root cause, and run retrospectives on material variances.Challenge cross-functional teams on conversion, renewal, and timing assumptions, and drive the changes needed to make the forecast more reliable.Build driver-based models using leading indicators (pipeline, usage, renewals, price) and ASC 606 treatment; incorporating consumption based revenue models.
Lead long-range and annual revenue planning, translating targets across the P&L.
Turn analysis into executive level recommendations
Shape revenue strategy and bring a position and options to the CFO. Build Board, investor, and ELT materials.
Evaluate pricing and packaging changes (list price, discounting, renewal uplift, plan mix) and quantify the impact on topline and margin.
Partner with Deal Desk, Pricing, and R&D Finance to analyze margin, pricing profiles, and deal structures (discounts, multi-year terms, ramps, payment terms, commitments).
Build deal guardrails and approval frameworks that balance growth, margin, and revenue recognition, advise on non-standard deals, and run post-close analysis.
Build with AI and Automate
Default to AI first. Before adding a manual process, ask whether an AI-enabled workflow can do it better, and build it yourself.
Ship automations that go beyond text generation: forecast roll-ups, variance analysis, anomaly detection, deal and pricing analytics, and agentic workflows.
Define where AI should automate, where human judgment stays in the loop, and how outputs are validated, with appropriate controls and data security.
Roll Up Your Sleeves and Self-Initiate
Stay hands-on in the data and the models. Spot problems and opportunities on your own, propose the fix, and drive it to completion without waiting to be asked.
Partner with Controllership, Accounting, Finance Ops, RevOps, and Deal Desk to ensure data integrity and accurate, streamlined reporting.

Experience and qualifications
The ideal candidate will: 
Required Experience10+ years of progressive finance experience (FP&A, revenue finance, or commercial and strategic finance), with significant time in high-growth SaaS or tech.Ownership of a revenue, bookings, or ARR forecast at scale, with a proven record of improving accuracy and working knowledge of revenue accounting.A history of pricing, packaging, or commercial recommendations that executives adopted, grounded in margin, discounting, and price realization analysis.Experience with consumption based modelsDemonstrated influence: you challenge senior leaders with data, hold your position under pushback, and change how others work.Hands-on AI experience in finance workflows, with specific automations you built and shipped (not just prompts for polishing emails), using tools such as Claude or ChatGPT.Expert-level, driver-based financial modeling, and the ability to communicate complex recommendations clearly to executives, the Board, and investors.A self-starter and builder who takes ownership, moves fast, and does the detailed work personally.Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related field.
Preferred QualificationsMBA, or investment banking, consulting, or strategic finance experience.Experience with various pricing models.Hands-on experience with enterprise planning and finance systems (e.g., NetSuite, Pigment, Salesforce).Experience building AI agents or workflows (e.g., Claude Cowork).

jobs.title: Head of Growth
jobs.description:
About Prefect

Prefect builds automation for an unpredictable world. The last decade of automation was about protecting workflows from unpredictability; in the agentic era, unpredictability is the point. Our mission is to give people confidence in automated work, whether that work is a mission-critical data pipeline or a fleet of AI agents.

In August 2026, Prefect and Dagster, competitors for eight years, joined forces to build the next generation of automation infrastructure. Today, our ecosystem includes Dagster, the data platform; Prefect, the agent platform; and FastMCP, the leading open-source developer framework for the MCP ecosystem. Together, our open-source and commercial products are trusted by Fortune 500 companies, data innovators, and high-growth technology companies around the world.

We think of our culture as the operating system of the company. We’ve carefully created a supportive, high-performance environment that empowers our team to do the best work of their careers, have meaningful impact, and continue growing personally and professionally. We’re a remote-first team that values high standards, ownership, and thoughtful collaboration.


ROLE SUMMARY

We have an audience most companies our size would be thrilled to have. FastMCP https://github.com/PrefectHQ/fastmcp is the leading framework for building MCP servers, with 27,000+ GitHub stars and a docs site developers read start to finish. Prefect's open-source orchestrator has been trusted by data teams for years. This year we acquired Dagster, which brings a second large open-source community with us.

With that opportunity in mind we're hiring a Head of Growth. You will set the strategy for how that audience becomes revenue and own the path from audience to signup to activated user to qualified pipeline, across the Prefect https://www.prefect.io/prefect/cloud, FastMCP Gateway https://www.prefect.io/horizon, and Dagster https://dagster.io funnels. That means deciding which motions we invest in and in what order, then building them: attribution, lifecycle and email, paid and organic acquisition, CRO and experimentation. You'll have a budget, a number to hit, and the mandate to build the growth function around what works.

You'll start as the only person in growth and build the team as results earn it. You'll report to our Chief Growth Officer, sit at the table where company priorities get set, and work daily with the Marketing, Sales, Product and Engineering leads.

Time zones: Anywhere in the continental US. We're remote-first. We have a slight preference for candidates near New York, the Bay Area, or Washington D.C., where our spaces and most of our events are, but it isn't a requirement.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

In your first year you will:

 - Set the growth strategy and own the number. Decide how Prefect turns its audience across FastMCP, Dagster and Prefect open source into revenue: which motions we invest in, in what order, and what we expect back. Bring a plan with a budget and a pipeline target to leadership each quarter, and be accountable for hitting it.

 - Build the funnel system. Model every major demand source with a baseline, a conversion target and an owner. Decide which stages we fix first, and ship the fixes yourself until there is someone else to do it.

 - Run acquisition end to end. Own the paid and organic budget, channel mix, landing pages and CRO. Report cost per activated user and pipeline per dollar, reallocate budget monthly on that evidence, and kill what doesn't work quickly and out loud.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Spend
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Spend team, you'll lead the architecture and development of backend systems that support Airwallex's financial operating layer for modern businesses. You'll shape technical direction across corporate cards, expenses, bills, and procurement while helping build reliable financial workflows at scale.

 - Lead the architecture, design, and evolution of complex backend systems that power Airwallex's Spend products, including corporate cards, expenses, bills, and procurement.

 - Drive cross-team technical initiatives and shape the long-term engineering strategy for scalable, secure, and reliable financial workflows.

 - Own backend services end to end, from technical discovery and design through implementation, testing, deployment, observability, and ongoing maintenance.

 - Raise the bar on system design, API quality, testing, reliability, and performance while helping teams make sound technical trade-offs.

 - Mentor engineers and collaborate closely with Product, Design, Infrastructure, Risk, and Compliance to deliver dependable solutions for global businesses.

You'll work from our Singapore office five days a week.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Essentials

 - A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

 - 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including experience in technical leadership roles.

 - Proven experience architecting and scaling backend systems and APIs in production.

 - Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.

 - Expertise in at least one backend language, such as Java, Kotlin, Go, or Python.

 - Deep understanding of REST API design and modern backend frameworks, such as Spring Boot.

 - Experience with cloud infrastructure, such as AWS or GCP, and container orchestration tools such as Kubernetes.

 - Strong commitment to code quality, reliability, and performance.

Preferred

 - Experience leading cross-team initiatives and influencing technical direction at a system-wide level.

 - Proficiency with observability and monitoring tools, such as Grafana, Prometheus, or Splunk.

 - Familiarity with security and compliance considerations in financial services.

 - A passion for mentoring and helping others grow.




YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

 - You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

 - You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching. Quality and accountability aren't external expectations, they're internal ones.

 - You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work.

 - You value in-person collaboration and are happy being in the office five days a week.




LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

The Spend team builds Airwallex's financial operating layer for modern businesses, bringing together corporate cards, expenses, bills, and procurement on top of our accounts, payments, and issuing infrastructure. We're building AI that makes real decisions about expenses, policies, and payments, aiming to get 95%+ of submissions down to one click, while every workflow still has to hold up across multi-entity businesses, currencies, and audit trails. This is a team for people who want broad ownership across product, data, and AI, while the roadmap is still being defined. If you want to build production AI for real financial workflows that directly change how businesses operate, this is where that work happens.

jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer, San Francisco
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

Airwallex’s corporate network needs to remain secure, reliable and scalable as our global footprint grows. You’ll own critical network infrastructure and help shape the systems, practices and team capabilities that support our people across regions.

 - Build the foundations of Airwallex’s corporate network and help shape the team structure and capabilities needed as we grow.

 - Design, deploy and maintain secure, highly available LAN, WAN, wireless and VPN infrastructure across our global offices and regions.

 - Design multi-region hybrid network patterns connecting physical offices, data centres and cloud environments, including AWS and Alibaba Cloud.

 - Configure and operate global connectivity across international leased lines and domestic internet connections, working across mixed-vendor environments.

 - Lead the configuration and troubleshooting of routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers and wireless access points.

 - Own CorpNet as a first responder and escalation point for complex network incidents, taking issues through to resolution and completing after-action reviews.

 - Partner with CorpSec, ProdSec, Engineering, Product, IT Engineering, Workplace and other teams to integrate network solutions and support business initiatives.

 - Work with IT Engineering and IT Support to troubleshoot endpoint network issues and build core networking capability across the team.

 - Use infrastructure-as-code and automation, including Terraform and Ansible, to improve network consistency and operational efficiency.

 - Develop and maintain network documentation, including diagrams, configurations and operational procedures.

 - Evaluate networking technologies and solutions that support Airwallex’s continued growth.

 - Mentor and coach network engineers, share knowledge, support skill development, manage performance and help attract strong talent.

 - Participate in a global follow-the-sun on-call rotation for corporate networking issues, with occasional after-hours or weekend work for network upgrades where needed to minimise business disruption.

You’ll work from our San Francisco office three days a week.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


ESSENTIALS

 - Senior-level experience designing, implementing and maintaining Juniper and Palo Alto Networks solutions.

 - Demonstrated experience working in a global, multi-vendor networking environment, including technologies such as Juniper, Palo Alto, Cisco and Aruba.

 - Experience with networking solutions for mainland China and international connectivity.

 - Strong fundamentals in Wi-Fi technology and endpoint engineering; hardware experience is a plus, including Juniper Mist, Cisco Meraki or Aruba.

 - Expert command-line configuration skills across networking hardware and vendors, including JunOS and IOS.

 - Experience operating and troubleshooting complex corporate network environments.

 - Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

 - Ability to move quickly and make sound decisions with incomplete information when supporting a global business.


PREFERRED

 - Strong knowledge of Palo Alto Networks GlobalProtect, Prisma and Prisma Cloud.

 - Experience managing or leading a team of network engineers, ideally in a startup or scaling environment.

 - A bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field, alongside five or more years of relevant experience.

 - Understanding of common identity standards, including SAML, OAuth and SSO.

 - Experience with cloud infrastructure, including AWS or GCP.

 - Understanding of RBAC, ABAC, PBAC, ACLs and common access-management principles in security and corporate IT environments.

 - Experience working with SaaS-based systems and applications.

 - Strong understanding of MDM systems across macOS and Windows, including Kandji, Jamf and Intune.


YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

 - You’re comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA.

 - You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

 - You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

 - You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.


LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

Engineering at Airwallex is for people who want to define a category, not maintain one. We're reimagining how businesses interact with finance from the ground up, AI- and agent-native by default, think agent wallets, agentic bookkeepers, and spend-management autopilots, with APIs designed for agents as first-class users. The hard part is trust: building agent-native systems precise enough to move real money autonomously, on top of a decade of real infrastructure. jobs.title: Staff Engineer | Voyagu
jobs.description: Role: Staff Engineer (Integrations / Supply, air travel) Company: Voyagu Location: Fully remote, Europe preferred. European time zone; about two hours of difference is fine. About eight hours online, and some overlap with US time zones helps because many users are there. Job Type: Full-time. Contract model is flexible: contractor, payroll provider or direct employment. About Voyagu Voyagu builds one platform that runs several travel businesses. Today the focus is air travel. The platform covers client management (CRM), ERP modules for finance and accounting, travel operations, and integrations with travel supply systems. The model is offline travel: agencies that sell through people. Voyagu does not sell the software and does not plan to, but agencies work with it in different models. It is a bootstrap scaleup, so teams are lean and money is counted. Development leans heavily on AI. Teams of AI agents run big features under a business operator and a technical operator. Sometimes this turns two half-years of work into two weeks. It does not always work. When code is cheap, product vision and architecture become the bottleneck, and that is where you come in. This role owns the integrations and supply direction. Air travel alone is deep: every airline has its own distribution channels and APIs. You would lead one of five platform development streams and report to the CTO. There is no product manager in between, and you work directly with the founder and other business stakeholders. The team has no one with your profile today, so you would be the first. What you are expected to do Technical ownership Lead the integrations and supply direction as its technical owner. Build integrations with GDS systems. Voyagu works with one today and needs more. Connect airline direct APIs and non-GDS protocols across multiple sources. Handle servicing after sale: changes, cancellations, refunds, and group bookings split into parts. Work with live, real-time availability. Seat availability does not depend on price. Prevent costly errors. One missed booking can mean tens of thousands of dollars. Design for reliability, for example with idempotency, so nothing is paid or bought twice. Keep the solution sized to Voyagu’s scale and avoid over-design. This is not internet-scale work. Keep the system stable. Speed and error rate are the measures. Vision and delivery Shape the technical vision with stakeholders and defend it. They will challenge it. Expect no ready-made tasks. Business stakeholders give you a direction, not a finished task. Turn the agreed platform capabilities into features and give estimates. Several dozen capabilities are written down, such as search and booking. Success means Voyagu accepts your estimates and you deliver them, or come close. Part of the plan will be agreed together with you. AI-driven development Build and direct teams of AI coding agents instead of writing code by hand. Explain and defend how to use AI effectively. Bring AI practices that are as good as Voyagu’s, or better. Team Lead the two people already working in this direction, once you have onboarded. Hire as little as possible. Hiring is a last resort. Long term the direction may grow to one to three people. What you need to succeed You have worked in the travel domain, especially on integrations with supply systems. About two or more years is likely enough. You understand booking versus ticket, and the statuses and states of each. You have owned a large piece of a product, not a small slice. You work at staff or senior level, as architect and technical lead. You understand what Voyagu does and why, and you talk well with stakeholders. You use AI well beyond the beginner level and have a clear view on how to use it effectively. You believe small teams work. You do not think in big organisations. You work in a European time zone; ideally you are based in Europe. You speak Russian: engineering works mostly in Russian. Business teams speak English, and English B2 is enough. Nice to have: you have seen both corporate and lean startup worlds, or a bootstrap scaleup. You may be an ex-founder or a small-company CTO who stayed hands-on. Nice to have: you have run teams of agents, not only asked an agent to write a feature. Nice to have: vendor-side experience building for end users. Python is the current main stack, but language skill is not important. Not required: high-load experience, writing agent skills, or deep C#/legacy aviation knowledge. What you get You own a whole direction, with responsibility handed over fully. You are the technical lead for integrations and supply, with no product-manager layer in between. You work with AI agent teams. Voyagu will invest heavily in tokens and compute where it pays off. You can bring AI practices better than Voyagu’s own, and the team will share theirs. A large, technically hard platform: real-time inventory, many sources, money at stake. A lean environment with few meetings and flexible hours. Fully remote in Europe, with flexible contract models. Equity is not standard, but it is negotiable for an exceptional candidate. How to apply Apply through hirehire, the agency running this search for Voyagu. The process has three stages: an engineering interview with the CTO, a travel-domain interview with the founder, and a practical case with a defence. jobs.title: Tech Lead - Python & AI
jobs.description:
This is a full-time, permanent opportunity for candidates based in the UK and authorised to work without sponsorship.

This position also requires travel to client sites with travel expenses covered by the company.

About Nearform

Nearform is an independent team of data & AI experts, engineers, and designers who build intelligent digital solutions and capability at pace. We create AI-enabled solutions that enhance digital experiences, empower developers, and deliver measurable results. In these ways, we partner with ambitious enterprises to deliver enduring impact.

Our deep expertise in solving the world’s most complex digital problems, along with our collaborative, people-first approach, enables enterprises to build breakthrough products and modernise legacy systems by unleashing the power of AI.

Today, our team of 500 experts in 20+ countries is trusted by leading enterprises including Lululemon, Puma, Sun Life, Starbucks, Travelex, Virgin Media 02, and Walmart.  

As part of our Engineering function, you will work closely with clients to translate complex business requirements into innovative digital products.
Whether you are a Senior Engineer, Tech Lead, or DevOps Engineer, you will collaborate with distributed teams, leveraging cutting-edge technologies to build secure, high-performance applications. Our Nearform engineers are known for building high quality, scalable solutions that solve real world problems.

About the Technical Lead Role:

As a Technical Lead at Nearform, you will be responsible for leading and guiding development teams while working directly with clients to translate business and technical requirements into impactful applications. However, as you’ll likely work on a variety of projects in your time here, your responsibilities may also include:

  • Provide technical and line-management leadership to your development team.
  • Take responsibility for the successful delivery of projects.
  • Identify and resolve blockers before they become issues.
  • Ensure best practices in software development, DevOps, and agile methodologies are upheld within the team.
  • Work directly with clients, translating requirements into technical briefs.
  • Shape and define architectural decisions ensuring scalability, security, and maintainability.
  • Provide updates to client and Nearform leadership to ensure clear understanding of project status and drive good decision-making.

What we are looking for in this person:

  • Significant experience in software engineering and 2+ years of experience leading projects and mentoring as a Technical Lead. For this particular role, we are looking for professional experience Python.
  • Experience with AI application development and Agentic frameworks and platforms (e.g., LangGraph, Agentspace, etc.)
  • Experience working directly with clients or customers to understand technical requirements.
  • Proven experience working with Kubernetes for container orchestration.
  • Strong CI/CD experience, including hands-on work with Terraform, Helm, and other cloud-native IaC technologies.
  • Deep understanding of observability practices, with practical experience using OpenTelemetry (OTel) and related tooling.
  • Experience leading software engineering teams through technical delivery and either direct line management or mentoring.
  • Deep understanding of agile ways of working, best practices and design patterns.
  • Deep understanding of test-driven development and testing best practices.
  • Deep understanding of version control tools, e.g. Git.
  • Understanding of DevOps practices and cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Understanding of operational concerns (such as monitoring, performance testing, security considerations, accessibility, GDPR)
  • Empathy and people skills


Benefits and Perks we offer at Nearform

  • Annual Company Bonus - We all help Nearform to hit company goals so we all receive a share of the profits on an annual basis in line with company performance. 
  • Work Remotely and Flexibly - We have a genuine dedication to work/life balance. Our flexible working culture allows you to work around what matters - school run, no problem! 
  • Paid Time Off Package - We offer an annual leave of 25 days plus public holidays. We also offer sick leave, marriage leave and many more.
  • Remote Working Allowance - Every 2 years, you will have a budget of up to €1250 (equivalent in GBP) to help you set up a comfortable and productive workspace in addition to your essential equipment provided by Nearform when you join.
  • Training and Development Allowance - Nearform is committed to supporting and investing in employees’ ongoing learning and professional development. You will be encouraged to pursue relevant learning opportunities that support your growth and the growth of others, subject to manager approval.
  • Healthcare - It’s important to always take care of your health, so we offer additional private healthcare here at Nearform. If you wish to learn more about the plan offered feel free to reach out to our team.
  • Pension & Insurances - We offer a pension match of up to 5% and In

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Billing & Monetization
jobs.description: We are looking for a skilled and passionate Senior Software Engineer, Billing & Monetization to join our Billing team in the Amsterdam office. Working in a high-growth scale-up, you’ll have the unique opportunity to drive innovation at scale while contributing to a company transforming the world of audit and finance. About the role: Every customer's path through DataSnipper, from first sign-up to first agent run to renewal, runs on the systems this team owns: how customers get in, what they are entitled to, and how AI usage turns into revenue. As we move from seats to usage and credits for our agentic products, these systems become as strategic as the product itself, and they have to be fast, accurate and trustworthy. This is a hands-on role for an engineer who cares about correctness as much as speed, and wants to see the commercial impact of their code. Why DataSnipper? The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast. If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way. What You Will Do: Metering & Billing Build real-time usage metering and credit consumption for our agentic products, accurate down to the individual agent run Design pricing and rating logic that supports seats, usage, credits and enterprise contract terms without a rewrite for every new plan Integrate with billing, payment and finance systems (e.g. Stripe , CRM and ERP), and keep them reconciled Licensing & Onboarding Build the entitlements service that decides what every user and tenant can do, enforced consistently across the Excel add-in and Alwin Own the onboarding flow end-to-end: sign-up, trials, provisioning, SSO and SCIM, and the first-run experience Instrument activation and conversion, and work with Product and Design to remove friction Engineering & Collaboration Build systems where correctness is non-negotiable : idempotent, auditable, observable and secure Own it end-to-end , from design to production in our Python stack on Azure through to the web and add-in front ends. Anticipate issues, and shape the team's technical direction without waiting to be asked Influence across functions : partner with Product, Finance, Sales and Customer Success, using data and empathy to turn pricing, packaging and licensing decisions into robust implementation Raise the bar through code reviews, mentorship and clear, balanced feedback, and ask for the same in return What You Bring: Must-Have 6+ years in software engineering, with strong, production-grade backend experience (ideally Python ) Experience building billing, metering, licensing or entitlement systems in production Solid experience building data-driven web APIs and distributed systems on a major cloud platform A strong grasp of financial correctness : idempotency, consistency, reconciliation and audit trails Strong fundamentals in software architecture , system design and data modelling Product mindset: you care about activation, conversion and revenue as much as uptime Sound judgment under ambiguity: you balance speed and accuracy, stay calm when plans change, and reprioritise without being told Proficient with AI-assisted engineering (we use Claude Code) Excellent communication; you can work directly with Finance and commercial teams to define what "correct" means Nice-to-Have Usage- or credit-based billing in production, including AI token metering and cost attribution Billing and payment platforms (e.g. Stripe ), CRM (e.g. Salesforce ) and ERP integrations Identity and provisioning: SSO , SCIM , multi-tenant account models Product-led growth : self-serve sign-up, trials, in-product upgrades Revenue recognition, invoicing and tax basics Event streaming and high-volume data pipelines Scale-up experience, ideally in SaaS, fintech or audit tech What We Offer: Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share the company's success and growth Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energized NS business card

jobs.title: Senior Field Marketing Manager - Public Sector, Federal & Defense
jobs.description:
Datadog is looking for an experienced Senior Field Marketing Manager - Public Sector to own marketing strategy and execution for our U.S. Federal and Defense business. In this role, you will build and run an integrated, multi-channel field marketing program across Federal Civilian agencies, Federal Systems Integrators, the Department of War (DoW/DoD), and the Defense Industrial Base. 

This will span mission-focused events, executive briefings, account-based programs, and digital campaigns, in close partnership with Public Sector sales leadership.

The role is a full-funnel mandate with the latitude to prioritize the programs that move pipeline in a market where the buying cycle, the procurement path, and the compliance bar all look different from commercial tech.

Datadog for Government operates in a FedRAMP High-certified, AWS GovCloud (US) environment, with work underway toward DoD Impact Level 5. You will be the marketer who translates that platform and compliance story into mission language for program offices, CIOs, and the integrators who build for them.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You ll Do:

  • Set the strategy for, and execute, the integrated Federal and Defense field marketing plan — aligned to Public Sector sales priorities, target agencies and programs, and pipeline goals. You will propose the pipeline target for this segment, not just deliver against one handed to you.
  • Build segment-specific program tracks for Federal Civilian, Federal Systems Integrator, DoW/DoD, and Defense Industrial Base audiences, recognizing that each buys on a different cycle and responds to different proof.
  • Own Datadog’s presence across the federal event calendar, from large-scale defense and civilian conferences to service association events, agency industry days, virtual events, and targeted executive gatherings.
  • Build the program formats that move federal buyers through the funnel — executive briefings, technical workshops, roundtables, and webinars — owning Federal and Defense field marketing budget, audience strategy, target account recruitment, and follow-through.
  • Work with Product Marketing to shape Federal-specific messaging and content: FedRAMP High, IL5 progress, data residency, U.S.-persons operations, continuous ATO, zero trust, and the compliance frameworks (NIST 800-53, CMMC, DISA STIGs) your audience is actually measured against.
  • Partner with Demand Generation on campaign strategy and execution. Adapt nurture tracks and email motions for a federal audience, manage lead flow and follow-up SLAs with sales, and tune programs based on funnel performance You bring the market context that makes a central campaign land with the audience, and you own stage-over-stage conversion for the segment.
  • Raise the bar for the wider field marketing team — mentor less experienced marketers, and bring federal market expertise back into how the broader org plans.

Who You Are:

  • 6+ years of field marketing experience in B2B SaaS, including 4+ years marketing to the U.S. Federal government, with a demonstrated track record of driving pipeline for a public sector segment or business unit.
  • Direct experience with Defense buyers — DoW/DoD services and combatant commands, or the Federal Systems Integrator and Defense Industrial Base firms that serve them.
  • Fluent in the federal buying cycle: appropriations and fiscal-year dynamics, contract vehicles (GSA, SEWP, CIO-SP, GWACs), the role of resellers and integrators, and how an ATO actually gets granted.
  • Proven experience planning and executing large-scale federal events, executive forums, and sponsored trade shows.
  • Comfortable with the technical subject matter — observability, cloud, DevSecOps, or cybersecurity — and tune messaging that holds up with a technical federal audience.
  • Experience with account-based marketing against named agencies and programs.
  • Experience owning a program budget and reporting against a pipeline number you are accountable for.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication with strong executive presence, and a track record of influencing sales leadership and driving alignment across marketing functions.
  • A self-starter who makes confident decisions without a playbook in front of you, and who is comfortable being handed an ambiguous goal and coming back with the plan.
  • Hands-on with Salesforce, marketing automation, ABM platforms, and attribution tooling.
  • U.S. citizenship required.
  • Based in or willing to relocate to the Washington, D.C. metro area, with willingness to travel roughly 40% for events.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That s okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits & Growth:

  • Generous and competitive benefits package
  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan
  • Continuous career development and pathing opportunities
  • Employee-focused best in class onboarding
  • Internal mentor and cross-departmental buddy program
  • Friendly and inclusive workplace culture

jobs.title: Staff Client Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We re all in on this mission. If you are too, let s talk.

The TDI Client Platform Engineering Team

The Technology, Data, and Insights (TDI) team is on a mission to accelerate Okta’s scale. We are a group of innovative engineers who prioritize automation, testing, and performance tuning. We touch every part of the business, and we are obsessed with creating a seamless, secure end-user experience for every Okta employee.

The Staff Client Platform Engineer Opportunity

As a Staff Client Platform Engineer, you will be the subject matter expert for Okta’s macOS and iOS fleet. While your primary focus is the Apple ecosystem, you will also play a key role in our broader endpoint strategy, contributing to our Windows, Android, Linux, and VDI management workflows as needed. This is an ideal path for an engineer who wants to maintain deep Apple expertise while expanding their influence across the entire OS landscape.

We are looking for a versatile engineer who thinks automation-first. You will combine Jamf Pro expertise with open-source tools like Munki and Santa, while helping to bridge the gap between platforms using unified tools like FleetDM.

What makes this role unique: You are Customer Zero. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Atlan is building the context layer for enterprise AI. Enterprises are pouring money into AI and most of it dies in production because the AI does not understand the business context around the data. That is the problem Atlan solves.

Gartner has named context the defining issue in enterprise AI, and calls context graphs the essential infrastructure for AI agents, naming Atlan one of three vendors already building it. We are also the only vendor named a Leader across all four major Gartner and Forrester evaluations for data catalogs, data governance and metadata management, the foundation the context layer runs on.

Come build the infrastructure that AI runs on.


THE OPPORTUNITY

AI applications are moving from prototypes to production, and the infrastructure underneath them is becoming increasingly complex.

We build and run the infrastructure behind our AI products: the cloud and Kubernetes platform they run on, the pipelines that ship code to production, and the observability that tells us when something breaks. We're also building AI agents that can operate that infrastructure themselves

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer who can work across these areas, build systems from the ground up, and think ahead about how they will behave at scale.

A key part of this role is building AI agents for infrastructure and engineering workflows. We’re looking for someone who has actually built and shipped agents or agentic systems that perform real work, not just used AI coding assistants or experimented with prompts.



WHAT YOU WILL DO?

 - Build reliable infrastructure at scale. Design and improve cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, compute, storage, and distributed systems.

 - Design for failure. Identify bottlenecks, failure modes, and operational risks before they become production issues.

 - Build safer deployments. Improve CI/CD, testing, rollout strategies, and deployment controls.

 - Build strong observability. Develop monitoring, alerting, tracing, and operational tooling that makes systems easier to understand and operate.

 - Improve infrastructure efficiency. Identify opportunities to improve performance, reliability, and cloud cost.

 - Build AI agents for infrastructure and engineering. Design and ship agents that can use tools and APIs, execute multi-step workflows, troubleshoot issues, or automate operational work.

 - Make agents safe to operate. Build the right evaluation, permissions, guardrails, observability, and failure handling around agents taking real actions.

 - Raise the engineering bar. Mentor engineers through architecture reviews, code reviews, technical discussions, and postmortems.

 - Share on-call ownership. Join the team’s on-call rotation, respond to production incidents, and turn what you learn into fixes, runbooks, and automation that reduce future pages.


WHAT MAKES YOU A MATCH?

 - You've built AI agents, not just used AI tools. You have shipped agentic systems that perform meaningful work and understand tools, state, workflows, evaluation, and guardrails.

 - You have strong infrastructure fundamentals. You understand distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, and production operations.

 - You've built systems through scale. You have taken infrastructure from relatively early stages to meaningful production scale and can talk about the trade-offs along the way.

 - You think about reliability by default. Failure modes, blast radius, operational complexity, and recovery are part of how you approach architecture.

 - You can debug across layers. You’re comfortable moving from application behaviour to Kubernetes, networking, and cloud infrastructure to find root causes.

 - You build rather than operate manually. Your instinct is to automate repetitive work and build tools that make engineering teams more effective.

 - You've built platforms other engineers build on. Package registries, artifact stores, CI systems or internal developer platforms all count.

 - You write things down. At staff level most of your influence comes through design docs and reviews.

Strong signals: Experience with multi-tenant SaaS, distributed systems, infrastructure automation, or production-grade AI agents. Experience with agent orchestration, tool use, evaluation, memory/state, or agent reliability is particularly valuable.

Our stack: AWS/EKS, Kubernetes, OpenTofu, FluxCD, Temporal, VictoriaMetrics, ClickHouse, Grafana, Go, and Rust. You don't need experience with all of these. Strong engineers from other backgrounds can pick them up quickly.




WHY ATLAN?

Joining Atlan means being part of a global movement to help data teams do their life’s best work. Here’s what you can expect:

 - Competitive Compensation:  We benchmark at the top of the market and keep compensation simple: strong base salary, performance‑based variable pay, and impact‑driven equity (for most roles), so your total rewards grow in step with the value you create over time.

 - AI Native Culture: Atlan is where AI-native builders come to build the systems the future of work will run on. AI isn’t an add-on, it’s woven into how we build, think, and work every day, empowering every Atlanian to move faster and create a bigger impact.

 - Health & Wellness: From Day‑1 health, dental, vision, and mental health to flexible health stipends, we design benefits offerings that lead in each country we're in.

 - Flexible Time Off & Leave Policies: We trust you to own your energy: flexible time off and modern leave so you can unplug properly, support yourself and your loved ones, and come back ready to drive an impact.

 - Accelerated Growth & Learning: Develop at an uncommon velocity through cutting-edge tech, complex implementations, and an experienced team that values mastery.

 - Global, Remote-First, High-Trust:  Work from anywhere with a diverse team across 15+ countries, in a trust-first, async environment that gives you true flexibility and ownership

jobs.title: Principal Security Architect, Applied Field Engineering
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Our Solution Engineering organization is seeking a Security Architect to join our APJ Field CTO Office to act as a security evangelist, architect, and hands-on subject matter expert/practitioner. In this role, you will cultivate key customer and partnership relationships, demonstrate thought leadership, and act as a trusted security advisor to current and potential customers. You will also collaborate with internal and external technical and business stake Security Architect, you must share our passion and vision in helping our customers and partners secure their Snowflake Accounts, thrive in a dynamic environment, and have the flexibility and willingness to jump in and get things done. You are equally comfortable in both a business and technical context, interacting with executives and talking shop and deep diving with technical audiences.



IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:



 - Help to scope security related feature enhancements on behalf of customers to work with Product Management on ways to improve the product from a security perspective.

 - Assist in clarifying concepts of data engineering, data warehousing, data collaboration, AI and Machine Learning. Share industry best practices, and features in the Snowflake platform; Assist in building demos and prototypes using Snowflake in conjunction with other integrated solutions; Engage with other relevant Snowflake stakeholders internally.

 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Support in order to drive customer security feature adoption.

 - Partner with our Product Marketing team to define and support Snowflake's  AI and Data Cloud posture and Security DataLake workload awareness and pipeline building via marketing initiatives including conferences, trade shows, and events.

 - Work and collaborate with other Field CTO members in areas of: Enterprise AI, Gen AI, Data Engineering, Applications, as a security export you may be involved in collaborative engagements.

 - Partner with the best in the industry product team, helping to shape vision and capabilities for Snowflake Data Marketplace.

 - Share knowledge with internal and industry communities via webinars & conferences.




ON DAY ONE WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:



 - 10+ years of industry, customer-facing, and hands-on implementation experience with a core focus on data concepts, privacy, governance, networking, infosec and security technologies.

 - Strong understanding of security related concepts such as RBAC, OAuth, Identity and Access Management, encryption and data governance.

 - Expertise and in-depth working knowledge and hands-on experience in cloud platforms (at least one of the following: AWS, Azure, GCP), and its corresponding security, data encryption, and networking architecture and technologies.

 - Ability to build out demos, configure CSP environments,  build out prototypes, and test use cases on the Snowflake platform and relevant integrations with CSP services and external security tools.

 - Ability to create security and networking-related reference architectures, security best practices and hardening guides, and articulate them to a customer audience.

 - A demonstrated knowledge of security frameworks such as NIST, CIS, OWASP, MITRE ATT&CK and how to articulate controls and security mechanisms within a Risk Assessment centred approach.

 - Knowledge of ANSI SQL compliant databases and / or data warehousing is preferred

 - AWS/Azure/GCP security and / or networking specialty related certification achievement is a plus

 - Strong understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, IP routing, DNS, Proxies and CSP private networking technologies including NAT, Firewalls, TLS and related design and troubleshooting.

 - Strong knowledge of cloud networking, including cloud service providers like Azure, AWS, and GCP

 - Strong understanding of identity management use cases, including authentication (SAML), authorization (OAUTH), and identity governance (SCIM & RBAC)

 - Deep experience with large-scale infrastructure-as-a-service platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, etc.)

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, interpersonal and collaborative skills, presentation and whiteboarding skills to a large audience, and the ability to successfully communicate security and risk-related concepts to technical and nontechnical audiences.

 - Fair understanding of the culture diversity across Asia Pacific Japan region and flexibility of working with customers and colleagues from multiple APJ time zones.

 - Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Management Systems, or related field required. Masters preferred.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com http://careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Business Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Business Systems Engineer to own the systems that turn a signed deal into a correct invoice and accurate revenue numbers. You’ll work across our go-to-market and finance stack: CRM, quoting and CPQ, billing, the data warehouse, and the integrations between them. Salesforce is one important part of that stack, not the whole job. This is an engineering role with business ownership: you’ll design how data and money move between Sales, Finance, Billing Ops, and Data teams, build the automation that keeps them in sync, and use AI to remove manual work and surface timely signals to reps and operators. You’ll partner closely with Sales, Deal Desk, Billing Ops, Revenue Accounting, and Data Engineering.

This role is based in one of San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - The big bet: Create a reliable GTM and quote-to-cash foundation across CRM, CPQ, billing and finance systems, marketing automation infrastructure, the data warehouse, and the integrations between them.

 - By day 90, build a clear understanding of the critical data flows between GTM systems, finance systems, and the warehouse, then ship an initial improvement to a high-value integration or workflow.

 - By day 90, develop AI-powered and agent-based workflows that reduce manual work for reps, Deal Desk, and Billing Ops while improving the quality of signals available to reps and operators.

 - By the end of your first year, automate billing-critical workflows such as upgrades and prorated refunds, early renewals, true-ups, and credit deferment, with audit trails Finance can trust.

 - By the end of your first year, improve data integrity and reporting through clear data models, deduplication, validation rules, reconciliation, and monitoring—including accurate ARR, pipeline, dashboard, and forecasting infrastructure.

 - Raise the bar for how the team ships and operates: sound access, change management, and release practices; thoughtful documentation and tool decisions; reusable tests, runbooks, code review, and AI-assisted development practices.
   
   


SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Demonstrated experience in business systems engineering, GTM engineering, revenue operations, or a technical sales or marketing operations role, with the ability to own problems end to end and work effectively across functions.

 - Strong SQL skills and experience working with a data warehouse such as Snowflake or BigQuery; you design for clean, traceable data and understand how to protect its integrity across systems.

 - Experience building integrations with APIs, webhooks, event-driven services, reverse ETL, or automation platforms such as Zapier, Workato, or Tray.io http://Tray.io. Scripting in Python or JavaScript, or building serverless integrations, is a plus.

 - Familiarity with finance systems and concepts such as quote-to-cash, billing, invoicing, and revenue recognition, and the ability to work effectively with Finance and Billing Ops. Experience with an ERP such as NetSuite is a plus.

 - Hands-on Salesforce development experience with Apex, triggers, Lightning Web Components, and Salesforce automation, following the team’s development and release practices: source control, pull requests, code review, automated testing, and the deployment pipeline - is a plus.

 - Hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ, Revenue Cloud, or a similar CPQ tool — including product and pricing data models, price books, bundles, and approval rules — is a plus.

 - Genuine curiosity about AI, with experience applying it to day-to-day work through AI-assisted development, agents, or workflow automation. Familiarity with Salesforce administration and customization—including objects, flows, permissions, and integrations—is a plus, not a requirement.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Data & Evals
jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Member of Technical Staff, Data & Evals in Harvey Research, you’ll build the data and measurement systems that power our post-training, benchmarking, and agent capability efforts.

We recently post-trained our first model built for legal work, and we’re now building the team to scale up our post-training efforts. You’ll own synthetic data pipelines, evaluation design, the tasks and grading behind training environments, and the systems that turn feedback from domain experts into training signals and rewards. These are tasks where correctness often can’t be verified automatically, so defining and measuring quality is a core research challenge. You’ll join a small, high-bar team of hands-on engineers and researchers, where each person owns a large part of the work.

We’re looking for research engineers who can build reliable data and evaluation systems, question what a metric actually tells us, and work closely with researchers and legal experts to turn model failures into measurable improvements.

Learn more about our work at harvey.ai/research http://harvey.ai/research.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build synthetic data pipelines that generate, filter, and curate training and evaluation samples for complex legal reasoning and agentic workflows.

 - Design evaluations and verifiers that reflect real legal work, calibrate them against expert judgment, and investigate where they fail.

 - Build and maintain capability benchmarks like our Legal Agent Benchmark (LAB), along with product-focused evals that track how models perform on real customer workflows.

 - Work with legal domain experts to define quality metrics, rubrics, and other grading mechanisms for training and evaluation.

 - Own training and evaluation data quality, including provenance, coverage, and safeguards against contamination.

 - Close the loop from product usage and customer feedback to new evaluations and training data, so models improve where customers need them most.

 - Partner with researchers to investigate model failures, distinguish real gains from misleading metrics, and use findings to guide training and release decisions.




WHAT YOU HAVE

 - Experience building data pipelines, ML evaluation systems, or experimentation tooling, with strong Python skills and ownership of production-quality code.

 - A rigorous approach to measurement, including statistical reasoning, experimental design, and understanding when a metric can mislead.

 - The ability to translate ambiguous goals or expert judgment into structured datasets, rubrics, and measurable criteria.

 - Experience with synthetic data, LLM evaluations, automated raters, or preference data is a plus. Strong data and measurement engineering experience close to ML model development is valuable even without prior LLM work.

We are hiring for this role across multiple levels.




COMPENSATION

$230,000 - $340,000 USD

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
jobs.description: About Us Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world. The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone. Role Summary The Parallax Cloud team builds the communication fabric that lets vehicles, mobile apps, and cloud services exchange live state and commands securely and reliably. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build and operate services and APIs that hide messaging, routing, and authorization complexity from product teams. This is hands-on platform work: you will solve distributed-systems problems, trace failures across the stack, and carry changes from design through production. Responsibilities Design, build, and operate cloud services and gRPC /Protobuf APIs that let product teams read vehicle state, subscribe to changes, and send commands. Operate and tune NATS, our high-performance messaging system, including configuration, upgrades, troubleshooting, performance validation, and capacity planning. Own services end to end, from implementation through deployment and production operation, using Kubernetes , GitOps/Argo CD, and infrastructure as code. Diagnose production behavior using metrics, traces, logs, dashboards, and alerts. Design, operate, and tune service networking, load balancers, and L4/L7 traffic routing. Develop and run end-to-end, integration, and load tests to catch functional and performance regressions before production. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications: At least 5 years of software engineering experience focused on distributed systems, high-scale backend services, or streaming and messaging platforms. Strong proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language and willingness to work primarily in Go , with occasional work in Java and TypeScript client SDKs. Practical experience building and operating production services, including observability and troubleshooting. Solid foundations in API design, networking, concurrency, and distributed systems with working knowledge of Kubernetes. Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience with high-throughput messaging systems such as NATS, Kafka, or MQTT. Experience with Kubernetes and owning service deployments; familiarity with GitOps/Argo CD and infrastructure as code. Strong knowledge of HTTP/2, TCP, L4/L7 load balancing along with experience operating gRPC services in production is a major plus. Familiarity with mTLS, certificates, service identity, secure transport and authentication patterns. Track record of maintaining or making contributions to established open-source projects. Why this role Parallax Cloud engineers collaborate closely with both product and cloud platform teams, creating a unique opportunity to shape how connected features are designed and how the underlying platform evolves. The role offers broad visibility across the system and meaningful influence on decisions on both sides. You will have the autonomy to investigate problems and carry improvements from design through rollout. Total Rewards We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program. Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements. In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. Offerings vary by country. Learn more about our global benefit programs . External candidates can apply for this role through the Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies careers site ( https://rivianvw.tech/#careers ). If you are a current employee, please apply through our internal job board . Equal Opportunity Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are also committed to ensuring compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws regarding citizenship and immigration status.
