jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Aker Systems was founded in 2017 by a team of experienced technology professionals who recognised an opportunity to provide highly secure enterprise data platforms to large organisations.  We build and operate ground-breaking, ultra-secure, high performance, cloud-based data infrastructure for the enterprise. Our proprietary technology solutions drive performance and reduce costs while helping our clients to improve the management and sharing of data across their organisations.

In 2024, Aker Systems won the Breakthrough Culture Awards highlighting growth companies putting culture first. In 2020 Aker Systems was recognised as a ‘One to Watch’ on the Sunday Times Tech Track.  The Company was also recognised at the Thames Valley Tech Awards 2020; winning the Thames Valley Tech Company of the year, the Emerging Tech Company and High Growth Tech Business categories.  We encourage people of all different backgrounds and identities to apply.  We are committed to maintaining an inclusive, and supportive place for you to do your very best work.

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Lead Data Engineer to design, build and evolve secure, scalable data platforms for clients across the UK Public Sector and Utilities sectors.

You will work closely with architects, engineers and client stakeholders to deliver modern cloud-based data solutions that support operational, analytical and AI-driven use cases. The role combines technical leadership with hands-on engineering, helping clients modernise their data estates while ensuring solutions are secure, reliable and scalable.

Working across multiple projects, you will lead the development of batch and real-time data pipelines, support architectural decision-making, and help establish engineering best practices across delivery teams.

Strong experience with real-time streaming technologies is essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development and deployment of secure, scalable data pipelines and data platform components.
  • Design and implement batch and real-time streaming solutions using modern event-driven architectures.
  • Own technical design decisions across projects, balancing scalability, security, performance and delivery requirements.
  • Lead technical workshops, discovery sessions and architecture discussions with client stakeholders.
  • Assess existing client data platforms and design practical approaches for modernisation, migration and integration.
  • Build and maintain data ingestion, transformation and integration capabilities across a variety of data sources.
  • Develop cloud-native data platforms using AWS services and open-source technologies.
  • Ensure data quality, governance, lineage and security requirements are embedded throughout the data lifecycle.
  • Drive engineering best practices including code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Support multiple client engagements, helping delivery teams maintain consistent engineering quality and standards.
  • Mentor and support engineers across project teams, providing technical guidance and leadership.
  • Perform data modelling, performance tuning and root cause analysis to resolve complex data and platform issues.

Essential Skills & Experience

Real-Time Streaming & Data Engineering

  • Strong commercial experience designing and implementing real-time streaming data platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with technologies such as Apache Kafka, AWS Kinesis, Apache Flink, Spark Streaming, Apache Pulsar, or similar event-driven technologies.
  • Experience building high-volume, low-latency, resilient data pipelines in production environments.
  • Strong understanding of modern data engineering patterns, including batch, streaming and hybrid architectures.

Data Engineering & Databases

  • Extensive experience developing and operating enterprise-scale data platforms.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience designing data models for analytical and operational workloads.
  • Proficiency in Python or other modern programming languages used for data engineering.
  • Experience configuring, tuning and optimising relational and NoSQL databases.

Cloud & Software Engineering

  • Strong experience working with AWS cloud services, including EC2, RDS, Lambda, Athena, Glue, S3 and IAM.
  • Experience working within Agile delivery environments.
  • Strong understanding of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and automated testing practices.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and engineering automation.
  • Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code principles.
  • Experience using version control systems such as Git.

Regulated Environments

  • Experience delivering technology solutions within UK Public Sector, Utilities, Energy, Water, Financial Services or other highly regulated industries.
  • Understanding of security, governance and compliance considerations within regulated environments.

Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Terraform.
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Knowledge of Ansible and Packer.
  • Linux and Windows administration experience.
  • Experience supporting AI, machine learning or advanced analytics platforms.
  • Experience working on programmes requiring UK Government security clearance.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer II, Resilience
jobs.description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we re looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania s first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we ve grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As Vinted’s new Senior Backend Engineer II, you’ll be joining the Platform Resilience team (Service Ecosystem domain). The purpose of our team is ensuring stable and resilient growth of the Vinted Marketplace services ecosystem. The team consists exclusively of experienced backend engineers, ensuring you always have someone to discuss your ideas with.

Here are some of the technologies we use: Ruby on Rails, Sidekiq, Golang, MySQL, Vitess, Redis, Kafka, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Kibana, Elastic APM, Datadog, Backstage, Jenkins, Kubernetes, Unix/Linux, Istio, ArgoCD.

Take a look at https://vinted.engineering/ to get a sense of our challenges.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Develop platform capabilities that help all Marketplace engineers build scalable systems.
  • Investigate and improve overall system stability and performance.
  • Consult other engineers on how to build robust systems with high availability.
  • Craft code that affects more than 80M+ users and handles 10M+ requests per minute.
  • Participate in on-call rotation every 5-6 weeks.

About you 

  • Experience building and supporting large-scale applications.
  • Good understanding of how infrastructure and code work together.
  • A strong communicator, skilled in discussing complex topics and collaborating across cultures in spoken and written English.
  • Analytical and acute problem-solving skills.
  • Eager to learn and master new technologies and concepts.
  • Familiar with most and have deep knowledge in some of the following disciplines (depending on your seniority level): Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Structures and Algorithms.
  • You are motivated by challenging, complex engineering problems requiring deep technological understanding, perseverance, collaboration with other developers, and solutions beyond regular product development
  • Advantage: experience with Distributed Systems, event-driven architecture, performance optimization and monitoring.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance 
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it s 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

jobs.title: Senior Kafka/AWS Integration Engineer
jobs.description: Join Our Team Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team. As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact. We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence. About the Role We are looking for an experienced Senior Kafka/AWS Integration Engineer to join a project focused on building and productionizing an event-driven middleware platform using Apache Kafka and AWS . This is a highly hands-on engineering role where you will build the AWS side of the integration platform, with Salesforce serving as the initial event source . You will work alongside the Lead Integration Architect and within the Agile sprint process, implementing solutions based on an established architecture and prioritized backlog. You will work across Apache Kafka, Amazon MSK, Java, Kafka Connect, Change Data Capture (CDC), AWS serverless technologies, and Infrastructure as Code , while helping establish reliable, testable, and maintainable event-driven integrations. Responsibilities: Provision and configure Amazon MSK clusters, Kafka topics, and schema registry . Configure and maintain Kafka Connect and CDC source connectors . Build REST-based event ingress using Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda to receive Salesforce events and publish them to Kafka. Develop Java stream-processing applications to transform data between Kafka topics. Build Java-based integration pipelines to deliver events from outbound topics to downstream systems. Implement dead letter queues and error-handling patterns for reliable event processing. Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated tests, and code coverage . Build and maintain infrastructure using AWS CloudFormation , enabling the client's operations team to redeploy and manage the environment. Work within the client's Agile/sprint process and collaborate closely with the Lead Integration Architect. Create clear technical documentation and provide ongoing knowledge transfer to the client's engineering and operations teams. Requirements: 5+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong hands-on experience developing backend and integration solutions with Java . Professional experience building event-driven and Kafka-based systems . Hands-on experience working with AWS services and cloud-based integrations . Experience building and supporting production-grade integration pipelines. Strong understanding of automated testing, CI/CD, and production-quality software development practices. Comfortable working within an Agile/sprint environment under the direction of a client architect. Strong communication and technical documentation skills. Ability to transfer technical knowledge effectively to client engineering and operations teams. Advanced written and verbal English communication skills. Must Have: Strong Java development experience, including stream processing and API components. Strong hands-on experience with Apache Kafka and Amazon MSK , including: Kafka clusters and topics Kafka Connect Change Data Capture (CDC) Experience with Schema Registry , including schema versioning and evolution. Strong experience with AWS serverless technologies , including: API Gateway AWS Lambda Infrastructure-as-Code experience with AWS CloudFormation . Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines . Experience with automated testing and code coverage . Experience building or supporting event-driven integration systems . Comfortable working in an Agile/sprint environment under a client architect's direction . Strong communication and documentation skills for technical knowledge transfer . Advanced written and verbal English communication skills. Nice to Have: Experience with Salesforce CDC or Salesforce event integrations . Experience implementing dead letter queues (DLQs) and error-handling patterns in event-driven systems. Kafka-AWS-Integration-Engineer. Compensation Additional Information Benefits & Perks: Home office; Competitive compensation based on experience; Career plans to allow for extensive growth in the company; International Projects; Oowlish English Program (Technical and Conversational); Games and Competitions; You can also apply here: Website: https://www.oowlish.com/work-with-us/ LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/oowlish/jobs/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/oowlishtechnology/

jobs.description: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars. PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER (PLATFORM TEAM) The Platform Team builds the foundational tooling and security infrastructure that empowers every team at SpaceX to harness AI effectively. This team creates secure, scalable gateways and proxy systems that allow engineers and operators across the company to write code faster, perform advanced data analysis, connect AI to their daily tools and problems, and turn ideas into deployed solutions with confidence. By onboarding new frontier models, expanding compute capacity, optimizing proxy efficiency for logging and control, and building shared prompts, skills, and infrastructure, this team unlocks reliable, high-impact AI capabilities across the entire organization. As a Principal Software Engineer for SpaceX's AI platform , you will set the technical vision and serve as a senior leader and entrepreneurial force for the leanest and most effective applied use of AI at SpaceX. You will architect platforms that convert engineering know-how into tested software, automation, and reliable data stores at massive scale while pioneering risk-mitigation tools such as intelligent code review and PR assistants. Current systems are built with Docker containers acting as secure gateways and proxies that integrate with any cloud compute provider and multiple frontier model providers. Your strategic leadership will be critical to accelerating SpaceX production and development by making trustworthy AI a core capability for every team at SpaceX. RESPONSIBILITIES: Define and drive the long-term technical vision and architecture for SpaceX’s AI platform and security infrastructure Lead high-impact initiatives with full ownership over strategy, design, implementation, and successful company-wide rollout Oversee onboarding of frontier models, massive compute scaling, and continuous optimization of proxy systems for security, efficiency, logging, and control Lead adoption efforts at scale — establishing standards, mentoring senior engineers, building reusable assets, and driving cultural change toward AI-first workflows Proactively identify and execute on the highest-leverage opportunities to turn ideas into production software, trained models, and automated systems with managed, reliable compute Invent and scale advanced risk-mitigation capabilities (AI code review, automated PR tools, safety systems) that protect and accelerate the business Establish best practices and technical direction for lean, secure, and maximally effective applied AI across the company Serve as a key technical advisor and collaborator with leadership and cross-functional teams to align platform capabilities with SpaceX’s most ambitious goals BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or other engineering discipline and 7+ years of professional experience building and scaling production platforms; OR 9+ years of professional experience building and scaling production platforms in lieu of a degree Experience designing and operating large-scale AI/ML platforms, internal developer platforms, or mission-critical infrastructure PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: Demonstrated success architecting and scaling AI gateways, secure proxy layers, or enterprise MLOps platforms that serve hundreds of users Expert-level experience with Docker/Kubernetes ecosystems, zero-trust security models, and multi-cloud/frontier-model integrations Deep expertise in MLOps, distributed compute, model lifecycle management, and building highly observable, reliable systems Strong history of enabling organization-wide impact through technical leadership, mentoring, and creation of shared platforms and standards Entrepreneurial leadership with a proven ability to spot and deliver transformative solutions Mastery of Python and broad expertise across modern languages and tooling Extensive experience with infrastructure-as-code, advanced observability, and building platforms that others love to use Deep passion for responsible AI, developer velocity, and converting deep engineering knowledge into reliable automation at planetary scale COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: Pay range: Principal Software Engineer: $210,000.00 - $295,000.00/per year Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Payments International Engineering team builds and operates the systems that enable bank and card payments across Affirm’s international markets. Based in Europe, with teammates across the UK, Spain and Poland, we give customers familiar, local ways to pay, while building shared capabilities that make expansion into each new country easier.

Our work spans improving existing payment experiences and building the foundations for launches in new countries. We solve challenges across currencies and local customer needs, creating reusable solutions that support Affirm’s international ambitions. We work closely with product and engineering teams across Affirm, connecting the customer experience with the financial systems behind it.

We own our work from design through to production, combining the pace of international expansion with the reliability, security and operational readiness that payments demand. Testing, monitoring and supporting our systems are integral to how we build. As a growing team, we also shape the architecture, tools and engineering practices that support this growth.

Joining Payments International means helping build the foundations of a global payments platform, with a direct connection between the systems we create and the customers Affirm can serve.

What you’ll do

  • You will be responsible for owning and delivering quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers on your team through ambiguity to solve open-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery.

  • You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.

  • You will proactively identify project, process, technology or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them.

  • You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.

  • You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting or improving code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.

  • You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.

What we look for

  • You have 4+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.

  • You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes.

  • You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.

  • You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely.

  • Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.

  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Backend (Compute Platform)
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Affirm s engineering team is building a large-scale, highly-available, and global infrastructure that is shared across multiple financial products. Ensuring that our infrastructure is accessible to all engineers is critical to the success of the business. We pride ourselves on our culture across engineering of engaging in thorough technical design review, operational excellence, and capable incident response and analysis.

The Compute Platform team owns the EKS foundation that Affirm s products run on, from cluster provisioning and lifecycle through the safety standards that keep thousands of workloads reliable at scale. Affirm operates 90+ EKS clusters across environments and regions, and this team is responsible for making that fleet standardized, automated, observable, and self-healing, while establishing and enforcing the workload configuration standards that protect availability. Our mission is to provide a secure, reliable, and scalable Kubernetes platform that lets infrastructure and application teams deploy and operate with confidence and minimal operational friction.

What you’ll do

As a member of the Compute Platform organization, you will collaborate with other teams - including Product, Infrastructure, Traffic, Cost & Capacity Engineering to:

  • Architect and evolve Affirm s EKS platform, driving strategy across cluster lifecycle, node management, and shared cluster components

  • Lead the technical direction for cluster provisioning, upgrades, and teardown through standardized IaC (Terraform, Spacelift) and self-service workflows

  • Own the reliability of core shared components across the fleet (Karpenter, CoreDNS, VPC CNI, Kube Proxy, Metrics Server, etc) and the CI/CD pipeline that ships them consistently

  • Define and enforce EKS workload safety standards covering resource configuration, workload isolation and blast radius, disruption tolerance (PDBs), Karpenter consolidation strategies, etc

  • Build the enforcement and automation path that moves each standard from research and white-glove onboarding through broad adoption to policy-enforced defaults for new workloads

  • Establish the observability, baseline audits, and reporting needed to identify hot spots and measure risk mitigation over time

  • Partner with cluster-user teams (checkout, batch, ML, analytics, DevProd, etc) to understand workload needs and shape the platform accordingly

  • Drive cost and capacity strategy across node scaling, bin packing, and EC2 instance selection

  • Mentor engineers across the Compute Platform teams and set the bar for operational excellence

  • Participate in the on-call rotation, triage and catalogue runtime K8s issues, and collaborate with SRE on production incidents

What we look for

  • Deep EKS and Kubernetes internals expertise, including cluster upgrades, node lifecycle, scheduling, and autoscaling (Karpenter, Cluster Autoscaler)

  • Demonstrated experience automating Kubernetes operations at fleet scale, from cluster provisioning, upgrades, and node lifecycle to self-healing remediation and policy-driven enforcement, replacing manual toil with auditable, self-service workflows

  • Strong grasp of workload reliability patterns: resource tuning, probes, PDBs, topology and isolation constraints

  • Experience designing and enforcing platform standards through policy (admission control, OPA/Gatekeeper or equivalent) and automated frameworks

  • Infrastructure as Code fluency with Terraform and a GitOps or pipeline-driven delivery model (ArgoCD, kube-applier, or similar)

  • Observability instincts: defining SLOs, building metrics, logs, and alerting coverage, and running data-driven baseline audits

  • Cross-functional collaboration skills with platform, product, SRE, and capacity teams

  • Demonstrated mentorship and technical leadership across teams

  • Drive to track emerging Kubernetes community best practices and adapt them to Affirm s needs

 Qualifications

  • 10+ years in software or infrastructure engineering with proven delivery of complex platform solutions

  • 6+ years hands-on operating production Kubernetes at scale, ideally EKS on AWS

  • Strong cloud-native architecture experience on AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, EKS)

  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Spacelift a plus) and GitOps-style deployment pipelines

  • Expert-level proficiency in Go or Python and a proven track record building production-grade Kubernetes controllers, operators, and platform tooling that other engineering teams depend on

  • Track record designing and enforcing standards across many teams without becoming a bottleneck

  • Exceptional problem-solving and systems-thinking skills

  • Demonstrated leadership and cross-functional influence

  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

We build the experiences that connect a customer s intent to buy with the flexibility of Affirm Card. From making financing options easier to understand to creating intuitive checkout journeys, we turn complex financial capabilities into simple, trustworthy experiences. Our roadmap includes evolving Default Terms, supporting additional cards, and strengthening the mobile experiences customers rely on when deciding how to pay.

Our work sits at the intersection of mobile, backend systems, and product innovation. We partner closely with Product, Design, and engineering teams across Affirm to introduce new capabilities while protecting the reliability of our checkout-critical surfaces.

As a full-stack Software Engineer II, you ll help bring these experiences to life through customer-facing features and the services behind them. We re looking for a curious, collaborative engineer who cares about the complete customer journey and enjoys turning challenging problems into thoughtful solutions. Together, we ll make Affirm Card easier to use and help customers make financial decisions with greater confidence.

What You ll Do

  • With the support of your team s tech lead and manager, you will break down larger projects into individual tasks, deliver them in multiple phases, and collaborate with others to ensure timely delivery of your work.

  • You will support the operations and availability of your team s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting "keep the lights on" & on-call efforts.
  • You will contribute to a sense of community on your team by engaging in growth and development activities such as participation in the interview process.

  • You have experience designing, developing and launching backend systems and are proficient in one of Python or Kotlin.
  • You are familiar with the building blocks of distributed systems, and the technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes.
  • You have experience shipping web apps using declarative UI frameworks like React or Vue.

  • You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code.
  • You are comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others code, and providing feedback to other engineers through code reviews.
  • Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Data Platform
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
Software is eating the world, but AI is eating software. We live in unprecedented times – AI has the potential to exponentially augment human intelligence. Every person will have a personal tutor, coach, assistant, personal shopper, travel guide, and therapist throughout life. As the world adjusts to this new reality, leading platform companies are scrambling to build LLMs at billion scale, while large enterprises figure out how to add it to their products. To make them safe, aligned and actually useful, these models need human evaluation and reinforcement learning through human feedback (RLHF) during pre-training, fine-tuning, and production evaluations. This is the main innovation that’s enabled ChatGPT to get such a large headstart among competition.

At Scale, our products include the Generative AI Data Engine, SGP, Donovan, and others that power the most advanced LLMs and generative models in the world through world-class RLHF, human data generation, model evaluation, safety, and alignment. The data we are producing is some of the most important work for how humanity will interact with AI.

At the foundation of these products is the Platform Engineering team. In this role, you will lead the design and development of core data storage, streaming, caching, and indexing platforms and underlying systems.  You’ll also get widespread exposure to the forefront of the AI race as Scale sees it in enterprises, startups, governments, and large tech companies.

You will:

  • Drive the architecture, design, implementation, and reliability of our foundational data platforms and systems, working closely with stakeholders and internal customers to understand and refine requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for, and driving improvements to, current programming practices, including process enhancements and tool upgrades.
  • Present technical information to teams and stakeholders, providing guidance and insight on development processes and technologies.
  • Provide technical leadership, including: upholding and upleveling engineering standards across the organization, mentoring junior engineers. 

Ideally you’d have:

  • 8+ years of full-time engineering experience, post-graduation with specialties in back-end systems, specifically related to building large-scale data storage, streaming, and warehousing systems.
  • Extensive experience in various database technologies (MongoDB, Postgres), streaming/processing solutions (Kinesis, Flink, Spark), indexing/caching (ElasticSearch, Redis), and various data query engines (Trino, Presto, Snowflake, etc.).
  • Show a track record of mentoring and leading teams in successful projects.
  • Possess excellent communication and collaboration skills, and the ability to translate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working fluently with standard containerization & deployment technologies like Kubernetes and various public cloud offerings.
  • Extensive experience in software development and a deep understanding of distributed systems, cloud platforms and data systems.
  • Experience driving cross functional collaboration and communication at an organizational or broader level. 

Nice to haves:

  • Strong knowledge of software engineering best practices and CI/CD tooling (CircleCI).
  • Experience with performance tuning and cost optimizations of cloud based data platforms. 
  • Experience defining a data lifecycle strategy and designing/implementing tooling for data privacy (i.e. GDPR) needs.  
  • Experience scaling products at hyper-growth startups.
  • Excitement to work with AI technologies.

Compensation packages at Scale for eligible roles include base salary, equity, and benefits. Scale employees in eligible roles are also granted equity based compensation, subject to Board of Director approval. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process, and confirm whether the hired role will be eligible for equity grant. You ll also receive benefits including, but not limited to: comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, a learning and development stipend, and generous PTO. Additionally, this role may be eligible for additional benefits such as a commuter stipend.

$252,000—$315,000 USD

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Metadata
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Staff Software Engineer – Metadata




COMPANY PITCH

Snowflake is the AI Data Cloud. Thousands of organizations run their most critical data, analytics, and AI workloads on our platform. We built Snowflake for the cloud from day one: near-unlimited scale, concurrency, and performance. Our goal is to make every organization's data instantly useful and always available.




TEAM PITCH

The Metadata team owns the brain of Snowflake. Every query, table, transaction, and permission depends on the metadata layer we build. Our systems handle millions of metadata operations per second. We also power cross-region and cross-cloud replication and failover, keeping customer data available through outages. If you want hard distributed-systems problems with direct customer impact, this is the team.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Lead the design of core metadata and replication systems across multiple teams.

 - Set technical direction for scalability, consistency, and fault tolerance of the metadata layer.

 - Drive cross-region and cross-cloud replication toward lower RPO and higher reliability.

 - Solve hard problems in performance, availability, and correctness at global scale.

 - Partner with Product and architects to turn customer needs into durable designs.

 - Raise the operational bar through observability, safe rollouts, and blast-radius controls.

 - Mentor senior engineers and grow technical leaders on the team.




REQUIREMENTS

Core Requirements:

 - 10+ years building large-scale distributed systems or database internals.

 - Strong development skills in Java or C++.

 - Proven record leading multi-team technical initiatives from design to production.

 - Deep understanding of consistency, transactions, and fault tolerance.

 - BS/MS in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.

Any of the following would make you a stronger candidate:

 - Experience with FoundationDB or other distributed key-value stores.

 - Experience building replication, disaster recovery, or geo-distributed systems.

 - Experience with database metadata, catalogs, or query compilation.

 - Experience running services on AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, GTM
jobs.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply.  Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.



We are looking for a GTM Forward Deployed Engineer to build and launch AI agents for our go to market (GTM) teams (Marketing, Sales, Product and Revenue Operations) using platforms like Salesforce, Slack, Claude Code, Gemini, Snowflake, Marketo, Clay, Nooks, and Rox


Key Responsibilities


 - Prototype and deploy AI agents for customer retention, pipeline generation, GTM productivity, deal inspection, account research, opportunity updates, and meeting prep.

 - Create prompt templates and system instructions for accurate, consistent outputs.

 - Define agent persona, tone, and fallback logic

 - Re-engineer GTM processes by connecting LLMs to GTM systems

 - Build and test agentic tools quickly.

 - Document agent logic and prompt structures to ensure scalable, independent automation across the global GTM organization.

 - Test system prompts, context retrieval, and model selection to boost output quality, seller adoption, and deal velocity.

 - Track and audit production agents to quickly fix output drift, performance gaps, and accuracy issues

 - Partner with GTM Analytics teams to integrate GTM data sources for real-time customer and pipeline insights.

 - Create practical prompt libraries, quick-reference playbooks, and training sessions to maximize seller, customer and/or potential customer value.

 - Ensure prompt, workflow, and deployed solutions meet security, legal, and company AI standards.
   



Required Qualifications



 - Have 5+ years of software engineering experience

 - Working knowledge of GTM strategy, AI Operations and hands-on experience putting AI workflows or LLM agents into production.

 - Experience creating internal documentation, toolkits and playbooks that outlived your involvement and were adopted at scale.

 - Experience in a technical or cross-functional role that required problem-solving across teams and functions.

 - A track record of building AI-powered tools, automations, or workflows that changed how real work gets done — with specific examples you can speak to.

 - Clear, concise communication skills — you can explain a technical concept to someone who's never thought about it before, without talking down to them.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and self-direction; you don't need a detailed roadmap to know where to start.




Preferred Qualifications:

 - Hands-on experience with AI development platforms and tools such as Claude, Claude Code, MCPs, LLM APIs, custom agent frameworks, or workflow automation platforms.

 - Background in change management, organizational development, or a large-scale rollout that required bringing skeptical stakeholders along.

 - Experience in solutions engineering where you had to earn trust and deliver results quickly.

 - Familiarity with the enterprise SaaS tools Kong runs on: Okta, Slack, Google Workspace, Salesforce, Jira, or Freshservice.

 - Familiarity with Kong Konnect, Kong Gateway, or API management concepts — understanding how APIs and AI models connect will help you build smarter tools.

 - Experience helping others develop new technical skills, whether through formal training, one-on-one coaching, or team enablement programs



About Kong: 

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com http://www.konghq.com.

jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.



Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:



 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.



We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to land and expand n8n inside the world’s largest organisations, closing the biggest deals in our portfolio.

As a Large Enterprise Account Executive covering US West (California, Washington, Colorado and Texas), you will own a territory of global-scale accounts and lead long, complex deals from first conversation to multi-year commitment:


BUILD STRATEGIC ACCOUNT PLANS

 - Build and execute account strategies for organisations with 5,001 or more employees in the US West territory.

 - Open doors with outbound campaigns aimed at CTOs, CIOs and engineering and platform leaders.

 - Turn community adoption inside large companies into sponsored, funded opportunities.


LEAD COMPLEX, MULTI-THREADED DEALS

 - Run deep discovery, quantify business impact and build an executive-level business case.

 - Map and align decision makers across engineering, IT, security, legal and procurement.

 - Partner with Solutions Engineers, Partnerships and Customer Success to prove value and de-risk adoption.


CLOSE AND EXPAND AT SCALE

 - Own the cycle through security, legal and procurement, typically over three to six months or more.

 - Negotiate six-figure deals with confidence and keep clear commercial control.

 - Plan expansion across business units and use cases, and share what you learn with Product and leadership.


REQUIREMENTS


MUST-HAVES

 - 🏢 Large Enterprise sales: You have at least five years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, selling into organisations with 5,001 or more employees, and you can explain customer size, deal complexity and cycle length.

 - 💰 Six-figure deals: You have closed multiple deals of £100k+ ACV in multi-stakeholder cycles of three to six months or more.

 - 🧑‍💻 Technical buyers and executives: You have sold to developers, engineers, CTOs and CIOs, and you can carry a technical conversation and an executive one in the same deal.

 - 🎯 New-logo hunter: You generate your own pipeline through outbound and win new customers rather than relying on expansion or inbound.

 - 📈 Track record: You have consistently hit or exceeded quota over the past two to three years.

 - 🧭 Structured selling: You use a methodology such as MEDDPICC and navigate technical evaluations, procurement, legal and security reviews.

 - 📍 Location: You are based in California, Washington, Colorado or Texas and you already have the right to work in the US. This role covers the US West territory and involves regular travel to customers in the region.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - 🛠️ Technical product background: You have sold developer tools, cloud infrastructure, data, AI or automation platforms.

 - 🤝 Partner-led deals: You have worked deals with system integrators or cloud partners.

 - 🚀 Open source or PLG exposure: You understand how community adoption turns into enterprise revenue.

Why join us?

You will close the largest deals in our portfolio and shape how n8n sells to the world’s biggest organisations, with a product technical teams already use and love. You will work closely with Solutions Engineers, Partnerships, Customer Success and Product, and leadership will listen to what you learn in the field. n8n is growing at an exceptional pace, backed by a vibrant community and a remote-first culture built on autonomy, experimentation and high talent density. Apply now and help us bring AI-powered automation to the global enterprise.About the role

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

We're hiring a Sr. Infrastructure Engineer to own the shared layer that every Harvey IT system runs on. You'll join Core IT Engineering & Infrastructure, reporting to Dave Vega, Director of IT, alongside engineers who own identity and collaboration, Microsoft platforms, networking, and client platforms.

Harvey is cloud-first. We run no servers or data centers of our own. Our IT infrastructure is cloud tenants, SaaS configuration, office networks across a growing global footprint, and the automation that ties them together. Today that cross-cutting work is done on the side by each platform owner. This role makes it someone's primary job, so it gets built once, done well, and doesn't break quietly.







WHAT YOU'LL DO

You'll own the shared infrastructure, automation and reliability work that cuts across every IT platform.

 - IT cloud accounts and tenants. Own access, guardrails and cost for the cloud accounts IT runs (AWS, Azure, GCP projects for IT tooling). Be the BizTech engineering partner to Security and Infrastructure on tenant-level changes, such as cloud migrations that touch Entra and M365.

 - Infrastructure as code for IT. Build and run the Git repos, CI pipelines and review process for IT configuration (Okta, Jamf, Intune, Google Workspace). Platform owners keep owning their config. You own the framework they all use.

 - IT automation and provisioning. Own the automation behind identity lifecycle and IT workflows: SCIM and provisioning flows, onboarding and offboarding orchestration across systems, and IT workflows in Serval.

 - Monitoring, backup and resilience. Set up health checks and alerting for critical IT systems and integrations, config drift detection, SaaS backup (Google, Slack, M365) and tested recovery runbooks.

 - Scripts and internal tooling. Take over the scripts and admin utilities that live on individual laptops today. Put them in source control, document them and keep them running.

 - Office site standard. Work with Network and AV/Media teams to define the repeatable technical template for new offices: configuration, monitoring and documentation each site copies. Network and AV build execution stays with their owners.

 - Engineering practices. Raise the bar on change control, documentation and runbooks across the pillar, so primaries and backups can cover for each other.

 - Certificates, domains and DNS. Track and renew every certificate IT depends on (Apple Push, SAML signing, SSL, Wi-Fi/802.1X). Work with Network and CorpSec teams to own and manage DNS NS solutions for IT. Build expiry monitoring to avoid surprises.







WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 6+ years in corporate IT engineering, systems engineering or SRE, with at least 2 years owning shared infrastructure or automation for a SaaS-first company.

 - Strong infrastructure-as-code experience. You've managed real systems with Terraform or similar, in Git, with pull-request review and CI.

 - Solid scripting in Python plus one of Bash, PowerShell or Go. You write code other people can read and maintain.

 - Hands-on with identity and provisioning: SAML, OIDC, SCIM and lifecycle automation in Okta or Entra.

 - Working knowledge of at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP): IAM, accounts and cost basics.

 - Comfort with DNS, TLS and certificate management, and basic enterprise networking.

 - You've built monitoring and alerting that people actually trust, and written runbooks that someone else used successfully.

 - Clear written communication. You can explain a change, its risk and its rollback to non-engineers.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, LLM Gateway
jobs.description:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?




YOUR MISSION

As a Principal Software Engineer on the LLM Gateway team, you will set the technical direction of UiPath’s AI Trust Layer: the gateway through which every UiPath product, and every agent our customers build, reaches models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and other commercial and open-weight providers. You will lead the architecture of a secure, globally distributed, high-throughput proxy serving text, image, voice and emerging modalities, with intelligent routing, rate limiting and cost controls, running the same way in our public cloud, in government and sovereign clouds, and in customer-hosted deployments. You will own the LLM infrastructure behind it: sourcing and balancing model capacity across vendors, tiers and regions, with data residency guaranteed in every geography. You will also own how customers see and control AI in their organizations: which models their users and automations can access, including the models they bring themselves, under what conditions, and with what policies, data protection and audit trail. You will raise the engineering bar of the team, work closely with product teams, security, legal and our model vendors, and help shape how we build software with AI agents.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO AT UIPATH

 - Lead the architecture and technical direction of complex backend and cloud-native services across the UiPath platform.

 - Design scalable, secure, reliable, and high-performing distributed systems across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments.

 - Partner with engineering leaders, architects, product managers, and cross-functional teams to shape technical solutions for high-impact product and platform areas.

 - Drive technical planning and roadmap input for complex services, platform capabilities, or cross-team initiatives.

 - Identify long-term scalability, reliability, security, performance, and cost challenges, and lead the design of sustainable solutions.

 - Set high standards for system design, code quality, testing, observability, automation, incident management, and engineering excellence.

 - Mentor and guide engineers through design reviews, technical discussions, architecture decisions, and hands-on technical feedback.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TEAM

 - 7+ years of software engineering experience, with strong backend and cloud development experience.

 - Hands-on experience with one or more modern programming languages such as C#, Java, Python, or Go.

 - Strong experience designing and building distributed systems, microservices, APIs, and cloud-native architectures.

 - Proven ability to influence technical direction and drive architecture decisions across teams.

 - Experience building and operating production-grade services in cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.

 - Good knowledge of containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, monitoring, logging, observability, and production operations.

 - Strong understanding of system design, data structures, algorithms, multithreading, asynchronous programming, and performance optimization.

 - Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases, messaging systems, event-driven architectures, or high-scale data processing.

 - Ability to balance customer experience, reliability, security, scalability, and cloud cost when making technical decisions.

 - Strong technical leadership, ownership, and communication skills, with the ability to guide teams through ambiguity.

 - Interest in automation, AI, developer platforms, enterprise software, or large-scale cloud systems is a plus.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy https://www.uipath.com/legal/trust-and-security/privacy-policy.

Datadog and Sentry experience is a plus. Collaborate directly with the Senior AI & Design Lead for clear ownership, feedback, and iteration. Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and observability tools. Take-home assignment (Step 1 of the process) Please complete a take-home assignment. You are allowed to use LLMs to write code. To ensure that your work will not be used at Fluence, we’ve made it unrelated to healthcare: Build “LendLoop”: a neighborhood tool-lending board with automated workflows A simple app where neighbors list tools they are willing to lend, request to borrow from each other, and receive automated notifications and reminders handled by n8n. A “Sign in to lend or borrow” button wired to Clerk. Authenticated experience Only signed-in users can: List a tool with: name category (power tools, garden, kitchen, camping, etc.) condition short description Request to borrow a tool for a date range. Approve or decline requests on their own tools. Mark a loan as returned. Show: All tools with availability status, filterable by category. “My listings”, “My requests”, and “Incoming requests” views. Nice, minimal layout. Roles & rules Have two roles: admin : Can remove any listing, view all loans, and mark a lender as “Trusted Lender”. user : Can create, edit, and delete only their own listings, and act only on requests involving their own tools or their own borrowing. Implement the above role-based access control with best practices, enforced in Convex functions, not only in the UI. Automation with n8n Build at least two n8n workflows: Request notification: when a borrow request is created or changes status, Convex calls an n8n Webhook. The workflow notifies the relevant user (email, Slack, Discord, or a logged mock notification is fine) using only the fields it needs. Overdue reminders: a scheduled workflow runs daily, fetches overdue loans from a Convex HTTP endpoint, sends a reminder to each borrower, and writes the reminder status back to Convex. Secure the integration in both directions: Sign webhook payloads (e.g. HMAC with a shared secret) and verify signatures on the receiving side. Keep secrets in environment variables and n8n credentials, never in code or exported workflow JSON. Make write-backs idempotent so retries do not create duplicate records or reminders. Handle failures with retries and an error workflow (or equivalent) so failed runs are visible and never fail silently. (Bonus) Show recent automation activity on each loan in the app, e.g. “Reminder sent 2 days ago”. Deliverables A GitHub repository with the app source code. Exported n8n workflow JSON files in the repository. A README covering local setup (including n8n, e.g. a docker-compose file), environment variables, architecture, and your security and data-minimization decisions. A short note on what you would change to run this in production. jobs.description: Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the role: As a Senior Software Engineer on Camunda's new Data Streaming team, you'll help build a foundational new piece of architecture that changes how customers and internal products access process data. Today, customers have no first-class way to stream their own process data out of Camunda, and Camunda's own analytics product is bottlenecked by querying the same storage the live engine depends on. You'll be part of a greenfield team rebuilding how process data is consumed and served at scale, built on top of a durable, continuously-written streaming layer that decouples data consumption from the live engine. You'll be part of a small team from day one, with real room to shape both the architecture and the team's scope as it matures. At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, the Data Layer and Distributed Systems teams, QA, and support, and work closely with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence how our data streaming architecture evolves to meet our customers' needs. What You Will Do: Help rebuild how Camunda's analytics product consumes and serves process data at scale, moving it off the engine's critical path entirely. Design and build the core streaming infrastructure that decouples process data access from the live execution engine, backed by durable, object storage. Build customer-facing data streaming capabilities, including a supported way to integrate with systems like Kafka, so customers can reliably get their process data into their own tools. Make foundational architecture decisions as part of a small, high-ownership team, including how the system guarantees consistency and durability across a distributed streaming pipeline. Participate in L3 support and on-call rotations, partnering with Support and SRE to investigate data layer production issues, and feeding what you learn back into the product. What You Will Bring to the Role: Must Haves: 7+ years of experience as a backend engineer, in Java, with a strong focus on distributed or data-intensive systems. Hands-on experience building or operating an analytical serving layer over a table format such as Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake - including experience with an embedded/lightweight query engine (e.g. DuckDB, or similar), or a stateful stream-processing framework (e.g. Flink, Kafka Streams). A track record of working with object storage systems (S3/GCS/Azure or similar) and building reliable, idempotent upload/commit protocols against them. Solid grounding in the reasoning behind correctness and consistency in data-intensive systems (e.g. concurrent writes, atomicity, idempotency). A demonstrated track record of driving a technical initiative through genuine ambiguity in a still-being-designed system, not just extending an established one. Proven experience leading medium-to-large engineering initiatives (3+ months) end-to-end, from solution design, project planning, and coordinating across teams, right through to driving predictable delivery. Strong communication and collaboration skills in a remote-first environment: you translate requirements into actionable technical work with Product, and give and receive clear, direct feedback in code review. Nice to Haves: Experience with Kafka or a similar streaming/event-log system Experience with embedded state stores (RocksDB or similar) for projection/checkpointing workloads. Experience with stream processing frameworks (e.g. Apache Flink), particularly stateful processing with local state backends and checkpointing. Familiarity with object-storage-native streaming architectures (e.g. systems like WarpStream) is a plus, even without direct hands-on experience. jobs.description:
Working at CreateFuture

CreateFuture is an AI-native consulting partner where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference  while always putting people first.

We’re a team of creators. We write code, shape delivery, build go-to-market strategies, develop AI solutions and create the practices that support our people. We work side by side with our clients, challenging what’s not working and helping them to build the future. Our commitment to craft, quality, and culture has helped us scale to over 600 people in just a few years.

CreateFuture is a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company and has won Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row.

Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today.

About the role and team:

We are looking for TechOps Engineers to operate, stabilise and modernise our Azure-hosted platforms (Java/Spring Boot microservices on RHEL). The role covers 24/7 operations, incident management, hands-on troubleshooting and security remediation, and helps build out a codified platform: Terraform, GitHub Actions + Ansible, and centralised ELK.

Key responsibilities

  • Build and support environments on Azure; hands-on RHEL administration (hardening, patching, tuning)
  • Act as escalation for L2/L3 incidents, driving RCA and permanent fixes
  • Debug issues hands-on across the stack (OS, network, middleware, JVM, database) using logs, metrics, thread/heap dumps and packet captures
  • Support Java/Spring Boot microservices and the middleware they run on; diagnose JVM issues (memory, GC, threads, latency)
  • Drive security vulnerability remediation across OS, middleware and cloud platform
  • Collaborate with Security/SOC/NOC on incident response and post-incident reviews
  • Deliver changes as code: infrastructure in Terraform, deployments via GitHub Actions running Ansible
  • Own backup, restore testing and DR failover readiness
  • Participate in regular 24/7 on-call rotation
  • Manage incidents/problems/changes via Jira Service Management
  • Maintain runbooks, dashboards and documentation
  • Work with development and Platform team to take ownership of an inherited Azure estate, stabilise it, then modernise it with AI-assisted & reviewed tooling

Technical skills

  • Cloud/Network: Azure VMs, VNet, NSG, Load Balancer, App Gateway/WAF, Firewall, Virtual WAN, Key Vault, private endpoints, VPN; Azure Front Door, Cloudflare, Nginx, TLS
  • Data: Azure MySQL Flexible Server (HA, replicas, point-in-time restore), Redis, Blob Storage; Canal (MySQL CDC), MongoDB
  • OS: RHEL (enterprise production), Azure Update Manager; Docker engine on hosts
  • Java/Middleware: Spring Boot, Dubbo, Nacos, ZooKeeper, XXL-Job, Kafka, RabbitMQ
  • Observability: Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch cluster ops, ILM, Logstash, Kibana); Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana, Azure Monitor; Micrometer/JVM observability; PagerDuty
  • Access/Security: Entra ID, RBAC, PIM; Azure Bastion, JumpServer (PAM), Zscaler ZPA
  • Backup/DR: Azure Backup, DR region failover
  • IaC/CI/CD: Terraform, GitHub Actions, Ansible, GitHub Packages, GitOps; Python, Bash
  • Tooling: Jira Service Management, Confluenc

Requirements

  • 8+ years in TechOps/Infrastructure/SRE/Production Operations
  • Strong hands-on Azure and RHEL experience in production
  • Proven support of Java microservices/middleware in production
  • Strong hands-on debugging and analytical skills; comfortable working an unfamiliar problem from symptoms to root cause
  • Advanced Elasticsearch and JVM observability skills
  • Hands-on Terraform, GitHub Actions and Ansible; Python/Bash scripting
  • Strong incident management/RCA capability; ITIL familiarity
  • Comfortable with 24/7 operations; strong communication
  • Experience in gaming or another regulated, high-availability digital sector
  • Systems administration experience desired

 

What we’ll offer you:

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously. About the Job At Gravis, we build high tech systems that give machine operators superhuman capabilities. To adapt in real time to changes in the environment the Gravis Rack fuses data from LiDAR, cameras, GNSS, and hydraulics into an autonomous control system. The robotics platform team builds the software foundation for our robots to enable non stop operation in the harshest environments. We ensure all algorithms execute correctly, based on a rock solid communication layer and world class introspection capabilities. We provide all the tools to deploy, develop and debug the most powerful robots on earth. As a robotics platform staff software engineer, you will help shape and implement our vision of a scalable, safe and high performing robotics platform. You will gather requirements from internal customers, architect the communication layer, node orchestration and lifecycle management as well as APIs to off-machine systems. The main focus will be on the design, implementation and maintenance of essential parts of the on-robot platform, contributing to open source projects where feasible. With your outstanding skills, you will be a role model for other developers in our organisation and guide them on their professional journey. Guide junior team members to support your endeavors Monitor external dependencies and alternatives to assess potential issues or improvements Influence, nurture and grow our engineering culture Contribute upstream to open source software projects to close gaps in required functionality Engage in the robotics scene to stay up to date with ongoing developments and share knowledge in and outside of our company What we're looking for Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field 7+ years of hands-on experience in Software Engineering, Robotics Development or similar roles Strong Software Engineering skills and solid experience with related tooling (e.g. clangd, cargo, pyrefly) Strong programming skills in a systems language like C++ or Rust, Python is nice to have Track record of leading high impact projects across teams Experience with middleware (iceoryx2, DDS, AUTOSAR Adaptive) and IDLs (FlatBuffers, Protobuf) Bonus Qualifications Don't meet every requirement? We still want to hear from you. These are nice-to-haves, not dealbreakers: Experience working on safety-critical systems and the respective software development processes Experience in developing a production grade robotics system Track record of open source contributions Experience using Rust in a production environment Gravis is an equal opportunity employer.
