jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Tooling Infrastructure
jobs.description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Software Engineer, AI Tooling Infrastructure to join our AI Tooling team and help build and run the backend services behind Supabase’s AI products. The Supabase MCP server is one example of what the team runs in production, alongside the services that support agent skills and the dashboard assistant. You’ll work closely with the Platform, SRE, Auth, Billing and Edge Functions teams, and with the engineers on the AI Tooling team who build the product surfaces.

The AI Tooling team runs its own services in production and carries its own on-call. Traffic from AI clients and agents behaves differently from traffic from people: hundreds of calls a minute, retry loops, and no reading of deprecation warnings. This role makes sure the services they use are reliable, correctly authorized and observable. It is a systems and infrastructure role rather than a product AI role, and it is not an SRE role. You will build and operate these systems, not only advise on them.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments, owns what they ship in production, and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.




WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

In this role, you’ll:

 - Build and operate the production backend services behind Supabase’s AI products, including the MCP server: deployment, scaling, configuration and release.

 - Take ownership of how those services are structured, including splitting or reshaping a service when that makes it safer to run and easier to change.

 - Define, measure and meet reliability targets for the services the team runs. Set SLOs with the SRE team, track error budgets, and use them to decide what to fix first.

 - Participate in the AI Tooling team on-call rotation, and be a first responder for incidents in those services. Investigate, fix, coordinate with other teams during incidents, and write the follow-ups and runbooks.

 - Work the AI Tooling team support queue alongside on-call, and turn recurring issues into fixes rather than repeated manual answers.

 - Own authentication and authorization for AI and agent clients: OAuth apps, scoped tokens, and permissions that make sense for agents as well as humans, including how we change or deprecate a permission without breaking existing integrations.

 - Own observability for the services the team runs: metrics, traces, logs, dashboards and alerts, so we find problems before customers do.

 - Handle capacity and abuse for agent traffic: rate limits, cost and safety controls, and behavior under load or when a dependency degrades.

 - Improve the architecture of the services the team owns as they grow, including splitting or reshaping a service when that makes it safer to run and easier to change.

 - Work with the Platform team on shared code, review ownership and release process, and with the SRE team on infrastructure, alerting and incident practice.

 - Contribute to the code of the AI Tooling team’s tools, such as the MCP server, where it affects reliability and security, in partnership with the engineers who own the product surface.



YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

Must have:

 - Have 5+ years of experience building and running backend services in production, and have carried on-call for them.

 - Write strong TypeScript or Go, and are comfortable working in the other.

 - Have designed and operated APIs with real consumers: versioning, error handling, rate limiting, and backwards-compatible change.

 - Know OAuth, OIDC, JWT and API authorization well enough to debug them in production and to explain where implementations commonly deviate from the spec.

 - Have a good understanding of PostgreSQL and relational databases.

 - Are comfortable with CI/CD, Docker and containerized deployments, and with infrastructure as code. Any tool is fine.

 - Can debug across services: follow a slow or failing request through several systems using metrics, traces and logs.

 - Communicate clearly in writing, work with a wide range of stakeholders, and thrive in async, globally distributed teams.

 - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly.

Pick your centre of gravity. We expect you to be deep in at least one of these, and to tell us which:

 - APIs and auth: You have designed permission models, token scopes or OAuth flows for third-party or machine clients, and you have migrated them without breaking users.

 - Operations: You have run production services yourself: carried the pager, written alerts and runbooks, used SLOs or similar to decide what to fix, and made shared systems less risky over time.

 - Gateways and distributed systems: You have built or run proxies or gateways, or debugged hard failures across services (retries, partial failures, upstream outages, fail-open vs fail-closed decisions), and you can reason about load and degradation.

Nice to have:

 - Experience with agent tooling (MCP or similar), or serving traffic from AI agents and LLM clients.

 - Experience moving a service out of a larger codebase while keeping existing clients working.

 - Experience with Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Logflare or a similar observability stack, and real SLO work.

 - Open-source contributions, especially to Node.js, Go, TypeScript or API tooling.


WHAT WE OFFER

   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer- Databricks AI
jobs.description:
P-1700

At Databricks, we are passionate about helping enterprises that build ML models and AI agents deliver high-quality AI to production fast. Founded by engineers, and customer obsessed, we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing great developer experiences to building reliable systems at global scale. And we re only getting started.

Our team builds the MLOps and LLMOps platform that millions of AI developers and ML practitioners use to track model training experiments, manage model registry, observe and evaluate AI agents. We re the team behind MLflow, the most widely adopted open-source AI engineering platform with more than 30 million package downloads per month, and its managed service used by thousands of organizations globally. We re now expanding to Bengaluru, India, and building our first AI engineering team there from scratch to work on this platform.

As a Staff Software Engineer and a founding member of the Bengaluru team, you ll be the team s technical lead. You ll set the platform strategy and architecture, drive alignment with partner teams, and lead the team to deliver a world-class MLOps and LLMOps platform, while staying hands-on.

 

Check out our recent blog post: coSTAR: How we ship AI agents at Databricks fast, without breaking things

 

The impact you will have:

  • Define the platform strategy and long-term architecture.
  • Lead engineering efforts from design to production rollout, with high standards for performance, correctness, and reliability.
  • Solve hard problems in ingesting and querying traces, metrics, and artifacts at scale, and in evaluating AI agents in production.
  • Align product, research, and engineering teams across sites on technical direction and trade-offs.
  • Shape APIs and developer experiences that make it easy for customers to ship AI.
  • Mentor senior engineers through design reviews and technical discussions.
  • Represent the team externally through blog posts, talks, and open-source contributions to popular AI frameworks.

 

What we look for:

  • BS (or higher) in Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience developing large-scale distributed systems, scaling infrastructure, or building platforms and developer tools for other teams.
  • Strong foundation in algorithms, data structures, and system design.
  • Strong experience with backend technical stacks such as Scala or Java.
  • Experience with cloud technologies, e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Engineering maturity in security, correctness, and operational excellence.
  • Proven track record as a technical lead, driving architecture decisions and delivering complex, high-impact projects end-to-end.
  • Ability to lead through influence across teams.
  • Strong communication skills and a passion for mentoring engineers.
  • Experience with ML or LLM systems is a plus.



About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

An overview of this role

As a Data Engineer at GitLab, you ll build, run, and maintain the pipelines and infrastructure that bring data from our enterprise applications, internal systems, and GitLab s software as a service (SaaS) platform into our data platform. Your work will power company reporting, data science, and artificial intelligence (AI) self-service.

You ll own features end to end, from source integration to tested, monitored, documented data ready for use. You ll focus on keeping the platform reliable, secure, and cost-efficient as data volumes and AI usage grow, and making governed data ready for AI tools, agents, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based access. This is an AI-first role: you ll use AI coding agents every day while maintaining high standards for code review and testing. You ll report to the Director, Data Platform.

What you’ll do

  • Build, extend, and maintain extract, load, transform (ELT) pipelines from enterprise applications such as Salesforce, Zuora, Zendesk, and Marketo, internal systems, and the GitLab SaaS platform. Integrate data through application programming interfaces (APIs) and event sources such as Snowplow.
  • Manage and maintain the infrastructure behind the platform, including SaaS tools such as Snowflake, Fivetran, and Monte Carlo, and self-managed services such as Airflow and Kubernetes.
  • Write maintainable, well-tested, performant Python and Structured Query Language (SQL) code that meets our internal standards, and review GitLab team members merge requests.
  • Own day-to-day platform operations: triage and resolve failed pipelines, infrastructure issues, and GitLab team member requests. Use monitoring, service-level agreements (SLAs), data contracts, query and warehouse tuning, and data quality checks to keep the platform reliable and cost-efficient.
  • Partner with Analytics Engineers, Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Data Governance, and business partners so data lands in the shape they need for downstream use.
  • Use AI coding agents such as Claude Code, OpenCode, GitLab Duo, or similar tools to speed up development, debugging, testing, and documentation without compromising review rigor.
  • Apply role-based access control (RBAC) and masking policies to make governed data available to AI tools and agents. Handle data subject to Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) controls, material nonpublic information (MNPI), and personal data safely.
  • Ship medium-sized features independently in small, iterative merge requests, and document architecture and runbooks in the handbook.

What You ll Bring

  • Professional experience shipping production data pipelines in Python.
  • Deep, hands-on SQL skills and experience with a cloud data warehouse; Snowflake is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with ELT or extract, transform, load (ETL) pipelines at scale, including incremental loads, schema changes, backfills, and API ingestion.
  • Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow, familiarity with dbt, and solid data modeling fundamentals, including Kimball dimensional modeling.
  • Experience running and troubleshooting data infrastructure, with comfort using Git-based workflows, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and code review.
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding tools in your daily work, with an understanding of where they help and where they fall short.
  • Clear written communication, the ability to use GitLab, and comfort working asynchronously in a fully remote organization in line with GitLab s values.
  • Preferred, not required: experience with Snowflake; Docker, Kubernetes, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Terraform; SaaS application APIs such as Salesforce, Zuora, or Zendesk; data observability tooling; or Snowflake administration.

That includes managing and maintaining the infrastructure we use, both SaaS and self-managed, and building and maintaining the data pipelines that bring data into it. Okta Workflows is the secure, no-code automation platform that empowers organizations to build identity-centric workflows across cloud applications — all without writing code. Our intuitive drag-and-drop interface allows enterprises to automate complex business processes at scale, enhancing productivity, enforcing security, and simplifying IT operations.

Customers like Netflix, MGM, and NTT rely on Workflows to automate high-impact identity scenarios with speed and confidence. As we continue to scale, we’re investing in extensibility, developer experience, and performance. Join us to help shape the future of cloud automation and low-code development.

 

Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

Work Mode: Hybrid (2-3 days Onsite per week)

Note: "This role requires in-person onboarding and travel to our Bengaluru, IN office during the first week of employment."

 

Position Description

We’re hiring a Staff Full-Stack Engineer to join the Flow builder team within Okta Workflows. This team owns the core no-code canvas that enables both internal teams and our customers to build powerful automation experiences with ease.

As a Staff Engineer, you’ll lead initiatives that span front-end and back-end services — delivering performant, secure, and scalable features. You’ll help define architecture, drive implementation, and collaborate closely with Design, PM, and Platform teams. You’ll also work directly with our technical architects to help shape what we build — and how we build it. This is a high-impact role in a growing, strategic product area with strong executive visibility.

Role Details:

  • Design, build, and maintain end-to-end features using modern JavaScript and cloud-native technologies (React, Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL).
  • Lead technical design for key initiatives, driving quality, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Build reusable and performant UI components for a best-in-class no-code builder experience.
  • Own services throughout their lifecycle — including implementation, testing, deployment, observability, and incident response.
  • Work closely with Product, Design, and Architecture to define the “what” and “how” of features, ensuring solutions are both user-friendly and technically sound.
  • Partner with infrastructure and platform teams to optimize system performance and reliability.
  • Mentor and support engineers across the team, fostering a culture of quality, ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to cross-functional planning, architectural reviews, and team-wide engineering practices.

Experience: 

  • 8+ years of experience building modern web applications in a full-stack environment.
  • Deep expertise in TypeScript, ReactJS, and Node.js (Express or similar frameworks).
  • Experience designing APIs and building robust services at scale in a distributed, cloud-based architecture.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Experience delivering elegant, enterprise-grade user experiences by partnering with Product and Design teams in a fast-paced, agile environment.
  • Ability to collaborate closely with Architects to make smart technical tradeoffs, and drive alignment across teams.
  • Passion for craftsmanship and high engineering standards (testing, monitoring, documentation, scalability).
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions and build consensus across functions.
  • A growth mindset and interest in mentoring others and upleveling the team.

Nice to Haves:

jobs.title: Research Engineer / Scientist, Pre-training
jobs.location: Remote-Friendly (Travel-Required) | San Francisco, CA | Seattle, WA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is at the forefront of AI research, dedicated to developing safe, ethical, and powerful artificial intelligence. Our mission is to ensure that transformative AI systems are aligned with human interests. We are seeking a Research Engineer to join our Pre-training team, responsible for developing the next generation of large language models. In this role, you will work at the intersection of cutting-edge research and practical engineering, contributing to the development of safe, steerable, and trustworthy AI systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct research and implement solutions in areas such as model architecture, algorithms, data processing, and optimizer development

  • Independently lead small research projects while collaborating with team members on larger initiatives

  • Design, run, and analyze scientific experiments to advance our understanding of large language models

  • Optimize and scale our training infrastructure to improve efficiency and reliability

  • Develop and improve dev tooling to enhance team productivity

  • Contribute to the entire stack, from low-level optimizations to high-level model design

Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field

  • Strong software engineering skills with a proven track record of building complex systems

  • Expertise in Python and experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch preferred)

  • Familiarity with large-scale machine learning, particularly in the context of language models

  • Ability to balance research goals with practical engineering constraints

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a results-oriented mindset

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a collaborative environment

  • Care about the societal impacts of your work

Preferred Experience

  • Work on high-performance, large-scale ML systems

  • Familiarity with GPUs, Kubernetes, and OS internals

  • Experience with language modeling using transformer architectures

  • Knowledge of reinforcement learning techniques

  • Background in large-scale ETL processes

You ll thrive in this role if you

  • Have significant software engineering experience

  • Are results-oriented with a bias towards flexibility and impact

  • Willingly take on tasks outside your job description to support the team

  • Enjoy pair programming and collaborative work

  • Are eager to learn more about machine learning research

  • Are enthusiastic to work at an organization that functions as a single, cohesive team pursuing large-scale AI research projects

  • Are working to align state of the art models with human values and preferences, understand and interpret deep neural networks, or develop new models to support these areas of research

  • View research and engineering as two sides of the same coin, and seek to understand all aspects of our research program as well as possible, to maximize the impact of your insights

  • Have ambitious goals for AI safety and general progress in the next few years, and you’re working to create the best outcomes over the long-term.

Sample Projects

  • Optimizing the throughput of novel attention mechanisms

  • Comparing compute efficiency of different Transformer variants

  • Preparing large-scale datasets for efficient model consumption

  • Scaling distributed training jobs to thousands of GPUs

  • Designing fault tolerance strategies for our training infrastructure

  • Creating interactive visualizations of model internals, such as attention patterns

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe. Our data flows from our applications, product events and business systems, in a highly regulated healthcare context. This role exists to build the platform that makes sure that data arrives complete, on time and safe to use, so Product, leadership, RevOps and Finance work from the same numbers. You will be the first data engineer in a new data team that sits in Product, works across the company and reports to the Head of Data. You will own the platform that moves our data into Snowflake and shape the architecture decisions around it: which tools we build on, how pipelines are orchestrated and monitored, and how data infrastructure is managed as code. What to expect This is what you can expect from us as a Senior Data Engineer: Purposeful work – your work gives the teams serving hospitals and aftercare providers data they can trust. Real ownership – as the first data engineer in a new team, you shape the data platform and its tooling. Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you. Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement. Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs. Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off. This is how you will make an impact as a Senior Data Engineer: Data from our application databases, product events and SaaS tools needs to reach Snowflake reliably. You build and run that ingestion and decide where to buy a managed connector and where to build. Our pipelines need clear dependencies, retries, alerting and SLAs. You set up orchestration so a failed or partial load stops downstream work instead of silently producing wrong numbers. New products need event pipelines. You design them together with engineers, keeping patient data out of analytics events by design. Product and Finance need to work from the same definitions. You maintain the dbt models that connect product usage with customer, billing and revenue data. Our CRM (HubSpot) and our internal systems need to talk to each other. You build the data flows between them, including two-way synchronisation where it is needed. Data quality problems need to be caught before a dashboard or a board report does. You establish validation, monitoring and alerting. Our data needs strong privacy and access controls. You enforce role-based access and masking in Snowflake, pseudonymisation, and deletion that propagates across raw and modelled data. Data code needs the same engineering standards as our product code. You bring code review, testing, documentation and CI/CD to it. How we build We run a modern cloud-native stack to move, model and protect data reliably in a regulated healthcare environment. Cloud: AWS (The European Sovereign Cloud partition) Runtime: Kubernetes (EKS) and Postgres (RDS) Warehouse and modelling: Snowflake (EU), dbt Orchestration: Airflow or Dagster (being introduced) BI: Looker Observability: Datadog CI/CD: GitHub Enterprise Cloud with Actions Infrastructure: CloudFormation Business systems: HubSpot, Chargebee Several years (typically 5 or more) building production data pipelines, as a data engineer or as a backend engineer on data-intensive systems. Strong Python: you write tested, maintainable production code, not only scripts. Advanced SQL, including window functions, CTEs and query optimisation. Production experience with Snowflake or a comparable cloud warehouse: compute sizing and cost control, role-based access, masking, and performance tuning. Experience with dbt, or a similar tool for tested and documented transformations. Solid ingestion fundamentals: initial versus incremental loads, change data capture from Postgres, idempotency, schema evolution, late and out-of-order data, and backfills. Production experience with an orchestrator such as Airflow or Dagster. Experience with AWS and with deploying your own work in containers. A data quality mindset: you profile data, test assumptions and build checks. Practical knowledge of GDPR: you can identify personal data and implement pseudonymisation, access control and deletion. You use AI coding tools in your daily work and know where they help and where they need checking. Ability to own decisions as the only data engineer and to explain technical trade-offs to non-engineers. Preference for writing over talking, resulting in clear, concise, yet complete documentation and asynchronous communications. Fluent English, written and spoken. Other languages are a plus. Bonus points Healthcare or regulated-domain experience (e.g. ISO 27001, C5). Integrating CRM and SaaS systems such as HubSpot or Salesforce, including reverse ETL or two-way sync. Designing product event tracking (e.g. Snowplow or Segment). Kubernetes in production. Reading and changing Go code. Managing Snowflake as code. German language skills. jobs.title: Software Engineer - New Grad (2027 Start) - London
Sr. Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Applications
jobs.description:
Senior Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Applications

Enterprise Platform Group · Commercialization (Quote-to-Cash) · Mountain View, CA

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer on the Agentic Applications team, you will be the hands-on technical lead for how Databricks quotes, orders, bills and recognizes revenue. Your core function is to build bespoke first-party, agents-first applications built on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. You will own the technical architecture end to end, from quote to cash. You will design agents that work reliably inside revenue-critical workflows, set the engineering standards the team builds on, and make sure every agent-assisted decision can be observed, audited and trusted by Finance, Deal Desk and Sales.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a people-management role. You will write code, review designs, and be the most senior technical voice in a domain that touches every dollar Databricks books.

The impact you ll have

  • Own the agentic architecture for Quote-to-Cash. Define and lead the target technical architecture across Configure-Price-Quote, deal management, ordering, subscriptions, investments, billing and revenue recognition. Drive the move from vendor-configured workflows to first-party, AI-native applications built on Databricks Apps, Lakebase, Unity Catalog and Mosaic AI.
  • Build production agents that sellers and Deal Desk trust. Design and ship LLM-powered agents for deal guidance, quote generation and summarization, multi-option proposals, approval insights, and pricing and discount recommendations. Work directly with sales, Deal Desk and Finance to define what "good" looks like for each workflow.
  • Make agent reliability a core system property. Own the eval and quality system for this domain: per-workflow quality criteria, offline eval suites, LLM-as-judge and human-labeled benchmarks, behavioral regression testing in CI/CD, online tracing, and feedback loops that improve agents based on what users approve, edit and reject.
  • Design human-in-the-loop controls for revenue-critical decisions. Build the separation between what an agent proposes and what gets committed, plus diff-based review, approval routing, audit logging, and policy guardrails. Together these decide when an agent can act on its own and when a person has to approve, especially for pricing, discounting, contract terms and order creation.
  • Treat systems of record as agent tools. Architect tool-calling and MCP-style interfaces that give agents governed, run-time access to pricing, product catalog, order, contract, subscription and billing data. Follow single-source-of-truth principles across CRM, ERP and billing systems.
  • Protect financial integrity at scale. Make sure agent-assisted quoting and ordering produce accurate, compliance-grade outputs downstream: order validation, billing, invoicing and revenue recognition, where errors directly affect financial reporting.
  • Lead the migration path. Act as the bridge between today s production quoting platform and the target agentic architecture. Sequence the migration so the business keeps scaling without disruption, and decide what to retire, rebuild or wrap.
  • Raise the engineering bar. Lead architecture reviews, establish design patterns for agents (orchestration, memory, retrieval, tool use, multi-agent coordination), and mentor senior and mid-level engineers on production-grade agentic engineering.
  • Earn cross-functional credibility. Partner with Finance, Deal Desk, Sales Ops, Legal and the broader Platform engineering org. Turn complex commercial processes into clear technical roadmaps and measurable business outcomes.

What we look for

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, with a clear track record of technical leadership and ownership of large-scale production systems.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building and running LLM-powered or agentic applications in production, such as agents, RAG pipelines, tool use, multi-agent orchestration (LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, DSPy or equivalent), and evaluation frameworks for generative outputs.
  • Strong backend and distributed-systems skills: API and service design, data modeling, idempotency, consistency and transactional integrity, and observability.
  • Proven experience designing human-in-the-loop systems: approval workflows, review interfaces, audit trails, and guardrails for probabilistic systems operating in regulated or high-stakes domains.
  • Experience leading technical architecture for complex business domains, ideally Quote-to-Cash, Order-to-Revenue, billing, pricing or other revenue-critical enterprise systems.
  • Full-stack fluency. You are comfortable across modern web frameworks (React/TypeScript), backend services (Python, Java, Scala or Go), and data platforms.
  • Ability to work directly with non-engineering stakeholders and turn ambiguous business workflows into clear agent and system architecture.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and improving technical execution across a team, without relying on positional authority.

Nice to have

  • Domain experience with CPQ, deal management, subscription management, or revenue recognition in a high-growth SaaS or consumption-based business.
  • Experience building first-party applications on top of, or as replacements for, enterprise SaaS platforms (e.g., Salesforce CPQ/Revenue Cloud, NetSuite, Zuora). Platform-specific configuration expertise is a plus but not a requirement.
  • Experience with the Databrick

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

About the Role

The Scale Ecosystem Sales Manager (ESM), India is a senior, market-facing role responsible for building and scaling GitLab s partner business in India across the full breadth of the ecosystem. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who has already built a career scaling partner-sourced and influenced revenue in India — someone who knows the hyperscaler ecosystem (AWS & GCP), has deep, credible relationships with India s major SIs, and understands how to engage newer-generation cloud-native and AI partners as they become an increasingly important part of the go-to-market.

  • Own hyperscaler relationship management and Marketplace motion with AWS and/OR GCP.
  • Build and grow relationships with major India SIs and market-making channel/born-in-the-cloud partners and emerging AI-native partners.
  • Drive partner-sourced pipeline and bookings, and carry a quota tied to partner-sourced/generated revenue.

  • Contribute to partner enablement, certification, and go-to-market programs suited to the India market.
  • Report on partner engagement health, pipeline contribution, and progress against strategic-partner milestones.

What We re Looking For

  • 15+ years of experience in channel/alliance/partner management or ecosystem sales, ideally within enterprise software, DevOps, or cloud infrastructure.

  • Comfort carrying a partner-sourced revenue quota and being measured on pipeline origination, not just deal closure.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills — able to align internal sales, marketing, and partner-side stakeholders around joint goals.
  • Native or business-fluent Hindi and strong business English (for regional collaboration with APJ leadership).
  • Based in or willing to relocate to Mumbai OR Delhi.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Fullstack (Card Experiences)
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Card Experiences team builds the product surfaces that make the Affirm Card feel simple and trustworthy. We own the cardholder journey from the moment a card is ordered to every time it s used. Our work spans the full stack: customer-facing web and mobile experiences and the backend services behind them. You ll work closely with product, design, risk, and operations partners to turn customer pain points into shipped improvements, and use data to measure their impact. You ll own features end to end, from shaping the problem to launching and monitoring in production, and you ll help raise the bar on reliability and on-call health. AI is central to how we work. We use it to build faster, to improve the quality of what we ship, and to create smarter, more helpful customer experiences. We lead from the front on adopting it, while holding a high bar on security and craft. A card is a high-trust product, so speed never comes at the expense of quality. If you want to help change how people plan their purchases, with a customer-first mindset and an eye for both speed and craft, we d love to meet you.


What You ll Do

  • You will be responsible for setting technical strategy for your team on a year-long time scale, and help your team tie it together with critical, business-impacting projects.
  • You will collaborate across teams in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics to ensure technical sustainability, risks and trade-offs are well understood and managed.
  • You will act as a force-multiplier for your team through your definition and advocacy of technical solutions and operational processes.
  • You take ownership of your team’s operations and availability by ensuring you have the right monitoring, triage rotations, playbooks, policies, testing and alerting in place to support “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
  • You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
  • You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.



What We Look For

  • This is a full stack role. You have 8+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
  • You have an extensive track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL, Spark and Kubernetes.
  • You have a total of 8+ years of experience as a software engineer.
  • You are proficient in developing web apps using declarative UI frameworks like React Native or React or Vue.
  • You are proficient in designing, developing and launching systems at scale.
  • You have experience delivering major features, system components or deprecating existing functionality in a system through the definition of a technical and execution plan. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
  • You thrive in ambiguity, and are comfortable moving from low level language idioms all the way to the architecture of large systems to understand how they work.
  • You think AI first and an adopter of latest technologies. You identify trends and safely apply them to the work.
  • Your growth and impact trajectory demonstrates that you have mastered gathering and iterating on feedback from your engineering and cross-functional peers.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.
 

Base Pay Grade - P

Equity Grade - 7

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

jobs.title: Software Engineer I (Remote Eligible)
jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

We are hiring a Software Engineer I to join our Engineering team. You will get your hands on full-stack services, dig into distributed systems problems, and work right at the intersection of traditional software engineering and AI-driven development. We are not just dabbling in AI here. We use it to write better code, catch bugs faster, and troubleshoot smarter, and we want engineers who want to get good at that too and help their teammates do the same. You will ship real features, sit in on architectural conversations that actually shape the product, and grow alongside a team that cares as much about doing good work as they do about doing meaningful work. 

You Will:

● Build scalable front-end and back-end services for the next generation of applications at Smartsheet (Kotlin, Java, Typescript, React)

● Solve challenging distributed systems problems and work with modern cloud infrastructure (AWS, Kubernetes) ● Take part in code reviews and architectural discussions as you work with other software engineers and product managers

● Forge a strong partnership with product management and other key areas of the business

● Enhance existing application code with new features and strike a balance when making technical decisions (build vs refactor vs simplify)

● Actively use AI tools to improve personal and team efficiency across coding, testing, design, and troubleshooting, exploring AI integration opportunities within team processes and features, and coaching others on effective AI use 

You Have:

● 1+ years software development experience building highly scalable, highly available applications

● 1+ years of programming experience with full stack technologies such Java, Kotlin, Python or TypeScript

● 1+ years of experience with cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, etc.)

● Experience developing, documenting, and supporting REST APIs

● 6+ months professional experience leveraging AI to improve personal productivity in service of building complex SaaS feature sets

● A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent practical experience

● Adaptable as priorities or problems change

● Ready to take ownership of your work and grow into bigger challenges 

● A clear written and verbal communicator, able to explain your thinking in code reviews, documentation, and team discussions

● Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis 

Current US Perks & Benefits:

  • Employer subsidized medical/vision and dental coverage for full-time employees
  • 401k Match to help you save for your future (50% of your contribution up to the first 6% of your eligible pay)
  • Monthly stipend to support your work and productivity
  • Flexible Time Away Program, plus Sick Time Off
  • US employees are automatically covered under Smartsheet-sponsored life insurance, short-term, and long-term disability plans
  • US employees receive 12 paid holidays per year
  • Up to 24 weeks of Parental Leave
  • Personal paid Volunteer Day to support our community
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development including access to Udemy online courses
  • Company Funded Perks, including a counseling membership, local retail discounts, and your own personal Smartsheet account
  • Teleworking options from any registered location in the U.S. (role specific)

Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market competitive incentive opportunity.

$107,500—$147,500 USD

 

Get to Know Us:

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

jobs.title: Senior Channel Sales Manager - LATAM
jobs.description:
About Teleport

Don't wait for the future of infrastructure. Be part of it.

Teleport is the AI Infrastructure Identity Company. We're solving one of the hardest problems in security: giving every human, machine, workload, and AI agent a cryptographically secured identity, improving engineering velocity while maintaining security. We make trusted computing simple. This gives you the freedom, power, and autonomy to build and innovate with confidence.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we work with companies like Nasdaq, DoorDash, and Elastic to secure infrastructure for an AI world.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Teleport's Channel team builds the partner ecosystem that helps our Enterprise Account Executives source more deals and close them faster. As a Senior Channel Sales Manager, LATAM, you'll own that ecosystem across Latin America from a US base: recruiting and onboarding partners, building joint business plans, and driving the co-sell motion that turns partner relationships into sourced pipeline and revenue. This is a quota-carrying role. You'll also help decide which partners we invest in and how we show up with them.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the partner-sourced pipeline and revenue number for LATAM - this is a building from scratch position

 - Recruit, onboard, and manage regional partners (resellers, distributors, MSPs, and cloud partners) to drive co-sell

 - Build joint business plans for a focused set of go-to partners that line up with regional sales goals

 - Run account mapping and regional sales meetings that connect partner reps with Teleport AEs on real accounts

 - Quarterback co-sell deals between Teleport AEs and partner sellers, from registration through close

 - Present the Teleport portfolio and partner program benefits to partner leadership

 - Work with Product, Sales Engineering, and Marketing to train, enable, and certify partner sales and technical teams in the region

 - Own regional partner MDF plans and budgets, and report on results against OKRs




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8+ years of partner or channel sales experience at a B2B SaaS or technology company, covering the LATAM market

 - Background selling security, infrastructure, or DevOps tooling

 - Fluency in Portuguese is a must

 - Deep understanding of how channel partners work with ISVs to co-sell, and an existing network among partners in Latin America, Brazil specifically

 - Proven ability to work cross-functionally and earn the trust of internal sellers, so AEs want to work with you

 - Self-motivated, hands-on, and comfortable in a lean, fast-moving environment (start-up experience is a plus)

 - Based in the United States, comfortable traveling, with a Bachelor's degree or equivalent




NICE TO HAVE

 - Additional fluency in Spanish

 - MSP and distribution experience

 - Experience co-selling with AWS, including registering opportunities through ACE




HOW WE HIRE

Our process is designed to be straightforward and respectful of your time. We skip performative rounds and focus on what matters: understanding how you think and what you can do.

You'll start with a 30-minute recruiter screen, followed by a 30-minute conversation with the hiring manager, a series of 30 to 45-minute conversations with members of our Channel and Sales teams, and a 45-minute presentation to a panel of Teleport leaders.



Why Teleport

You're joining a company where the problem is real, the team is small, and your work shows up directly in the product. We're not a big company, you won't get lost in a crowd. You'll have the freedom and autonomy to do what you're great at, alongside teammates who care about doing it right and want to see you succeed. The work is collaborative, there's real room to grow, and the mission is one worth showing up for.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we're genuinely passionate about what we're building.



The Benefits

At Teleport, we believe your career is more important than a list of perks. That's why we focus on making your day-to-day the best it can be — giving you the autonomy, access, and support to do the best work of your career.

- Extensive health coverage

- Annual expense budget

- Rest and recovery policies that maximize your ability to recharge

- Investment in your future with retirement savings plans

- Professional development opportunities

jobs.title: Director, Data Platform - T0
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


ABOUT THE TEAM

This team designs intelligent, autonomous systems that eliminate financial operations for companies globally. We automate everything from bookkeeping and reconciliation to tax, payroll, forecasting, and document understanding: turning hours of work into seconds. The team blends deep research pedigree with proven industry experience. We operate with high standards, are tool-agnostic, and expect engineers to own problems end-to-end. We collaborate closely, push boundaries responsibly, and ship exceptional work quickly. You’ll solve unprecedented technical challenges using unique, end-to-end financial datasets no one else in the industry has.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Director of Data Platform Engineering, you’ll lead the team responsible for the data backbone of our financial systems. You’ll set the technical direction for high-volume financial data ingestion, our Databricks lakehouse, data orchestration, canonical financial models, and the infrastructure that makes our data platform reliable, scalable, and increasingly real-time.

You’ll combine strong technical judgment with people leadership—building a high-performing engineering organization, establishing platform standards, driving major migrations, and partnering closely with product, accounting, and platform teams. You’ll help shape a data platform where correctness, auditability, performance, and operational excellence are foundational.

This role is based in San Francisco.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead and grow a high-performing data platform engineering team, providing technical direction, mentorship, career development, and clear ownership.
   

 - Set the technical strategy for high-volume financial data ingestion across payment processors, banks, billing systems, and ERP/GL platforms, with strong guarantees around correctness, replayability, and recovery.
   

 - Lead the evolution of our Databricks lakehouse using Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, dbt, Python, and SQL, optimizing for scale, performance, reliability, and cost.
   

 - Define standards for data contracts, schema evolution, drift detection, data quality, and canonical financial models.
   

 - Evolve the platform from batch toward near-real-time processing using Kafka, CDC, micro-batching, incremental processing, and Dagster orchestration.
   

 - Own the architecture of canonical financial models that transform complex source data into consistent financial objects and relationships powering our accounting engine.
   

 - Partner with infrastructure and platform teams to build reliable production foundations across observability, alerting, incident response, recovery, and operational readiness.
   

 - Guide infrastructure strategy across GCP, Terraform, Kubernetes/GKE, Helm, GitOps, and CI/CD.
   

 - Lead migrations from legacy pipelines to the lakehouse, with rigorous parity validation, staged rollouts, and clear rollback strategies.
   

 - Drive performance and cost optimization across PostgreSQL, Databricks, and large-scale data workloads.
   

 - Partner with product, accounting, ML, and platform leadership to translate business needs into scalable data platform capabilities.
   

 - Set technical direction through architecture reviews, design documents, engineering standards, and long-term platform roadmaps.
   

 - Champion AI-assisted engineering practices that improve team velocity while maintaining high standards for code quality, testing, security, and reliability.
   


WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO HAVE

 - 8+ years of experience in data platform, backend, or infrastructure engineering, including significant experience leading engineering teams.
   

 - Proven experience managing and developing senior engineers and technical leads and building strong, autonomous teams.
   

 - Deep expertise in data platforms, distributed systems, data modeling, and production data pipelines.
   

 - Strong experience with Python and SQL, plus hands-on experience with Spark, Databricks, Delta Lake, dbt, and modern lakehouse architectures.
   

 - Experience building reliable ingestion systems with large-scale backfills, incremental processing, checkpointing, rate-limit handling, idempotency, and failure recovery.
   

 - Strong understanding of streaming and event-driven architectures, including Kafka, CDC, and micro-batching.
   

 - Experience with data orchestration platforms such as Dagster and designing for freshness, partitioning, and incremental computation.
   

 - Experience optimizing PostgreSQL and analytical workloads for performance and cost.
   

 - Experience operating production infrastructure on GCP, with familiarity with Terraform, Kubernetes/GKE, Helm, GitOps, and CI/CD.
   

 - Strong understanding of observability, reliability engineering, and production operations.
   

 - Excellent technical communication skills, with the ability to influence architecture and engineering decisions across teams.

jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops AI-native silicon and system-level solutions for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads. Building on efforts like Jalapeño, our custom silicon program, the team works across silicon architecture, RTL design, verification, physical design, systems software, and infrastructure to deliver highly performant, efficient, and scalable hardware solutions.

The Silicon & Systems team brings together hardware and software engineers to co-design and build the next generation of AI infrastructure. We operate at the intersection of silicon, systems, and software, tackling complex technical challenges across the full hardware development lifecycle, from early architecture and design through validation, deployment, and production.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Infrastructure Software Engineer to build and scale the infrastructure and developer workflows that power OpenAI’s custom silicon development. You’ll work closely with engineering teams across design verification, physical design, emulation, formal verification, and systems software to develop reliable, automated, and efficient workflows that accelerate hardware development.

In this role, you'll own and improve the cloud infrastructure, high-performance computing (HPC) environments, CI/CD pipelines, regression systems, and data platforms that support our silicon engineering teams. You'll translate complex hardware development requirements into scalable infrastructure solutions, reducing manual overhead, improving reliability, and enabling engineers to iterate faster.

This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role with opportunities to drive improvements across the entire hardware development lifecycle. We're looking for engineers who bring deep expertise in one or more infrastructure domains, strong software engineering fundamentals, and an interest in expanding their impact across the broader platform.

In this role, you will:

 - Build developer tools and workflows: Partner with hardware engineering teams to understand their development processes, identify bottlenecks, and build tooling, services, and APIs that automate workflows and accelerate engineering productivity.

 - Develop and scale regression infrastructure: Design, implement, and operate large-scale regression systems spanning job scheduling, execution, results collection, triage, and reporting, with a focus on performance, reliability, and reproducibility.

 - Own CI/CD infrastructure: Build and maintain automated pipelines for infrastructure, developer tooling, and cluster configurations, enabling safe deployments, testing, and continuous improvement.

 - Scale cloud and HPC environments: Design, provision, and operate cloud infrastructure and high-performance compute clusters, optimizing scheduling, capacity, reliability, and cost efficiency to support demanding silicon development workloads.

 - Build data infrastructure and observability: Develop data pipelines, databases, and monitoring systems that provide visibility into regression results, infrastructure health, resource utilization, and engineering efficiency.

 - Drive platform reliability and operational excellence: Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues, improve monitoring and alerting, automate recovery processes, and build systems that are resilient, maintainable, and scalable.

 - Collaborate across hardware and software teams: Work directly with engineers across RTL, verification, physical design, emulation, and software to continuously improve the infrastructure supporting OpenAI's silicon development.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have strong software engineering fundamentals, with proficiency in Python or a similar programming language and experience building reliable automation, tools, or infrastructure services.

 - Bring deep technical expertise in at least one area of infrastructure engineering, such as Linux/HPC environments, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD systems, storage, networking, or EDA development workflows.

 - Have experience designing, deploying, and operating cloud infrastructure, preferably Azure, with familiarity in infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or Bicep.

 - Have strong Linux systems knowledge, including processes, filesystems, networking, permissions, performance troubleshooting, and system administration.

 - Have experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, Buildkite, GitHub Actions, or similar platforms.

 - Are comfortable debugging complex distributed infrastructure problems, identifying root causes, and implementing durable solutions.

 - Enjoy working closely with engineering teams to understand technical requirements and translate them into scalable, practical infrastructure solutions.

 - Take ownership of systems end to end, from initial design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing operational improvements.

 - Bring strong technical judgment, clear communication, and a collaborative approach to solving ambiguous engineering challenges.

 - Are curious about hardware development and excited to expand your technical expertise across infrastructure, silicon design workflows, and developer productivity.

jobs.description:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?



Your mission
The Guardrails service empowers organizations to confidently deploy autonomous agents by embedding protection mechanisms that govern agent behavior, data access, and decision boundaries. Through policy enforcement, monitoring, and adaptive controls, we help safeguard users and systems while maintaining the agility and intelligence that make agentic automation transformative.

Our mission extends beyond UiPath Agents — we're evolving Guardrails into a scalable, platform-wide capability that brings consistent governance and protection across the broader UiPath ecosystem. By combining innovation, security, and user trust, we enable customers to explore the full potential of automation with confidence and control




WHAT YOU'LL DO AT UIPATH

 - Plan, design, develop, and test software systems or applications for enhancements and new features, including cloud-based tools.

 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams across UiPath to design and engineer product areas and services.

 - Ensure technical deliverables meet expectations for quality, security, scalability, modifiability, extensibility, and testability.

 - Contribute to the establishment of effective and agile engineering practices.

 - Identify performance bottlenecks and bugs; implement solutions to address them.

 - Plan feature development, design system components, and contribute to the engineering roadmap.

 - Maintain code quality, organization, and automation.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TEAM

 - 5+ years of experience in a software engineering role using high-level languages (C#, C++, Java, Python, Rust, etc.)

 - Strong grasp of object-oriented programming and architectural design patterns.

 - Knowledge of multithreading, synchronization, and asynchronous programming.

 - Solid understanding of data structures and algorithms.

 - Ability to write well-tested, high-quality code.

 - Familiarity with the latest versions of .NET and C# features.

 - Experience with other languages and technologies: C++, NodeJS, JavaScript, Angular, XAML.

 - Cloud services experience with one or more of: Azure (preferred), AWS, GCP.

 - Experience with data processing platforms and ETL/ELT pipelines (e.g. Snowflake, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Spark, dbt).

 - Familiarity with modern data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, and analytics engineering best practices.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy https://www.uipath.com/legal/trust-and-security/privacy-policy.

jobs.title: (Senior) Full Stack Engineer (m/f/x) - Based in Germany
jobs.description: Cara Care, a digital health company backed by Bayer AG, is on a mission to improve people’s digestive health through technology. As we expand our product portfolio and modernize our platform, we’re looking for a versatile, pragmatic, and forward-thinking (Senior) Full-Stack Engineer (m/f/x) to help shape the future of digital therapeutics. Your Role You’ll join a cross-functional product team with high ownership, lean processes, and a clear focus: deliver real impact to patients. We’re looking for someone who thrives on solving real-world problems with code, is technology-open, and knows when to build fast and when to build right. Your main focus will be building and improving our backend services, while also contributing to our React Native apps. You’ll also help us use AI tools and coding agents thoughtfully in day-to-day engineering, turning emerging capabilities into reliable workflows that improve how we design, build, test, and operate patient-facing products. Your Responsibilities Design, build, and operate reliable backend services and APIs , primarily using Python, Django, and PostgreSQL, and contribute targeted changes to our React Native applications with TypeScript. Use AI coding agents to implement features, refactor code, and generate tests. Define clear tasks and constraints, provide relevant context, Provide clear context and constraints, and validate changes through code review, automated tests, and application-level checks. Take an end-to-end view of features : understand how mobile clients, APIs, data models, and infrastructure interact, and make pragmatic technical decisions across these boundaries. Own backend delivery from architecture and implementation to automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and iteration, and continuously improve our CI/CD pipelines. Improve the performance and reliability of our backend services, APIs, and databases. Connect AI-assisted development to engineering and design tools via MCP, for example to automate repetitive coding tasks or check frontend changes against Figma designs. Keep patient data, credentials, and other sensitive information out of unapproved tools and workflows. Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Medical to explore, define, and deliver patient-centric features across our platform, supporting regulated digital health products for IBS, GERD, and upcoming indications. Uphold technical excellence in architecture, code quality, and security , including applicable requirements under IEC 62304, BSI TR-03161, and the MDR. Mentor other developers and help raise the technical bar across the team. Requirements Your Profile Must haves 5+ years of professional software engineering experience , with a strong backend focus and an understanding of how complete applications work from user interface to infrastructure. Strong backend development skills in an established language such as Python, TypeScript, Java, or PHP. Our current stack includes Python, Django, and PostgreSQL. Working knowledge of React Native and TypeScript , with the ability to implement and test changes in an existing mobile application. Solid understanding of relational databases, API design, distributed systems and services . Experience writing and maintaining automated tests for backend services and APIs , including unit and integration tests. Solid understanding of backend security and privacy , including authentication, authorization, secrets management, and secure handling of personal and patient data. Strong practical knowledge of containers, Kubernetes, and cloud-native architecture , with experience using GCP or another major cloud provider such as AWS or Azure. Hands-on experience using AI coding agents to implement features, refactor code, and write automated tests, including connecting agents to engineering tools via MCP . You can explain how you scoped the work, verified the results, and handled tool permissions and sensitive data. A pragmatic product mindset : you collaborate effectively with non-technical stakeholders, understand the impact of technical decisions on patients and UX, and continuously improve both product and platform. Nice-to-have Strong Linux administration skills , including setting up, operating, and securing self-managed cloud instances; familiarity with monitoring and observability concepts. Experience with Prometheus, Loki, and Grafana ; GitOps using ArgoCD or FluxCD; or configuration management using Ansible or similar tools. Networking knowledge and experience with mobile CI/CD, release automation, or application monitoring tools such as Sentry. Experience in regulated industries, healthcare, or other security-conscious environments . 💡 Please note : Cara Care is a remote-first company with a fully distributed team. All team members are based in Germany so candidates must reside in Germany to join us . Benefits 💸 Fair compensation: We offer fair pay, regular salary reviews, and the equipment you need to do your best work. 🫶 Great team spirit: Join a vibrant, interdisciplinary team and enjoy a friendly, supportive working atmosphere, with regular in-person team events. 👨‍💻 Remote-first working: Prefer working from home? No problem. Want to join us at our Berlin office? That works too. Our remote-first approach gives you the flexibility to work where it suits you best. 🏝️ 30 days off per year: Rest matters. You’ll get 26 vacation days plus 4 additional company-wide mental health days each year to take a breather and recharge. 🦉 Flexible working hours: Whether you’re an early bird or prefer a later start, you can shape your working day around what works for you. 🏋️ Urban Sports Club (USC): Enjoy access to a wide range of sports, fitness, and wellness activities at discounted rates. 🧠 OpenUp: Access a variety of resources and services to support your mental health and personal wellbeing. 🛍️ Corporate Benefits: Get attractive discounts and exclusive offers from a wide range of well-known brands and providers. �

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Transport & Customs (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Notre équipe Transport&Customs Engineering recherche un·e ingénieur.e développement logiciel backend basé·e à Lille.

Au cœur de Value Chain et rattaché à Decathlon Digital, les équipes united du sous domaine Fulfillment, Logistics, Transport and Customs (FLTC) ont un rôle très important à jouer avec un impact direct sur l’expérience client à travers la disponibilité de nos produits et les délais de livraison. 

Notre équipe Transport&Customs Engineering design, développe et assure la maintenance de nos outils digitaux interconnectés avec un écosystème Decathlon complexe qui permet la gestion de la chaîne de valeur de bout en bout. Ces outils sont réparti sur deux périmètres : 

Transport : plusieurs produits digitaux pour gérer le transport international (upstream) et les flux de transport locaux (downstream) de nos produits et composants. Ces produits digitaux interviennent depuis nos fournisseurs jusqu’au client final.Customs : Des outils digitaux pour les douanes permettant le référencement de nos produits et composants, le calcul des taux et la génération des documents douaniers ainsi que les opérations de déclaration et dédouanement à la sortie/entrée d’une zone douanière.

TA FUTURE MISSION

Rejoignez l équipe Transport et Douane l! Historiquement basée sur des outils monolithiques (Legacy) générant une complexité de référencement et une forte imprévisibilité des coûts à payer en douane, nous sommes en pleine transformation. Notre vision est de créer une source intelligente et malléable à fin que notre référentiel soit une source de vérité unique. L utilisation de l IA pour l auto-classification et l optimisation dynamique des droits de douane, transformera la douane à Decathlon et fera de la conformité, un levier stratégique de compétitivité.

Pour répondre à ces challenges, tout en permettant la croissance du business de Decathlon, nous cherchons à renforcer l’équipe produit Ref&Calcul par un développeur backend  qui va travailler avec le reste de l’équipe et en se référant au inputs business pour développer from scratch la solution de référencement des produits et composants et de calcul des taux de douanes. Dans le cadre de cette mission, Il sera amené à faire du support niveau 2 et Niveau 3 sur des solutions existantes et de celles qu’il développera. 

 

Une attention particulière sera apportée quant à l’autonomie requise pour les développements, autant que sur le partage d expérience et de compétence.

 

TON EXPERTISE 

 

Une expérience en développement dans des contextes agiles est fortement appréciée.

Le profil évoluera dans une équipe support et aura la responsabilité de prendre les sujets supports de Niveau 2 et 3

Il sera force de proposition sur les développements d amélioration continue, la supervision et le monitoring de l ensemble des applications du périmètre.

Le profil doit être intéressé et volontaire sur du Backend et capable d appliquer et de différencier les bonnes pratiques de développement

Communiquant et force de proposition, tu dois aussi savoir faire preuve de transparence, gérer tes priorités, et être impliqué autant dans la réussite du/des projet(s) que dans la réussite de tes collègues

 

Compétences Requises

  • Concept : BDD, TDD, DDD, Clean Architecture / code, …
  • Back : Java 17+, SpringBoot, RESTful API, Kafka, kafka connect, OpenAPI, Oauth2, JWT, …
  • Architecture Microservices
  • Infra & Database : Docker, Kubernetes (GKE, EKS), Vault, postgres, mongodb
  • Deploy : Github - Github Actions, Flux, Helm
  • Tools & Monitoring : SonarQube, Datadog, Bruno, Gravitee…
  • Testing : Cucumber, Gatling, testContainers…

Compétences Souhaitées

  • Front : React, Typescript, Javascript, NextJS, TailwindCSS
  • Testing : Cypress ou Playwright, Jest ou Vitest, Gatling, X-RAY

Qualités attendues

  • Ecoute, communication, transparence
  • Autonomie
  • Rigueur et organisation
  • Sens du service

 

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

  • 2 jours de télétravail par semaine ;
  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac, Windows, ou Chromebooks) ;
  • Une équipe de projet locale au sein d un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;
  • Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, certifications techniques dès la première année, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;
  • Package de rémunération (participation des employés aux actions de l entreprise, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.
