jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the Team & Role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

Robinhood has been tapped as the brokerage and initial trustee for Trump Accounts, and is working alongside BNY and The U.S. Department of Treasury to develop and operate the program, which aims to expand market access for the next generation of Americans. In this role, you will help build a world-class, intuitive platform, leveraging Robinhood’s industry-leading financial technology to deliver a standalone web and app experience for this historic national initiative.

The Government Products team focuses on building and scaling systems that support long-term investing and account management for millions of customers. This team works closely with product, data, and infrastructure partners to deliver reliable, secure, and intuitive  experiences. You will help shape systems that enable customers to plan for their financial future with confidence!

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you will serve as a foundational technical leader for this 0-to-1 initiative. You will be responsible for designing and building the critical backend architecture, pipelines, and complex cross-functional integrations required to interface securely with government systems. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role where you will directly shape a platform built to serve millions of future customers

This role is based in our New York, NY office(s), with in-person attendance expected 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What You ll Do

  • Lead the technical design, architectural strategy, and implementation of a brand-new, standalone backend infrastructure optimized for security, reliability, and scale.
  • Design secure data pipelines and robust APIs to integrate government-backed registries, employer contribution frameworks, and institutional banking systems.
  • Guide engineering teams across Robinhood s broader brokerage ecosystem, fostering technical excellence, setting high bar code standards, and mentoring senior engineers.
  • Partner closely with Product, Security, Legal, and external stakeholders to navigate the unique protections and technical compliance protocols of a highly regulated government contract.
  • Own backend stability and performance tuning ahead of initial high-volume user rollouts and the general public launch.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience with a proven track record of operating as a principal or staff-level engineer, driving multi-year technical vision, long-term architecture, and strategic direction for large-scale distributed systems.
  • Advanced mastery-level proficiency in designing, building, and maintaining high-throughput, low-latency distributed infrastructure and secure data pipelines using Python or Go.
  • Deep expertise in domain modeling, microservices architecture, and building highly reliable APIs capable of orchestrating complex cross-functional data flows across multiple engineering domains.
  • Demonstrable execution in a zero-to-one product space, navigating high levels of technical ambiguity, setting foundational engineering patterns, and systematically de-risking complex technical blockers.
  • Experience serving as a primary technical point of contact across an entire organization, with a strong commitment to raising the engineering bar by sponsoring and mentoring senior engineers.
  • Exceptional communication skills with a proven capability to partner closely with Product, Security, Compliance, and external institutional partners to translate highly complex legal or regulatory constraints into clean, maintainable backend infrastructure.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
  • Best in class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals

jobs.title: Senior Auditor - IT
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Senior IT Auditor - IT Internal Audit

Snowflake is growing and looking for a driven Senior IT Auditor to join our team. You will report to the Manager, IT Internal Audit and help with an evolving workload with minimal supervision in a fast-paced environment. Whether it is facilitating Snowflake’s SOX compliance efforts or conducting internal audits, we strive to enhance the effectiveness, efficiency and scalability of the company’s processes, systems, and underlying internal control environment. You will be expected to problem solve, collaborate, and move fast while keeping attention to detail.

AS A SENIOR IT AUDITOR, YOU WILL:                           

 - Execute and support our IT SOX internal controls assessment, other IT audits and investigations.

 - Evaluate and test the Information Technology General Controls (ITGCs), automated controls, key reports and other IT dependencies as applicable.

 - Develop and update risk and control matrices (RCM), flowcharts, and testing procedures.

 - Prepare and maintain testing workpapers as well as ensure timely testing.

 - Assess and analyze the impact of IT control deficiencies and audit findings; identify remediation procedures and compensating controls to address the associated risks.

 - Participate in risk assessments and the design of audit programs to address relevant risks.

 - Lead in all phases of internal audits including planning, fieldwork, close meetings, and reporting.

 - Partner the Managers and Senior Managers to identify areas of improvement as well as recommend industry-wide best practices.

OUR IDEAL SENIOR IT AUDITOR WILL HAVE:

 - Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology or Systems; or relevant MBA.

 - Recognized professional qualification(s) CA/CPA/CISA/CIA/CISSP.

 - 7+ years of relevant work experience in IT SOX, other Technology or System audits and SOC 1 / SOC 2 / CIS controls assessment.

 - Experience with Big 4 accounting firms or global public companies is strongly preferred.

 - Experience with cloud-based or software as a service (SAAS) companies, and certifications like AWS, Azure and Google Cloud is a plus but not required

 - Proven experience in supporting the execution of an end-to-end IT SOX program and control principles (e.g. COSO). Experience in auditing Salesforce and Workday Financials is strongly preferred.

 - Data interpretation and data driven audit/analytics approach with experience in SQL. Ability to read Java/Python preferred.

 - Detail and team-orientated; ability to work both independently and as a team member.

 - Self-starter, ability to proactively problem-solve, identify, advocate for and execute improvements.

 - Ability to maintain a positive attitude and embrace changes, thrive in a fast-paced environment.

 - Ability to manage multiple, concurrent projects efficiently and effectively with minimal oversight. Maintain relationships with process owners and other key stakeholders.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com http://careers.snowflake.com

jobs.title: Staff DX Engineer
jobs.description:
At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure.

Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users.

Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development.

We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you.




APPLYING TO RENDER

We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.

We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.

Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

DX Engineering shows developers what building on Render is actually like. We make the tutorials, demo apps, templates, and videos that get developers to try Render, and we build the agent skills and internal tooling that keep that work running at scale. We're also often the first real users of what Render ships. We test major releases end to end, the way a customer would, and tell Product and Engineering where they fall down before customers hit it.

As a DX Engineer, you'll own technical content and code from the first idea to a working sample app, docs, and video. You'll work with DevRel, Product Marketing, Product, and Engineering, and you'll have real influence over how developers and coding agents discover and adopt Render.

This is a remote role within the US, with the option to work out of our headquarters in San Francisco.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build tutorials, demo apps, and videos that show developers how to build real things on Render, with a focus on AI applications, agents, and Render's AI runtime products like Render Workflows.

 - Own Render templates and the render-examples GitHub org for the frameworks developers ask about most. Everything you ship has to deploy and run.

 - Build agent skills, automation, and internal tools so the team stops doing repetitive content and ops work by hand.

 - Improve how Render shows up in LLM and answer-engine results. Dig into why Render is missing from an answer it should be in, then ship the content or fix that changes it.

 - Alpha test new releases end to end and write up what breaks, with enough detail for Product and Engineering to act on.

 - Contribute code to developer-facing surfaces like the Render CLI, MCP server, SDKs, and docs.

 - Shape the content roadmap and quality bar with Product, Engineering, and Marketing, and iterate on feedback and metrics.

 - Set technical direction for DX Engineering's content and tooling, and raise the bar for the rest of the team through reviews, standards, and your own work.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8+ years building developer content, or working as an engineer who teaches, at a developer tools or infrastructure company.

 - Experience setting technical direction and raising the bar for a team.

 - Full-stack engineering experience. Strong backend skills (Node.js/TypeScript, Python, Postgres), comfort with Docker and containers, and enough frontend skill to ship sample apps end to end.

 - Deep, hands-on knowledge of AI agents and the workloads they run. You've built and deployed agents that call tools, run code in sandboxes, and handle long-running tasks with retries and state, and you know what infrastructure each of those needs.

 - Experience with the agent stack: MCP servers, agent frameworks, LLM APIs, evals, and durable workflow or background job systems.

 - Daily fluency with coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor, and the taste to ship quality work at a steady cadence with them.

 - Excellent technical writing. You know what world-class developer content looks like.

 - A track record of owning projects end to end with little direction.

 - Strong intuition for developer tools and a love of well-crafted user experiences.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - You've used Render before, professionally or on side projects.

 - Experience with AEO or SEO, or with measuring how content performs in LLM answers.

 - A public body of work: talks, a YouTube channel, popular open source repos, or a well-read blog.

 - Experience presenting workshops and technical talks.


SOME PROJECTS YOU MIGHT WORK ON

 - A video series on building and deploying an MCP server on Render.

 - A sample app for an upcoming launch, built with Product and Engineering ahead of release.

 - An agent skill that turns a tutorial

jobs.title: Director Partner Programs & Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply.  Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.



Partners are one of Kong's biggest levers for AI Gateway pipeline and bookings, and our partner business is growing fast. Kong is hiring a Director, Partner Operations to build the operating model that helps it scale.

You'll be the operating partner to the Ecosystem VP and Partner Sales leaders, sitting in Revenue Operations. You own how partner business flows through Kong — registration, deal structure, attribution, crediting, and payout — and you bring an AI-first mindset to how it runs.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Business partner to Ecosystem leadership
Serve as the strategic and operational partner to the Ecosystem VP and Partner Sales leaders across theaters. Run an AI-assisted operating cadence — forecast and pipeline reviews, QBRs, and executive reporting — where the prep is automated and meetings go to decisions. Facilitate cross-functional alignment on people, then process, then systems, so changes are agreed before they are configured.

Partner GTM strategy & planning
Lead annual and quarterly planning for the partner organization, including targets, capacity, and coverage. Help build a business that maximizes the impact of partner investments and resources. 

Rules of engagement, deal registration & attribution
Own the rules that govern how partner deals are registered, protected, sourced, and credited, including sourced vs. influenced credit, lookback windows, and the line between partner credit and partner marketing credit. Encode them into systems and agents so they apply automatically.

Partner lead & deal workflows: Define and own how partner-touched leads and deals move between ADR, PSD, and AE, including routing, SLAs, and prioritization. Cover partner event leads, prospective partners, existing partners, and deal registrations, and give PSDs one view of the leads that need their action.

Partner deal execution
Partner with Deal Desk, Finance, and Legal to make partner deals easy to structure, discount, and book across resale, referral, and cloud marketplace routes

Partner compensation & crediting
Partner with Incentive Compensation on channel-neutral crediting and referral fees, so sellers choose the best route to market.

Manage cloud marketplace operations: Own Kong’s cloud marketplace operations across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud, including listings, private offers, channel partner private offers (CPPOs), and co-sell registration. Lead the launch of marketplaces in new regions, and manage marketplace dynamics with Deal Desk, Finance, and the cloud alliances team, including fees, customer commit drawdown, and partner involvement on marketplace deals.

Performance insights & data quality
Define and report the partner KPIs that matter, give every partner leader a run-the-business view, and keep partner data accurate.

Partner marketing measurement & MDF
Work closely with Partner Marketing and Marketing Ops to define how partner marketing is measured. Tie MDF and event spend to registered deals by capturing funding source on deal registrations, and report sourced and influenced pipeline separately.
Operational playbooks & enablement
Build and maintain the partner operations handbook and repeatable workflows, from partner onboarding to software access, including prospective partner intake and ADR and PSD training on routing rules, so every seller knows the process on day one.

Systems & data architecture
Own partner data design and routing rules. That includes partner account structure, alignment of deal registration approval with lead routing, and alerts when opportunities open on partner accounts. Evaluate whether the PRM remains the right long-term fit.

AI & automation roadmap
Own the Partner Operations AI roadmap: find the highest-leverage workflows, build or buy the agents and automations, and measure the hours returned to the field. Own business requirements for partner tooling across Salesforce, PRM, and CPQ.

Lean, high-output team
Build a small team of AI-native operators, and work across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Customer Success to drive change as the ecosystem scales.

Required Experience:

 - 10+ years in Partner or Channel Operations, Revenue Operations, or Sales Strategy & Operations at a B2B SaaS or infrastructure software company, including 3+ years leading partner operations - with direct ownership of deal registration, rules of engagement, and partner attribution.

 - 3+ years experience operating a multi-type, multi-region partner ecosystem - GSIs, regional SIs, resellers, distributors, ISVs, and hyperscalers.

 - Hands-on partner deal execution end to end - resale, referral, and cloud marketplace transactions, partner discounting, and order form requirements - in partnership with Deal Desk and Finance.

 - 3+ years experience leading partner planning - targets, quota, capacity, and coverage  and designing channel-neutral crediting with Incentive Compensation.

 - Proven track record as a trusted advisor to VP-level Partner or Sales leaders, with the presence to hold a governance line and the judgment to know when to evolve it.

 - Deep Salesforce fluency (opportunity design, sourcing fields, reporting) plus PRM and BI tools, and hands-on use of AI tools to automate ops workflows.

Preferred experience:

 - Hyperscaler co-sell and marketplace mechanics: AWS ACE and ISV Accelerate, Marketplace private offers, Microsoft co-sell, and Google Cloud Partner Advantage.

 - Experience supporting a shift to usage-based or consumption pricing and reflecting it in partner deal structures and crediting.

 - Experience leading a team from building processes to running them at scale.

 - API, cloud infrastructure, or AI platform experience.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure Foundations
jobs.description:
SUMMARY

 

Infrastructure Foundations builds and operates the multi-cloud platform underneath Temporal Cloud, turning the complexity of AWS, Google Cloud (GCP), and Azure into one cohesive platform the rest of Temporal builds on. Every cell we run is provisioned, managed, and safely changed by systems this team owns. When a customer's workflow runs, it runs on our work. We are heading into the next stage: Kubernetes-based infrastructure platforms built for the next orders of magnitude of growth.

 

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to design and build the next version of that platform. You will own a significant multi-component system, from the APIs other teams build on to how infrastructure state is modeled, changed, and recovered, and coordinate the engineers building its parts. You will stay close enough to the code to prove decisions out, build the capability roadmap for this area with the engineering manager, and lead through design reviews and the hardest incidents.

 

What makes this team different



 - Real multi-cloud, not multi-cloud on a slide. We run across AWS, GCP, and Azure and keep extending the platform to new providers. The abstractions you design are the ones every new cloud plugs into.

 - We build Temporal Cloud with Temporal. Cell creation, component deployment, and cloud provisioning run as Temporal workflows. You will shape how Temporal runs its own infrastructure on Temporal.

 - A platform transformation, not maintenance. HA/DR for our control infrastructure, a declarative model for the whole platform, and a deployment control plane, all designed while a live platform keeps running.

 - Everything sits on top of it. Nearly every team at Temporal depends on what we build, so the standards you set for this platform shape how those teams ship.

 

Responsibilities

 

 - Multi-cloud architecture: Design the abstraction model that makes AWS, GCP, and Azure read as one platform. Decide where provider differences in IAM, networking, quotas, and failure modes get absorbed, and how new regions and providers plug in.

 - Own a significant system: Design and build the multi-component platform end to end, and coordinate the engineers working on its parts. Make the system-level tradeoffs between conflicting requirements, and make them explicit.

 - Declarative infrastructure model: Define how components are described, versioned, and reconciled across Kubernetes workloads and supporting cloud resources. Set the approach for reproducible environments, drift visibility, and safe reconciliation.

 - Deployment control plane: Design the shared inventory, dependency awareness, rollout sequencing, and approvals that let many teams change production safely. Keep orchestration and safety policy cohesive while integrating with the frameworks that execute deployments.

 - Reliability by design: Spot architectural flaws before they cost us performance or reliability. Make bounded blast radius, progressive rollouts, observability, load and failure testing, and recovery part of every design. Stay cool in the hardest incidents, then bring what we learn back into the platform.

 - Roadmap and judgment: Build the capability roadmap for this area with the engineering manager. Scope big ideas down into well-understood pieces, evaluate the viability of requests from other teams, and weigh technical and business risk when the path isn't clear.

 - Raise the bar: Define the team's development process and operational best practices. Coach Senior engineers and invest in their growth, lead design reviews, and catch the critical PRs, as a keeper of standards who is seen as a value-add, not a blocker. Help hire the engineers who will build this with you.

 - Cross-team collaboration: Work with Traffic, Control Plane, Developer Productivity, Security, and service owners. Communicate complex designs clearly, influence toward the right course of action, and earn adoption through useful abstractions and dependable operations. Own compatibility and migration as the platform evolves.

 

Qualifications



 - 10+ years building software, including significant time designing and operating distributed infrastructure in production.

 - Production infrastructure experience on at least two of AWS, GCP, and Azure, including building, operationalizing, and scaling Kubernetes-based platforms across them.

 - Deep Kubernetes knowledge: scheduling, controllers and reconciliation, resource management, isolation, and upgrade safety.

 - A record of designing and building a significant multi-component system and coordinating other engineers to deliver it, ideally through a substantial infrastructure transition while production kept running.

 - Proficiency across a diverse set of technologies, with strong coding skills in Go or another systems language. You still write meaningful code.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication. You can explain complex systems, make tradeoffs explicit, and drive alignment with engineering and leadership.

 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 

Required Skills



 - Multi-cloud platform thinking: reusable abstractions that account for provider differences and stay secure, observable, and maintainable.

 - Kubernetes architecture and operations judgment, especially recovery under failure.

 - System-level tradeoffs and good judgment in ambiguous situations, balancing foundational work, customer needs, and unplanned operational demands.

 - Raising the bar through design reviews, code reviews, coaching, and clear technical writing.

 

Preferred Experience

 

 - All three providers. Building and operating infrastructure across AWS, GCP, and Azure, especially bringing a new provider onto an existing platform.

 - Building Kubernetes controllers and operators, including cloud resource controllers like Crossplane or AWS Controllers for Kubernetes (ACK).

 - Upstream open source contributions or maintainer experi

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - AI Gateway
jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.



Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:



 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.



We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.



AI is now part of almost every workflow built on n8n. But before a new user can build their first AI automation, they often hit a wall: sign up with a model provider, create an API key, add billing, and paste credentials into n8n. Many people never get past that step.



The Relay team removes that wall. With Gateway credits, n8n Cloud users get leading AI models and services such as web search, scraping and document parsing built in, with no keys to manage. A new user can open a template or ask the AI assistant to build something, and it just works on day one.





MAKE DAY-ONE SUCCESS THE DEFAULT

 - Own the Gateway credits experience end to end: from sign-up to first successful AI workflow or Agent, to ongoing usage.

 - Remove credential friction across the product. Work with the Growth, Agents and n8n Assistant teams so new users land on services that work out of the box.

 - Decide which models and services we offer, and how we price and package them for users..




BUILD AND RUN PROVIDER PARTNERSHIPS

 - Own relationships with model and tool providers, from first conversation to signed deal.

 - Lead commercial negotiations, including volume commitments, pricing and terms.

 - Partner with Finance on commitment approvals and consumption forecasting.

 - Decide when to add, expand or drop a provider, based on user demand, quality and cost.




SHAPE THE ENTERPRISE AI GATEWAY

 - Lead discovery with enterprise customers and prospects: platform teams, IT and security leads, and AI owners.

 - Turn what you learn into a clear product strategy, and be honest about what to build, what to pause and what to stop.

 - Define the core capabilities: virtual keys, budgets and spend limits, model access policies, usage reporting and audit.

 - Consider how the gateway works for self-hosted and Cloud customers. Work closely with engineering and our Cloud team on deployment questions.

 - Help define how the enterprise gateway is packaged and sold, together with Sales, Finance and leadership.




LEAD ACROSS TEAMS

 - Work with a dedicated engineering team, and with design, as one product team.

 - Coordinate with teams that own nearby areas, such as identity and access management, governance, billing and the Cloud experience.

 - Keep leadership, Sales and Customer Success informed, and bring them clear recommendations.




REQUIREMENTS




MUST-HAVES

 - Experience as a PM for AI infrastructure, developer platforms or LLM tooling (for example AI gateways, model APIs, or AI platform products), or for enterprise admin and governance products (for example access control, policy, spend management or audit).

 - Hands-on experience with partner or vendor deals: you have negotiated terms, not only managed relationships.

 - A strong grasp of usage-based pricing, unit costs and consumption forecasting.

 - Comfort talking with enterprise buyers: platform engineers, security teams and IT leaders.

 - Builder mindset: You’re entrepreneurial and hands-on, and you enjoy moving from an ambiguous problem to a prototype, shipped product, and iteration quickly.

 - Technical fluency: You’re comfortable reasoning about APIs, integrations, authentication, schemas, data flows, and system constraints and can partner deeply with engineers.

 - Data fluency: You can define meaningful success metrics, investigate product behaviour and funnels, and combine quantitative evidence with qualitative insight and product intuition 




NICE-TO-HAVES

 - You have built or run an LLM gateway or proxy, or worked closely with tools like LiteLLM, Portkey or similar.

 - Experience with products that run both self-hosted and as SaaS.

 - You’ve built products for technical users and understand what great developer and builder experiences look like.

 - You’ve worked on products involving third-party APIs, authentication, developer platforms, or integration ecosystems.

 - You’ve built products alongside developer communities, contributors, or external ecosystems.

jobs.description:
About Teleport

Don't wait for the future of infrastructure. Be part of it.

Teleport is the AI Infrastructure Identity Company. We're solving one of the hardest problems in security: giving every human, machine, workload, and AI agent a cryptographically secured identity, improving engineering velocity while maintaining security. We make trusted computing simple. This gives you the freedom, power, and autonomy to build and innovate with confidence.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we work with companies like Nasdaq, DoorDash, and Elastic to secure infrastructure for an AI world.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Reporting to the COO, the VP of Finance will serve as the senior financial executive responsible for the full spectrum of corporate finance, including FP&A, accounting, strategic planning, board reporting, and IPO-readiness. You will manage a high-performing finance team, build the systems and processes that support a scaling infrastructure as a service business, and act as a trusted advisor to leaders across the organization.

This is a high-ownership role for a builder who is equally comfortable in the boardroom and in the details. A successful hire will be able to turn complex business data into clear strategic guidance and scale a lean finance function without losing rigor by leveraging the latest technology available.

There is not currently a CFO in place, so there is also potential room for growth into that role for high performers.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Financial Planning & Strategy

 - Serve as a strategic thought partner to the COO and CEO — bringing a financial lens to company-level decisions on market positioning, competitive strategy, pricing, geographic expansion, and capital allocation

 - Co-own the company’s long-range strategic plan alongside executive leadership, shaping not just the financial expression of strategy but the strategy itself

 - Identify the financial and operational levers that drive sustainable growth, and advocate for resource allocation decisions that reflect Teleport’s most important strategic bets

 - Own the annual planning and quarterly forecasting cycles, delivering accurate, driver-based financial models across revenue, cost, and headcount

 - Lead scenario analysis and sensitivity modeling to pressure-test strategic options and support key investment decisions

 - Translate financial data into clear, actionable insights for the COO, CEO, and Board of Directors by connecting day-to-day performance to long-term strategic goals

Accounting & Controls

 - Oversee all accounting operations including monthly close, revenue recognition (ASC 606), and financial statement preparation

 - Maintain and strengthen internal controls, ensuring compliance with US GAAP and audit readiness

 - Manage relationships with external auditors and tax advisors

Board & Investor Reporting

 - Prepare board-level financial packages, investor updates, and management reporting with clarity and precision

 - Support fundraising, debt financing, and M&A diligence processes as needed

 - Develop the financial narrative for investors and analysts, underpinned by robust SaaS metrics

Business Partnering

 - Partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and People leaders to drive financial accountability across the business

 - Own financial metrics and provide regular performance analyses

 - Support revenue operations, pricing strategy, and go-to-market financial planning

Team & Systems Leadership

 - Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing finance team including FP&A, accounting, and revenue operations

 - Drive the selection, implementation, and optimization of financial systems and tools (ERP, FP&A platforms, billing infrastructure)

 - Build scalable, automated financial processes that support rapid growth and eventual public-company readiness

 - Champion and model the use of AI and modern technology tools — actively embedding automation, AI-assisted analysis, and intelligent workflows into finance operations to move faster, reduce manual work, and raise the quality of output

 - Set the standard for technology fluency on the finance team: encourage experimentation with tools like Claude and other AI systems for modeling, reporting, and documentation, and create space for the team to share what works




WORKING AT TELEPORT IN THE AGE OF MODERN TECHNOLOGY

At Teleport, using the best available tools and systems isn’t a nice-to-have — it’s part of how we work. We expect every Teleporter to actively adopt modern technology to do their job better: move faster, think harder, and produce work they’re proud of. That means embracing automation, better documentation systems, analytics, and tools like Claude regularly, bringing technology into your problem-solving, and sharing what works with your team.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 18+ years of progressive financial leadership experience, with significant time as VP of Finance, CFO, or equivalent senior finance executive

 - Proven record of success at a high-growth B2B Cybersecurity, SaaS or infrastructure technology company in Series D/E/F stages with over $200mln in ARR

 - Strong command of GAAP accounting, SaaS financial metrics, financial controls, and audit processes

 - Demonstrated experience supporting a company through key inflection points — Series C+, late-stage private, or IPO preparation

 - Outstanding communication skills — able to present complex financial matters to executive teams, boards, and investors with confidence and clarity

 - Proven ability to build and lead high-performing, geographically distributed finance teams

 - Hands-on experience evaluating, selecting, and scaling financial systems (NetSuite, Workday, Adaptive Insights, or comparable platforms)

 - Collaborative, data-driven decision-maker who thrives in a fast-moving, distributed environment

 - Ability to be in-person in our HQ in Oakland, CA, a few times a week for in-person collaboration with the executive team.

jobs.description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 



Our Staff Software Engineers lead strategically important technical work and deliver meaningful customer and business outcomes. They pair deep technical contribution with influence across teams: clarifying ambiguous problems, setting direction, and helping others build effectively.

 

Vanta’s Growth group helps prospects evaluate and try Vanta, new customers reach value faster, and existing customers expand with confidence. We improve discovery, trials, onboarding, purchasing, upgrades, and renewals, including the path to a customer’s first compliance milestone. We also build the platform that lets other product teams own and improve their products’ customer journeys and growth. For customers, that means clearer next steps and less friction as their needs change. For Vanta, these experiences influence prospect-to-customer conversion, activation, time to value, retention, and expansion. Shared growth capabilities extend that impact across product areas while letting each team improve the journey it owns. We use customer feedback and product data to decide where changes will have the greatest impact.



As a Staff Software Engineer in the Growth group, you’ll turn important customer and business goals into working product and platform capabilities. You’ll own technical direction for major initiatives, shape the architecture, scope, sequence, and dependencies, and align partners on goals and tradeoffs. You’ll lead multi-team work from problem framing through launch and adoption, build foundational pieces yourself, and give other engineers meaningful ownership so the results can keep improving after your initial ships.

jobs.title: Partner Development Representative | Advisory and Services
jobs.description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.



About the Role

Ramp's Advisory & Services channel is one of the most strategically important growth levers in the business. As an Advisory& Services Partner Development Representative (PDR), you'll be the engine behind acquiring, reactivating, and qualifying the consulting firms, System Integrators (SIs), and advisory practices that refer, implement, or integrate Ramp for their clients.



You'll be holding conversations with partnership heads, business development leads,Managing Directors, and practice leads at consulting firms, ERP implementation shops, and strategic advisory practices - building relationships that turn into signed referral agreements and a pipeline of activated partners that are Ramp champions.



This role is perfect for someone who:

 - Is gritty and relentless - comfortable reaching out to firm leaders who are slow to respond and keeps going anyway

 - Carries real executive presence and can credibly hold a conversation with a Partner or MD at a top-tier firm

 - Has a strong client hand - naturally curious about how consulting and advisory firms serve their clients, and speaks their language

 - Thrives when the playbook is still being written and takes ownership of building it

 - Embraces AI to augment and automate processes to drive greater efficiencies for workflows



What You'll Do

 - Source and qualify net new consulting, advisory, and technology partners that can drive referral pipeline and commercial value to Ramp, focused on firms with active CFO-level client relationships

 - Build top-of-funnel pipeline for Channel Partner Managers by qualifying partner candidates against Ramp's tiering criteria and handing off warm, ready-to-activate relationships

 - Reactivate dormant services partners across Ramp's existing book of ~400 consulting, technology, and advisory firms - identifying which relationships have gone cold and reigniting them through strategic, senior-level outreach

 - Identify and engage system integrators (SIs) and ERP implementation specialists - specifically firms in the NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Dynamics, and Odoo ecosystems - to build Ramp's productized SI implementation program

 - Craft outbound messaging and campaigns tailored to services partner archetypes - boutique firms, PE-focused advisory practices, tech consulting firms, and ERP implementation shops

 - Maintain accurate partner and opportunity data in Salesforce; track pipeline health across both dormant reactivation and net new acquisition motions

 - Leverage AI tools and lightweight automations to scale partner outreach, surface reactivation opportunities, and build repeatable workflows across a high-volume partner book



What You Need

 - Grit and drive to run a high-volume, high-quality outbound motion against senior contacts who are hard to reach - and the persistence to keep going

 - Executive presence: you can hold a credible conversation with a Partner or Managing Director at a consulting or advisory firm, and they take you seriously

 - Deep understanding of how consulting firms go to market, how they serve CXO-level clients, and drive influence

 - A client-oriented mindset - you lead with what's in it for the partner's business, not just Ramp's

 - Strong written communication skills - outreach that is pithy, credible, and gets responses from senior people at busy firms

 - Comfort managing a large, segmented partner book and staying disciplined across long reactivation and qualification cycles

 - 1-3 years of experience in partnerships, channel sales, business development, or sales development or as a business analyst in a strategy consulting firm (e.g., McKinsey, Bain, BCG)

 - Bachelor's degree from a four-year university




Nice to Haves

 - Background at - or selling to - consulting firms, strategy practices, Systems Integrators (SIs) or advisory businesses

 - Exposure to ERP ecosystems: NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics, Odoo, or similar implementation partner communities

 - Familiarity with how system integrators operate: how they price services, staff implementations, and build revenue relationships with technology vendors

 - Experience working in a partner channel that was still being built - first rep in a motion or early team member in a new GTM track

 - Background in B2B fintech, SaaS, or financial services

 - Familiarity with Salesforce or similar CRM tools

 - Hands-on experience using AI tools (specifically Claude Code), building basic automations (bots, workflows, etc.) to drive efficiency in a sales, partnerships, or business development context




BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

 - Flexible PTO

 - Centralized home-office equipment ordering

 - Health and wellness stipend

 - Budget for intra-office travel

 - Weekly coffee stipend




UNITED STATES

 - 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

 - One Medical annual membership

 - 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

 - Fertility

jobs.description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. How you'll make impact Own the frontend work for the Scale team, taking responsibility for the design, implementation, and ongoing quality of user-facing experiences across our platform products. You'll work independently on ambiguous problems, partnering with backend engineers, Product, Design, and other stakeholders to turn customer and business requirements into reliable, maintainable solutions. Build and maintain frontend experiences across the stack, with particular ownership and depth in React-based development Deliver reliable, maintainable solutions for multi-tenant platforms, enterprise integrations, and cross-domain product features Partner with backend engineers, Product, Design, and other stakeholders to turn customer and business requirements into effective technical solutions Make pragmatic decisions in ambiguous situations, balancing flexibility, simplicity, and maintainability in system and component design You'll work from our London office three days a week. Essentials Strong experience building frontend applications with ReactJS. Experience with modern JavaScript or TypeScript. Experience working across the full stack, with the ability to own frontend work end to end. A track record of working independently and delivering high-quality software with minimal oversight. Make pragmatic decisions on when to optimize for performance vs. velocity based on business impact Thrive in cross-functional environments spanning Product, Design, Compliance, and Sales Design for scale, maintainability, and production excellence Preferred Fintech, payments, or regulated industry experience. High-scale performance tuning (100k+ QPS, large user bases, strict latency SLAs). Multi-tenant SaaS or platform architecture background. Proficiency with PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, or cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure). Experience with OAuth2.0, API design, or developer documentation. Cross-region deployment or data residency compliance experience. Solutions engineering or customer-facing technical experience. Learn more about your team The Scale team builds the infrastructure that lets platforms embed Airwallex financial products at speed and with confidence. The team owns multi-tenant systems powering companies like Brex, Rippling, Navan, Qantas, and SHEIN. The engineering challenges are real: balancing tenant isolation with resource efficiency, low-latency performance with cross-data-center resilience, and immediate customer needs with long-term architectural extensibility. Beyond infrastructure, the team owns cross-domain product features and designs enterprise integrations by translating customer business requirements into scalable technical solutions. jobs.title: AI Engineer, Marketing
jobs.description: At Instructure , we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers. We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in: Why This Role Exists Marketing's AI tools are already in production and delivering real results - localization time down 90%, meeting prep down 90%, case study builds down 70%. Demand for new tools now outpaces what one person can build. This role adds dedicated engineering capacity so the team can ship more, support what's live, and keep raising the bar on quality without becoming a bottleneck. Scope You'll build for all marketing functions - Brand, Content, Events, PMM, International, and SDR. If a marketing team has a workflow AI can improve, it's in scope. You'll partner closely with the Senior Manager on where to focus, then own your pieces of the build. Day to day, you'll work across the marketing tech stack (Salesforce, Asana, Marketo, CMS platforms) and the automation and LLM tooling that connects them. Key Responsibilities AI Tool Development (~50%) Build and maintain production AI tools for marketing teams - content generators, meeting and SDR prep systems, case study automation, and workflow integrations. Write, test, and iterate prompts across LLM-powered applications; version them and track what works. Build integrations between AI tools and the marketing tech stack (Salesforce, Asana, Marketo, CMS platforms) using APIs, webhooks, and automation platforms. Take tools from prototype to production with clear quality checks, and own them after launch - monitor outputs, tune prompts, fix drift, and ship improvements based on user feedback. Enablement & Documentation (~25%) Write clear, usable documentation and playbooks so teams can self-serve. Help train marketing teams on the tools you build - not just the clicks, but how to get good output and when AI isn't the right fit. Support the AI Incubator intake process: help evaluate submissions and move projects from sandbox toward production. Quality & Support (~25%) Keep production tools inside data and brand guardrails; flag anything that touches customer data or brand voice for review before it ships. Respond to user issues on live tools, triage what's breaking, and close the loop. Help track tool usage and impact so every tool has a defensible ROI story. Required Qualifications Proficiency with or ability to quickly ramp on our primary AI and marketing tech stack, including Claude, Gemini, Clay, and Glean. 2+ years in marketing technology, automation, software, or a comparable technical role or equivalent hands-on project experience. Hands-on experience with LLMs: writing and iterating prompts, evaluating output quality, and working within context limits. Comfort with technical integration: APIs, webhooks, automation platforms (Zapier/Make), and at least basic scripting (Python preferred). Strong written communication - this role produces documentation others rely on. Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward shipping. This function is evolving, and you'll iterate constantly. Preferred Qualifications Experience in B2B SaaS marketing, ideally EdTech or enterprise software. Familiarity with marketing ops tooling: Salesforce, Marketo, Asana, Google Analytics, or comparable platforms. Experience building something real with AI that people actually used - a tool, a bot, an automation, even a side project counts. Exposure to CMS or web platforms (Drupal, content management, localization workflows). Experience with GitHub and Railway for version control and deployment Get in on all the awesome at Instructure! We offer competitive, meaningful benefits in every country where we operate. While they vary by location, here's a general idea of what you can expect: Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success. Flexible work culture. Our remote, hybrid and in-office collaboration spaces vary by role, team and location. Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs. Comprehensive wellness programs and mental health support Learning and development resources, including professional development tools and tuition reimbursement, to support your growth The technology and tools you need to do your best work Motivosity employee recognition program A culture rooted in inclusivity, support, and meaningful connection We believe in hiring great people and treating them right. The more diverse we are, the better our ideas and outcomes. Instructure is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We comply with applicable employment and anti-discrimination laws in every country where we operate. All employees must pass a background check as part of the hiring process. To help protect our teams and systems, we’ve implemented identity verification measures. Candidates may be asked to verify their legal name, current physical location, and provide a valid contact number and residential address, in accordance with local data privacy laws. Any attempt to misrepresent personal or professional information will result in disqualification.

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Partnership Manager (Sales/SaaS)
jobs.description: Who We Are: At Emburse , you’ll not just imagine the future – you’ll build it. As a leader in expense intelligence, we are creating a future where technology drives business value and inspires extraordinary results. Our AI-powered platform helps organizations modernize financial operations, increase visibility, and optimize spend across the enterprise. We are seeking a commercially focused, results-driven Senior Strategic Partnership Manager to lead and scale strategic relationships across the Human Capital Management (HCM) ecosystem. In this high-impact role, you will spearhead Emburse’s strategic alliances with market-leading HCM platforms—specifically UKG and Dayforce —generating measurable pipeline, revenue, and customer value through targeted joint go-to-market (GTM) motions. The ideal candidate blends proven partnership development experience with a disciplined sales mindset. You know how to uncover commercial opportunities, build trust with executive stakeholders, align cross-functional teams, and convert partner engagement into tangible revenue outcomes. If you enjoy connecting people, technology, and commercial opportunity—and have the sales discipline to turn strategic relationships into meaningful growth—we’d love to meet you. **Please note we are unable to offer sponsorship now or in the future** What You will Do Own and grow strategic HCM partnerships, with a focus on UKG, Dayforce, and adjacent HCM providers. Identify, prospect, qualify, and develop new partnership opportunities that expand Emburse’s market reach and revenue. Build business cases and present partnership proposals that deliver value for Emburse, partners, and mutual customers. Develop and execute joint go-to-market plans, including Reseller and co-selling motions, referral programs, integrated campaigns, events, and partner enablement. Work closely with Sales to create partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, support joint account planning, and help advance opportunities through the sales cycle. Build trusted relationships with partner sales, alliances, product, marketing, and executive stakeholders. Negotiate partnership terms and manage agreements to support sustainable, mutually beneficial growth. Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Product, Finance, and Legal to launch joint offerings and ensure operational alignment. Track partnership performance, including pipeline, bookings, revenue, referrals, engagement, and return on investment. Monitor HCM market trends, competitive activity, and partner priorities to refine strategy and uncover new growth opportunities. What You will Bring 5+ years of demonstrated success in strategic alliances, partner management, channel sales, or enterprise business development within the B2B SaaS industry. Ability to travel - 30% travel required Direct experience working for, with, or alongside UKG and/or Dayforce is strongly preferred (familiarity with their partner programs, sales motions, integration architectures, and customer base is highly valued). Consistent history of delivering against revenue targets, driving qualified pipeline, and scaling successful co-sell or reseller programs. Strong proficiency in value-based selling, territory planning, pipeline qualification, contract negotiation, and executive-level pitching. Demonstrated ability to motivate and collaborate with internal direct sales reps and partner sales forces to co-sell and advance opportunities through the funnel. Ability to translate complex software workflows, APIs, and product capabilities into clear, compelling joint value propositions for buyers and sellers alike. Solid analytical capabilities to evaluate partnership health, track metrics in CRM/PRM systems (e.g., Salesforce, Crossbeam), and make data-backed decisions. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Compensation Additional Information Why Emburse? Finance is changing—and at Emburse, we’re leading the way. Our AI-powered solutions help organizations eliminate inefficiencies, gain real-time visibility, and optimize spend—so they can focus on what’s next, not what’s slowing them down. • A Company with Momentum – We serve 12M+ users across 120 countries, helping businesses modernize their finance operations. • A Team That Innovates – Work alongside some of the brightest minds in finance, tech, and AI to solve real- world challenges. • A Culture That Empowers – Competitive pay, flexible work, and an inclusive, collaborative environment that supports your success. • A Career That Matters – Your work here drives efficiency, innovation, and smarter financial decision-making for businesses everywhere. Shape your future & find what’s next at Emburse. Emburse provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Emburse complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location where the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment.

jobs.description: Are you ready to unlock intelligence? If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others. Are you ready to unlock intelligence? If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others. About the Role: As a Site Reliability Engineer , you’ll join the global Platform SRE team responsible for building, operating, and scaling Kong’s multi-region SaaS platform that powers the world’s API connectivity. You’ll design, automate, and run production systems serving thousands of customers across AWS, GCP, and Azure. You’ll work on everything from multi-region Kubernetes clusters to service mesh and gateway architectures , ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of Kong’s SaaS offerings. This is a hands-on role ideal for engineers who thrive on running production SaaS systems at scale , automating operations, and continuously improving performance, resilience, and deployment pipelines. What You’ll Do: Operate and scale Kong’s global SaaS platform (Konnect) , ensuring reliability, availability, and performance across regions and clouds. Build, automate, and maintain Kubernetes-based infrastructure and deployment workflows using Terraform/Terragrunt , Helm , and ArgoCD . Design, maintain, and optimize multi-region data and caching layers — including PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse, and Druid — for high availability and low latency. Operate and improve Kong Gateway and Kong Mesh environments supporting hybrid and distributed architectures. Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows to automate service delivery and ensure consistent infrastructure changes. Enhance observability and incident response readiness through systems like Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, and Thanos , defining and tracking SLOs. Collaborate closely with development and security teams to ensure smooth operation of SaaS services in compliance with reliability, security, and regulatory standards. Participate in a global 24/7 on-call rotation and drive continuous improvement of operational playbooks and postmortem practices. Lead and contribute to scaling initiatives that improve elasticity, reliability, and cost-efficiency across the SaaS platform. What You’ll Bring: BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. Proven experience managing SaaS or PaaS systems at enterprise scale (multi-region, multi-tenant, secure environments). Deep expertise in Kubernetes , including debugging cluster/networking issues and designing for fault tolerance and scalability. Strong proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools like Terraform or Terragrunt . Experience with CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows (ArgoCD, Atlantis, Helm). Proficiency in one or more programming languages ( Go, Python, Bash ) for automation and tooling. Solid understanding of Linux/Unix systems , networking (DNS, TLS/SSL, HTTP) , load balancers and distributed systems . Experiencing working with API gateway and service mesh technologies Familiarity with streaming systems like Kafka and observability platforms (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana). Experience working in a 24/7/365 production support environment. Bonus Points: Hands-on experience with Kong Gateway , Kong Mesh , or similar service connectivity technologies. Experience operating ClickHouse , Druid , or other time-series and analytics databases . Experience managing PostgreSQL and Redis in multi-region configurations. Working knowledge of AWS networking (PrivateLink, Transit Gateway, VPC Peering, Firewalls), Azure VNet , or GCP NCC . Strong understanding of disaster recovery , resiliency testing , and compliance-driven reliability practices. #LI-KC1 About Kong: Kong Inc. , the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com .

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Internal Tooling
jobs.description: RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile. We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue. We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading. The role: We are looking for a Senior, proactive Software Engineer to join our Devops/Devex engineering team and help building and scaling the internal development platform. You would be building the tools, services and automations that empower the rest of our engineering team to ship safely and fast. RevenueCat invests heavily in tooling. We already have custom services for CI/CD, automated one-push-per-commit releases with automatic canaries, Feature Flags, DB query approval workflows, VPN access workflows. We are using Pulumi and python for IaC to describe k8s services and associated infrastructure in a single place. We want to provide autonomy, build a self-serve culture that allows teams to move fast but ensures safety and best practices. The advent of IA and agentic development is going to change a lot of things, and you will help shape this future fostering adoption while ensuring our security and architectural standards remain sane. Your job is to take all this to the next level. About you: You are a Builder: You don't just use tools; you build them. You have 5+ years of experience in SRE, DevOps, DevEx or Platform Engineering with a heavy emphasis on software development. You are Proactive: You see what is needed, you take action and own problems to turn them into solutions. You love building frameworks, abstractions and automation: You see that the best way to ensure best practices are follow is to make something so easy and joyfull to use that nobody wants to use anything else. You are AI-Curious: You understand how LLMs and AI coding tools are changing engineering and want to help a world-class team leverage them effectively. You move fast, test and iterate quickly. Preferred Experience: Experience with AWS cloud, k8s, docker, IaC, github. Solid knowledge of Python In the first month, you'll: Meet your team! Get up to speed on our unique infrastructure-as-code patterns. Familiarize yourself with our existing internal tools for releases, canaries, and access control. Ship your first project —improving an existing tool or automation. Within the first 3 months, you'll: Be able to scope and work on tasks self-sufficiently. Understand most of our internals tools and feel confident making changes to them. Start oncall training. Participate in code reviews, design reviews, brainstorms. Within the first 6 months, you'll: Design and ship major initiatives and have a positive impact in the engineering team. Collaborate closely with other engineers, creating ties, understanding their painpoints and starting to become more involve in the roadmap and prioritization of new initiatives. Within the first 12 months, you'll: Be the go-to expert for our internal platforms, services and infrastructure abstractions. Have your own initiatives for improving DevOps and DevEx Lead AI tool adoption across the engineering org, following well-stablished patterns for safety and simplicity. What we offer: Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator 10-year window to exercise vested equity options A fully remote environment designed around autonomy and flexibility 4-5 weeks of flexible time off annually Paid desk at a co-working space Workspace budget and continuous learning stipend Interviewing at RevenueCat Our interview process is rigorous on purpose. We want to be sure that everyone we bring on is genuinely excited about this work, aligned with how we operate, and ready to meet our high bar for performance. Curious what that actually looks like? Read more in our blog post on how we hire at RevenueCat , including tips to help you succeed. More on how we work: How we think about hiring and team design: Building a Winning Team The values that guide how we work: Our Values How we work as a remote team: How We Work Remotely at RevenueCat What to expect from our interview process: Interview Expectations What to expect from comp and employment: Employment FAQ

jobs.title: Staff Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. In one line Our team builds the platform that every TRM product, every internal AI agent, and every investigation our customers run depends on. We are not maintaining a system someone else finished - we are building its next generation, on the bleeding edge, for workloads where reliability and security are not negotiable. We're looking for an engineer who has taken infrastructure from zero to one and can operate it in production. Why this work matters TRM's platform lets financial institutions and governments trace illicit finance, disrupt crypto- and AI-enabled crime, and run some of the highest-stakes investigations in the world. Our infrastructure is what lets investigators and banks trust the data underneath them . When we get it right, a case moves and a threat gets stopped. When infrastructure is weak, everything above it is slow, fragile, or unsafe. That's the job: make the foundation something the mission can be built on. What you'll actually work on This is real, current work - not a hypothetical roadmap: Multi-region, multi-cloud Kubernetes across US GCP, EU GCP, and AWS GovCloud - making "stand up another site" a self-serve configuration instead of a bespoke project. A genuinely self-serve internal PaaS. ~60+ engineers already deploy on it, the large majority with no infra person in the loop. You extend the paved road - golden paths, guardrails, and interfaces engineers actually enjoy using. Agent-native infrastructure. Secure sandboxes where AI agents build and ship, and encoding our operational knowledge into skills so the platform increasingly runs and heals itself. Zero-trust secrets with Vault. Short-lived, dynamic credentials replacing every long-lived secret in the system - closing the blast radius on leaked passwords, one database at a time. Reliability engineering that means it. SLOs and error budgets, real observability, and disaster recovery with validated cross-region restore and sub-hour RTO. Databases as a first-class platform concern. Postgres on Kubernetes, migrations, replication, and redundancy for services that can't blink. Compliance as code. SOC2 and FedRAMP posture built into the platform so security is the default, not a scramble before an audit. What you'll own You'll own an Area of Responsibility end to end - a slice of the platform that is genuinely yours. You'll define what "great" looks like for it and build the glide path to get there rather than waiting for one; obsess over the metrics that tell you whether it's actually working; and fix root causes so a class of problems disappears instead of working the ticket queue faster. You own the outcome, not just your layer of it. Who you are This is a builder's role , and the bar is high: You've taken infrastructure from zero to one - designed and shipped a platform capability that other engineers came to depend on, not just operated one that already existed. You write real software (Go, Python, or similar). You build tooling, automation, and services - you don't only wire up other people's tools. You're deep in GCP and/or AWS - compute, IAM, VPC, networking, storage, load balancing - and comfortable operating across clouds. You've run Kubernetes in production (GKE/EKS) and are up to date with the state of the art for IaC. You can debug low-level problems without hand-holding - a networking issue, a saturated node, a slow query, a failing deploy - and get to the actual cause. You're fluent across the modern platform toolchain: GitOps (Argo/Flux), containers, CI/CD, observability built on SLOs rather than dashboards no one reads. You have strong instincts for security and databases — zero-trust, secret management, systems hardening; provisioning and migrating production databases. SOC2/FedRAMP exposure is a plus. If you've built platforms that other engineers rely on every day, we want to talk. What makes people thrive here High ownership and low ego. Mission-first. Comfortable where speed and rigor have to coexist - something that takes a quarter elsewhere is expected to move in weeks here, without cutting the corners that matter for security and reliability. You see infra, security, data, and product as one connected system, and you turn one-off fixes into reusable paved roads by instinct. What should give you pause The scope is real and the playbook isn't fully written - you'll be writing it. Reliability and compliance expectations are high, and mistakes here show up as real incidents for customers and internal teams. If you prefer an environment where everything is defined before you start, this will feel uncomfortable. If that kind of ownership is exactly what you're after, you'll love it. How we work Remote-first (US). Small, high-leverage team with a weekly on-call rotation you'll take part in. We're an AI-native team in practice, not in theory - we use agents in our daily workflow and ship the skills that let the platform operate itself. The estimated base salary range for this role and level is $205,000 - $245,000 Application Instructions If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team. Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your qualifications for the role.
