jobs.description:
Account Executive, Strategic Deals - Attribute™

Location
This is a fully remote opportunity based out of any of the following with travel as needed: UK, Ireland, Netherlands, Sweden, Estonia.

Who We Are
Become part of the team behind Attribute™. Following our recent acquisition, we re bringing together visionary engineers and go-to-market leaders to disrupt cloud management with real-time, tagless cost visibility across cloud and AI workloads. As an Account Executive focused on Strategic Deals, you ll join a founding GTM movement inside an established market leader trusted by over 4,500 global customers, unlocking high-impact opportunities through top-tier strategic partnerships.

DoiT empowers cloud-native organizations to scale faster and innovate with confidence. By combining our Cloud Intelligence technology with Forward Deployed Engineers and deep specialization across AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure, we help tech-forward companies navigate their toughest infrastructure and cost governance challenges end to end.

The Opportunity
As an Account Executive, Strategic Deals for Attribute™, you will be at the forefront of building a brand-new region from scratch and introducing a groundbreaking solution to a fundamental business problem in modern FinOps. You will work on Strategic Deals, leveraging strategic partnerships with AWS, OpenAI, Top Private Equity firms, and our global current install base. A strong focus will be placed on co-selling and unlocking strategic deal opportunities with AWS, ISVs, and channel partners. Traditional cloud cost allocation methods rely heavily on static tagging—an approach that becomes obsolete in modern, shared cloud and AI infrastructure. When multi-tenant clusters, shared GPUs, microservices, and dynamic AI workloads dominate, organizations face severe blind spots: they cannot accurately determine the true cost-to-serve for specific applications, autonomous agents, or business teams, making it impossible to calculate true gross margins at a granular customer level.

Attribute™ solves this by taking a completely different approach. Leveraging runtime eBPF technology, Attribute™ captures real-time network traffic signals and kernel-level observability without requiring engineering teams to manually tag or instrument code. By analyzing actual runtime consumption across CPU, GPU, memory, network, and AI model API requests, it provides accurate total cost of ownership (TCO) and unit economics based on real usage. Organizations finally get precise cost governance and gross margin visibility across complex cloud and AI environments with zero developer overhead.

As an Account Executive building this region from scratch, you will establish a high-potential greenfield territory. You will drive sales end-to-end with a heavy emphasis on net-new logo acquisition, defining the regional go-to-market strategy and creating the foundational customer success stories that define this category.

You will own full-cycle deal execution across Startup, Digital Native, and Enterprise segments—prospecting new accounts, running compelling solution pitches, navigating complex technical evaluations alongside engineering partners, and closing strategic partnerships end to end.

You ll have the rest of the Cloud Intelligence portfolio behind you: 4,500 customers, AWS/Google Cloud/Azure partnerships, and Forward Deployed Engineers who solve problems other vendors walk away from. But the product you ll carry every day is Attribute™, and the market is only just learning it exists. That s the opportunity.

Expect to travel 10–15% of the time to meet customers, engage with hyperscale teams, and show up at industry events that matter.

Responsibilities

  • Build a high-volume pipeline and establish the region from scratch with a hunter mindset, driving outbound prospecting and net-new logo acquisition across EMEA
  • Build the first wave of reference customers and case studies the rest of the GTM org will run on
  • Develop and execute a regional strategy that identifies high-growth opportunities and untapped markets across EMEA
  • Build deep, mutually valuable relationships with AWS Sales Leaders and Partner Managers to co-sell and expand market share
  • Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers and Solutions Architects to solve the toughest technical challenges prospects face
  • Maintain rigorous forecast accuracy in Salesforce and ensure every proposal reflects the quality of what we actually deliver
  • Guide customers from initial curiosity through contract execution, setting them up for a world-class onboarding experience
  • Feed real customer signal back to product and marketing every week — in a founding team, that loop is the job
  • Generate your own pipeline through prospecting, networking, and creative outreach — not just working what s handed to you

  • A track record of selling cloud services and understanding how consumption-based models work

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: About Solace Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes. We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly. Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way. Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here . About the Role At Solace, data isn't just about understanding the past; it's about predicting the future. We are a rapidly scaling startup where we work hard, move fast, and wear many hats. The Solace Data Team is looking for a Data Scientist who excels at forecasting, prediction, and machine learning to help us anticipate patient needs and optimize our operations. Reporting directly to the VP of Data, you will have the opportunity to lead high-impact projects that directly influence our strategic decision-making. In this role, you will go beyond descriptive analytics to build the predictive engines that drive our business. Whether you are forecasting operational volume, modeling patient risk, or designing rigorous A/B tests, you will bridge the gap between advanced statistics and practical business application, ensuring our models are robust, interpretable, and impactful. What You’ll Do Build Predictive Models: Develop and refine machine learning models to solve critical business problems, such as predicting patient churn, estimating operational volume, or scoring advocate quality. Drive Forecasting Rigor: Own the development of time-series forecasts that guide our capacity planning and resource allocation. You will help us anticipate "what comes next" with higher accuracy. Design & Analyze Experiments: Lead the design and analysis of A/B tests and causal inference studies. You will ensure we measure the true impact of our product and operational changes. Uncover Deep Insights: Apply advanced statistical methods to complex datasets to find patterns that simple reporting might miss. You will answer the "why" and "how" behind our most difficult questions. Productionize Solutions: Work closely with Data Engineers to take your models from a local notebook to a production environment, ensuring they run reliably within our data infrastructure. Communicate Complexity: Translate complex statistical findings into clear, actionable narratives for non-technical stakeholders. You will be the voice of statistical reason in strategic discussions. What You Bring Statistical Expertise: You have a strong background in statistics, probability, and mathematics (e.g., hypothesis testing, regression analysis, time-series forecasting). Python & ML Proficiency: You are fluent in Python and its data science ecosystem (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels, NumPy). You write clean, reproducible code. Forecasting Experience: You have hands-on experience with time-series analysis and forecasting techniques (e.g., ARIMA, Prophet, exponential smoothing). Advanced SQL: You can write complex queries to wrangle your own data from Snowflake without relying solely on others to prepare it for you. Preferred Masters Degree or PHD: Data Science, Applied Science, or related fields. Data Privacy Awareness: You understand the importance of protecting patient data. You are familiar with best practices for handling PHI and PII and ensuring privacy in your analysis. Startup DNA: You are a self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity. You take ownership of problems and are willing to wear many hats to get the job done. Bonus Points Deployment Experience: Experience using tools like Docker, Airflow, or MLflow to deploy and monitor models in production. Healthcare Experience: Experience working with healthcare or insurance claims data is a plus. NLP & Unstructured Data: Experience applying Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques to extract insights from unstructured text data. Marketplace Matching: Experience designing matching algorithms or ranking systems for two-sided marketplaces. dbt & Engineering Skills: Comfort reading or writing dbt models to understand the lineage of your data. Applicants must be based in the United States. Up for the Challenge? We look forward to meeting you. Fraudulent Recruitment Advisory: Solace Health will NEVER request bank details or offer employment without an interview. All legitimate communications come from official solace.health emails only or ashbyhq.com . Report suspicious activity to recruiting@solace.health or advocate@solace.health.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) C-UAS
jobs.description: EMPLOYER IS A CONTRACTOR FOR THE U.S. GOVERNMENT. THIS POSITION REQUIRES U.S. CITIZENSHIP. Role Description This is a forward-deployed engineering role . You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with mission heroes- the users, operators, and program engineers who run real workloads in real DoD environments- and lead the software integration of modular Counter-Unmanned Aerial Systems (C-UAS) sensors and effectors. You will deploy, harden, integrate, and operate our modular C-UAS solution. Forward-deployed means aligned with the mission hero , not always on a plane . Most of the work is remote. You'll travel to sites when the engagement genuinely calls for it — initial standup, in-SCIF integration work, on-the-ground incident response, training, and knowledge transfer- and you'll be on a video call or in a shared chat with that same mission hero the rest of the time. The job is being their engineer, not living at their desk. You are a cross-functional engineering leader. You can take responsibility for the full breadth of a data and software integration platform- make it work where it has to work, analyze what's running through it, and solve problems in real time for the mission hero. About 20% of your time, you'll also help make Defense Unicorns ' forward-deployed team better — pairing with junior Data Engineer FDEs on hard problems, helping them develop technical judgment, and raising the ceiling on what the team can take on. Responsibilities Deploy and harden UDS Data Capability in the mission hero's environment — stand up UDS Store (Iceberg, Rook/Ceph, pgvector, Postgres), wire up UDS Transit for air-gap data movement, configure UDS Govern policies (Pepr/Lula), and integrate UDS Connect (Strimzi/Kafka) where streaming or legacy connectors are required. Own integration with existing mission systems — connect UDS Data Capability to existing infrastructure, including sensor arrays, computer-vision-enabled UAS interceptors, and a broad range of C-UAS solutions. Build pipelines that move data through classification boundaries — ingestion, transformation, catalog registration, model/dataset packaging via Zarf, cross-domain transit, and eventual consistency across DDIL conditions. Operate what you deploy — own initial day-2 operations, including capacity, performance, backup/restore (Velero), observability (Vector/Loki), incident response, and upgrade paths. Transition ownership to the mission hero's operations team once stable. jobs.title: Security Architect
jobs.description: NetBox Labs builds NetBox, the open source network source of truth, and the cloud and enterprise products built on it. We're hiring a hands-on Security Architect: a builder unleashed by AI, who designs and ships the systems that keep our products, our cloud, and our company secure as we grow. AI agents do most of the coding. You bring the judgment: what good looks like at scale, which outcomes matter, and when an agent's output is plausible but wrong. You own what ships and run it in production. Most of the role is Applied AI: building the platforms and paved paths that let teams across the company build their own automations, agent workflows, and software, secure by default, with identity, data access, and cost controls built in. You'll also work as a forward-deployed engineer, embedded with teams to get their first workflows running and turn what works into patterns. Success looks like teams building and running their own workflows on secure, pre-approved paths without waiting on a security review, and patterns you built being reused well beyond the team that first asked for them. The rest of the role is security engineering, with a focus on turning security from a review step into paved paths that engineering uses by default. You'll report to the Director of Security & IT and work with Engineering, Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance. What you'll do Make secure AI adoption the easy path Build and run the platforms that let teams across the company build their own automations, agent workflows, and software on a secure path by default, with the guardrails built in: pre-approved tools and connectors, scoped identities and credentials, authorization on data retrieval, approval for consequential actions, audit logging, and cost limits. Lead enablement so teams can self-serve: templates, starter kits, and reference patterns that make the secure way the fastest way to build, plus the guidance and support to use them well. Work alongside teams outside Engineering on their first workflows, then turn what you build into patterns others pick up without you. Set evaluation criteria and quality gates for agent workflows built on the platform, covering accuracy, safe use of tools and data, and how they handle failure. Automate security into how we build and ship Build security into the SDLC and PDLC: threat modeling, secure design review, code scanning, secret detection, and supply-chain and CI/CD controls enforced in the pipeline. Automate product and cloud security reviews so coverage keeps pace with delivery. Automate vulnerability intake, prioritization, routing, and SLA escalation so the team works the highest-risk findings first. Automate Security & IT operations Build access automation as code, with just-in-time elevation for privileged access. Set multi-account AWS guardrails and reference architectures for identity, network, and data. Run what you build Own the services you build end to end: CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, alerting, runbooks, and incident response. You'll join the Security & IT on-call rotation once the systems you own alert on failure. Internal platforms are supported during business hours. What you bring 12+ years across security architecture, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise IT. You've made architecture decisions that held up as companies grew, and you know what breaks first at scale. You've recently built and run something other people depend on, by directing agents or otherwise: a product, a platform, or an internal tool. This role ships; it is not an oversight role. You build with AI agents as your primary engineering tool. You specify the work, review what agents produce, and can tell code that runs from code that is secure and will hold up in production, across Python, Go, TypeScript, and Terraform. You've shipped LLM or agent systems to production that people rely on. You can explain how you evaluated them, how they failed, and the controls they needed: tool and MCP governance, retrieval with access controls, approval steps, and cost limits. You tie security work to product and business outcomes. You can explain the tradeoffs to an executive and hold your own in design reviews with senior engineers. Deep AWS experience: multi-account organizations, identity, network security, and infrastructure as code. Zero Trust and identity architecture in practice, for both workforce and services: SSO, user provisioning, device management, and privileged access. Product security depth: threat modeling, secure design review, supply-chain security, and SDLC automation with code scanning, dependency analysis, and secret detection. You default to delivering everything as code: infrastructure, policy, detections, and controls. You think in platforms. You'd rather give every team a secure way to build than build everything yourself, and you know what makes a platform people adopt by choice. You can work with a sales or customer success lead, find the real problem behind the request, and deliver a workflow they keep using. Nice to have Security architecture for a SaaS product. A regulated or high-trust background, or experience with compliance programs such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001. Multi-tenant SaaS security, including tenant isolation. Experience building detections and monitoring for the systems you own. Experience with a second cloud provider. How we work Small team. What you build runs in production and changes how Sales, Customer Success, and Finance work. Work ships behind alerting and runbooks, and the people who build it share on-call. jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us


Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We’re looking for a Manager Sales Engineering Specialists to oversee our data platform Specialists functions. In this role, you will work alongside global Sales Engineering leadership to leverage a team of technical experts to accelerate our most complex enterprise deals, drive customer adoption after the sale, and improve the efficiency of the Sales Engineering motion at large. As customers build toward AI and agentic workloads, you will keep your team ahead of what those workloads demand of the data platform.

You will need a deep understanding of how modern data movement and transformation platforms like ours are architected, including the AI use cases built on top of them, and a keen ability to lead a team of highly specialized resources. You will be tasked with developing and retaining experienced, high-performing talent who can speak the language of enterprise architects, data engineers, and data platform owners, and with hiring where the team needs to grow.

This is a full-time position based in the US.

Technologies You’ll Use

Fivetran, dbt, Enterprise databases and applications (including SAP), cloud data warehouses and lakehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks), open table formats (Apache Iceberg), dbt, SQL, reverse ETL, AI and agent tooling, AWS, GCP, Azure

  • Execute hands-on tasks when needed, including architecture reviews, critical customer calls, or complex proofs of value.
  • Ensure the team provides timely, strategic, and accurate guidance during technical evaluations and customer escalations.
  • Build strong working relationships with strategic internal partners, including Product, Engineering, and other sales teams.
  • Coach team members to maximize performance and efficiency, and prepare them for future roles.
  • Ensure the team shares specialist knowledge across the field through enablement and documentation.
  • Keep the team current on how AI and agentic workloads change customer requirements, and turn that into field guidance.

jobs.description:
Category-defining tech. Career-defining work.

For more than a decade, Cockroach Labs has built database technology trusted to power some of the world s most mission-critical applications. Now, as AI transforms how software is created and operated, the infrastructure behind it has to keep pace. Cockroach Continuum is built to meet this moment, bringing individual databases together into one fleet designed for agentic applications, where AI agents help teams provision, scale, and optimize workloads at machine speed.  

At Cockroach Labs, you ll solve problems that didn t exist five years ago alongside people who believe the simplest solutions often require the most sophisticated thinking. Your work will run in production at some of the most innovative companies in the world. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to own that opportunity.  

The Role

The Migrations team owns the full suite of MOLT (Migrate Off Legacy Technology) tooling: Convert, Fetch, Replicator, and Verify. We also recently launched the Migration Assistant, which brings the individual MOLT tools together into a single migration workflow which guides customers through moving their databases to CockroachDB and Cockroach Continuum. We re looking for a staff software engineer to help build out the Migration Assistant, expand the capabilities of the MOLT toolkit, and to drive innovation around how AI can be leveraged to further reduce friction during the migration process..

You ll report to Eric Alton, who leads the Migrations and Observability teams, and work closely with other engineers, SREs, and our product and design teams.

This role follows Cockroach Labs hybrid model: Roachers local to an office come in Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, and work flexibly the rest of the week.

You Will

  • Build and extend CockroachDB s migration tooling, including the Migration Assistant, to make migrating to CockroachDB effortless.
  • Apply AI to real migration problems in a way that ensures security of customer data and correctness of the migration workflow.
  • Help expand the capabilities of MOLT s Convert, Fetch, Replicator, and Verify tools into a single, cohesive migration experience.
  • Develop primarily in Go (we ll teach you if you don t know it) alongside engineers and PMs across the cloud and database teams.
  • Take part in a collaborative, technically rigorous culture, and help shape engineering practices on a growing team.

 The Expectations

In the first month, you ll join the team and get familiar with our production systems, the MOLT tooling suite, the Migration Assistant s architecture, and how customers actually migrate to CockroachDB. Take the time to learn the technology, the team, and how we work before diving into big projects.

After 3 months, you ll be a full member of the team, contributing to the MOLT and Migration Assistant tooling ecosystem. You ll have a feel for where customers hit friction during migrations, and you ll work with your manager to point your efforts at the areas that matter most.

As the team grows and the Migration Assistant matures, you ll have real influence over where migration tooling at CockroachDB goes next, including how far we push AI to take the guesswork out of migrations. We also offer technical training and mentorship to help you grow in whatever direction you want.

You Have

  • A strong grasp of system design for high-throughput data systems.

  • Experience and interest in designing and building systems and tools that leverage AI.

  • Change Data Capture & Streaming: Enhance and scale our Change Streams product, enabling real-time event tracking and data synchronization across downstream systems.

This role can be based out of one of our US offices or remotely in the United States.

Candidate Profile

  • 5+ years of experience in software development and/or performance engineering
  • Experience with large backend/compiled codebases, such as Rust or C/C++
  • Solid computer science fundamentals with expertise in data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and software design architecture
  • Strong interest in database internals, query engines, and distributed systems architecture (hands-on experience or an advanced degree like an M.Sc./Ph.D. in databases is a plus).
  • Experience with observability tooling (e.g. time series metrics, dashboards)

Position Expectations

  • Design, implement, and optimize integrations connecting the MongoDB query engine with our broader ecosystem
  • Write clean, maintainable, and high-performance C++ code while actively participating in code reviews and design discussions
  • Lead projects end-to-end—from initial design to implementation and support.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product and engineering peers to define technical roadmaps and deliver robust engineering solutions

Success Measures

  • In 3 months, you ll have shipped code into production and collaborated with the team to solve tough problems

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. This is a remote opportunity and we are looking for candidates from the U.S.

The Opportunity

Grafana Labs is seeking a Staff Engineer (AI & Automation) to own the AI agent infrastructure and automation platform that powers our Marketing Operations organization. You’ll build multi-agent architectures, LLM integrations, and backend services that connect AI models to internal and third-party data platforms. You’ll ship production systems that teams depend on daily.

This is a high-autonomy role where you own the technical direction. You’ll identify the highest-leverage problems across Marketing, RevOps, and SDR teams, design the solutions, and ship them. You’ll define the technical direction for the automation platform (data models, API contracts, shared libraries, reference architectures) and partner with Data Engineering, GTM Systems, and Field Operations to build scalable, self-service automation that eliminates manual work and drives operational efficiency.

Agentic Systems & AI Infrastructure

  • Develop reusable agentic skills that agents invoke across interfaces (Slack, dashboards, internal apps, CLIs)
  • Implement observability and feedback loops including logging, performance metrics, prompt iteration, model evaluation, and cost management
  • Establish governance and compliance standards for AI workflows including access controls, audit trails, PII handling, and human-in-the-loop escalation paths

Systems Integration & Backend Services

  • Build MCP servers, APIs, CLIs, and microservices connecting AI models to business systems (BigQuery, Slack, CRMs, email, calendars, analytics tools)
  • Architect data flows for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), connecting LLMs to internal knowledge bases, customer data, and real-time business context
  • Build serverless or containerized services (GCP Cloud Functions, Cloud Run) that scale with usage and integrate with Grafana s cloud infrastructure

Automation & Workflow Enablement

  • Partner with RevOps, Demand Generation, Regional Marketing, and SDR teams to scope high-impact automation problems, identify bottlenecks, and build solutions with measurable business outcomes
  • Design and deploy workflows using orchestration tools (n8n, Workato, or custom platforms) with CI/CD, testing, and production reliability standards
  • Build systems designed for self-service with documentation, playbooks, and enablement materials that let partner teams operate independently

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You ll have access to AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenAI Codex, and others of your choice within security guidelines). We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development paired with strong code review and quality standards.

jobs.title: Senior Corporate Security Engineer
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Senior Corporate Security Engineer, you ll help secure the systems GitLab team members rely on every day across a fully remote environment. This role sits within Corporate Security Engineering and focuses on building secure-by-default controls for endpoints and the SaaS platforms that support them, with a strong emphasis on macOS. You ll own meaningful technical decisions around endpoint hardening, automation, and detection, and you ll help turn security requirements into scalable engineering systems that are measurable, auditable, and designed to reduce friction for end users.

This is a strong fit if you re motivated by solving security problems with code. You will work across endpoint management, identity, and security operations to improve how GitLab manages macOS, iOS, Windows, and Linux devices through Infrastructure-as-Code, Terraform, and GitOps workflows. In your first year, you ll be expected to strengthen endpoint security architecture, expand automation, and improve the reliability and auditability of how controls are deployed and maintained.

What you’ll do

  • Help lead the security architecture of GitLab s endpoint fleet and related infrastructure, with a primary focus on macOS.
  • Design and support automation for secure endpoint deployment, configuration, and lifecycle management using code-based workflows.
  • Manage endpoint and SaaS security configuration through Terraform, version control, merge requests, continuous integration pipelines, and automated rollouts.
  • Define and enforce security baselines across macOS, iOS, Windows, and Linux endpoints.
  • Develop patching and software distribution approaches that align with security, compliance, and operational requirements.
  • Partner with Information Technology, Security Operations, and Detection and Response teams to improve endpoint telemetry, detections, and response models.
  • Drive process improvements that reduce manual work and lower risk by favoring automation, policy-driven controls, and auditable change management.
  • Mentor engineers across Corporate Security and Information Technology, and serve as a senior escalation point for complex endpoint security issues.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience designing and delivering endpoint, systems, or corporate security solutions in environments that require scalable, durable controls.
  • Deep knowledge of endpoint management platforms such as Jamf Pro or FleetDM, especially for architecting and securing macOS environments.
  • Strong hands-on ability with Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code practices, including module design, state management, and pipeline-based deployment.
  • Experience working with GitOps workflows where changes are managed through Git repositories, merge requests, code review, and automated pipelines.
  •  Strong proficiency in scripting or programming for automation and security tooling, such as bash, Python, PowerShell, or Go.
  • Familiarity with cloud identity providers and directories, including platforms such as Okta, Google Workspace, LDAP.
  • Ability to communicate clearly, collaborate across distributed teams, and work independently in an all-remote environment.
  • Openness to bringing transferable experience from adjacent security, systems, or platform engineering backgrounds, along with a practical and security-focused approach to problem solving.

About the team

The Corporate Security Engineering team secures the internal environment GitLab team members use every day, including endpoints, identity systems, SaaS applications, and platforms that store sensitive internal data. It s a small, high-leverage team that treats security work as engineering work: building with code, operating through Git, and using reviewable, testable, and auditable workflows by default. The team partners closely with Information Technology, Security Operations, and Engineering across regions, collaborating asynchronously to build controls that scale across GitLab s all-remote workforce while reducing friction for end users.

jobs.title: AMER Data Analyst - Sales Strategy and Operations
jobs.location: Chicago, US Remote, SF, NYC, Seattle
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Sales Strategy & Operations team is responsible for the overall productivity and effectiveness of the sales organization, partnering closely with the sales team and other teams across Stripe to drive highly strategic initiatives. This team is integral in the success of our sales organization. With a commitment to excellence and a deep understanding of the art and science of sales, our team is dedicated to informing the sales strategy, optimising processes, and providing insights that propel our sales growth. We do this by being objective, trusted partners to the Sales Leadership team.

What you’ll do

We are seeking a technically sophisticated and detail oriented individual who will serve as a Sales Strategy and Operations Data Analyst in support of the AMER Velocity (Commercial and SMB) business. This person will be responsible for improving the quality of sales analytics and insights, including standardization of reporting and scalability with the primary objective of enabling sales leadership to make effective, analytically driven decisions. You will work primarily with Sales Leadership and other cross-functional business partners to drive the operational cadence and strategy/planning of the business.

Responsibilities

  • Operating Cadence: Execute on a standard weekly, monthly and quarterly cadence of operations (weekly forecasting calls, monthly business reviews, quarterly business reviews).
  • Business Insights: Develop a deep understanding of the Velocity business and its sales funnel. Provide actionable insights and a strategic perspective on business performance to help inform key decisions. Effectively communicate insights and recommendations to business leads and influence strategic decision-making.
  • Strategy / Planning: Analyze sales and revenue data and other metrics to build models and provide actionable recommendations to shape the strategy during the annual planning process (resource planning, territory design, target/quota setting and management).
  • Program and Process Management: Independently develop and manage project or program plans to support requests from key stakeholder and core operational planning processes. Manage segment wide operational processes and programs including but not limited to sales territory development.
  • Scalable Insight: Conceptualize, build, manage and maintain centralized tools (including spreadsheet models, dashboards) that the business and Sales Strategy & Operations team can use to extract data / insights for daily business management in an automated manner to drive current and future rhythms of business. As a result of insights, identify and improve the usability and accessibility of insights from existing systems and tools, in collaboration with respective development teams.

Who you are

We re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 3–5 years of work experience in B2B sales strategy and operations and/or business analytics, business strategy/operations, data science, investment banking, management consulting, and/or related domains.
  • Strong analytical skills, business intuition and a structured approach to solving complex business problems.
  • User-first mindset: Ability to work proactively and collaboratively with stakeholders, particularly in clearly communicating data insights and takeaways.
  • Has an enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves” mentality. Pragmatic problem solver, with a bias to action and “getting things done”. Passionate about driving business outcomes and change at the ground level.
  • Ability to communicate technical content to non-technical audiences and translate business insights into practical recommendations, with a willingness to grow into presenting to leadership.
  • Experience initiating and completing analytical projects, taking a structured approach to solving unique business problems.
  • Experience in Salesforce (or other CRM). Intermediate to advanced SQL and strong Google Sheets or Excel modeling skills.
  • Experience working with large data sets, especially in analyzing large imperfect data sets to creatively solve problems and creating scalable reports and dashboards or ad-hoc analysis in a fast-paced, high-volume business.

Preferred qualifications

  • Proficiency in BI visualization tools (e.g., Tableau).
  • Interest in learning and applying AI tools to improve analytical and operational workflows.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
As a Solutions Architect inside the Solutions Center of Excellence, you will serve as a strategic, technical partner in our most complex enterprise sales cycles. You are a recognized subject matter expert who empowers global teams and customers to achieve their mission by showcasing "the art of the possible" through deep technical expertise in Asana’s API, AI, and platform ecosystem.

You will manage large, complex technical projects with our strategic customers, influencing both internal product roadmaps and external customer technology frameworks. This role is a transformation from one-off technical fixes to building the architectural foundation that orchestrates work at scale.

This role is based in our Dublin office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you re interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What You’ll Achieve

  • Strategic Team-Selling: Partner with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers to design innovative, integrated solutions that transform customer workflows and drive strategic business growth for Tier 1 accounts.
  • Technical Validation & MVPs: Own the design and execution of technical proof-of-concepts (POCs) and minimum viable products (MVPs) that prove Asana’s value as a platform.
  • Platform Evangelism & Enablement: Level up the broader Solutions organization by creating technical guides, reusable demo assets, and training programs on non-code and low-code technical engagements.
  • Product Partnership: Serve as the "eyes in the field" for R&D, capturing insights from global enterprise engagements to influence the future roadmap of Asana’s API and AI capabilities.
  • Architectural Leadership: Develop "before/after" architectural frameworks and workflow diagrams that illustrate how Asana integrates into diverse customer tech stacks.
  • Scaled Impact: Identify repeatable technical patterns and turn them into global assets—such as custom script galleries or workflow templates—that enable self-service across the revenue organization.
  • Roadmap Influence: Partner directly with Product Management and Engineering to identify gaps and proactively shape the long-term platform strategy and roadmap.

About You

  • Expert Architect: You have 6–10+ years of experience in a technical customer-facing role (Solutions Engineering, Architecture, or Technical Consulting) 
  • Proven Orchestrator: Extensive experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder projects end-to-end or building technical programs from the ground up.
  • Deep Technical Acumen: Proficient in scripting (Python, JavaScript, or Node.js) and designing custom integrations using RESTful APIs and serverless architectures (e.g., AWS Lambda).
  • Strategic Thinker: You look "around corners" to identify technical obstacles before they arise and can articulate complex initiatives across cross-functional teams to gain internal buy-in.
  • Independent Driver: A self-starter and independent thinker who thrives in dynamic environments and takes total ownership of outcomes.
  • Master Storyteller: Comfortable presenting a bold vision of the future to C-level executives, moving beyond feature-selling to value-based solutioning.
  • Global Collaborator: Skilled at influencing without authority and working across regions (NAMER, EMEA, APAC) to standardize best practices while respecting regional nuances.
  • Continuous Learner: Passionate about emerging technologies, particularly AI/LLMs, and eager to leverage them to enhance organizational productivity.
  • Cross-Functional Catalyst: Proven ability to align marketing, business, and product teams to deliver cohesive, high-value solutions.
  • Leadership: Demonstrated ability to delegate, oversee the work of others, and mentor junior team members.
  • Commercial Acumen: Deep knowledge of software and SaaS buying behaviors and enterprise procurement cycles.
  • Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of the work management category and how enterprise technology ecosystems (CRM, iPaaS, Cloud Hosting) intersect.
  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, GPS
jobs.description:
Principal Software Engineer, Global Public Sector 

Scale’s rapidly growing Global Public Sector team is focused on using AI to address critical challenges facing the public sector around the world. Our core work consists of:

  • Creating custom AI applications that will impact millions of citizens
  • Generating high-quality training data for national LLMs
  • Upskilling and advisory services to spread the impact of AI

We are hiring a Principal Engineer to join a small team of our most senior engineers who take on the problems no one else can. You will work at the earliest stage of our engagements: shaping the technical approach with clients, defining the technology we build on, and turning ideas into working prototypes fast. You will step in when a project is stuck or a problem is unusually hard, and turn what you learn in the field into shared capabilities every team can build on.

This is a very senior, hands-on role. Our engineering organisation is young, so mentoring is a core part of the job: you will raise the bar for how we design, build and deliver, and grow the next generation of technical leaders around you. The role is based in London.

At Scale, we’re not just building AI solutions, we are building repeatable blocks to enable the public sector to transform their operations and better serve citizens through cutting-edge technology. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI in the public sector and be a member of our rapidly expanding team, we’d love to hear from you.

You will:

  • Take on the hardest technical problems across our programs, stepping in where projects are stuck or the path forward is unclear
  • Lead the technical side of early engagements: work with clients to scope problems, shape proofs of concept and keep the scope needed to prove value as small as possible
  • Build working prototypes quickly, from AI agents and evaluation pipelines to data and knowledge systems, and take the most promising ones to production
  • Define the technology and architecture our solutions are built on, keeping them cohesive, secure and reusable across clients
  • Mentor engineers across a young organisation through pairing, design and code reviews, and set the bar for engineering excellence
  • Partner with Directors, VPs and client executives to navigate high-stakes business and technical trade-offs, including travel to client sites as engagements require
  • Turn patterns from the field into reusable capabilities, contributing components back to our core platform so every engagement starts further ahead
  • Lead from the front on agentic engineering, both in the AI systems we build and in how our teams use coding agents day to day, and push the boundaries of what’s possible with AI

Ideally you’d have:

  • A strong engineering background, with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • 10+ years of post-graduation engineering experience, with demonstrated proficiency in languages such as Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, or C++
  • 5+ years of experience applying AI/ML in production environments, such as building generative/agentic AI applications, RAG systems or evaluation pipelines
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with a track record of taking ambiguous, early-stage problems from a blank page to a working prototype and into production
  • Deep expertise in system design and architecture, including experience with cloud-based machine learning tools and platforms (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar of a team or organisation
  • Comfort working directly with clients, from their engineering teams to senior executives
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills to collaborate effectively in a cross-functional environment

Nice to haves:

  • Past experience in a forward deployed engineering role
  • Experience working at a startup, particularly as a founding engineer
  • Experience building and deploying large-scale AI solutions
  • Experience delivering technology programs for governments or regulated industries
  • Experience deploying solutions on-prem or in customer-controlled environments
  • Current or previous UK government security clearance (e.g. SC or DV)

PLEASE NOTE: Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants.

jobs.description:
Software is eating the world, but AI is eating software. We live in unprecedented times – AI has the potential to exponentially augment human intelligence.   • Directly mentor software engineers ranging from new grads to experienced engineers.
  • Proactively identify opportunities and drive improvements to software development practices, processes, tools, and languages.
  • Present technical information to teams and stakeholders, providing guidance and insight on development processes and technologies.

  • Extensive experience defining and evangelizing best-practices for AI development tools, including cost guardrails, security frameworks, and hosting knowledge-sharing sessions, among others.
  • Extensive experience in software development and a deep understanding of distributed systems and public cloud platforms (AWS preferred).

  • Experience working fluently with standard infrastructure, containerization, and deployment technologies like Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, etc.
  • Experience with modern web frameworks like NodeJS, NextJS, etc.
  • Strong knowledge of software engineering best practices and CI/CD tooling (CircleCI, Helm, ArgoCD).

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Observability
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Build the foundation for faster, safer innovation.

Snowflake’s AI Data Cloud supports critical enterprise workloads across multiple clouds and regions. As AI accelerates software development, the volume and pace of change are outgrowing what engineers can manually review, coordinate, and monitor. Moving faster requires systems that make understanding, diagnosing, and resolving issues an integral part of how customers and engineers work.

The Observability team builds the telemetry, analytics, and diagnostic platform that helps Snowflake customers and engineers understand the health of their workloads and services, detect problems early, and resolve them quickly. We’re looking for a hands-on, product-minded Principal Software Engineer I to help build an AI-driven observability platform, combining deep distributed-systems engineering with a strong instinct for what customers and developers need.

You will shape technical direction, solve challenging systems problems, and lead initiatives from concept to customer launch across engineering, product, and design. The opportunity is to build a platform where AI agents and engineers detect, diagnose, and resolve issues together, so that growing scale and complexity translate into faster answers rather than more manual investigation.




AS A PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:

 - Architect and build distributed infrastructure. Design scalable pipelines and services for ingesting, storing, and querying logs, metrics, traces, and events at very high volume, with predictable cost, low query latency, fault isolation, and clear data-freshness guarantees.

 - Ship observability products to customers. Partner with product management and design to define and deliver customer-facing capabilities, from telemetry collection and alerting to dashboards and diagnostics, that work natively within Snowflake. Turn customer feedback and usage data into product decisions, and own outcomes through launch and adoption.

 - Build AI-driven detection and diagnosis. Develop agentic workflows that correlate signals across the stack, surface anomalies, explain likely root causes, and recommend or take remediation steps. Ground these capabilities in high-quality telemetry and rigorous evaluation so customers and engineers can trust them.

 - Build and work AI-first. Make AI integral to how you design, implement, test, and operate software. Establish rigorous evaluation, security, and reliability standards for AI-powered capabilities, and drive adoption of AI-first practices across the team.

 - Lead from architecture through adoption. Translate ambiguous customer and developer needs into practical designs and milestones. Deliver intuitive APIs, SDKs, and self-service experiences built on open standards such as OpenTelemetry, and guide incremental migrations from existing tooling.

 - Raise the engineering bar. Write and review production code, diagnose complex failures, own operational outcomes, and mentor engineers. Influence across teams through technical depth, clear communication, and sound judgment.




OUR IDEAL PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

 - 12+ years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership of complex backend, infrastructure, or data-platform initiatives spanning multiple teams.

 - Deep experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems, with strong understanding of concurrency, consistency, caching, failure recovery, storage and query efficiency, and performance.

 - Strong computer science fundamentals and hands-on proficiency in Java, Go, C++, or a comparable backend language, plus experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

 - An AI-first engineering practice: you actively use AI throughout the software lifecycle and can demonstrate how it improves your execution, problem-solving, and quality. You are ready to build AI-powered platform capabilities and help others adopt this approach.

 - A track record of shipping products to external customers: partnering with product and design, turning ambiguous problems into delivered systems, making scope and quality trade-offs, and driving adoption, reliability, and customer satisfaction after launch.

 - Clear written communication, low-ego collaboration, strong ownership, and experience mentoring senior engineers.

 - A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Especially relevant: Experience building observability, monitoring, or analytics platforms (logs, metrics, traces, alerting); OpenTelemetry; time-series or columnar storage; AIOps or agentic diagnosis systems; or developer-facing data products.

Help build the platform that lets customers and engineers understand and resolve issues faster than manual investigation allows, with the scale and trust that critical workloads demand.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Who we are

We're Redis. We built the product that runs the fast apps our world runs on. (If you checked the weather, used your credit card, or looked at your flight status online today, you’re welcome.) At Redis, you’ll work with the fastest, simplest technology in the business—whether you’re building it, telling its story, or selling it to our 10,000+ worldwide customers. We’re creating a faster world with simpler experiences. You in?


WHY WOULD YOU LOVE THIS JOB?

The Redis Cloud Operations team is hiring for a Site Reliability Engineer role, offering you the chance to work on large-scale systems and support our valued customers. You'll operate state-of-the-art products using the most cutting-edge and best-in-class SRE tools. In this global role, you'll participate in the monitoring, operation, and management of a Redis managed service at one of the world’s largest cloud providers. We’re looking for highly motivated team players with a keen attention to detail and substantial experience working in intense production environments. If you have a passion for tackling technical challenges on a global scale, this position is perfect for you.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own and manage production incidents impacting Redis Enterprise clusters in Azure cloud

 - Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed systems, driving root cause analysis and resolution

 - Partner with R&D and Product teams to resolve bugs, influence product improvements through operational insights, and drive long-term reliability enhancements

 - Participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation in a global team (follow-the-sun model)

 - Design and develop code-driven automation tools, internal platforms, and data workflows leveraging cloud services and AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Cursor, Codex, Claude) to streamline operations, enhance incident analysis, and improve visibility into production systems.

 - Build and maintain services to enhance incident management, reporting, and fleet-level insights.

jobs.title: Senior AI Developer
jobs.description:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀



We're looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior AI Engineer to join our ClickUp Engineering team, with a focus on AI evaluations. You'll own how we measure and improve the quality of ClickUp's AI: building the eval systems that tell us how well our AI is performing, the core agent harness, and the AI that performs well on those evals. You'll work on backend systems that make AI-powered capabilities scalable, reliable, and secure, while working hands-on with LLMs to solve real user problems and drive product innovation.

 

Key Responsibilities:

 - Design, build, and own ClickUp's AI evaluation system, including golden datasets, LLM-as-judge and automated scorers, regression detection, and quality tracking across AI features.

 - Build and evolve the core agent harness, and the AI that performs well on those evals, partnering closely with product and engineering to define what "great" looks like.

 - Build self-improvement loops where agents modify other agents or prompts, rerun evals, and iterate automatically.

 - Benchmark new models as they're released and own model selection, routing, and fallback strategies across providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, open-weight), balancing quality, latency, and cost.

 - Architect, design, and implement scalable AI platform services that support the deployment, orchestration, and lifecycle management of LLMs and other AI models.

 - Build and maintain robust APIs and backend systems that integrate AI-powered features into ClickUp's core platform.

 - Develop infrastructure for model serving, monitoring, logging, and automated evaluation to ensure high reliability and performance of AI services in production.

 - Drive best practices in AI privacy, security, and compliance, including data anonymization, secure data handling, and regulatory adherence.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with product, frontend, and data teams to deliver seamless, reliable, and user-centric AI experiences.

 

Qualifications:

 - 5+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years building production LLM or ML systems.

 - Hands-on experience building LLM evaluation systems in production (golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, judge calibration, offline and online evals), tied to real product quality.

 - Strong experiment design and statistical rigor, including A/B testing, offline vs. online metrics, and separating real regressions from noisy or variable results.

 - Proven track record of applying LLMs and AI models to real-world, customer-facing product features.

 - Proven experience integrating and managing multiple LLMs, including benchmarking, routing, and cost/latency/quality tradeoffs.

 - Deep expertise in backend engineering, distributed systems, and cloud-native technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker, AWS/GCP/Azure).

 - Strong programming skills in Python (preferred), Go, TypeScript, or similar languages used for backend and AI platform development.

 - Proficiency in orchestration frameworks and workflow engines (e.g., LangGraph, Airflow, Ray, or similar).

 - Familiarity with search and retrieval technologies and their integration into AI-driven applications.

 - Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with a track record of working effectively in cross-functional teams.

 - Passion for staying at the forefront of AI and applying new technologies to solve real-world problems at scale.

 

Nice to Have:

 - Background in data science, applied science, or machine learning engineering.

 - Experience with eval tooling (e.g., Braintrust, LangSmith, Weave, Arize, or in-house frameworks).

 - Experience with model routing, AI gateways, or inference optimization.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Runtime Systems
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.
 
We re proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

 

What You’ll Do:

The Physical AI Engineering Team at CoreWeave is building the software and infrastructure that enables demanding AI, simulation, robotics, and engineering workloads to run reliably at scale.

As these workloads become more complex, the challenge is no longer simply providing compute. We need to make heterogeneous workloads easier to execute, observe, reproduce, and move across different systems without hiding the capabilities or semantics of the infrastructure underneath them.

About the role:

We’re seeking a Staff Software Engineer, Runtime Systems to help design and build this layer.

This is a hands-on systems engineering role at the intersection of distributed systems, runtimes, workflow execution, programming language concepts, and large-scale compute infrastructure.

You’ll work on the foundations that allow complex workloads to move from an abstract description into reliable execution across systems such as Kubernetes, Argo, OSMO, and future execution environments.

A major part of the role is deciding where abstraction is useful — and where it creates more complexity. Rather than building another universal workflow engine, you’ll help establish clear contracts between our platform and the systems that execute work, while preserving native capabilities.

You’ll operate across architecture and implementation: defining contracts, writing production software, validating assumptions against real workloads, and working closely with platform and infrastructure teams.

In this role, you will:

  • Runtime Systems & Architecture
  • Design and build runtime components for complex AI, simulation, and engineering workloads.
  • Define abstractions for workloads, execution environments, dependencies, state, capabilities, and failure.
  • Design interfaces between higher-level services and systems such as Kubernetes, Argo, and OSMO.
  • Establish clear boundaries around which systems own state, decisions, and side effects.
  • Make architectural decisions balancing simplicity, extensibility, performance, and operational reality.
  • Execution Models & Contracts
  • Define durable contracts between workload definitions, control-plane services, and execution backends.
  • Develop typed representations and schemas that allow workloads to be transformed safely across systems.
  • Design compatibility and evolution mechanisms for those contracts.
  • Build conformance and validation mechanisms that make guarantees executable rather than dependent on documentation.
  • Reason deeply about retries, partial failure, idempotency, cancellation, dependencies, and uncertain outcomes.
  • Hands-On Systems Engineering
  • Write production-quality software for critical runtime and control-plane components.
  • Build adapters and integrations for heterogeneous execution environments.
  • Diagnose behaviour across application, orchestration, cluster, and infrastructure boundaries.
  • Improve the reliability, observability, and debuggability of distributed workload execution.
  • Work closely with Go, Kubernetes, and infrastructure engineers to turn architecture into production systems.
  • Performance & Experimentation
  • Develop rigorous ways to understand workload performance across large-scale GPU infrastructure.
  • Design experiments that separate real performance gains from noise, warm-up effects, scheduling behaviour, and stragglers.
  • Build repeatable workload and benchmark environments.
  • Use evidence from real execution to challenge assumptions and guide platform development.
  • Technical Leadership
  • Lead ambiguous systems problems where the correct architecture is not yet known.
  • Reduce complex problems into smaller contracts and mechanisms that can actually be implemented.
  • Challenge unnecessary abstraction and simplify designs where complexity has outgrown its value.
  • Influence technical direction across teams without requiring direct authority.
  • Mentor engineers and contribute to technical hiring and engineering standards.

Who You Are:

  • Significant experience building complex systems software, distributed infrastructure, runtimes, workflow systems, or adjacent technology.
  • Deep expertise in at least one of:
    • Distributed systems
    • Runtime systems
    • Workflow or execution engines
    • Programming languages, compilers, or interpreters
    • Cluster scheduling and orchestration
    • High-performance or systems software
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and production coding ability.

jobs.title: Platform Software Engineer
jobs.description: The Developer Enablement & Security (DE&S) team within Platform Engineering owns the tooling that TomTom engineers use to write, build, store and secure code. This covers GitHub platform management, artifact management with JFrog Artifactory, security scanning, developer tooling and AI governance platforms. We treat internal developers as our customers and aim to make the secure path the easy path. What you will do Administer and automate GitHub Enterprise: repository settings, rulesets, access and governance across a large repository estate. Operate and improve JFrog Artifactory, including repository configuration, cleanup, permissions and support for our hybrid cloud setup. Replace repetitive admin work with scripts and automation using Python, Bash and REST APIs. Build and maintain GitHub Actions workflows and support teams whose pipelines pull and publish packages. Manage platform configuration as code with Terraform or similar tools. Use AI tools to speed up automation and support work, and help developers adopt them safely in line with our AI governance approach. Take ownership of well-defined platform tasks from start to finish, asking for guidance when needed. Troubleshoot developer issues across DNS, TLS, proxies and authentication. Write and maintain documentation and runbooks that let developers help themselves. Explain platform policies clearly and work with developers to adopt them. What you need 2 to 5 years of experience in DevOps, platform, build or infrastructure engineering. Git and GitHub: comfortable with branching, pull requests, reviews and repository settings; hands-on experience with GitHub Actions. Scripting and automation: Python or Bash, with experience calling REST APIs. CI/CD basics: you have built or maintained pipelines and understand how builds pull and publish packages. Package ecosystems: working knowledge of at least two of Maven/Gradle, npm, PyPI, Docker and NuGet. Linux and networking: you can find your way around a server and troubleshoot DNS, TLS, proxy and authentication problems. Infrastructure as Code: some experience with Terraform or a similar tool, ideally for managing platform configuration. AI in day-to-day work: good understanding of AI coding assistants and agents such as GitHub Copilot or Claude, and hands-on experience using them to write scripts, automate tasks, troubleshoot and document your work. Nice to have Cloud basics in Azure or AWS. Identity basics: exposure to SSO, SAML/OIDC or SCIM. Security awareness: secrets management, least privilege and dependency scanning; exposure to Black Duck, Coverity or Veracode is a plus. Admin experience on a developer platform such as GitHub, GitLab, Artifactory, Nexus or Jenkins. How you work You write clear docs and runbooks, because platform teams depend on them. You treat internal developers as customers and can explain a policy without creating friction. You keep learning; you pick up new tools quickly rather than relying on knowing one specific product. OUR MISSION
At Redwood, we empower our customers with lights-out automation for their mission-critical business processes with industry leading products and platforms developed through an AI-Driven Software Development Life Cycle.

ABOUT US
Redwood Software is the leading orchestration platform for the autonomous enterprise, driving business transformation at the lowest total cost of ownership. Redwood empowers organizations to intelligently automate and orchestrate mission-critical business and IT processes across complex ERP, hybrid cloud, data and emerging agentic AI systems. Through its SaaS-first automation fabric—with AI embedded across the automation lifecycle—Redwood accelerates the path to autonomous operations. You will shape backend architecture, build secure and reliable integrations, and improve the performance and operability of systems that support mission-critical customer workflows.

Unlike traditional tools, Computer unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries. About the role DevRev's Technology Alliances team partners with the most important AI and cloud platforms in the world — AWS, Anthropic, Databricks, Snowflake, MongoDB, Salesforce, and more — to create joint value with our customers. We're hiring Business Development Managers to work closely with these partners and accelerate GTM by driving pipeline generation and co-sell opportunities. You'll work hand-in-hand with DevRev's Tech Alliances team and these tech partners to build joint go-to-market motions, co-create pipeline with our partners, and bring DevRev sellers and partner sellers together to accelerate opportunities to close. This is a field-facing, revenue-oriented role that sits at the seam between DevRev's sales organization and our partner ecosystem. What you'll do Partner with DevRev's Tech Alliances team to design and run joint go-to-market motions with our technology partners. Co-build pipeline with partners — source and develop joint opportunities through co-sell, marketplace, and joint account planning. Bring DevRev sellers and partner (Tech Alliance) sellers together on live deals, aligning both sides to accelerate opportunities through the funnel. Drive account mapping and joint account planning between DevRev and partner field teams in your region. Represent DevRev in partner field forums, co-sell reviews, and regional GTM motions. Localize partner GTM strategy to your geography — accounting for the regional customer base, partner landscape, and field team structure. Report on partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, and on the health of the joint seller relationships you own. What you bring 8-12 years of experience in business development, alliances, partner/channel sales, or co-sell — ideally in SaaS, cloud, or AI. Techno-business acumen: comfortable in both the commercial and the technical conversation with sellers, partners, and customers. Established relationships with partner field/sales teams in your region a strong plus. Region-based (Palo Alto or New York), able to travel across the geography for partner and customer engagements.
