jobs.title: Staff Information Security Engineer
jobs.description: Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins. Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end. Overview Rithum expects employees across all roles to leverage AI and technology to improve efficiency, streamline workflows, and create scalable ways of working. Rithum is embedding AI into every corner of how it operates — and security is no exception. As a Staff Information Security Engineer, you own the intersection of AI adoption and information security: designing guardrails for AI-powered products, building automated security tooling, designing security controls and monitoring for an AI-First workforce, helping every team at Rithum move fast without creating risk they cannot see. This is not a typical security role. You spend as much time building and automating as you do reviewing, turning a repeating control into infrastructure-as-code, a manual review into a workflow, and a vague AI risk into a concrete, enforced guardrails. You work autonomously, balancing research with fast-paced delivery, and collaborating closely with Platform Engineering, IT, Security Champions, and external auditors. Responsibilities Act as the bridge between architectural intent and operational reality; mediate conflicts between security requirements and feasible implementation, propose compensating controls where gaps exist and help register, track and remediate residual risks. Implement preventive, default-on security controls across cloud and enterprise environments, codified as policy- and infrastructure-as-code so security is enforced by design, including controls that govern how AI tools and models may be used. Implement and enforce identity and access controls to an agreed standard, including access boundaries for AI systems and non-human/agent identities by partnering with Platform Engineering and IT to align tooling and policy to the architecture. Assist in maintaining the InfoSec risk register; track emerging threats and translate them into actionable guidance for engineering teams. Support third-party and vendor risk assessments, with a focus on vendors who process data through AI pipelines. Automate repetitive security workflows (evidence collection, access reviews, alert enrichment) and build or operate AI-assisted security agents — with human-in-the-loop approval gates, least-privilege credentials, and explicit attention to each agent's own blast radius. Integrate security tooling (SIEM, CSPM, DAST/SAST, vulnerability scanners) with LLM layers to surface actionable insight and automated responses. Define and enforce security requirements for AI-powered features: model access controls, prompt-injection mitigations, output validation, and data-handling boundaries. Conduct threat modelling on agentic and LLM-based systems, accounting for novel attack surfaces such as tool misuse, indirect prompt injection, and supply chain risk. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications 5+ years of security engineering experience with demonstrated AI/ML security depth (prompt injection, model supply chain, adversarial inputs, RAG). Experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, etc.) and LLM frameworks and APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, or similar) to accelerate and elevate your work. Hands-on identity and access expertise across modern enterprise and cloud identity stacks, including access models for AI systems and non-human identities. Infrastructure and policy-as-code (e.g. Terraform, OPA/Rego) and proficiency in a scripting language for automation (Python preferred). Cloud security expertise: AWS Solutions Architect / Security Specialty or equivalent demonstrated expertise, including multi-account governance, preventive guardrails, and policy-as-code. Application security (OWASP Top 10 and the OWASP LLM/GenAI Top 10, secure SDLC) and threat-modelling methodologies (STRIDE, PASTA, or equivalent). Practical experience building or operating AI agents, and integrating security tooling (SIEM, CSPM, SAST/DAST/SCA) so it surfaces action rather than raw alerts. Working knowledge of SOC 2 and/or ISO 27001 control frameworks. Preferred Qualifications Experience building or operating AI agents in a production environment. Awareness of privacy regulation (GDPR/CCPA) as it touches AI including privacy-by-design and DPIAs. Red teaming or adversarial ML research backgrounds. Experience implementing privileged-access, key-management, posture-management, or data-protection programs. Experience with EDR, CASB, DLP, Security automation and SAST, DAST, IAST and SCA tools. Cloud Architecture or Security certifications (CCSK, TAISE, AWS). Travel Required Up to 10% Other Duties Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - OpenTelemetry Python instrumentation | UK | Remote
jobs.description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from Germany, UK, Ireland and Spain. The Opportunity: Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, and traces with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, and Tempo – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack The Observability department is focused on enabling developers to understand the health and performance of their applications and infrastructure in any environment by providing tools to instrument their code, ingest observability data into Grafana Cloud and visualize and explore it. The OpenTelemetry SDKs team's mission is to make sure our users succeed in instrumenting their software with OpenTelemetry. We work closely with the OpenTelemetry SIGs to make OpenTelemetry SDKs and instrumentation libraries a success. Members of this team are experts in at least one programming language and have a broad knowledge of various other programming languages. In this role, you will focus on a language-specific implementation of OpenTelemetry in Python , with an emphasis on OpenTelemetry for Generative AI . You will get to work in an upstream-first approach, helping accelerate the OpenTelemetry project while bringing the innovations to Grafana labs products and offerings. As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a unique perspective to the software. We are looking for Engineers that are passionate about communicating with data and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team! Engineers at Grafana also have the opportunity to contribute to Open Source communities. At Grafana Labs, ICs have a dedicated career path and do not have to become managers to progress in their career. Staff Software Engineers at Grafana have a large amount of experience across multiple areas. They are able to estimate, plan, coordinate and deliver large tasks spanning multiple systems. They actively coach and mentor other team members in their team and are able to identify and resolve issues with technology and product processes. What You’ll Be Doing: You will bring your software engineering expertise to develop improvements to the OpenTelemetry Python SDK and instrumentation libraries, with a strong focus on AI applications and agent workflows. This is a hands-on role for someone with deep Python expertise and an interest in AI. Collaborate in open-source communities. You will develop and maintain the OpenTelemetry Python SDK and instrumentation libraries, working with maintainers and other vendors on specifications, APIs, and implementation decisions. Build Python instrumentation for AI agents. Build instrumentation that connects agent runs, model calls, and tool execution, including across asynchronous code. Contribute to evolving OpenTelemetry conventions for generative AI, with care for sensitive data and metric cardinality. Improve Python SDK performance. Use profiling and benchmarks to evaluate implementation approaches with the upstream community. Make sound tradeoffs around runtime overhead, compatibility, and maintainability. Be visible as an OpenTelemetry expert. Teach others, promote best practices around OpenTelemetry, semantic conventions, and various technologies and frameworks. Both within Grafana Labs and in the broader OpenTelemetry community. Support the technical direction and vision of the team, and contribute to business conversations on the OpenTelemetry strategy at Grafana Labs. Own projects from an ambiguous problem through design, implementation, testing, documentation, and release. Partner in an open and respectful way. Lend your knowledge and skills to our GTM, Product and Support teams. Join customer conversations, investigate instrumentation issues, and turn what you learn into fixes and practical guidance. As we are remote-first and our engineering organization is largely remote, we provide guidance and meet regularly using video calls, so high agency and good communication skills are a must. What Makes You a Great Fit: At Grafana Labs, Staff Engineers are defined by the impact they have and the people they enable. You take ownership of complex problems, set technical direction, and help others deliver improvements that matter to customers and the OpenTelemetry community. 8+ years of experience in software development, with strong proficiency in Python and experience debugging

jobs.description: At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. Visit klaviyo.com/careers to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny. At Klaviyo, we help businesses build stronger relationships with their customers. As our customers grow, our platform needs to support greater data volumes, more demanding workloads, and increasingly complex operations—with the performance and reliability they depend on. Engineering at this scale takes technical depth, sound judgment, and close collaboration. You’ll work across teams to solve challenging problems, turn architectural improvements into production results, and help build a platform ready for our largest customers. Your Impact We are seeking a senior technical leader to own Klaviyo’s approach to enterprise scalability, performance, reliability, and multi-region readiness. Reporting to a VP of Engineering, you will be a senior individual contributor with no direct reports. Your work will span system design, profiling, implementation, and production rollout. You will also help teams adopt practical tools and repeatable patterns that make performance and reliability part of everyday engineering. Drive architectural change. Design and implement sharding, partitioning, caching, back-pressure, and workload isolation strategies. Advance multi-region readiness and build safe paths for high-volume data migrations. Make scale engineering repeatable. Create lightweight benchmarks, profiling harnesses, and test environments that teams can use independently. Pair with engineers to turn successful fixes into reusable patterns. Build readiness into delivery. Lead scalability reviews and establish clear, proportionate release gates that surface risks early and help teams ship confidently. Communicate priorities, tradeoffs, and results clearly to engineers and executives, tying technical investments to customer experience, enterprise growth, and operating efficiency. What You’ll Bring Deep experience scaling multi-tenant SaaS. Engineering depth from diagnosis through delivery. You can investigate unfamiliar systems, test hypotheses, write production code, and work with service owners to roll out changes safely. Leadership across organizational boundaries. You align teams around shared outcomes, clarify ownership, and build practical standards that help engineers move faster. Clear communication. You explain complex technical decisions and their business implications to both engineering and executive audiences. Practical AI fluency. You have applied AI tools or automation to engineering work and can evaluate their usefulness, limitations, and operational risks. jobs.description:
P-1346

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world s toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world s best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. 

Networking Infrastructure is a core part of the platform that powers all our data and AI products. The platform also powers key enterprise security features used by customers across all our products to build connectivity solutions to cloud resources and prevent data exfiltration. And we re setting up the team from scratch in Bengaluru , India.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineers with a networking background to join the Networking Infrastructure team. As one of the seed members of the Bangalore site, you will be focussing on building new backend connectivity services that powers millions of VMs running on Databricks. You will also be leading the design and development of new services that powers the connectivity between our control plane and compute plane. This new platform enables Databricks to increase scalability of our compute plane while also efficiently use cloud resources. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including product management, operations, and other engineering teams, to ensure the delivery of robust, scalable, and efficient networking systems. This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about solving novel multi-cloud and distributed systems challenges.

What we look for:

  • 8+ years of production level experience in one of: Python, Java, Scala, C++, or similar language
  • 4+ years of experience developing large-scale distributed systems from scratch
  • Experience working on a SaaS platform or with Service-Oriented Architectures.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Integration Network (OIN)
jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We re all in on this mission. If you are too, let s talk.

Okta Integration Network (OIN)

The Okta Integration Network (OIN) is the platform that lets Okta customers discover, connect, and manage third-party applications and identity providers — from single sign-on and provisioning to newer, higher-order integration patterns as the ecosystem of connected software (including AI agents) continues to grow. It s core infrastructure: the workflows OIN powers run continuously for a very large share of Okta s customer base.

Our team builds and operates all of OIN — from the foundational data model, APIs, and security posture every integration in the network is built on, to the tools partners and customers use to build, test, and ship integrations, to the systems that power what those integrations can actually do once connected. In practice that spans connector metadata and provisioning primitives, partner-facing tooling, and the infrastructure work that keeps a very large, long-lived system fast, secure, and easy to extend as the network grows.

We re actively expanding OIN s scope beyond its original SSO-and-provisioning core — including new integration patterns as AI agents and machine-to-machine access become part of the identity landscape, and a lower-friction path for partners to bring new integrations into the network. You d be joining at a point where the platform s scope is visibly widening, working closely with product, architecture, and design to help figure out what "right" looks like as much as building it.

Staff Software Engineer, Integration Network (OIN)

As a Staff Software Engineer on the OIN team, you ll be a technical leader for a platform a very large share of Okta s customers depend on every day. You ll independently own complex, ambiguous problems end-to-end — from technical scoping through design, delivery, and production operation — partnering closely with product, architecture, and design to help figure out what "right" looks like as much as building it. You ll also be expected to raise the technical bar for the engineers around you, not just deliver your own code.

We re looking for self-motivated engineers who think from first principles, take pride in high-quality software, and are genuinely kind and collaborative to work with.

What you’ll be doing 

  • Lead discovery and technical scoping for new requirements, turning ambiguous product asks into a concrete architecture, phased delivery plans, and credible estimates, in close partnership with product, architecture, and design.
  • Design and evolve the APIs, data models, and security posture that OIN s integrations depend on, with an eye toward backward compatibility and long-term extensibility.
  • Drive technical decisions across ambiguous, multi-team dependencies, aligning stakeholders across engineering, product, and other parts of the business when the "right answer" isn t obvious yet.
  • Modernize and evolve a large, long-lived production system incrementally without disrupting the customers and integrations that depend on it every day.
  • Maintain a high bar for security, testing, and code quality, including vulnerability remediation and threat-aware design, while keeping a real sense of urgency on customer-impacting work.
  • Own the production health of the systems you build by writing root-cause analyses when things break, driving follow-through on the fixes, and building the observability that prevents repeat incidents.
  • Champion AI-native engineering practices by using AI coding assistants and AI-augmented workflows as a core part of how you design, build, review, and ship software, and helping the team adopt them well.
  • Mentor and raise the technical bar for the engineers around you, and represent the team s technical point of view in cross-functional forums.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • 8+ years of professional software development experience, with a demonstrated history of technical leadership and mentorship.
  • Deep proficiency in Java (our primary backend language) or a comparable strongly-typed backend language/framework, with the judgment to know when and how to modernize a large, long-lived codebase without disrupting the customers depending on it.
  • Proven experience designing, building, and operating complex, large-scale distributed systems in a cloud environment (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including caching, asynchronous processing, and data migrations at scale.
  • Real depth in identity and access protocols (OAuth 2.0/OIDC, SAML, and/or SCIM) and the security instincts that come from having built systems that other companies software authenticates against.
  • Experience designing and evolving APIs and integration frameworks that external developers or partners build on, not just internal consumers. You think about backward compatibility, versioning, and developer experience as first-class concerns.
  • Comfortable driving technical direction across ambiguous, multi-team dependencies. You can align product, architecture, and other engineering teams around a plan when the "right answer" isn t obvious yet.

jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn t a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you re ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

We re hiring a Staff Software Engineer to join the Coinbase Advisor team within the Consumer & Business group. Coinbase Advisor is the world s first RIA-licensed agentic trading system: an AI advisor living inside the Coinbase app that holds a natural conversation about a user s portfolio, gives personalized financial advice, and executes trades on their behalf. This role is primarily backend on a full-stack team. You ll own the services that make agentic trading feel fast, clear, and trustworthy for millions of customers.

What you ll do:

  • Own backend services powering Coinbase Advisor and Strategies, from technical design through launch and ongoing operation
  • Build integrations with Coinbase s trading APIs so agent recommendations and user-configured strategies translate into correct, auditable execution
  • Develop our agentic harness, including tool calling, orchestration, persistent state, and recovery from failed or partially completed actions
  • Shape agent behavior through prompt engineering, evals, and conversation analysis, partnering with our registered investment adviser on changes to financial advice
  • Improve service reliability, latency, observability, and execution safety, including retry behavior and safeguards against duplicate actions
  • Partner with frontend engineering, product, design, trading infrastructure, and legal/compliance to ship customer-facing capabilities within regulatory guardrails

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with deep backend expertise and a track record of shipping and operating production services
  • Strong experience with API design, distributed systems, data modeling, testing, and debugging production failures
  • Proficiency in Go or demonstrated ability to learn it quickly
  • Experience building production LLM or agentic systems, including tool calling, orchestration, or evaluation
  • Proven ability to take ambiguous projects from zero to production with minimal oversight and sound product and technical judgment
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Design Systems
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
jobs.description:
"We may say most aptly that the Analytical Engine weaves algebraic patterns just as the Jacquard loom weaves flowers and leaves."

— Ada Lovelace, 1843

What Lovelace saw in the loom was the pattern — flowers and leaves, repeated faithfully, each one begun by a hand that chose it. Mercury is built from patterns too. Every component, every interaction our customers come to trust, starts with someone deciding how it should go, and making it good enough to be used again and again. Tending those patterns, and giving everyone at Mercury the means to weave with them, is the work of our Design System team, and the north star of this role.

As a Senior Frontend Engineer on the Design Systems team, you will build and care for those patterns: the components and foundations that everything else at Mercury is built on. Done well, a single decision here makes every product team faster.

The ground under that work is shifting, though. Software is being built in new ways, and AI is increasingly part of how design systems are made and used. We are looking for someone who is fluent at that intersection: deeply versed in design systems, and equally as serious about what it takes to build a system that holds up at the leading edge of AI.

As part of this role, you will:

  • Build and maintain the components, patterns, and foundations (tokens, type, color, layout) that Mercury s product is woven from, holding a high bar for accessibility, performance, and pixel-level craft.
  • Lead projects that ship new UI patterns to solve real pain points for product teams, helping them build better experiences faster.
  • Develop a design system that s as ready for AI as it is for people, applying the technology to create leveraged outcomes.
  • Invest in the design system s prototyping experience, shaping the next iteration of how our design function rapidly prototypes, iterates on the product, and explores new concepts.
  • Raise the craft and AI fluency of the people around you, through mentorship and clear best practices.

The ideal candidate for the role:

We re looking for someone who cares about the foundational work that lets other people do their best work, and who s eager to help define what a design system means in a world where agents build alongside us. A successful candidate will likely have:

  • 7+ years of frontend development, with deep experience in React, TypeScript, and modern web technologies.
  • Experience building or maintaining a design system or shared component library.
  • A thorough command of modern frontend tooling: build systems, CI/CD, and testing.
  • High agency, and comfort creating clarity in ambiguous spaces. You take ownership and move without waiting for a defined path.
  • First-principles systems thinking that stays oriented to outcomes. You make clear decisions that drive toward results instead of getting stuck in open questions.
  • Strong product taste, and an instinct for leverage: the change that makes many teams better, not the one component polished in isolation.
  • Hands-on fluency at the intersection of AI and software development: a real command of how emerging AI paradigms are changing the way software gets built, and the ability to turn that into practical leverage, both for the design system itself and for the people who build on it.

If this role interests you, we invite you to explore our public demo at demo.mercury.com. 

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer, Agent Infrastructure
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRBYTE:

We’re on a mission to make data available and actionable to everyone, everywhere. With 700+ connectors, our platform powers analytics and gives AI agents the business context they need to do real work. More than 25,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Airbyte to put their data to work.


We’re built on open source because we believe companies should have full control over their data. A community of 27K members helps shape what we build, and we’re backed by $181M from investors including Benchmark, Accel, Altimeter, Coatue, and Y Combinator.


Models keep getting better. What holds AI back is the data informing and shaping its decisions, and that's the layer we're building.


We’re just getting started. If you’re excited by big challenges, meaningful ownership, and the chance to help build what’s next, we’d love to meet you.


THE ROLE:

Airbyte is incubating new product opportunities at the intersection of data, AI, and developer infrastructure. Our small team builds tooling and infrastructure for data practitioners and software engineers, leveraging Airbyte's foundation in enterprise connectivity.

This is not an ML research or prompt engineering role. We're looking for an experienced backend or platform engineer who has built complex production systems and has also worked hands-on with AI applications or infrastructure. You'll own technical explorations, build prototypes, and take promising ideas through to production.

We're still early. Some of our work extends existing products, while other projects begin as hypotheses that need validation. There's significant room to influence technical direction, challenge assumptions, and help shape what we build next.






WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Airbyte MCP: Build infrastructure that lets AI agents configure Airbyte, troubleshoot syncs, and access data directly from connected sources and warehouses. Design reliable, secure, and observable interfaces across the connector ecosystem.

 - Semantic Search & Retrieval: Build and operate search infrastructure for high-quality retrieval over enterprise data. Improve relevance, latency, and reliability in production.

 - Semantic Models: Develop systems for defining and maintaining semantic models over enterprise data. Help AI applications use consistent business definitions and produce answers that can be verified against underlying data.

 - SaaS Sandbox: Build realistic, stateful replicas of SaaS systems for developing and testing agents. Reproduce API behavior, failures, and state changes so workflows can be evaluated without using production accounts.


EXPLORE NEW PRODUCT OPPORTUNITIES

 - Turn product hypotheses into focused technical experiments. Build prototypes that test feasibility and expose important constraints.

 - Work directly with customers, Product, Design, and customer-facing teams to understand real-world problems and incorporate feedback into technical decisions.

 - Evaluate competing technical approaches and use what you learn to influence product direction.


BUILD PRODUCTION-GRADE INFRASTRUCTURE

 - Design and implement backend systems, APIs, and infrastructure for AI, data, and developer products.

 - Build reliable, observable systems with clear failure handling, debugging, and operational safeguards.

 - Take promising prototypes into production and improve them based on usage, incidents, and customer feedback.


LEAD TECHNICAL DIRECTION

 - Own architecture and execution across technical design, implementation, rollout, and iteration.

 - Lead technical decisions that span teams. Align interfaces and dependencies, and influence architecture beyond your immediate projects.

 - Communicate priorities, risks, and tradeoffs clearly, and follow through on commitments.




WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

You may be a strong fit if you are fundamentally a backend or platform engineer who has shipped AI-powered products.

 - 7+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production systems.

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals and experience designing distributed systems.

 - Experience building complex systems involving APIs, asynchronous workflows, concurrency, queues, state, retries, or distributed execution.

 - Hands-on experience building and shipping AI-powered products using LLMs, agents, RAG, tool calling, MCP, or similar technologies.

 - Experience with orchestration systems, workflow engines, developer platforms, or infrastructure products.

 - Strong system design skills and the ability to reason about reliability, scale, observability, and failure modes.

 - Demonstrated ability to lead technical direction across teams and influence architectural and engineering decisions.

 - Ability to move quickly from prototype to production without sacrificing engineering quality.

 - Strong product instincts and comfort operating in ambiguous, 0-to-1 environments.

 - Exceptional written communication skills.

 - A strong bias toward ownership and shipping.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience building and operating AI agents in production, including debugging, observability, and evaluation.

 - Experience building agent infrastructure, agent platforms, or evaluation systems.

 - Experience with retrieval systems, vector search, search infrastructure, or semantic models.

 - Experience building developer tools, platform infrastructure, or integrations with third-party SaaS APIs.

 - Experience with data infrastructure such as Kafka, Iceberg, Postgres, Spark, or modern data warehouses.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Success is not measured by the number of prototypes we build. It is measured by whether we turn promising ideas into products customers use and infrastructure they can depend on.

You'll help us:

 - Take new ideas from prototype to production and improve them through customer feedback and real-world usage.

 - Build reliable, observable systems that are easier to operate, debug, and improve over time.

 - Use technical experiment

jobs.description:
About Monte Carlo

Monte Carlo is the agent trust platform that autonomously observes, fixes, and continuously improves agents and the data that powers them — so enterprises can scale trust at the speed of AI. Bayes, our AI teammate, does the work: detecting, triaging, troubleshooting, and fixing issues in AI agents and the data powering them. The result is self-improving agents that get better with every fix instead of drifting. More than 400 enterprises, including Amazon, PepsiCo, CNN, Nasdaq, and JetBlue, rely on Monte Carlo. Learn more at montecarlo.ai https://montecarlo.ai.

 


THE ROLE

We're hiring an Applied Forward Deployed Engineer (Post-Sales) to own the technical side of every new customer from the moment the deal closes until they're live and getting value. You'll write production code in customers' Snowflake and Databricks environments, integrate Monte Carlo with their real pipelines, and become the technical advisor they call before they escalate. This isn't support and it isn't a CSM role: your metric is whether the customer is live and consuming. It's an early hire into a new function, so you'll help write the FDE playbook, not inherit one. Remote (US), with roughly 25% travel to customers.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own deployment from day one post-close: monitors, alerts, and integrations configured for the customer's actual environment.

 - Write production-quality Python, SQL, and API integrations tailored to customer pipelines, and clear whatever stands between a signed contract and a fully operational deployment.

 - Drive customers to consumption. You're accountable for active usage and measurable value, not just go-live.

 - Expand adoption beyond the first champion across teams, data assets, and use cases.

 - Feed what you see in the field back to Product and Engineering so it shapes the core product instead of turning into one-off work.

 - Shape the FDE playbook as an early member of the team.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Data platform depth. 5+ years building on Snowflake, Databricks, or a modern cloud warehouse as the person who designed and built it, not an end user. Production Python and SQL, and comfortable wiring up REST APIs in someone else's environment.

 - Post-sale ownership. You've owned technical outcomes for enterprise customers after the contract: implementation, solutions or forward deployed engineering, technical onboarding. You measure yourself on go-live and adoption.

 - Range with people. You can run a working session with a room of data engineers and brief a VP in the same week.

 - Builder in ambiguity. You've operated without a playbook and built the structure yourself. You create motion instead of waiting for direction.

 - Nice to have. dbt, Airflow, Fivetran, or Looker; data quality, pipeline monitoring, or incident response; a background in data observability or an adjacent category.


THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF

 - You want a support queue or a defined playbook to follow.

 - You've only worked pre-sale and never owned what happens after the contract is signed.

 - Your data experience is all internal, with no customer-facing context.

 - You'd rather advise on the stack than write code in it.

#LI-REMOTE

#BI-REMOTE




WHY MONTE CARLO

 - We created the data observability category, and we're doing it again with agent trust https://montecarlo.ai/agent-trust — you'll build where the market is forming, not where it's settled

 - Series D, $236M raised, backed by Accel, Redpoint, Notable Capital, ICONIQ Growth, and Salesforce Ventures

 - Customers include HubSpot, Fox, Nasdaq, Toast, and Mercado Libre — your work ships to enterprises with real stakes

 - Snowflake Partner of the Year and a verified connector in Anthropic's Claude AI directory

 - Remote-first by design since day one, and recognized as a Best Workplace for it

 - Competitive compensation, equity, and a remote-first environment.

Come As You Are

Equality is a core tenet of Monte Carlo's culture. We are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. 



Monte Carlo is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We’re leading the data revolution, building the world’s best data and applications platform. Our "get it done" culture empowers everyone at Snowflake to innovate, create lasting impact, and excel in a culture of collaboration.

Snowflake is rapidly expanding its Systems Integrator (SI) Go-To-Market initiatives. SIs are key to helping customers unlock the power of Snowflake Data Cloud.

Success in this role requires relationship management, program execution, goal-setting, and tracking progress. The candidate will help shape and deliver a strategy to build mindshare with Snowflake’s SI partners.

We seek a candidate with a proven track record of working with large SI partners, strong business acumen, and knowledge of the broader platform ecosystem, products, and competition to be a trusted advisor.

The role requires up to 25% travel within Brazil for partner engagement, enablement, deal support, and marketing events.




AS A SENIOR SOLUTIONS ENGINEER - SI PARTNERS, YOU WILL:

OUR IDEAL SENIOR SOLUTIONS ENGINEER - SI PARTNERS WILL HAVE:

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Applications
jobs.description:
ROLE SUMMARY




We're looking for a senior software engineer to join a high-impact team building the systems that power Temporal Cloud's customer experience at scale. Our team owns some of the most critical surface area in the product — Namespaces https://docs.temporal.io/cloud/namespaces, Audit Logs https://docs.temporal.io/cloud/audit-logs, and Export https://docs.temporal.io/cloud/export. Namespaces are the core unit of isolation within Temporal Cloud, providing security boundaries, workflow management, unique identifiers, and dedicated gRPC endpoints. Audit Logs and Export give customers reliable access to the operational and compliance data they depend on.

In this role, you'll work on a new initiative, set technical direction and build systems that directly shape how customers provision, operate, and extract value from Temporal Cloud. You'll partner closely with engineers, product managers, and solutions architects to design resilient architectures, drive cross-functional execution, and raise the bar on reliability and scalability for our most critical features. If you thrive on ambiguous, high-leverage problems and take pride in building durable systems that grow with the business, we'd love to meet you.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead the Design of Business-Critical Systems: Own end-to-end technical design and delivery for the services that power namespace scalability, reliability, and the customer data products built on top of them.

 - Bridge Instrumentation and Product Value: Partner with analytics and product engineers to ensure what gets collected actually powers meaningful customer insights; translate business questions into durable event schemas that outlast the feature that introduced them.

 - Architect Data Pipelines for Scale and Correctness: Define and evolve our data pipeline architecture for high-throughput usage and operational data; make principled tradeoffs across data freshness, query cost, tenant isolation, and fault-tolerance.

 - Drive Data Quality as a First-Class Concern: Establish schema contracts, pipeline-level anomaly detection, and alerting for silent failures — holding the line on data correctness before bad numbers reach customers.

 - Raise the Engineering Bar: Set quality standards through code and design reviews; introduce patterns and tooling that improve maintainability, observability, and incident response across the team.

 - Mentor and Multiply Impact: Grow the engineers around you, unblock execution, and foster a culture of ownership, learning, and pragmatic excellence.

 - Improve Developer and Customer Experience: Identify opportunities to streamline customer flows via automation, better tooling, and targeted platform improvements that reduce friction and support load.


TECHNOLOGY STACK

 - Primary Language: Go

 - Data Storage: PostgreSQL, Redshift, S3, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob Storage

 - Data Warehouse: Snowflake, Databricks, Clickhouse, Big Query

 - Data Processing: Kinesis, Firehose

 - Infrastructure: Kubernetes

 - Core Framework: Temporal (of course 😉)


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Deep experience designing and delivering production-grade backend systems in cloud environments, with direct ownership over architecture and operational outcomes — including what happens when things go wrong.

 - Strong proficiency in at least one systems or backend language (Go preferred), with the ability to navigate large codebases and drive technical decisions with confidence.

 - Hands-on experience building and operating distributed systems: concurrency, reliability, scaling, consistency, and failure handling in production.

 - Solid experience with data pipelines and storage systems (Postgres, Redshift, Kafka/Kinesis, S3-compatible storage, Clickhouse) and a track record of ensuring correctness and traceability at scale.

 - Experience with production operations: observability, incident response, performance tuning, on-call readiness, and continuous delivery.

 - Ability to work effectively across functions — translating ambiguous requirements from product managers and solutions architects into clear, executable technical plans.

 - Strong written and verbal communication: you write crisp design docs, align stakeholders on tradeoffs, and can explain a complex system to someone who didn't build it.

 - A builder's mindset: you enjoy simplifying complex workflows, improving tooling, and leaving systems better than you found them.


WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

 - High-impact ownership over systems tied directly to revenue, customer lifecycle, and platform scalability

 - Collaborative engineering culture focused on quality, pragmatism, and measurable outcomes

 - Exceptional technical colleagues and a feedback-rich environment

 - Lean processes and autonomy without unnecessary bureaucracy

 - Strong emphasis on reliability and operational excellence—balanced with rapid iteration

 - A team that values mentorship, thoughtful design, and steady improvements that compound over time

All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. We embrace and celebrate differences and diversity.

Temporal is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. If you need to request a reasonable accommodation, please let your Recruiter know so we can assist.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Cloud Platform
jobs.description:
About Teleport

Don't wait for the future of infrastructure. Be part of it.

Teleport is the AI Infrastructure Identity Company. We're solving one of the hardest problems in security: giving every human, machine, workload, and AI agent a cryptographically secured identity, improving engineering velocity while maintaining security. We make trusted computing simple. This gives you the freedom, power, and autonomy to build and innovate with confidence.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we work with companies like Nasdaq, DoorDash, and Elastic to secure infrastructure for an AI world.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Teleport Cloud Platform team architects a performant and scalable cloud platform that realizes the promise of Teleport as a SaaS product. The team is focused on scalability, security, and analytics of Teleport on our Cloud platform. They build multi-cluster Kubernetes controllers, networking services, platform monitoring tools, and more.

We strongly encourage you to explore our GitHub Repo https://github.com/gravitational to get a taste of what we are building.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - You will work on problems ranging from networking and performance to security and integrations with external systems.

 - Design, develop, and ship outstanding, high-quality products. A sample of potential projects:
   
   - BEAMS, Cloud Hypervisor-based, Kata container, agentic runtime platform
   
   - Multi-cluster Kubernetes operators for managing Teleport at scale
   
   - Zero-downtime upgrades for services with long-lived tunnels

 - Write most of the code in Go.

 - Closely collaborate with other teams at Teleport

 - Grow your technical expertise.
   
    


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Willingness to work collaboratively with Teleport's engineers on coding challenge in Go https://github.com/gravitational/careers/blob/main/challenges/systems/challenge-1.md as part of the interview process.

 - Extensive Go experience

 - Strong expertise with Kubernetes, including experience writing controllers and extending Kubernetes via APIs.

 - Extensive experience developing scalable, reliable, and performant systems.

 - Strong software-related security experience and strong interest in security space.

 - Proficiency with AWS and other cloud services.

 - Linux systems engineering experience.

 - Networking experience.

 - Intellectual curiosity and a willingness to master new technologies.

 - Transparency, honesty, and a no-ego mindset.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Significant contributions in Open Source is a big plus.

 - Knowledge of Envoy and Cilium

 - Cryptography engineering experience

 


HOW WE HIRE

Our process is designed to be straightforward and respectful of your time. We skip performative rounds and focus on what matters: understanding how you think and what you can do.

For this role, we use a take-home challenge that mirrors real work at Teleport — on your time, your way. You'll have support from the team throughout.

 1. Zoom meeting with a Teleport recruiter. You’ll learn about the company, our products, compensation philosophy, interview process, and key requirements.

 2. Zoom meeting with the Hiring Manager. The Hiring Manager will walk you through the coding challenge and answer your questions.

 3. Coding challenge collaboration. The day after your meeting with the Hiring Manager, you join a Slack channel and complete a coding challenge in Go https://github.com/gravitational/careers/blob/main/challenges/systems/challenge-1.md using GitHub. The challenge usually takes about 2 weeks and ends with a Zoom meeting with the Hiring Manager and a member of the interview team to review your solution.

 4. If your challenge solution meets our bar, you'll receive an offer to join Teleport.
    
    
    
    #LT-LT1
    
     



Why Teleport

You're joining a company where the problem is real, the team is small, and your work shows up directly in the product. We're not a big company, you won't get lost in a crowd. You'll have the freedom and autonomy to do what you're great at, alongside teammates who care about doing it right and want to see you succeed. The work is collaborative, there's real room to grow, and the mission is one worth showing up for.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer, Infrastructure Security
jobs.description:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀



Security at ClickUp

Security at ClickUp is engineering-focused. We partner with teams across the company to protect our platform, our internal systems and our customers through secure design, defensive controls, detection and response. We build tooling and automation, including AI-powered workflows, to turn what we learn into lasting improvements.

 

About the team

Infrastructure Security at ClickUp secures the cloud, compute, network and access layers underneath ClickUp: a multi-account AWS organization, a large Kubernetes fleet, infrastructure managed as code and the identity systems engineers use to reach production. We are a small team that works agentic first, using AI agents we build and maintain ourselves to multiply what a team our size can cover.

 

You will support this mission by thinking like a developer, breaking down a problem that we face, testing a method to approach it with automation, and implementing solutions that yield compounding value. Your skills to uncover threat indicators will be the foundation of this work.

 

The role

 - Architecture, proposals and reviews. Act as an initial reviewer on infrastructure proposals and designs from engineering and non-engineering teams such as business systems and go-to-market. Write our own security proposals and review the changes that follow. Translate security requirements and agent findings into clear guidance for less-technical partners, and bring their needs back into our designs.

 - Agentic security tooling and agent infrastructure. Build, evaluate and maintain the agents behind our reviews, triage and investigations, and help run the sandboxed, observable infrastructure they operate on.

 - Detection, investigation and response. Lead cloud and infrastructure alerts and incidents through to resolution and root cause, working alongside AppSec and incident response on incidents that span both.

 - Identity, access and least privilege. Move people, CI and services toward least privilege and just-in-time access across our cloud organization and the tooling engineers use to reach production. Deliver fixes as secure building blocks that teams adopt by default.

 - Compute, network and pipeline security. Harden our container, serverless and virtual machine workloads, our network perimeter and our CI/CD pipelines, and add checks so each class of issue is caught automatically next time.

 - Continuous review and audit evidence. Move vulnerability, access and attack-surface reviews from point-in-time checks to continuous monitoring that also produces evidence for our infrastructure controls.



Qualifications

 - 5+ years in security engineering, cloud infrastructure or SRE, with at least 2 years securing AWS at organization scale.

 - At least a year of agentic development experience: building agent skills and tools for real engineering work, and developing and maintaining the development harness they run in, from configuration and permissions to integrations, evaluations and cost controls. You can secure agents against prompt injection, over-privileged tools and unaudited actions, and explain how agents fall into the confused deputy problem and the lethal trifecta. You validate agent output against evidence and decide where human review is required.

 - Deep AWS IAM experience: IAM Identity Center or an equivalent SSO model, SCPs, permission boundaries, resource and key policies, cross-account trust, and the ability to prove a policy's effect with simulation rather than inference.

 - Production Kubernetes security on EKS or similar, covering RBAC, workload identity, network policy, admission control and container runtime hardening.

 - AWS networking for security: VPC design, endpoints and endpoint policies, network and DNS firewalls, egress control, and WAF.

 - Fluency with infrastructure as code such as Terraform, including reusable patterns, multi-environment rollouts and reading plans for security impact.

 - Experience with CNAPP, SIEM or runtime security tooling and the cloud detection sources around it, such as CloudTrail, GuardDuty and Access Analyzer.

 - Experience investigating cloud and infrastructure security events: correlating cloud audit, Kubernetes, identity and network logs to establish what happened, its blast radius and its root cause.

 - A track record of reviewing architecture and writing design proposals, guiding teams toward secure designs through conversation rather than mandate, mentoring others through reviews, and turning a review into a change another team is glad to make.

 - Python, Go or TypeScript for security automation.

 - Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical risk to non-technical partners. Most of our work with other teams is asynchronous, so much of the job is a well-evidenced finding, proposal or design note that another team can act on without a meeting.

Desirable

 - Experience using AI agents in a SOC or other incident response workflows.

 - Sandboxed runtime experience with gVisor, Firecracker or Kata.

 - Offensive security or red-team experience in cloud and Kubernetes environments.

 - Policy engines such as OPA or Rego.

 - Supporting audits like SOC 2 with automated evidence collection.

 

Our stack

AWS, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD with federated identity, an enterprise identity provider, observability and cloud security platforms, and AI agent tooling.



Equal Opportunity Employer 

ClickUp is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer, Identity
jobs.description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Corporate Security at Ramp owns the identity and access layer for the company: Okta, Google Workspace, the SaaS applications behind them, and the governance that decides who holds what. We are hiring a Senior Security Engineer, Identity, to turn that layer into IAM as a service — a platform the rest of Ramp can use without filing a ticket.

 

The role is hands-on. You will design how identity works at Ramp and write the code that implements it: identity configuration in Terraform, entitlements created and governed through an agentic workflow, and an on-call agent that answers access questions before anyone has to ask a person. As more access flows between applications and AI agents rather than people, you will own how those identities are issued, scoped, and audited.

 

You will report to the Corporate Security lead and work closely with IT, Security Engineering, AI DevX, and the Data team.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own Terraform for identity services: Okta applications, authorization servers, authentication policies, groups and group rules, and SCIM provisioning

 - Design and operate custom authorization servers, including audiences, scopes, claims, and access policies for internal services and AI agents

 - Implement app-to-app and agent access through Cross App Access (XAA) and ID-JAG, so delegated access is brokered and governed by the IdP rather than granted user by user

 - Own our IGA platform: the entitlement catalog, ownership, access requests, time-bound grants, and certifications

 - Build the agentic workflow that takes a team from "I have a new group of people who need access to X" to a defined, owned, and governed entitlement, with the Terraform and IGA changes opened for review

 - Build identity graphs with ISPM tooling to target overprivileged and long-standing access across human and non-human identities

 - Build the identity data lake behind an on-call agent that can explain events like a User Not Assigned Application error in Okta before the employee opens a ticket




WHAT YOU NEED

 - 6+ years in identity engineering or IAM, including operational ownership of Okta or an equivalent identity provider at scale

 - Deep understanding of OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and SCIM, including how custom authorization servers issue and enforce aud, scope, and claims

 - Working knowledge of how XAA and ID-JAG work under the hood, including token exchange and JWT bearer grants

 - Experience with ISPM or identity graph tooling, and turning its findings into automated remediation

 - Experience owning an IGA platform or building the equivalent in-house

 - Terraform experience managing identity providers, including module design, state, and CI

 - Programming in Python or Go, with experience building against platform APIs




BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

 - Flexible PTO

 - Centralized home-office equipment ordering

 - Health and wellness stipend

 - Budget for intra-office travel

 - Weekly coffee stipend




UNITED STATES

 - 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

 - One Medical annual membership

 - 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

 - Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

 - Pet insurance

 - In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

 - Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)
   
   


CANADA

 - Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

 - Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

 - Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

 - Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

 - Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health




UNITED KINGDOM

 - Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

 - Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

 - Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay




REFERRAL INSTRUCTIONS

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

 


OTHER NOTICES

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

 

Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @Ramp.com http://Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, GPU Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!


WHY THIS TEAM?

Internal Infrastructure builds the infrastructure and tools used to train, evaluate, and serve Cohere's foundation models. You will work with AI researchers and ML engineers on stability, scalability, and observability. The work accelerates the models behind Cohere's platform, North.

You will run the shared Kubernetes fleets those workloads land on: multi-cloud GPU and TPU clusters, node health, performance, and the partnership with cloud providers and hardware vendors. The role includes a compensated 24x7 on-call rotation.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Deploy and operate GPU Kubernetes clusters across clouds, and bring up new hardware generations and providers.

 - Work with cloud providers and hardware partners on reliability, performance, and cost, including RDMA and high-speed interconnects.

 - Automate node, GPU, and fabric fault detection and remediation so most faults are fixed without a human.

 - Improve fleet utilization, track cost, and cut the time it takes to get a faulty node back into service.

 - Troubleshoot production failures and performance problems, and leave the system easier to operate than you found it.

We hire at more than one level. We set level based on the scope you've owned and how independently you drive work.



YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE

 - Run GPU Kubernetes clusters with thousands of GPUs for ML or HPC workloads.

 - Debugged Linux, networking, and performance problems. Familiarity with RDMA, NCCL, or accelerator health is a plus.

 - Written software in Python or Go. You would rather extend a solid open-source project than rebuild it.

 - Worked with researchers, ML engineers, or another team whose goals were not identical to yours.

 - Found a bottleneck, proposed a fix, and driven it in a fast-moving environment.

If this does not line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. 


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.



We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.



Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

jobs.title: IT Engineer
jobs.description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role This is a hands-on technical role. You will join during a period of high growth for the IT team as the company expands its headcount, global footprint and opens new offices. You will work closely with the Security and Operations teams to keep our endpoints, offices, networks, and SaaS tools secure, while making sure people stay as productive as possible with the tools we have. You'll own and deliver technical projects across identity, endpoint management, office infrastructure, automation, and compliance, helping us build scalable IT systems that support the company as it grows. Requirements Strong hands-on background in IT Engineering, Technical Operations, or a DevOps-adjacent role, with an automation-first mindset and experience managing enterprise scale IT systems Strong knowledge of identity and access management technologies (SAML, SCIM, OIDC) with tools such as Okta and Google Workspace Expertise with Mobile Device Management tooling (e.g. Jamf, Kandji, Fleet) across a device fleet. Scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar) with a proven track record of automating compliance checks, device configuration, and other IT security tasks. Experience managing office network equipment (e.g. Cisco Meraki, Ubiquiti), including office buildouts. Proven ability to maintain compliance with SOC 2 / ISO 27001 (or similar) standards, paired with a friendly, end-user-focused attitude. Prior experience in a high-growth or startup environment. Bonus Experience implement corporate security controls / previous security role experience Strong hands-on experience with VPNs, firewalls, and secure network environments, including modern practices such as Zero Trust networking. Experience with OSquery and Santa Terraform or other infrastructure as code experience. Open source contributions (e.g. a tool you built to automate something). Location This role is remote but if you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, Warsaw, New York or San Francisco. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses. jobs.title: Ingénieur(e) développement logiciel - Backend  - Sécurité - Login (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Ingénieur(e) développement logiciel - Backend  - Sécurité - Login (f/m/d)      


L’équipe Login est le pilier de l’écosystème Decathlon. Composée de profils passionnés et multiculturels, notre équipe d une dizaine de personnes construit une solution d’authentification sécurisée et haute performance pour plus de 80 pays. Notre ambition ? Offrir une expérience membre fluide via un point d’entrée unique et hautement sécurisé. Notre défi actuel est de taille : mener une migration d architecture d envergure internationale depuis notre système Spring Security 5 vers Spring Security 7. Rejoins une équipe de passionné·es au cœur des enjeux globaux de Decathlon !

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION

La mission principale est d’accompagner la création de nouvelles fonctionnalités et l’amélioration de l’application, le tout tournant autour d’une organisation s’appuyant sur un écosystème agile afin de délivrer rapidement et fréquemment le plus de valeur possible à nos produits.

Contexte DevSecOps : you build it, you run it, you enjoy it !

  • Security by Design

Standard OAuth 2.1 / OIDC : Contribuer à l implémentation de ces protocoles pour garantir des accès sécurisés à nos services.

Sécurisation du Code : Appliquer les principes de sécurité dès la conception (OWASP, protection contre les injections, gestion sécurisée du cycle de vie des sessions).

Veille Sécurité : Identifier et corriger proactivement les failles potentielles au sein de l écosystème Java/Spring.

Administration Cloudflare : Gérer, configurer et optimiser notre infrastructure Cloudflare (WAF, protection DDoS, DNS, CDN, Gestion des Bots). 

Audit et Monitoring : Mettre en place la surveillance des menaces, analyser les logs de sécurité et réagir aux incidents (SOC/SIEM).

  • Développement & Delivery

Production : Assurer le delivery sur les briques core du CIAM (moteurs d authentification, gestion des jetons, intégrations protocolaires).

Patterns Avancés : Implémenter des solutions résilientes basées sur Kafka (Patterns CDC & Outbox) pour garantir la cohérence des données sans compromettre la performance.

Qualité Intégrée : Garantir la stabilité via des tests automatisés rigoureux (Playwright, Gatling) dès la phase de développement.

  •  Pilotage par la Donnée : Tracking & A/B Testing

Expérimentation : Mettre en œuvre des stratégies d A/B testing via Statsig pour valider les évolutions du tunnel d authentification de manière granulaire.

Tracking Comportemental : Intégrer et maintenir un tracking précis via Amplitude pour analyser les parcours utilisateurs et identifier les points de friction.

Performance Produit : Collaborer avec les équipes Produit pour traduire les besoins business en implémentations techniques mesurables et scalables.

  • Architecture, Scale & Observabilité

Conception Système : Modéliser les flux complexes via le C4 Model pour assurer une vision claire des interactions entre services.

Infrastructure & Ops : Déployer et opérer tes services sur Kubernetes (Helm), avec une maîtrise totale de l observabilité via Datadog.

CE QUE TU APPORTES

  • +7 ans en Java dans des environnements distribués à fort trafic.
  • Compétence sécurité : 
    • Standard OAuth 2.1 / OIDC
    • Expérience sur Keycloak ou équivalent
    • Sécurisation du Code (OWASP, injections, sessions sécurisées)
  • Spring & Spring Security : Connaissance des mécanismes internes (Filters, Authentication Providers, etc.).
  • Event-Driven Architecture : Expérience sur Kafka, CDC et utilisation du pattern Outbox.
  • Data & Growth : Expérience sur des outils de tracking (Amplitude) et de Feature Flagging / A/B testing (Statsig).
  • Cloud & Tools : Kubernetes, Helm, Datadog.
  • Testing : Playwright (E2E) et Gatling/Blazemeter (Load testing).
  • Langue : Anglais technique (documentation impérative).

 

CE QUE NOUS T’OFFRONS

Organisation de travail hybride ;

Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac ou Windows) ;

Une équipe de projet locale au sein d un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;

Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;

Package de rémunération (actionnariat salarié, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).

 

NOTRE ENGAGEMENT EN FAVEUR DE L INCLUSION ET DE L ACCESSIBILITE

Chez Decathlon, nous reconnaissons l immense valeur qu apporte la diversité à nos équipes et nous nous efforçons continuellement de favoriser et de cultiver un lieu de travail inclusif et équitable : c est pourquoi l Inclusion est l un de nos Fondamentaux Humains. Nous encourageons les personnes de tous horizons et de toutes capacités à postuler, car nous sommes convaincu·es que la diversité des pensées, des cultures, des identités et des expériences vécues nous rend plus fort·es.

Decathlon s engage également à offrir un processus de sélection inclusif et accessible à tous les candidat·es. En cas de besoin d aménagement, tu peux en faire
