jobs.title: Business Analyst - Enterprise & AI Solutions
jobs.description:
Who We Are

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

Working in technology & innovation with WPP Enterprise Solutions

At WPP Enterprise Solutions Netherlands, we create connected brands to drive growth. Our expertise spans the full customer journey, with deep capabilities in commerce, consultancy, CRM, CX, data, production, technology, content, media and more. We deliver end-to-end solutions for ambitious B2B and B2C brands, supported by the wider WPP network.

Our work combines strategy, product thinking, experience design, data, engineering and AI to solve real business problems, from enterprise commerce modernisation and digital shelf excellence to AI-enabled content operations, marketing automation, GEO, workflow orchestration and custom AI agents.

About the team

You’ll join the Product Management & AI Solutions team: the group that bridges business strategy, customer experience and technology to deliver scalable commerce and enterprise solutions. We work closely with UX/CX, Data & AI, SEO/GEO, Content, CRM, Paid and Retail Media, Engineering and Delivery teams.

Our ambition is to move beyond isolated skills and build repeatable, outcome-led propositions around commerce growth topics such as Search & Discovery, Personalisation, CRO & Experience Optimisation, Product Data/PIM & Digital Shelf, Content Supply Chain & AI Content Operations, CRM & Lifecycle Growth, Performance & Retail Media, SEO/GEO and Composable Commerce Modernisation. Alongside this, we are growing our applied AI work: shaping and delivering custom AI agents and AI-enabled workflows for clients, from discovery and pilot through to production and continuous improvement.

Why this role exists

Clients are increasingly asking for integrated solutions rather than isolated delivery capacity. They need people who can understand the business problem, shape the product direction, define the right solution, translate it into clear specifications and guide teams through delivery. At the same time, AI is changing how commerce, content, marketing and operations work, creating a need for analysts who can combine structured requirements thinking with product ownership, enterprise technology understanding and the design of AI-enabled workflows and agents.

This role is designed for someone who can operate as a strong Business Analyst, step into Product Owner responsibilities when needed, advocate for product thinking inside the organisation and help turn our AI and commerce capabilities into scalable client value. You will work across both our commerce and enterprise product work and our applied AI work. The mix depends on client demand, and we expect the AI share to grow over time.

The role

As Business Analyst, Enterprise & AI Solutions, you bridge business needs, product direction and technical delivery across enterprise digital commerce and martech ecosystems. You analyse business processes, clarify user and stakeholder needs, define requirements and support solutioning across the commerce stack: CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation, paid/media platforms and integration layers.

You will also work on AI initiatives such as custom AI agents (for example for pricing, search or customer service), content and marketing automation, product/content enrichment, GEO and organic discoverability, AI orchestration and workflow automation. You do not need to be a machine learning engineer or a domain expert, but you must be technically curious and comfortable working with APIs, data flows, automation tools, LLM-based workflows, AI quality evaluation, governance requirements and human-in-the-loop processes.

Depending on your experience and the project context, you may act as a hands-on BA, a product-minded discovery partner, a proxy Product Owner or a work stream lead. In all cases, your job is to make ambiguity manageable, decisions explicit and delivery focused on measurable value.

What you will do

  • Collaborate with Solution Architects and Product Owners and translate business goals into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, tech architecture, data flows and integration specifications that delivery teams can act on.
  • Work across commerce, martech and enterprise ecosystems, including CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation and media platforms.
  • Identify, shape and specify practical AI, automation and workflow orchestration opportunities across content, marketing, commerce and operational processes, from process mapping and readiness checks to a scoped pilot with a clear business case.
  • Specify AI agents and LLM-based workflows: define the task, data sources, tools and integrations, guardrails, human-in-the-loop steps and escalation paths, plus the evaluation criteria that decide when a solution is ready to go live. After launch, help measure quality, adoption and business impact.
  • Act as a Business Analy

jobs.description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. The Data Product team collaborates with an experienced group of data scientists, engineers, and product managers to build highly scalable features that power TRM's products and services. As a Data Engineer on the Data Product team, you will be responsible for designing and building mission-critical data services. These features analyze and provide insights into blockchain transaction activity at petabyte scale, and ultimately work to build a safer financial system for billions of people.. The impact you’ll have here: Build highly scalable features that integrate with dozens of blockchains. Competence in deploying and monitoring infrastructure within public cloud platforms, utilizing tools such as Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Datadog. With this input, the team devised a solution that fit the timeline, communicated the tradeoffs to stakeholders, and successfully delivered the solution as promised. jobs.description: This role may require in-person interview/s in Austin, Texas About Osano : Osano is an innovative B-Corporation built around a simple belief: privacy is a fundamental right. Since day one, we’ve been focused on giving modern enterprises the ability to innovate quickly, stay competitive, and earn customer trust by respecting data privacy and complying with consent guidelines. Our products help organizations operate confidently in a rapidly evolving regulatory and technological landscape. About The Role: We're looking for a product-minded Senior Software Engineer to own meaningful parts of the Osano platform end to end, from shaping a problem with Product to running the result in production. This role is for an engineer who treats AI tooling as a real force multiplier. You use coding agents and AI-assisted workflows to explore unfamiliar code faster, ship more and remove repetitive work. You also have the judgment to verify everything that goes out under your name. We want someone whose impact goes beyond what they write by hand, and who helps the engineers around them do the same. You'll work across our React front end, Node.js services, PostgreSQL data stores and AWS infrastructure. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, QA and Security. This is a remote role. You must be based in, and authorized to work in, the United States. What you'll do: Build and ship product, end to end Lead multi-sprint projects from design through rollout: turn a loosely defined problem into a plan, break it into work that you and others can action, and deliver close to estimate. Design systems that hold up, and write design docs and decision records that weigh the alternatives. Partner with Product on scope: propose MVP cuts, phasing and tradeoffs, and measure whether what we shipped actually helped customers. Engineer with AI to multiply your impact Use AI coding agents and assistants across the whole development lifecycle: exploring codebases, scaffolding, writing tests, debugging, refactoring, migrations and code review. Stay accountable for every line you ship. You understand and can explain AI-generated code, and you know where AI shouldn't be trusted. Turn repetitive engineering work into automation: scripts, agent workflows, and checks that save your team time every week. Share what works: help define how our teams use AI tools, and how we review and verify AI-assisted work. Use AI responsibly. Customer and personal data stays out of AI tools except through approved, privacy-safe paths. This is non-negotiable at a privacy company. Own what you ship in production Build observability, feature flags and rollback paths into your work from the start. Take turns on our triage and on-call rotation. Lead incident response for your team's systems, and see postmortem follow-ups through to completion. Identify tech debt, size it, and make the case to get it into the plan. Build with privacy and security by design Apply data minimization, residency, retention and access controls to the systems you design, especially those that handle customer and personal data. Write secure code and fix vulnerabilities in your area as part of normal work. Raise the bar and grow others Give code and design reviews that change outcomes, not just approvals. Mentor engineers earlier in their careers, and make your team better at testing, reviewing and operating software. Interview candidates and help us hire well. About you: Delightful Experience. You care about the customer problem, not just the ticket, and you push for what actually helps. Own Your Impact. You take full responsibility for outcomes, from the first design doc to how the feature behaves in production at 2 a.m. Stronger Together. You put team success ahead of individual wins, give direct and kind feedback, and treat documentation and async communication as first-class work. Growth Mindset. You're curious and keep learning, especially as AI changes how software gets built. You're excited about what it can do without overselling it or ignoring its limits. You're comfortable with ambiguity and create clarity for others through good design and clear writing. Must-haves: Typically 5+ years building and shipping production software. We care more about what you've owned than the number of years. A track record of leading multi-sprint projects from design to production in a team setting. Strong JavaScript/Node.js and React experience, and solid relational database skills (PostgreSQL preferred). Strong system design fundamentals: data modeling, API design, and naming the tradeoffs. Experience owning production systems : on-call, incident response, observability. Hands-on, day-to-day use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot, with concrete examples of how they made you or your team more effective, and how you verify their output. Experience mentoring other engineers. Strong written communication in a remote, async environment. Nice-to-haves: AWS experience (ECS/Fargate, Lambda, S3, RDS), especially multi-region or data-residency work. Privacy, security or compliance-sensitive B2B SaaS (GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2). Building AI-powered automations, agent workflows or LLM-based product features. Data and analytics tooling (Redshift, Athena) or event-driven architectures. CI/CD, preview/ephemeral environments, end-to-end testing (Cypress). How we work: Fully remote, with at least four hours of overlap each day with your team's core hours. jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: Who We Are Building the Backbone of Distributed Applications. At Orkes , we are reimagining how developers build reliable, scalable, event-driven applications without wrangling complex infrastructure. Born from Netflix's battle-tested open-source project, OSS Conductor , our platform is now powering billions of mission critical workflows across fintech, e-commerce, logistics, healthcare, and more. Our platform powers billions of mission critical workflows across industries like fintech, e-commerce, logistics, and healthcare helping companies run the core operations of their business with confidence. These are the workflows behind every transaction, every delivery, every patient check-in, quietly orchestrating our digital world. We’re solving some of the hardest infrastructure problems: how do you make distributed systems reliable, observable, and scalable – without every team having to reinvent the wheel? We absorb the complexity of distributed systems, letting teams build with confidence. We’re hiring a SRE to help us evolve and scale our platform. If you’re passionate about clean, efficient architecture, love solving tough distributed systems challenges, and thrive in an environment where your ideas actually shape the product then we’d love to talk. And the best part is we’re just getting started. What You’ll Do Own reliability, availability, and performance of production systems running in cloud environments Define and monitor SLIs/SLOs and help manage error budgets across the platform Lead incident response efforts including detection, triage, mitigation, and postmortems Improve observability through logging, monitoring, alerting, and dashboards Automate operational workflows and reduce manual toil wherever possible Partner closely with engineering teams to improve system resiliency and scalability Assist with capacity planning, infrastructure optimization, and performance tuning Build internal tooling, runbooks, and operational best practices Support Kubernetes-based infrastructure and distributed systems at scale Act as an escalation point for complex production and platform issues What We’re Looking For 5+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, or related infrastructure roles Strong experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerized environments Strong understanding of distributed systems and microservices architecture Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK, or OpenTelemetry Proficiency with infrastructure automation and scripting (Terraform, Python, Bash, etc.) Experience managing CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation Strong troubleshooting and incident management skills Ability to work cross-functionally and communicate effectively during high-pressure situations Nice to Have Experience supporting large-scale SaaS or cloud-native platforms Familiarity with workflow orchestration technologies such as Conductor, Temporal, or Camunda Experience with Kafka, messaging systems, or event-driven architectures Knowledge of security best practices and cloud infrastructure hardening Open-source contributions or strong systems engineering background Why Join Orkes? Work alongside a deeply technical and collaborative engineering team Solve complex distributed systems challenges at scale High ownership and impact in a fast-growing company Remote-friendly culture with strong engineering autonomy Opportunity to help shape the future of cloud orchestration and AI workflows More Details: The base salary for this role is $125,000-250,000 USD. However, pay is variable and when determining compensation, a number of factors will be considered: skills, years of experience, job scope, location/cost of living, and competitive compensation market data for your country/role. Start Date: ASAP Status: Full-time Type: Remote Location : Australia, EMEA Department: Engineering Reports to: Head of Engineering Travel: 15-20% Benefits Comprehensive health coverage including medical, dental, and vision Flexible PTO Support for personal development At Orkes, we are committed to building a team that reflects a rich tapestry of perspectives, identities, and professional experiences. We believe that diversity is not just a checkbox, but a driving force behind innovation, creativity, and success. By embracing a variety of backgrounds, we cultivate an inclusive environment where every team member feels valued and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. Join us at Orkes and be a part of a team where your unique perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Together we are shaping the future technology by leveraging the strength that comes from embracing diversity in all its forms. Your Journey with us is an opportunity to contribute to something greater and make a lasting impact.

jobs.title: Senior GTM Engineer
jobs.description: Location: Poland, Remote Employment Type: Full-time, B2B Contract Compensation: PLN 12,000–22,000 net + VAT per month About PubNub PubNub powers real-time interactive experiences that drive engagement, retention, and monetization. Our market-leading platform for real-time interactive apps enables customers to efficiently and effectively build, manage, and optimize engaging apps that captivate and delight users. Founded in 2012, PubNub is backed by notable investors like The Raine Group, Sapphire, Scale, Relay, Cisco, Bosch, Ericsson, and HPE. To date, over 2,000 companies worldwide, including Amazon, RingCentral, Gameloft, and DAZN, choose PubNub to build and enhance large-scale apps that launch quickly to engage, monetize, and retain users. At PubNub, you’ll enjoy the freedom of a remote-first environment paired with a collaborative culture designed to support your unique work style, so you can do your best work. About the Role We're looking for a Senior GTM Engineer to build the AI-powered tools, automations, and integrations that help PubNub's go-to-market teams operate more effectively. This is a hands-on engineering role combining software development, AI agents, automation, and business systems integration. You'll work across Marketing, Growth, Sales, and Customer Success, translating operational challenges into reliable technical solutions. You'll take ownership of projects from discovery and prototyping through production deployment, helping teams reduce repetitive work, improve data quality, accelerate execution, and make better-informed decisions. Success means delivering production-ready tools and automations that are adopted by teams and create measurable business impact. Key Responsibilities Design, build, deploy, and maintain AI-powered tools, agents, and workflow automations for go-to-market functions. Develop internal applications and integrations that improve prospecting, account research, lead enrichment, campaign execution, and customer intelligence. Partner with business stakeholders to understand workflows, identify bottlenecks, and prioritise engineering opportunities. Build and maintain integrations with CRM, marketing automation, analytics, and other business systems. Develop and maintain web-based applications and website infrastructure that support Marketing and Growth initiatives. Use LLM APIs, AI coding assistants, and agent-based development workflows to accelerate engineering productivity. Ensure solutions are maintainable, reliable, secure, and suitable for production use. Measure tool adoption, operational efficiency, and business outcomes, iterating based on stakeholder feedback. About You Minimum Requirements Strong professional software engineering experience, ideally involving full-stack development, internal tools, automation, or growth engineering. Hands-on experience with JavaScript or TypeScript and modern web frameworks such as React or Next.js. Strong experience working with APIs, system integrations, and data-driven applications. Practical experience building AI-powered applications, agents, or automations using LLM APIs. Experience taking applications from prototype to production, including testing, deployment, maintenance, and troubleshooting. Ability to understand business problems and independently translate requirements into working technical solutions. Strong ownership, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Strong English communication skills and the ability to work with technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Nice to Have Experience integrating Salesforce, marketing automation, or revenue operations platforms. Familiarity with AI coding assistants such as Claude Code or Cursor. Experience maintaining CMS-driven websites or marketing technology. Familiarity with developer-focused SaaS products, API platforms, or agent-based workflows. Experience developing reusable internal AI tools or agent skills. Why PubNub At PubNub, you'll help power real-time experiences used by millions around the world. What sets us apart is our people-first culture and strong sense of collaboration. Our team values the opportunity to contribute meaningfully, grow their skills, and help build innovative, high-impact technology. We offer competitive B2B compensation and the flexibility of a remote-first environment. We're committed to fostering collaboration, professional growth, and opportunities to make a meaningful impact. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to build practical AI solutions, own meaningful projects end to end, and work closely with teams that directly benefit from your engineering contributions. Ready to Make an Impact? If you're excited about building real-world AI solutions, automating complex workflows, and applying engineering to business challenges, we'd love to hear from you. Join us and help shape how PubNub uses AI and automation across its go-to-market operations. Information Accuracy Candidates are expected to provide accurate, complete, and truthful information throughout the application and hiring process. Any material misrepresentation or omission may affect employment eligibility.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff (Storage)
jobs.location: New York, NY; Remote, United States; San Mateo, CA; Toronto, Canada
jobs.description:
Category-defining tech. Career-defining work.

For more than a decade, Cockroach Labs has built database technology trusted to power some of the world s most mission-critical applications. Now, as AI transforms how software is created and operated, the infrastructure behind it has to keep pace. Cockroach Continuum is built to meet this moment, bringing individual databases together into one fleet designed for agentic applications, where AI agents help teams provision, scale, and optimize workloads at machine speed.  

At Cockroach Labs, you ll solve problems that didn t exist five years ago alongside people who believe the simplest solutions often require the most sophisticated thinking. Your work will run in production at some of the most innovative companies in the world. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to own that opportunity.  

The Role

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Storage Team to help shape and build CockroachDB’s storage systems. Storage is the foundation of CockroachDB, responsible for the safe, durable and efficient persistence and retrieval of data, on top of which the rest of the database is built. Our team develops and maintains Pebble, an innovative Log Structured Merge (LSM) Tree storage engine purpose built for Multi Version Concurrency Control (MVCC) data, and Plenum, the elastic, disaggregated storage layer that separates a cluster’s storage from its compute and allows them to scale independently. 

In this role, you’ll bring deep storage expertise to complex problems spanning Pebble, Plenum, encryption at rest (EAR), CockroachDB’s storage interfaces, and the cloud environments in which they operate. You’ll work hands-on, lead the design and delivery of significant improvements, and help the team make sound tradeoffs among durability, performance, scalability, cost, and operational simplicity.

You Will

  • Work on hard technical problems. Apply your deep knowledge of storage systems to solve technical challenges at the core of CockroachDB and its storage layers.
  • Lead through collaboration. Partner with engineering and product leadership to identify, design, and drive significant Storage initiatives, making tradeoffs clear and building alignment across involved teams.
  • Be a trusted partner across the company. Work closely and collaboratively with other engineers across the database and cloud organizations, product, support, and field engineering.
  • Set the standard for engineering excellence. Raise the effectiveness of the team through design reviews, mentorship, and clear technical communication. Help the team leverage AI to produce high-quality software in a modern development environment.
  • Ship mission-critical software. Ensure that CockroachDB remains scalable, survivable, and consistent as we continue to grow as a company. We work in Go and Rust, but if you don t know them, you ll learn while you re here.

The Expectations

In your first 30 days, you will establish relationships with the Storage team and learn about the Storage team’s domain and CockroachDB architecture. You will ship your first project.

After 3 months, you will be fully integrated into the team and comfortable contributing to the Storage team’s roadmap in partnership with Product. You’ll have built an understanding of the Storage team’s tech stack and feel comfortable with the architecture and components the team develops and maintains.

After 6 months, you will have led a meaningful piece of Storage work and participate in the Storage oncall rotation.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Security
jobs.location: New York City; Seattle; United States
jobs.description:
MongoDB s Global Security Organization (GSO) is looking for a Principal Engineer. The GSO secures MongoDB s products, infrastructure, and the trust our customers place in us — spanning product security, corporate security, and risk, and working across engineering, go-to-market, and corporate development to keep security moving at the same speed as the business.

The Principal Engineer will serve as a senior technical anchor for the team. This is a deep individual-contributor role that will stay hands-on with hard security and architecture problems, form sharp independent opinions, and know how to debate, align, and commit once GSO has made a call.  

Key topic areas will include collaborating with our product teams to ensure identity and permission models meet customer needs for our new autonomous agent platform and working with integration security teams to push the envelope on automated detection, reproduction, and remediation of security vulnerabilities via AI.  What we need here is depth, judgment, and the ability to build up the bench of senior technical talent around you.

This role can be based out of our NYC office or remotely in the North America region.

Responsibilities

  • Maintain real technical depth in security and in MongoDB s product architecture — compute, network, and storage — deep enough to evaluate actual risk rather than apply generic best practice.
  • Form independent, well-reasoned opinions on security and architecture decisions, and voice them even when they cut against consensus or a leader s default plan.
  • Push teams to move faster when process or over-engineering is introducing complexity without reducing risk — and push teams to slow down when GTM pressure is outrunning a clear-eyed view of the risk.
  • Debate hard, then align, then commit: help the org land on the right call, then execute on it.
  • Seed and grow a working community of senior ICs embedded in security operations, product security, and enterprise security — connecting people, sharing knowledge, and creating the venues (formal or informal) for that to happen.
  • Lead time-boxed, high-stakes, cross-functional engagements such as M&A security due diligence and partner risk assessments, often with incomplete information and a short runway.
  • Draw on your own expertise where it applies, and quickly figure out how to close knowledge gaps elsewhere — staying accountable for the outcome either way.

Requirements

  • 12+ years of experience in security engineering, software engineering, or a related discipline, including senior individual-contributor or technical-lead experience.
  • Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Deep, credible technical expertise in security, plus working depth across compute, network, and storage architecture.
  • A track record of forming and defending independent technical positions, along with the judgment to know when to stop debating and commit.
  • Experience influencing without formal authority, including with management and cross-functional partners, in both directions — accelerating and slowing down decisions.
  • Comfort owning ambiguous, deadline-driven work such as M&A diligence or partner risk reviews, and being accountable for the result even without the full picture upfront.
  • A genuine interest in mentoring and connecting other senior engineers, without needing a management title to do it.

Don t feel that you meet all of the requirements? We encourage you to apply anyway — studies show strong candidates sometimes rule themselves out prematurely. MongoDB has a diverse, inclusive, equitable, and high-performing environment, and we want to keep improving our ability to deliver for customers.

Nice to Haves

  • Direct experience leading M&A security due diligence or partner/vendor risk assessments.
  • Background spanning multiple layers of the stack (e.g., network and storage, or application and infrastructure security).
  • A history of building or growing technical communities of practice.

Success in This Role Means

  • Leadership trusts your technical judgment on the hardest, most ambiguous calls.
  • Your willingness to disagree — in either direction, faster or slower — makes decisions better, not just louder.
  • A real community of senior security talent has formed around you in GSO.

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone.

What is Grafana Cloud? 

Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, traces, and profiles with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software – including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, and Pyroscope – without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack.

The Databases team owns and operates the telemetry databases that are Mimir for metrics, Loki for logs, Tempo for traces, and Pyroscope for profiles. Our databases are offered as a hosted service in Grafana Cloud, and additionally as on-premise solutions with Grafana Enterprise Metrics, Grafana Enterprise Logs, and Grafana Enterprise Traces. They are multi-tenant distributed systems implemented in Go and operating at scale on Kubernetes across all major Cloud service providers (AWS, GCP, Azure).

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. 

Mimir Squad

The Mimir squad has two sub-squads, Ingest and Query, which together maintain the Mimir OSS project, and additionally own and operate Grafana Cloud Metrics across three major cloud providers. Engineers on the team focus on optimizing the efficiency and resilience of processing, storing, and querying metrics at large volumes. These services operate at a large scale and performance is key to keeping the offering competitive and running smoothly.

A Mimir engineer has various work streams. They likely are engaged in a larger project with another engineer, as well as mixing in some performance and reliability improvements discovered through operating the system in production. They are also responsible for writing and reviewing PRs and design documents from other engineers in the squad, shepherding automated release rollouts, and participating in the on-call rotation for their systems.

jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Staff Software Engineer on GitLab s Authentication team, you ll be the technical lead for how every user, application, token, and automated agent proves who it is on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated.

We re an OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) provider for millions of users. We also accept identity from enterprise identity providers through Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) and Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP). Behind that sit more than ten token types and several session methods that grew inside the Ruby on Rails monolith. You ll help us move this work onto GATE, GitLab s new authentication and authorization platform. GATE exchanges external credentials for short-lived tokens at the edge through a Secure Token Service written in Go.You ll set our technical direction, lead the hardest protocol and migration work yourself, and help senior engineers own the rest.

Our projects include:

  • OAuth across Cells: Making OAuth clients, grants, and tokens work when users and organizations live in different cells
  • Global identities: One user identity that works across organizations and cells
  • Token consolidation: Reducing the number of token types and moving token issuance and validation out of the monolith
  • Identity for artificial intelligence (AI) agents and workloads: OAuth for Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients, workload identity federation, and service identities with narrow scopes

What you ll do

  • Own the technical direction for authentication protocols at GitLab, including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and token exchange, across the Rails monolith and GATE services.
  • Write and drive design documents and architecture decision records (ADRs) for multi-quarter work, then break that work into increments that ship behind feature flags.
  • Lead migrations that must not break existing customers: token formats, client and grant state, and session behavior on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated.
  • Be hands-on in the most complex parts of the code, in Ruby on Rails and Go, and review the designs and merge requests of other engineers.
  • Agree interface contracts with the GATE Core, GATE Infra, Authorization, and Tenant Scale (Cells and Organizations) teams, and keep them current as the architecture changes.
  • Treat authentication as a security and availability boundary: threat-model new flows, add rate limits and abuse controls, and lead the technical response to authentication incidents.
  • Mentor senior and intermediate engineers on the team and raise the protocol and security knowledge of the whole group.
  • Work asynchronously with engineers in India, Europe, and the Americas, with most decisions made in writing.
  • Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.

What you ll bring

  • Significant experience building and running production authentication or identity systems at scale, with technical leadership across teams that moves unclear problems to written decisions and shipped code.
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of OAuth 2.0 and OIDC: authorization code with Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE), refresh token rotation, token exchange, client registration, scopes, and JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) with signing keys and key rotation.
  • Working knowledge of SAML 2.0 single sign-on and enterprise identity integration (LDAP, System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM), or similar).
  • Strong production experience in Ruby on Rails or Go, willingness to work in both, and experience with careful refactors, feature-flagged rollouts, and backward-compatible migrations in large, long-lived codebases.

jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We re all in on this mission. If you are too, let s talk.

Title: Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack), Lifecycle Management

Company Description:

Okta is the leading independent provider of enterprise identity. The Okta Identity Cloud enables organizations to securely connect the right people to the right technologies at the right time. With over 6,500 pre-built integrations to applications and infrastructure providers, Okta customers can easily and securely use the best technologies for their business. Over 7,950 organizations, including 20th Century Fox, JetBlue, Nordstrom, Slack, Teach for America and Twilio, trust Okta to help protect the identities of their workforces and customers

Position Description:

The Okta platform provides lifecycle management services, single sign-on, strong authentication, provisioning, workflow, and built in reporting. It runs in the cloud on a secure, reliable, extensively audited platform and integrates deeply with on premises applications, directories, and identity management systems.

We are looking for a full stack engineer to join our high caliber Lifecycle Management Engineering team. Your role will be to help us provide a world class experience to our customers. Okta s identity management group is focusing on identity stores and managing the lifecycle. Our platform manages users, groups and memberships, with stringent performance, reliability and scalability requirements. This role is to build, design solutions, and maintain our platform for scale. The ideal candidate is someone who has experience building software systems to manage and deploy reliable and performant infrastructure and product code at scale on a cloud infrastructure.

Job Duties And Responsibilities:

  • Work with product & design teams to deliver world-class user experiences.
  • Delight our customers by providing world class UX using our React-based design system.
  • Understand our lifecycle management codebase and development process: Jira, Technical Designs, Code Review, Testing, and Deployment.
  • Work with senior engineering team in major development projects, design and implementation
  • Provide support and handle incoming bugs and customer reported issues
  • Conduct quality code reviews and automated testings 
  • Work with QA team to outline and implement comprehensive test coverage for broad features
  • As part of the ongoing development in the team, provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers
  • Interface with cross-functional teams (Architects, QA, Product, Technical Support, Documentation, and backend teams) to develop connectors to on-prem and cloud apps
  • Partner with our Product Development, QA, and Site Reliability Engineering teams for scoping the development and deployment work

 

Required knowledge, skills, and abilities:

  • 5+ years of software development experience building highly-reliable, mission- critical software
  • Expertise with frontend application development.
  • Experience with object-oriented languages, e.g. Java and/or Golang.
  • Solid understanding of Javascript and experience with modern Javascript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular).
  • Experience with data stores, e.g. relational databases, graph DB, etc.
  • Experience with RESTful APIs and gRPC
  • Experience working with a system of scale.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience with server-side technologies including caching, asynchronous processing, and multi-threading
  • Experience in TDD
  • Knowledge of Identity and Access Management protocols and technologies: OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, etc
  • Experience automating and deploying large scale production services in AWS, GCP or similar

 Education and Training:

  • B.S. Computer Science or related field

jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn t a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you re ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

Join the Money Movement team within the Developer product group and help build the infrastructure powering the future of global payments. CDP brings together payments, trading, wallets, and stablecoins through a single onboarding flow and self-service APIs. You ll design and build backend systems for stablecoin-based pay-ins, payouts, deposits, and withdrawals, enabling fast, secure, and scalable transfers that underpin how value moves across the Coinbase ecosystem and beyond.

What you ll do:

  • Own key projects end-to-end as the Directly Responsible Individual, driving stablecoin-based money movement features from system design through production deployment with high accountability.
  • Build backend systems, infrastructure, and internal/external APIs that enable businesses and partners to embed stablecoin-powered payments into their products.
  • Partner with Product, Design, Infrastructure, and Compliance to translate requirements into robust, scalable solutions that balance speed, security, and regulatory needs.
  • Execute performance, scalability, and reliability improvements across distributed systems, identifying bottlenecks and driving fixes before they impact customers.
  • Support the team s engineering quality through code reviews, architectural best practices, and contributing to patterns that raise the technical bar.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 2+ years of software engineering experience building and operating backend systems, ideally in fintech, payments, or crypto.
  • Proficiency in backend languages (e.g., Go, Java) and cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS, GCP), with hands-on experience designing distributed systems and APIs.
  • Track record of serving as DRI for technical projects, driving end-to-end delivery from system design through production deployment.
  • Experience integrating with or building on blockchain or crypto technologies such as stablecoins, on-chain payments, or smart contract platforms (e.g., Ethereum, Solana, Base).
  • Demonstrated ability to write technical design documents and communicate architecture trade-offs to product and engineering stakeholders.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

jobs.description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we re on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

We’re hiring seasoned engineers to join our teams that work on core platform capabilities, improving our existing systems for extensibility and scalability, and building the future of Gusto s Tax platform. As a Gusto Software Engineer at this level, you’ll be guiding projects end-to-end by influencing initial feature specs, understanding how to take existing systems closer to desired end states, executing on projects, and maintaining code that powers core experiences. If you’re interested in building elegant software with far-reaching effects in our modern economy, join us!

 

About the Team:

Payroll is the beating heart of Gusto’s business. The Tax team ensures Gusto customers remain compliant and confident by managing every aspect of payroll taxes—including setup, calculation, payments, filings, and year-end communications. We design seamless, end-to-end experiences that simplify complex processes and build the infrastructure that keeps taxes accurate and on time. By combining reliable systems with thoughtful design, our team makes one of the most complicated parts of running a business simple for employers. Tax is a stabilizing pace layer at Gusto: continuity and trust are paramount, change is deliberate, and impact is wide. The domain is highly complex and offers the opportunity to engage in system design that simplifies this for customers.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

  • Design, build, and test the platform that supports tax compliance for millions of people
  • Help scale one of the largest Ruby/Rails and TypeScript/React applications in the world
  • Collaborate on complex and ambiguous problems with partnerships from Engineering, Product Management, Design, Data Science, Compliance, Operations, and other cross-functional teams
  • Improve the productivity and happiness of our teams with the services, tools, and APIs you build.
  • Build guardrails into the Tax platform that enable Gusto to safely leverage agentic AI to interact with tax concepts in a way that ensures compliance, accuracy, stability, and reliability. 
  • Engage in a highly supportive environment working with others to drive productivity and innovation
  • Own and drive the technical strategy and roadmap for your team’s domain area in alignment with team and group-level OKRs
  • Identify and prioritize long-term investments to improve foundational systems and architecture
  • Lead improvements to incident response processes, tooling, and culture to enhance system reliability and team effectiveness
  • Mentor and develop engineers on your team working to create holistic and scalable solutions. Track record of elevating team capabilities through pairing, code review, and knowledge sharing.

Here’s what we re looking for:

  • Successful applicants have at least 10+ years of experience
  • Experience in designing and developing robust, distributed systems using multiple general-purpose programming languages
  • Experience influencing and guiding the work of multiple teams on scaling, refactoring, and optimizing legacy products 
  • Experience architecting, building, and testing large-scale production level code
  • An aptitude and interest in bringing clarity and simplicity to complex and ambiguous problems
  • Ability to communicate technical complexity and help facilitate informed tradeoffs
  • Enthusiasm for a highly collaborative, test-driven environment
  • Able to build maintainable, structured, well-documented code 
  • Experience building fault-tolerant, mission-critical software
  • Experience building products in highly regulated and high risk domains
  • Experience in one of these domains is preferred: Payroll, Taxes, or Compliance
  • Familiar with current AI tools (LLMs, Agents) and their shortcomings / benefits
  • Embeds AI in daily development workflow (scaffolding tests, summarizing docs) to measurably reduce cycle time.
  • Mentors engineers on effective AI usage and helps develop an AI strategy for other engineers 
  • Bonus: Experience with Ruby on Rails, Typescript, and React

Our cash compensation for this role is targeted at $189,000–$236,000 per year in Denver and most remote locations, and $223,000–$278,000 per year in San Francisco and New York. jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is working on frontier AI systems that handle sensitive information at enormous scale. How we protect that data, and how we build privacy into our systems rather than bolting it on afterward, is central to our mission of building AI that is safe and beneficial.

As one of our principal privacy engineers, you will be among Anthropic s most senior individual contributors on privacy. You will set technical strategy for how personal data is handled across products, research, and infrastructure, and execute the hardest parts of delivering it. You ll work at the intersection of privacy engineering, distributed systems, and AI safety, on problems without established answers. You will lead through influence, quality of thinking, and trust rather than formal authority.

Key responsibilities

  • Define and drive technical strategy and architecture for major areas of privacy, spanning product surfaces, research and training data, internal tooling, and multiple clouds
  • Identify and lead the highest-complexity, company-critical privacy initiatives, guiding engineers across many teams. Be comfortable building the most difficult pieces yourself
  • Architect the primitives that make privacy the default and the safe path the fastest one: data discovery, classification, lineage, purpose-based access control, audit, retention, deletion, and export
  • Turn regulatory, contractual, and consent obligations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, the EU AI Act) into enforced, continuously verified technical controls in partnership with Legal, Policy, and Compliance team
  • Anticipate where AI capabilities, regulation, and customer expectations are heading, and position our systems ahead of them
  • Mentor and develop staff and senior staff engineers, raise the bar for privacy design across engineering, and help hire senior privacy talent
  • Represent Anthropic s privacy engineering to customers, regulators, standards bodies, and the research community

Minimum qualifications

  • A track record of operating as a Principal engineer or equivalent: setting technical direction that multiple teams adopted, and delivering company-critical, multi-year initiatives
  • Deep experience applying privacy engineering principles in production systems with a large user base, including privacy by design, data minimization, and purpose limitation
  • Experience architecting data governance infrastructure (classification, lineage, access control, retention, or deletion) across distributed systems and cloud infrastructure at scale
  • Proficiency in Python, Go, or similar languages; you are effective writing design docs, making architectural calls, and coding in critical paths
  • Understanding of privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA, and the ability to work as a peer with legal and policy experts to turn requirements into technical designs
  • Written and verbal communication that builds alignment across engineering, research, legal, and product teams, up to senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building privacy infrastructure or controls for machine learning or AI systems, including training data governance or AI agents
  • Hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (e.g., differential privacy, homomorphic encryption, secure enclaves, secure multi-party computation)
  • Experience establishing or re-architecting a privacy engineering practice under enterprise-customer or regulatory scrutiny
  • Experience briefing executives, auditors, regulators, or enterprise customers on privacy risk, and defending your recommendations under challenge
  • A history of growing engineers into Staff-level and more senior roles
  • Contributions to open-source privacy tooling, privacy research, or industry standards

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Sandbox Secrets (West Coast)
jobs.description:
ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________




THE ROLE

As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the local and cloud sandboxed environments that make interactive and autonomous agentic workflows trustworthy by default. At the heart of our trust model is the fact that user credentials and other sensitive secrets are injected at the sandbox layer and never exposed to an agent. An agent can never leak secrets it never sees.



The Secrets team builds the software that makes that possible, from easy-to-use SDKs to secure cloud services to high-performance network proxies. We operate at the intersection of the developer experience, enterprise governance, and security – delivering core security features that make Docker sandboxes the best way to run agents and other workloads safely.



As a Staff Software Engineer on the Secrets team, you’ll design and build core security systems that power Docker’s agentic platform and AI governance products. Your work will focus on creating scalable, reliable, and secure software that enables developers to safely run agentic workloads while allowing administrators to confidently manage their organization’s security posture.



The successful candidate is a technical, product-minded engineer with deep experience building secure software and scale-out cloud services and a track record of shipping critical infrastructure. They think naturally about isolation and security boundaries, understand the tradeoffs involved in running untrusted or semi-trusted workloads safely, and can reason confidently about a system that spans multiple surface areas.



If you thrive on solving security and usability challenges, are enthusiastic about agentic development but conscious of the risks it entails, and want to help shape the future of Docker’s platform, we’d love to hear from you.

Please note: this role is currently prioritizing candidates currently located in the Western time zone (US or Canada).

_______________________________________________________________________




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design, develop, and lead improvements to the secrets management and credential injection systems.

 - Investigate and resolve security, correctness, performance, and stability issues across cloud, macOS, Windows, and Linux.

 - Collaborate with peers, Product, and adjacent teams to evolve the architecture as requirements grow.

 - Mentor engineers on the team and set the bar in design reviews and code reviews.

 - Engage with the open source and agentic development community around sandboxing, MCP, and related ecosystems.

 - Participate in on-call rotations and respond to critical stability issues affecting users.

 - Document your work clearly and share knowledge with the rest of the team.

_______________________________________________________________________




QUALIFICATIONS


REQUIRED

 - 8+ years of software engineering experience, with demonstrated technical leadership on production systems at scale.

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

 - Experience building developer tools, desktop applications, or runtime infrastructure used directly by developers.

 - Familiarity with the agentic software development ecosystem: how coding agents work and how tools like Claude Code, Codex, or similar agents interact with their environment.

 - Ability to reason about isolation and security boundaries: what a sandbox should and shouldn't expose, and how to make safe defaults obvious to users.

 - Experience driving architecture and technical strategy across multiple engineers or teams.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills.

 - Comfortable working with a high degree of autonomy in a remote-first environment.


PREFERRED

 - Strong proficiency in Go, Rust, and/or Java

 - Experience with cryptographic key management systems and techniques (key wrapping, HSMs, cloud KMSes, etc.)

 - Familiarity with best practices for protecting credentials and secret material at-rest and in transit

 - Understanding of networking, TLS, HTTP, and the like.

 - Understanding of one or more OS-specific credential management capabilities.



Visa sponsorship: Docker considers visa sponsorship on a case-by-case basis based on business needs.

_______________________________________________________________________

 


COMPENSATION & EQUITY

All full-time roles include equity. Final compensation is determined on factors including but not limited to experience, skills, qualifications, and location.



United States: $170,350 – $275,550 base

______________________________________________________________________




POSTING INFORMATION

 - AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.

 - Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

______________________________________________________________________




PERKS & BENEFITS

jobs.description:
About Teleport

Don't wait for the future of infrastructure. Be part of it.

Teleport is the AI Infrastructure Identity Company. We're solving one of the hardest problems in security: giving every human, machine, workload, and AI agent a cryptographically secured identity, improving engineering velocity while maintaining security. We make trusted computing simple. This gives you the freedom, power, and autonomy to build and innovate with confidence.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we work with companies like Nasdaq, DoorDash, and Elastic to secure infrastructure for an AI world.



As a Staff Solutions Engineer, you will help the sales team drive revenue growth by evangelizing our technology via demos and technical discussions. You will get to collaborate with infrastructure engineering and security teams at the most sophisticated technology companies in the world. Most importantly, you will help these companies solve problems and get exposed to the latest ideas in technology.

You will partner with account executives, other solutions engineers, and other teams to understand customer challenges, design secure and scalable solutions, and guide prospects through technical evaluations and proof-of-value engagements. You will support our most strategic accounts.

While this role is fully remote, candidates must be based in the Pacific or Mountain time zones to ensure alignment with our customers.

You have experience working with AI technologies and infrastructure (LLMs, MCP, vector databases, AI tooling), and familiarity with traditional infrastructure networking and security (Linux/Unix, Windows, VPNs, bastion hosts, etc) and modern cloud-native technologies (cloud compute, containers, IaC, etc).

What You'll Do

 - Architect and deliver compelling demos and proof-of-concepts that showcase Teleport’s differentiation with Zero Trust principles, handling of human and non-human identities, identity governance, and identity security.

 - Act as the trusted advisor to engineering, platform engineering, DevSecOps, and security leaders.

 - Advise on protecting sensitive datasets and model endpoints with Teleport’s identity-based controls.

 - Position Teleport as a solution to eliminate API keys and static tokens in machine pipelines.

 - Support customers exploring AI/LLM use cases, including secure infrastructure for training and inference workloads.

 - Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering on feature gaps and market needs.

 - Collaborate with Marketing on thought leadership around identity, human, non-human, and AI security.

 - Support channel and technology partners with technical enablement.

 - Help across various go-to-market activities, including marketing collateral, product positioning, customer interviews, sales cycle optimizations, traveling to conferences, brand evangelism, attending meetups, etc.

 - Listen deeply and perceive feedback as an opportunity to improve.

 - Demonstrate a high level of empathy, resilience, and humility.

What You'll Bring

 - 8+ years of experience in pre-sales engineering, solutions architecture, DevSecOps or a highly technical customer-facing role.

 - Experience with using/configuring/debugging Linux machines and network issues.

 - Strong understanding and experience with Kubernetes, including hands-on troubleshooting.

 - Strong knowledge of at least one cloud computing platform

 - Strong knowledge of DevSecOps principles, CI/CD pipelines, and securing infrastructure at scale (e.g., source control, code reviews, unit testing, agile principles).

 - Strong understanding of system architecture, provisioning, and administration

 - Familiarity with AI/LLM infrastructure (GPU clusters, data governance, inference workloads, ML pipelines) and associated security requirements.

 - Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues

 - Ability to engage both technical and executive stakeholders with credibility and clarity.

You're joining a company where the problem is real, the team is small, and your work shows up directly in the product. We're not a big company, you won't get lost in a crowd. You have experience working with AI technologies and infrastructure (LLMs, MCP, vector databases, AI tooling), and familiarity with traditional infrastructure networking and security (Linux/Unix, Windows, VPNs, bastion hosts, etc) and modern cloud-native technologies (cloud compute, containers, IaC, etc).

 - Position Teleport as a solution to eliminate API keys and static tokens in machine pipelines.

 - Support customers exploring AI/LLM use cases, including secure infrastructure for training and inference workloads.

 - Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering on feature gaps and market needs.

 - Collaborate with Marketing on thought leadership around identity, human, non-human, and AI security.

 - Support channel and technology partners with technical enablement.

 - Help across various go-to-market activities, including marketing collateral, product positioning, customer interviews, sales cycle optimizations, traveling to conferences, brand evangelism, attending meetups, etc.

 - Listen deeply and perceive feedback as an opportunity to improve.

 - Demonstrate a high level of empathy, resilience, and humility.
   
   What You'll Bring

 - 3+ years of experience in pre-sales engineering, solutions architecture, DevSecOps or a highly technical customer-facing role.

 - Experience with using/configuring/debugging Linux machines and network issues.

 - Strong understanding and experience with Kubernetes, including hands-on troubleshooting.

 - Strong knowledge of at least one cloud computing platform

 - Strong knowledge of DevSecOps principles, CI/CD pipelines, and securing infrastructure at scale (e.g., source control, code reviews, unit testing, agile principles).

 - Advanced understanding of identity security and modern Zero Trust security approaches.

 - Proven ability to develop scripts and automation using Linux shell, Go, and Infrastructure as Code tools

 - Strong understanding of system architecture, provisioning, and administration

 - Familiarity with AI/LLM infrastructure (GPU clusters, data governance, inference workloads, ML pipelines) and associated security requirements.

 - Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues

 - Ability to engage both technical and executive stakeholders with credibility and clarity.

Why Teleport

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer, Mid-Market
jobs.description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 



As a Solutions Engineer, you’ll be leading the technical discussion with our key prospects & customers, making sure there’s nothing stopping our customers from using Vanta to its fullest potential to support their own security goals.



You’ll be an integral part of the Sales team, working pre-sales to ensure technical fit and create innovative solutions for our customers.



Your attention to detail, focused on customer needs, will drive compelling technical evaluations and proof-of-concept engagements. This will ultimately accelerate deal velocity and increase win rates while helping to shape competitive positioning, sales strategy, and product roadmap feedback.



GRC practitioners are especially encouraged to apply—whether you've managed GRC programs in-house, audited them as an internal or external auditor, or helped customers meet their GRC program needs at a GRC vendor, you'll bring exactly the customer empathy and domain fluency this role thrives on.



What you’ll do as a Solutions Engineer at Vanta:

 - Own the technical relationship with our customers

 - Develop a deep understanding of our product capabilities, integrations, configurations messaging, partner ecosystem, and competitive landscape.

 - Listen carefully to prospects and clients to provide market feedback to the product team and help prioritize functionality needed to drive sales opportunities

 - Support customers thought their trial process with Vanta

 - Build product examples, documentation, and other critical resources for our customers

 - Cultivate an environment of teamwork, openness, creativity, and continuous improvement

 - Creatively identify and help drive new programs to improve the pre to post-sales transition



How to be successful in this role:

 - Have 3+ years of customer-facing, technical experience as a solutions engineer, sales engineer, technology consultant or equivalent title

 - Ideally have prior experience in the GRC space or cybersecurity domain

 - Have previous B2B SaaS experience

 - Have hands-on experience with cloud platforms: AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure & Operating Systems (Windows, MacOS, Linux) and cloud application architecture

 - Have strong project management skills with a proven ability to operate in a startup environment that lacks structure of a larger organization

 - Be creative, technical, and naturally persuasive

 - Be detail-oriented and organized.

 - Love listening to customers, discussing strategy with colleagues, but also diving into the weeds.

 - Be familiar with REST API development and service integrations is a plus

 - Be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship

 - Use AI in day-to-day work to amplify your skills and strengthen your outcomes, applying it across routine workflows, actively building fluency through experimentation, and exercising sound judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets a high quality bar



What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

 - Industry-competitive salary and equity

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

 - 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

 - Health & wellness stipend

 - Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

 - Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

 - Family planning benefits

 - Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

 - Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

 - 11 company-paid holidays

 - Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

 - Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney
   
   

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.  



#LI-remote



At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.



About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

jobs.description:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀



ClickUp's mission is to make the world more productive. As we build an all-in-one productivity platform that helps teams plan and do their best work, dependable sales incentives help our go-to-market teams stay focused on customers and growth. The Senior Sales Compensation Manager sits at the intersection of Finance, Sales, and Revenue Operations, making variable pay accurate, understandable, and dependable.

 

The Role

 - Own the monthly commission calculation process for sales roles, translating approved plan rules and sales data into accurate payout results delivered on schedule.

 - Reconcile source data and compensation-system records, investigate discrepancies, and document calculations and adjustments so payout results are clear and auditable.

 - Own the investigation and resolution of complex commission exceptions, identify root causes, and partner across Finance, Sales, Revenue Operations, and Payroll to implement lasting improvements to processes and controls.

 - Maintain accurate compensation plan and participant data in the compensation system, and flag missing or inconsistent inputs before they affect payouts.

 - Respond to sales representatives' and leaders' questions with clear explanations of how plan rules were applied, and coordinate resolution of pay discrepancies.

 - Partner with FP&A, Sales, Revenue Operations/Sales Operations, and Payroll to manage handoffs and keep recurring commission workflows reliable.

 - Identify repeated errors or manual steps and recommend practical improvements to controls, documentation, and processes.

 

Qualifications

 - Hands-on experience calculating, validating, or administering sales commissions or other variable-pay programs; experience owning a complete payout cycle is especially relevant.

 - Experience using AI tools and building AI-powered workflows to streamline sales compensation calculations, reconciliations, and reporting, with the ability to validate outputs for accuracy and protect confidential compensation data.

 - Strong Excel or spreadsheet skills, including working with detailed datasets, formulas, reconciliations, and error checks.

 - Careful, methodical approach to validating inputs, tracing variances, documenting assumptions, and protecting confidential compensation information.

 - Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain calculations and policy details to sales and finance partners in plain language.

 - Collaborative approach to working with Finance, Sales, Revenue Operations, and Payroll teams.

 

Desirable

 - Experience with a sales compensation platform such as CaptivateIQ, Spiff, Xactly, or a similar system.

 - Familiarity with Salesforce or another CRM, sales quota and attainment data, or quota adjustments.

 - Experience supporting variable compensation in a B2B SaaS or technology business.
