jobs.description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Paying vendors is one of the most manual, error-prone jobs in finance. Invoices arrive by email and PDF, get keyed in by hand, wait on approvals, and then have to be paid on time, by the right method, for the right amount, and recorded correctly in the books. A single mistake can mean a late fee, a duplicate payment, or an unhappy vendor.



Ramp's Bill Pay team builds the accounts payable system that automates that work end to end: bill intake and parsing, approvals, payment execution by ACH, check, card, and international transfer, vendor credits, and sync to customers' accounting systems. Bill Pay is one of Ramp's fastest-growing products, and businesses rely on it every day to move large amounts of money.


We're looking for a senior backend engineer to own a core part of that system. You'll take responsibility for an area such as payment execution, bill intake and AI-powered extraction, approvals, or accounting sync, set its technical direction within the team, and keep it correct and reliable as volume grows. You'll work closely with product, design, and payments partners to make accounts payable faster and more trustworthy for finance teams.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the design and evolution of a core Bill Pay system, such as payment execution, bill intake, approvals, or accounting sync, from technical design through launch, monitoring, and iteration

 - Build payment workflows that move money correctly across ACH, check, card, and international rails, with strong safeguards against duplicate, late, or incorrect payments

 - Build AI-powered AP automation, including invoice extraction, auto-coding, and agents that reduce manual review for finance teams

 - Design data models that keep every bill, approval, payment, and credit accurate and traceable through to the general ledger

 - Build reliable integrations with ERPs and accounting systems that stay consistent through retries, partial failures, and edits on either side

 - Improve the reliability, performance, and observability of Bill Pay systems as customers process larger payment volumes

 - Drive technical direction for your area and raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code reviews, and mentorship



WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - Experience designing, building, and operating production backend systems, including APIs, data models, and asynchronous workflows

 - A track record of owning a system or product area end to end and shaping its technical direction over time

 - Strong system design judgment, especially around correctness, idempotency, and reliability in systems where mistakes have real financial impact

 - Product sense: you care about the customer problem, not just the ticket, and you balance speed with quality

 - Clear communication and a collaborative approach to technical decisions across product, design, and engineering



NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience with accounts payable, payments, money movement, or other financial systems

 - Experience building integrations with ERPs or accounting systems, such as NetSuite or QuickBooks

 - Experience applying LLMs, OCR, or other automation to document processing or financial workflows

 - Experience scaling high-volume, event-driven systems

 - Health and wellness stipend

 - Budget for intra-office travel

 - Weekly coffee stipend

 - Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

OTHER NOTICES

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Product team at Harvey, you'll play a critical role in designing and building new backend systems while equally scaling and strengthening our existing infrastructure. Our backend infrastructure is the foundation that powers every user interaction with Harvey — processing billions of prompt tokens and millions of daily requests across our global legal AI platform.

You'll work in an environment balanced between innovation — building new systems — and operational excellence, ensuring that Harvey remains resilient and efficient as it scales products, regions, customers, and usage. Your contributions will directly impact the reliability, scalability, and security of our platform as we serve the world's leading law firms and professional service providers.

This role is based in Bengaluru, India.







WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and build scalable, fault-tolerant backend infrastructure systems that power Harvey's AI platform across multiple cloud regions

 - Own and evolve our multi-cloud infrastructure (Azure, GCP), including Kubernetes orchestration, networking, and container management

 - Lead technical initiatives around observability, incident response, and operational excellence — building systems that enable rapid detection and resolution of issues

 - Architect and optimize our distributed systems for reliability, including load balancing, quota management, and failover mechanisms

 - Partner with Product Engineering and Security teams to ensure our infrastructure is an accelerant, not a constraint

 - Drive infrastructure-as-code practices using tools like Terraform and Pulumi to enable reproducible, auditable deployments

 - Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar across the organization through code reviews, design reviews, and technical leadership

 - Representative Projects
   
   - Design and implement a next-generation model proxy architecture that routes millions of daily inference requests while maintaining model API compatibility and enabling seamless model integration
   
   - Build distributed rate limiting and quota management systems using Redis-backed algorithms to handle bursty traffic patterns without degrading user experience
   
   - Architect multi-region deployment strategies that meet strict data residency requirements for global enterprise customers
   
   - Develop comprehensive observability infrastructure with granular SLA monitoring, burn rate alerts, and detailed token attribution for cost tracking
   
   - Lead the evolution of our CI/CD pipelines to improve developer velocity while maintaining production stability







WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 10+ years of experience in Infrastructure Engineering or Platform Engineering in a production environment

 - Long track record building and scaling complex, large-scale distributed systems

 - Deep proficiency with cloud infrastructure platforms (Azure preferred; GCP or AWS experience transfers well)

 - Strong fluency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools — Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation

 - Solid understanding of Kubernetes, container orchestration, networking, and cloud security at scale

 - Experience with observability tools (Datadog, Sentry) and incident response practices (PagerDuty, Incident.io http://Incident.io)

 - Strong programming skills in Python, Go, or similar languages

 - Excellent problem-solving skills, a "spidey sense" of where things could go wrong, and a commitment to operational excellence
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience building infrastructure for AI/ML workloads or high-throughput inference systems

 - Background with distributed rate limiting, load balancing, or quota management systems

 - Experience operating multi-tenant platforms with strict security and compliance requirements

 - Track record of leading complex cross-functional projects and delivering measurable impact




ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

 - Work eligibility: Must be authorized to work in India. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

jobs.title: Information Security Engineer - Application Security
jobs.description: Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the Role: Hi there! We're hiring an Information Security Engineer with a focus on Application Security to join our Information Security team at Camunda. We are a team that takes security seriously without making it feel like a locked door. We work in a transparent, straightforward way, and we care about doing the work right rather than just checking a compliance box. You will work side by side with our R&D engineers: reviewing designs, threat modeling new features, digging into code and helping teams make good, risk-based decisions about the vulnerabilities that come in. You'll also help build the internal tools that make this work scale, including our CVE registry and the LLM-assisted workflows we use to analyse code and triage findings. Camunda is an AI-first company, and InfoSec is no exception: AI agents are part of how we review code, assess vulnerabilities, and build our tools. You will help shape how that works. This is a hands-on role for someone who already has solid AppSec foundations and wants to grow. We are a generalist team, so you will also take part in our on-call rotation and incident response, and get exposure to other areas of security. But most of your time will be spent with engineers and building and maintaining internal tools and processes. What You Will Do Vulnerability management : triage findings from SCA, container and code scanning, external reports and internal security testing; assess whether Camunda is actually affected; agree fix / mitigate / accept with engineering and follow through to release. Threat modeling and security reviews : run threat modeling sessions and design reviews with R&D teams for new features and architecture changes, and turn the results into concrete, prioritised actions. Code analysis with LLMs : use and improve LLM-assisted tooling (agents, prompts, reusable skills) to review code, validate findings and reproduce issues, while applying your own judgement to know when the model is wrong. Build internal security tooling : contribute to the CVE registry and related automation that connects scanners, engineering teams, and customer communication. Much of it is built on Camunda itself. Help engineers do the secure thing by default : answer questions, review pull requests, improve guidelines and occasionally run a session or workshop. On-call and incident response : share the InfoSec on-call rotation with the other engineers and help investigate and resolve security incidents. Support the wider team : help write security advisories for our customers, answer customer security questions and support audits. What You Will Bring to the Role Around 3+ years in security or software engineering , with at least 2 of them working on application or product security (AppSec, product security, pentesting, or a security-focused developer role all count). Experience at a SaaS or software product company , working closely with engineering teams that ship often through modern CI/CD and cloud environments. Hands-on vulnerability triage : you've worked with tools like Snyk, Trivy, Semgrep, CodeQL or similar, can tell a real issue from a false positive, and can explain how exploitable something actually is in context (CVSS, exploitability, configuration). Threat modeling and design review experience (e.g. STRIDE) on real systems, ideally web apps, APIs, or distributed services. You read and write code. You're comfortable reading Java (Camunda is built on it) well enough to follow a data flow and spot a security bug. You can write scripts and small tools and contribute to an existing codebase with review. You build with AI, not just chat with it. You use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar) in your daily work to write tools, analyse code or automate tasks. And you know their output still needs a second look, especially when it comes to security. Clear, friendly communication with engineers. You see yourself as an enabler, not a gatekeeper, and you can explain risk to people who aren't security specialists. Nice to haves Some Python and/or JavaScript experience, or experience building internal tools. Willingness to learn and use Camunda, since we build a lot of our own security automation on it. Prior BPMN / workflow experience is a plus. Experience responding to security incidents or being part of an on-call rotation. Exposure to security advisories, CVE disclosure or bug bounty programmes. Knowledge of AI/LLM security risks (OWASP Top 10 for LLMs / agentic apps, prompt injection, tool abuse). Experience securing Kubernetes or container-based workloads, or open-source / B2B software. We also provide industrialization and production configurations for mission-critical web services. As domain experts, we proactively develop and disseminate reference infrastructure, best practices, knowledge, and tooling across all technical teams at Dataiku. This role encompasses a broad spectrum of responsibilities, from leveraging high-level managed services at hyperscalers to performing in-depth, low-level Linux debugging. As a key contributor to the deployment of our core product, the team actively participates in development initiatives related to infrastructure and Linux system interactions. We foster a collaborative environment and seek a like-minded individual to engage in highly collaborative projects. Effective communication skills are essential for interacting with diverse teams throughout the company. This position is based in Paris and may be considered for remote work. Your responsibilities: Design, deploy, and manage our core product based internal data platforms. Design, deploy, and configure production environments for multiple web services. Collaborate with teams to architect technical solutions, and subsequently deploy and manage those solutions. Develop core product features around cloud services and Linux integration. Guarantee optimal service capacity and robust security for all running workloads and services. The role might be a good fit if you have: Proficiency in infrastructure automation using tools such as Terraform. Expertise in container technologies and managed Kubernetes clusters. Advanced scripting skills in Python. Field experience with Linux operating systems and low-level system troubleshooting Practical experience in networking and compute within a major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Demonstrated resilience in resolving complex technical challenges, with a relentless pursuit of root cause analysis. About the Role The primary responsibility of this role is for CertiK’s security-related services. Intersecting cybersecurity and blockchain, CertiK’s security offerings include security consulting, security reviews, security auditing of smart contracts and blockchains, verification of smart contracts, penetration testing, and more. As a Security Engineer at CertiK, you will contribute to the security offerings of the company, working with the rest of the security team to deliver the best products and services. You might engage directly with CertiK’s existing and future clients, participate in expanding security-related products and services, and follow the blockchain world on emerging security problems and trends. The good stuff.. jobs.title: Full Stack AI Engineer
jobs.description: About 3Y Health 3Y Health is building the operating system for healthcare practices, an AI-native platform that helps clinicians start, run and grow their practice. We work as a managed services organization (MSO): along with the software, our operations team runs the back office for the clinics we partner with, including billing, insurance and compliance. We currently serve applied behavior analysis (ABA) therapy practices and are expanding into speech, occupational and physical therapy, and psychiatry. About the role Members of Technical Staff own features end to end. You'll work with the clinicians and operators who use what we build, scope the problem, design and build the solution across the stack, deploy it and follow how it performs in production. Our engineering team is flat, with no sub-teams, so you'll work across the whole platform. We build with AI coding agents every day and expect you to do the same. What you'll do Design and build AI agents and automated workflows for clinic operations, such as insurance benefits verification, prior authorizations, patient intake, claims and clinical documentation Build features for clinicians, patients and families, and our internal operations team, on web and mobile Take ambiguous problems from 0 to 1, working with operators and clinicians to define the problem, write the spec and ship a first version Design the services, data models and APIs behind your features and manage the infrastructure as code Own your services in production: deployments, monitoring and incident response Write evals for model-facing features and track the metrics of the workflows you ship Work with protected health information (PHI) safely, with least-privilege access, no PHI in logs and auditable changes Build and maintain the skills, plugins, MCP integrations and review bots our engineers use with Claude Code and Codex Our stack Backend: Python (our primary language for new services), Kotlin with Hasura (GraphQL) on our established platform, plus TypeScript (NestJS) and some Go Frontend and mobile: React, Next.js, React Native Data: PostgreSQL (including pgvector), Snowflake Workflows and contracts: Temporal, gRPC/Protobuf Infrastructure: AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS), Terraform, GitHub Actions, Datadog, LaunchDarkly AI: Claude and OpenAI models, Claude Code and Codex, with our own skills, plugins, MCP integrations and an AI code-review bot Must-haves 5+ years of experience building and shipping production software Recent, hands-on experience using or building AI harnesses: the layer around a model or coding agent (project instructions, tools and MCP servers, skills, hooks, subagents, evals), not only calls to a model API. You can show what you set up or built. At least one personal project you built and published on the web, live and usable by anyone, ideally a SaaS with payments working (e.g. Stripe). Share the link when you apply. What we're looking for A track record of owning products or features end to end, from an unclear problem to a system people depend on Strong full-stack skills in Python and TypeScript, with experience across frontend, backend, databases and cloud infrastructure Comfort working in a large, established codebase Hands-on experience building with LLMs, including tool use, agent orchestration, structured outputs, retrieval and evals (LangGraph, an agents SDK or similar) Daily use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. You know how to set them up for a codebase (project instructions, skills, MCP servers, hooks, subagents), run several tasks in parallel and review their output carefully. If you haven't heard of Claude Code, this role is likely not a fit. Good product sense and the ability to make solid UI decisions without a dedicated designer, using our component library High agency: you unblock yourself, look for context and ask questions when you need to Clear written communication. The team is distributed across time zones and most decisions happen in specs, PRs and tickets. Nice to have Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry (HIPAA, payer and claims workflows, EHR integrations, HL7/FHIR) Temporal or another durable workflow engine React Native Running LLM evaluations or safety checks on model output in production Having built your own agent harness, MCP server or plugin for a coding agent Open-source work or internal tools that other people use If you meet all the must-haves and most of the rest, we'd like to hear from you, even if you don't check every other box.

Hands-on experience implementing mobile in-app purchases and subscription flows for iOS and/or Android applications, beyond web-based payment integrations. Experience integrating mobile payment platforms with custom backend systems , including payment data synchronisation, receipt handling, subscription status tracking, and entitlement management. Strong understanding of mobile subscription and payment lifecycles , including renewals, cancellations, refunds, failed payments, and subscription state changes. Experience ensuring the accuracy, reliability, and consistency of revenue-critical backend systems , including troubleshooting production issues. Strong backend development experience with Node.js or TypeScript or JavaScript , ideally using NestJS and building GraphQL or REST APIs. Good understanding of event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and distributed systems . Experience writing reliable unit and integration tests . Strong technical ownership, independent problem-solving, and architectural decision-making skills, with the potential to take on technical leadership responsibilities . Strong communication skills and full professional proficiency in English. Nice to Have Experience with AWS cloud infrastructure , SQL and NoSQL databases. Our current stack includes ECS, DynamoDB, SQS, EventBridge, and PostgreSQL. Experience working directly with Apple App Store and Google Play billing ecosystems . Experience running monetisation experiments , including A/B testing, subscription pricing changes, and conversion optimisation. Experience managing regional pricing, multiple currencies, and country-specific monetisation strategies . Experience analysing the performance of monetisation experiments, including revenue, subscription conversion, and retention metrics. Previous experience acting as a Tech Lead or Lead Backend Engineer , mentoring engineers, and driving technical decisions. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Backend, Identity Threat Protection
jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We re all in on this mission. If you are too, let s talk.

Staff Backend Engineer, Identity Threat Protection

 

The Identity Threat Protection Team

Identity Threat Protection (ITP), powered by cutting-edge Okta AI, shatters the mold of traditional login security. We deliver real-time, surgical defense against the most sophisticated and rapidly evolving threats. By deeply integrating with existing security infrastructure, ITP relentlessly analyzes user behavior and system data to proactively hunt down and neutralize risks before they impact our customers.

Join an elite team of full-stack engineers, visionary data scientists, and pioneering ML engineers. We are not just redefining cloud authentication—we are engineering the next-gen security platform that continuously evaluates global threats and constructs a comprehensive, dynamic risk. ITP stands as the uncompromising guardian of trust and security, placing decisive risk prioritization at the core of every authentication and authorization decision.

Identity Threat Protection with Okta AI

The Staff Software Engineer Opportunity

Okta is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to be a driving force on the ITP engineering team. This is your chance to dive into the deep end and solve the most critical and complex security challenges facing enterprises today. We seek a candidate who has not just experience, but a proven record of designing, building, launching, and scaling world-class security products—from concept to global deployment.

You will be a technical cornerstone of a team that lives and breathes elegant solutions and uncompromising quality. Our philosophy is rooted in relentless automated testing, rigorous code reviews, and the design of systems for massive, planetary-scale operations. As a Staff Engineer, you are a player-coach and a standard-setter, demonstrating absolute excellence in software engineering.Our environment is high-speed, fiercely innovative, and highly autonomous, utilizing agile cycles where individual ownership is paramount. If you crave stimulating, mission-critical security projects, pioneering emerging technologies, and conquering complex security and Machine Learning challenges, this is your defining career opportunity.

What you’ll be doing 

  • Architect and Lead: Command the design, development, delivery, and supportability of cloud-native security products—leading the charge from initial concept to final, production-ready implementation.
  • Drive Collaboration: Build solid, cross-group partnerships and demonstrate exceptional interpersonal communication, working closely with engineering, product management, design, support, and documentation teams.
  • Uphold Excellence: Commit to the highest programming standards through rigorous code reviews and the creation of comprehensive unit and functional tests.
  • Lead Remote Teams: Excel at working with remote teams and individuals while relentlessly ensuring product quality, agility, and velocity.
  • Mentor and Empower: Act as a player-coach to mentor, groom, and educate junior engineers.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • 8+ years of professional software development experience, with a demonstrated history of technical leadership and mentorship.
  • Deep expertise in Java, including a strong understanding of object-oriented design, multithreading, and building high-performance services.
  • Proven experience designing, building, and operating complex, large-scale distributed systems in a cloud environment (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
  • A strong grasp of architectural patterns for scalability, reliability, and security, with the ability to lead technical design discussions and make informed trade-offs.

jobs.title: AI-Native Staff Product Designer, AI + Compute
jobs.description:
ROLE SUMMARY

As AI agents move into production, they need a foundation that keeps them running through failures, retries, and long waits. Temporal is that foundation, and building AI-native experiences on top of it is paramount to where we are headed. We're looking for a technical, AI-native Staff Product Designer to shape how developers build, run, and scale agents on Temporal, from the agent platform and harness down to the compute and workers that execute them.

You'll design with AI and for AI. You use AI as a core part of how you work, and you bring that fluency to the products developers use to run AI in production. You're comfortable going deep on how workers execute tasks, how compute scales, and what it costs, and you turn that depth into experiences that feel simple. This role owns a focused domain while spanning the full developer experience, well beyond our UI.





WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design the experiences developers use to build, run, deploy, and observe agentic workloads on Temporal, across Agent Platform, Agent Harness, and Serverless Workers.

 - Shape the compute experience end to end, from configuring and scaling workers to understanding usage and cost.

 - Create future state prototypes with your design leadership that show where Temporal's agent and compute experiences are headed, giving Product and Engineering a concrete vision to align roadmaps around.

 - Work across the surfaces where developers meet Temporal, including the Cloud UI, CLI, SDKs, and documentation.

 - Design with AI as a daily practice, using it to explore, prototype, and test ideas faster, and bring that perspective into product decisions.

 - Partner with PMs and Engineers from discovery through delivery to define problems, validate direction, and ship at Temporal's pace and scale.

 - Contribute to and extend Temporal's Design System for agentic use cases, keeping our expanding product surface consistent.

 - Bring rigor to ambiguous, technical problem spaces, translating infrastructure complexity into interfaces that feel simple and clear.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 8+ years of Product Design experience, including senior or staff-level ownership of complex, technical products, with a track record of influencing product direction through strong execution.

 - A solid understanding of compute and infrastructure concepts such as workers, scaling, queues, and resource usage, and the ability to discuss them credibly with engineers.

 - A portfolio that shows systems thinking and 0→1 work in developer tools, B2B or infrastructure products, dashboards, or similarly dense, data-heavy interfaces.

 - Experience designing AI-powered products or agent experiences.

 - Fluency with AI tools like Claude or Codex in your own design workflow, along with comfort in GitHub and terminal environments.

 - Hands-on experience with Figma.

 - Experience partnering directly with Engineering on technically constrained problems, ideally in developer tools, cloud infrastructure, or platform products.

 - Experience instrumenting and analyzing product usage to inform design decisions.

 - A bias for building. You prototype quickly, often in code or with AI, and you move through build, ship, learn, and iterate cycles in days rather than weeks.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Working knowledge of distributed systems, workflow orchestration, or durable execution concepts.

 - Experience with serverless platforms, container orchestration, or cloud compute products.

 - Familiarity with agentic AI patterns and the challenges of running agents in production.

 - Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and comfort reading code.

Teleport is the AI Infrastructure Identity Company. We're solving one of the hardest problems in security: giving every human, machine, workload, and AI agent a cryptographically secured identity, improving engineering velocity while maintaining security. We make trusted computing simple. This gives you the freedom, power, and autonomy to build and innovate with confidence.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we work with companies like Nasdaq, DoorDash, and Elastic to secure infrastructure for an AI world.



As a Solutions Engineer, you will help the sales team drive revenue growth by evangelizing our technology via demos and technical discussions. You will get to collaborate with infrastructure engineering and security teams at the most sophisticated technology companies in the world. Most importantly, you will help these companies solve problems and get exposed to the latest ideas in technology.

You will partner with account executives, other solutions engineers, and other teams to understand customer challenges, design secure and scalable solutions, and guide prospects through technical evaluations and proof-of-value engagements. You will support both mid-market and enterprise customers. 

While this role is fully remote, candidates must be based in the Pacific or Mountain time zones to ensure alignment with our customers.

You have experience working with AI technologies and infrastructure (LLMs, MCP, vector databases, AI tooling), and familiarity with traditional infrastructure networking and security (Linux/Unix, Windows, VPNs, bastion hosts, etc) and modern cloud-native technologies (cloud compute, containers, IaC, etc).



What You'll Do

 - Partner with Account Executives and Account Managers to expand technical discovery, and map Teleport’s capabilities to customer initiatives.

 - Architect and deliver compelling demos and proof-of-concepts that showcase Teleport’s differentiation with Zero Trust principles, handling of human and non-human identities, identity governance, and identity security.

 - Act as the trusted advisor to engineering, platform engineering, DevSecOps, and security leaders.

 - Advise on protecting sensitive datasets and model endpoints with Teleport’s identity-based controls.

 - Position Teleport as a solution to eliminate API keys and static tokens in machine pipelines.

 - Support customers exploring AI/LLM use cases, including secure infrastructure for training and inference workloads.

 - Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering on feature gaps and market needs.

 - Collaborate with Marketing on thought leadership around identity, human, non-human, and AI security.

 - Support channel and technology partners with technical enablement.

 - Help across various go-to-market activities, including marketing collateral, product positioning, customer interviews, sales cycle optimizations, traveling to conferences, brand evangelism, attending meetups, etc.

 - Listen deeply and perceive feedback as an opportunity to improve.

What You'll Bring

 - 3+ years of experience in pre-sales engineering, solutions architecture, DevSecOps or a highly technical customer-facing role.

 - Experience with using/configuring/debugging Linux machines and network issues.

jobs.description:
About Team & About Role

Rubrik helps organisations in every major industry stay resilient against cyberattacks, insider threats and operational disruption, protecting the data that hospitals, banks and public institutions depend on every day. As Territory Account Executive in Southern Germany, you’ll build business in one of Europe’s strongest industrial and financial regions, with large companies and ambitious Mittelstand firms on your doorstep. You’ll join a close-knit German team that shares deal strategy openly, backed by regional marketing, events and partner support to help you open doors.

What You’ll Do

  • Own a territory of accounts, from established Mittelstand to larger companies, and decide where your time creates the most value.
  • Tier your list and create the entry points that turn them into real opportunities.
  • Generate your own pipeline through outbound, LinkedIn, local events and partners, so that first conversations become qualified deals that protect customers against cyber risk.
  • Make the most of Rubrik’s regional marketing, events and partner activity by following up quickly on the interest it creates in your territory.
  • Run multi-stakeholder sales cycles end to end with MEDDPICC: find the budget owner, build champions and position Rubrik against the full scope of customer risk.
  • Work with Solutions Engineers, Channel Development and partners to extend your reach, and meet customers in person to build lasting relationships.
  • Learn from experienced colleagues through structured enablement and hands-on mentoring, and share what works with the German team in pipeline reviews and deal strategy sessions.
  • Feed local market insight and competitive signals back to Rubrik’s leadership to shape how we go to market in Germany.

Experience You’ll Need

  • A track record of winning new business in B2B enterprise software or SaaS, with consistent quota attainment and self-generated pipeline.
  • Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and engaging technical, security and executive buyers.
  • Fluent German and professional English.
  • A structured approach to qualification and pipeline management, with MEDDPICC or a comparable framework.
  • Based in or near Düsseldorf, Frankfurt, Stuttgart or Munich, with willingness to travel regularly across your territory.
  • A learning mindset: you seek feedback, adapt quickly and want to keep growing with the support of a hands-on manager.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in cybersecurity, data protection, backup/recovery or adjacent infrastructure and cloud categories. It’s not a must, since we’ll teach you the rest.
  • Experience selling with channel partners.
  • Knowledge of the industrial, financial and Mittelstand landscape in Western and Southern Germany.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce for pipeline management and forecasting.

jobs.description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

 

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we ve set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you ll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We re a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

 

About The Team

The Roku Enterprise Engineering team is at the forefront of building a robust, integrated, and scalable platform that powers critical business processes across the organization. As a cornerstone of Roku s corporate strategy, this team is instrumental in automating workflows across all Business Systems, including Supply Chain, Finance, Sales Operations, and Human Resources. By challenging traditional approaches to workflow automation, the team leverages cutting-edge Engineering practices and API-driven design to streamline internal processes, boost efficiency, and deliver innovative solutions.

The team s expertise spans a wide range of technologies, including Java and Python-based MicroServices, AWS/GCP cloud backend systems, Big Data technologies like Hive and Spark, and modern Web applications. With a globally distributed presence across the US, India and Europe, the team thrives on collaboration, bringing together diverse perspectives to solve complex challenges. At the heart of their success is a shared commitment to technical excellence, creativity, a strong sense of ownership, and a collaborative spirit that drives impactful results for Roku s business operations.

As a senior technical lead, you consider yourself a platform services developer and developing innovative solutions using modern software frameworks and paradigms. You are execution focused and would develop a reputation for repeatedly delivering projects on-time.

  • Drive architecture discussions, take ownership and responsibility over new projects, and deliver high quality software with tight timeline

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • BS or MS degree in Computer Science or equivalent
  • Experience in distributed computing frameworks like - Hive/Hadoop, Apache Spark
  • Experience in developing Finance or HR related applications
  • Experience with following cloud services: AWS Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, DynamoDB, VPC, Elastic Cache, Lambda
  • Working experience with Terraform
  • Experience in creating workflows for Apache Airflow

jobs.title: Tech Lead - Platform
jobs.description: About Pelico Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor. We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones. Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started. This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside. About the Platform squads Pelico is a configuration-driven, AI-native platform: a field engineer stands up a running factory application by authoring YAML — schema, algorithms, widgets, actions, agents — instead of writing code. The Platform squads build the reusable blocks that make that possible, and we run them as a product : our customers are other engineers — the Solution squads, our Regional Solution Engineering pods, and customer AI teams building on top of us. You'll lead one squad — the configurability framework, the compute layer, the widget surface, the agent-development substrate (MCP/LSP/harness/BYOM), the integration layer, or the end-user Copilot — owning a capability cluster the whole company builds on. Your mission You'll own a platform capability end to end — and ship it yourself: Build the substrate. Author the framework, SPI, runtime, or AI tooling other squads depend on, and review the rest at architectural depth. Run it as a product. Own the roadmap, the contracts your consumers rely on, the adoption metric, and the deprecation policy that keeps the surface clean. Set the bar. Author specs, run the spec-driven workflow, and stand up the eval and review gates that make agent-authored code trustworthy. Harvest the field. Turn recurring customer patterns into platform capabilities, so learning compounds instead of fragmenting into bespoke forks. Lead by example. Write the load-bearing code, pair with your engineers, raise their craft, and grow the squad as the leverage you ship earns it. Your impact Every Solution squad and every customer deployment is only as strong as the platform underneath it. Own a capability cluster well and you create leverage the entire company compounds on — the difference between a platform that scales and a pile of one-off forks. What we're looking for This is a lead-by-example role for a senior engineer who builds platforms other engineers love. You're excited by deep, high-blast-radius problems, you measure yourself by what others build on your work, and you lead by being among the best engineers in the room. You'll need: A track record of shipping production platform / framework / infrastructure that other engineers build on (SPIs, libraries, runtimes, dev tooling, or AI substrate) Deep, current hands-on coding — we build in Kotlin / Java 25 (TypeScript/React for the experience squads); strong here, or a fast learner Real API / SPI / abstraction-design judgment, with a feel for performance and correctness at scale (up to hundreds of millions of records) A platform-as-product mindset — you optimize for adoption and others' leverage, and you're comfortable deprecating A track record of leading senior engineers by example , not by leaving the keyboard Nice to have: Running a team as an internal platform (adoption metrics, internal NPS, deprecation, roadmap) Squad-relevant depth — codegen/annotation processors, Kubernetes/IaC/observability, React/design systems, MCP/LSP/agent harnesses, ERP/connectors, or end-user agent UX AI-native ways of working (agentic workflows, eval harnesses, spec-driven development) Aerospace / defense / discrete-manufacturing context French is a plus, not a requirement If you bring the essentials and a strong mix of the rest, we want to hear from you — we're hiring the person who'll make this real, not a checklist. What we offer A real ownership mandate over a capability cluster, with equity in a category-defining scale-up Deep, high-leverage problems with real customers and real scale An AI-native engineering culture and a small, elite squad — be challenged, learn, and have fun Hybrid working from our Paris HQ, an international team of 36+ nationalities Your interview experience Intro call with Talent Acquisition (30 min) Hiring manager conversation with the VP Engineering (45 min) Case Study onsite 1h30 / 2h Leadership conversation + founders (CEO/CTO) Offer + References , run in parallel Pelico is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.description: Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things, so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition. Now, we’re entering our next chapter, defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together. This position is 100% remote within LatAm. About the Role We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design and build high-quality products using Next.js, Node.js, and TypeScript. You will operate across architecture and delivery, taking ownership of systems while also guiding teams and driving technical direction. What We’re Looking For Day-to-Day Responsibilities Design and build end-to-end applications across frontend and backend. Define system architecture, APIs, and data models for scalable products. Lead technical discovery by understanding systems, constraints, and opportunities. Guide engineering decisions and support other engineers through design and code reviews. Partner with product and design to shape solutions from idea to implementation. Write and review code with a focus on quality, performance, and maintainability. Communicate clearly with stakeholders on approach, progress, and risks. Drive delivery while helping maintain a high technical bar across the team. Required Skills & Experience 10+ years building production-grade applications with real-world complexity. Experience operating as a technical lead or owning significant parts of a system. Strong expertise in JavaScript or TypeScript, React including Next.js, and Node.js. Experience building full-stack applications across frontend and service layers using modern TypeScript frameworks such as React, React Native, or NestJS. Experience designing and building APIs using REST and GraphQL. Strong experience working with databases and data modeling across systems such as PostgreSQL, MySQL or DynamoDB. Strong understanding of system design, application architecture, and scalable system patterns. Hands-on experience with cloud environments such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. Experience with deployment, CI/CD, and infrastructure practices such as Terraform or similar. Ability to clearly explain technical decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience producing clear architecture documentation and guiding implementation. Strong ownership with the ability to drive problems end-to-end. Nice to Have Experience operating as a technical lead or owning end-to-end systems Experience building AI-enabled product features or integrating ML systems Experience working in client-facing roles or multi-project environments Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology. This position is 100% remote within LatAm. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement. As a team member, you can expect: To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed. Payments made in USD. 18 days of PTO per year, observance of local holidays, and an annual break between Christmas and New Years. Wellness + Remote Stipend AI Voucher About Able Able builds technology products in a portfolio model. We’ve built products in a variety of industries. Everything from media to finance to toys to healthcare. Each time, we look for opportunities to leverage technology built at the portfolio-level to drive value faster. Able is committed to inclusion and diversity and is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is but the beginning of a conversation we’d love to have with you. Apply, and let’s get this adventure started!

jobs.description: Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. The Mission We are seeking a Senior Revenue Forecasting & Operations Business Partner to own Caylent’s revenue forecast and the operational data that feeds it, and to act as the finance partner to our Sales and Delivery leadership. Reporting to the Director of Finance, you will turn signed SOWs, staffing plans, and billing schedules into a forecast leadership can rely on, and explain the variance when actuals land. This is a hands-on role with high visibility to the CFO and the executive team. You will work daily with senior leaders across Sales, Delivery, Resource Management, and Accounting, challenging assumptions, influencing decisions, and translating financial trade-offs into clear recommendations they can act on. As we grow, you will also help integrate acquired entities into our forecasting, reporting, and systems. Your Assignment Revenue Forecasting and Finance Business Partner Own the monthly and quarterly revenue forecast across all entities (US, Canada, Brazil, Argentina, Mexico) and subsidiaries, and maintain a rolling 12-month forecast that supports the annual budget and reforecast cycles. Build the forecast bottom-up from signed SOWs, change orders, staffing plans, and billing schedules, and reconcile it top-down to the Salesforce pipeline and bookings. Forecast by revenue type : time and materials, fixed fee, managed services, and AWS-funded engagements. Model backlog burn, utilization, and bench impact on revenue, and flag engagements at risk of under-delivery or overrun. Deliver a monthly forecast vs. actuals package with variance explained by engagement, practice, and entity. Business Partnering Act as the trusted finance partner to Sales, Delivery, and Resource Management leaders, joining their forecast, pipeline, and staffing reviews on a recurring basis. Partner on deal and SOW structuring (pricing, fee model, AWS funding) before signature, not only after. Challenge assumptions (pipeline conversion, utilization, staffing, deal structure) with data, and influence decisions. Translate financial trade-offs (margin, cash, risk) into clear recommendations for senior, non-finance stakeholders. Systems, Data & Reporting Be the Finance owner of revenue data across Salesforce, the PSA or time tracking system, and the ERP; define the fields and controls that keep them in sync. Build and maintain forecast models and dashboards with full traceability from reported numbers back to source records. Automate recurring reporting where practical (Google Sheets, Apps Script, SQL, BI tooling, or AI tools). Document revenue operations processes and controls to support audit and month-end close. What Success Looks Like First 30 days: Understand the forecast end to end and map every active engagement to its fee structure, billing schedule, funding terms, and staffing plan. First 90 days: Own the monthly forecast and deliver the first forecast vs. actuals package with variance explained by engagement; establish regular cadences with Sales and Delivery leadership and become their go-to finance partner for forecast and deal questions. First 6 months: Forecast accuracy within 5% of actuals at the company level and within 10% by offering; forecast reviews with Sales and Delivery leaders run on a regular cadence. First year: Forecast model and dashboards are the single source of truth for revenue; recurring reporting is automated; Sales and Delivery leaders rely on Finance’s view in their own planning decisions. Your Qualifications 5+ years in FP&A, revenue operations, or revenue accounting, with at least 2 years in professional services or consulting. Proven track record as a finance business partner to senior commercial and operational leaders. Hands-on experience forecasting project-based revenue : time and materials, fixed fee, and milestone engagements Experience in Salesforce and at least one PSA or time tracking system Advanced Google Sheets or Excel modeling ; comfortable building models others will audit Clear written and verbal communication; executive presence with senior stakeholders; able to explain a variance in a few sentences. Preferred Qualifications Experience at an AWS or cloud consulting partner , including AWS funding programs Exposure to M&A , including integration of acquired entities into forecasting, reporting, and systems. Working knowledge of ASC 606 for services revenue, including percentage-of-completion and deferred and unbilled revenue. jobs.description: JD Edwards Data & ERP Consultant Particle41 is seeking a talented and versatile JD Edwards Data & ERP Consultant to join our innovative team. We are staffing a dedicated consultant for a large enterprise client that runs JD Edwards as its core ERP. The client needs someone who knows the JDE data model inside and out and can build reliable data pipelines around it. This is a working seat on the client team, not a short advisory project. You will work shoulder to shoulder with their ERP, IT, and business teams every day. In This Role, You Will: Own JDE data work: Extract, model, and transform data from JD Edwards tables (Address Book, Item Master, Sales Order, General Ledger, and related files). Build data pipelines: Design and maintain ETL/ELT flows from JDE into the client's data warehouse or reporting platform. Support ERP implementation work: Lead data mapping, conversion, cleansing, and reconciliation for implementation, upgrade, or migration efforts. Support cutover planning and execution. Enable reporting: Build clean, trusted datasets for BI dashboards and finance and operations reporting. Protect data quality: Set up validation and reconciliation checks between JDE and downstream systems. Find and fix root causes. Partner with the business: Work with finance, distribution, and manufacturing users to turn their questions into data requirements. Document as you go: Keep data flows, mappings, and conversion rules clear and current for the client team. Strong SQL on Oracle, SQL Server, or DB2 / IBM i (AS400). Data engineering experience: ETL/ELT development, pipeline design, and data modeling. At least one full-cycle ERP implementation, upgrade, or migration where you owned data conversion or data migration work. Working knowledge of core JDE modules: Financials, Distribution / Logistics, and Manufacturing. Able to work full-time during US business hours. Clear, confident written and spoken English. Comfortable working directly with client stakeholders. Able to work as an independent contractor. Nice to Have JDE technical tools: Orchestrator, Business Services (BSSV), UBEs / Report Design Aid, Table Conversion, and Form Design Aid. Cloud data platforms: Snowflake, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, AWS (Glue, Redshift), or dbt. BI tools: Power BI, Tableau, or OBIEE. Python for data processing and automation. Industry background in manufacturing, distribution, or automotive aftermarket. Oracle JD Edwards certification. Prior consulting or staff augmentation experience. jobs.description:
SLSQ327R329

East Coast

Midwest

Databricks is seeking a Lakebase Associate Director Specialists to help customers modernize their operational data foundation with Databricks Lakebase, our fully-managed Postgres offering for intelligent applications. This high-impact role sits within the Lakebase Go-To-Market team and partners closely with regional Account Executives within our Retail vertical to drive adoption of Lakebase with platform, application, and data teams.

Lakebase gives customers a unified, governed foundation for operational workloads and AI-native applications, helping them move away from a fragmented estate of point databases toward a modern, scalable, serverless Postgres service. If you want to be at the forefront of operational databases for AI and intelligent applications at one of the fastest-growing data and AI companies in the world, this is your opportunity.

The impact you will have

  • Drive new Lakebase revenue by identifying, qualifying, and driving Lakebase activations and consumption within a defined territory, in partnership with regional Account Executives and the broader account team.
  • Lead with outcomes for key Lakebase personas — including platform teams and developers, data teams, and central IT — articulating how Lakebase helps them ship features faster, simplify operational data architectures, and improve governance and cost efficiency.
  • Sell the value of fully-managed Postgres for intelligent applications, positioning Lakebase as the optimal choice for operational workloads that power real-time, AI-driven experiences.
  • Run complex, multi-threaded sales cycles from discovery and value hypothesis through commercial negotiation and close, navigating executive, technical, and line-of-business stakeholders.
  • Orchestrate proof-of-value and POCs that validate Lakebase’s benefits for OLTP-style workloads, reverse ETL, and AI/ML-driven applications, in partnership with solution architects and specialists.
  • Compete and win against legacy and cloud-native operational databases by leveraging our compete assets, benchmarks, and customer references.
  • Align to measurable business outcomes such as performance, developer productivity, time-to-market for new features, cost reduction, and simplification of the operational data landscape.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner teams to shape territory plans, launch plays, and co-selling motions with key ISVs and GSIs.
  • Enable the field by sharing Lakebase best practices, success stories, and sales motions with broader sales teams, helping scale Lakebase proficiency across the organization.

What success looks like in this role

This role requires the ability to operate across two key motions simultaneously:

  • Establish top strategic focus accounts by engaging application development teams to create net-new intelligent applications leveraging Lakebase.
  • Drive longer-term Postgres standardization and migration within Databricks most strategic accounts.

Candidates should demonstrate how they can act as a force multiplier across multiple dimensions of the business.

Success in this role requires strength in four areas:

  1. Business ownership – Operate at a business-unit level by tracking revenue, pipeline, and key observations, and by identifying areas needing additional focus or support.
  2. Strategic account engagement – Partner with account teams to engage priority accounts across the global DB700, driving strategic opportunities from initial engagement through successful outcomes.
  3. Field, account, & customer enablement: Align customers and the field on the value of Lakebase by equipping AEs and SAs with the messaging and execution motions needed to confidently own accounts without specialist intervention.
  4. Market voice and thought leadership – Develop an internal and external presence by contributing to global AMAs and internal forums, and by representing Databricks at key first- and third-party events.

The interview process is designed to evaluate candidates across all four of these dimensions.

What we look for

  • 7+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, consistently exceeding quota in complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
  • Proven success selling data platforms, operational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, cloud-native DBaaS), or adjacent data/AI infrastructure to technical buyers and business leaders.
  • Strong understanding of modern data and application architectures, including cloud-native services, microservices, event-driven systems, and how operational data underpins AI and analytics strategies.
  • Ability to sell to both technical stakeholders (developers, architects, data engineers) and business stakeholders (product leaders, operations, line-of-business owners).
  • Demonstrated experience leading specialist or overlay motions, working jointly with core Account Executives to create and progress opportunities.
  • Executive presence with the ability to whiteboard architectures, lead C-level conversations, and build trust with senior decision makers.
  • Strong value selling skills: adept at discovering pain, building a business case, and tying technical capabilities to clear, quantified outcomes.
  • Excellent communication, storytelling, and negotiation skills, with comfort presenting to both large and small audiences.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer | Experimentation - Product Analytics | Germany | Remote
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applications from the UK, Ireland, Sweden, Spain and Germany.

The opportunity:

Grafana Labs is building a native experimentation platform: a Grafana app that lets teams define A/B tests, connect them to feature flags and product telemetry, and get trustworthy, statistically sound answers about what their changes actually did.

It started as a hackathon project and is now used by Grafana engineering and product teams in our internal environment to run real experiments. The next step is to make it a first-class product: one we rely on every day internally and, over time, one we offer to Grafana Cloud customers alongside Frontend Observability, Session Replay and our other user-experience capabilities.

You ll join the Product Analytics team, a group of highly technical product analysts who help teams across Grafana understand how our products are used and run experiments on them. As the team s dedicated software engineer, you ll own the engineering of the experimentation app and have a lot of influence over where it goes. You ll partner closely with data scientists on the statistics, data engineers on event pipelines and the data warehouse, software engineers across Grafana on feature flags, Frontend Observability and the App Platform, and product stakeholders who rely on experiment results to make decisions. This is a hands-on engineering role that ships production code. It is not an analyst role.

About the product:

The experimentation app is built on the Grafana App Platform:

  • Frontend: a TypeScript and React app plugin using @grafana/ui, plus a custom datasource plugin that powers experiment statistics panels.
  • Backend: Go, built with the Grafana App SDK. Experiments are Kubernetes-style custom resources defined in CUE, with an operator, admission webhooks, and support for declarative, GitOps-style management.
  • Feature flags: integration with OpenFeature and the OpenFeature Remote Evaluation Protocol (OFREP), Grafana s multi-tenant feature toggle service, and an embedded GO Feature Flag evaluator.
  • Statistics engine: a Bayesian analysis engine (TypeScript, with a Go port) that produces a direction-aware verdict per metric, probability to be best, credible intervals, expected loss and sample-size recommendations.
  • Data: experiment exposure and outcome events flow from product instrumentation through RudderStack into BigQuery, or from Grafana Faro into Loki, and are queried live through Grafana datasources.
  • AI: experiment authoring assisted by Grafana Assistant, which discovers relevant data and drafts the experiment configuration for a human to review.

What You’ll be doing:

  • Evolve the experimentation app from internal tool to product. Full ownership of features end to end across the React frontend and Go backend, from problem framing and design through rollout, measurement and iteration.
  • Build the experimentation experience. Develop intuitive workflows for defining hypotheses, configuring experiments and metrics, managing their lifecycle, and exploring results. Make these experiences useful for product managers and analysts as well as engineers.
  • Make instrumentation easier to adopt and trust. Evolve the experimentation SDK and its OpenFeature and Faro integrations. Help teams connect variant assignment, actual exposure, and outcome events with consistent identity and event contracts.
  • Connect experiments to the rest of Grafana’s user-experience stack. Integrate with Grafana Faro and Frontend Observability so flag exposures and outcomes are captured automatically, and link experiment results to Session Replay and critical user journeys so teams can see why a variant won, not only that it won.
  • Harden the statistics and analysis path.

Mobile replay extends the same story to native apps as part of our Digital Experience Monitoring (DEM) strategy.

We are starting with Android. A working prototype already exists, and you will help turn it into a product customers can trust. The plan is to push ahead from there: iOS next, then our Flutter, React Native and OpenTelemetry mobile SDKs, so customers get a consistent replay experience across platforms.

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. We are looking for Staff Mobile Engineers who are passionate about working with data and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team!

  • Own the on-device replay library end to end, starting with Android and extending to iOS.
  • Make privacy a default, designing masking and consent controls so sensitive data never leaves the device.
  • Keep the overhead low and measure it on real devices, protecting startup time, UI responsiveness, battery, memory, network use and disk, and profiling the impact of capture and masking while the app is actively being used. Give customers controls to trade fidelity against cost.
  • Build the integration layer so customers do not copy demo glue code: adapters that tie replay to the active RUM session, sampling decisions and screen or navigation changes.
  • Work across the stack with Frontend and Mobile Observability teams on the capture, upload and storage pipeline, session inactivity handling, the timeline player and the mobile sessions and replay experience in Frontend Observability. Evaluate the format and API tradeoffs rather than assuming the current prototype approach is final.
  • Define quality and compatibility: automated tests, CI, device and OS coverage, and backwards-compatible upgrade paths for an SDK that customers cannot easily update.

  • Mentor engineers and help grow technical leadership in the team

jobs.description:
What We’re Building
Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023! 
 
If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb.io press releases. 
 
Who We Are
We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers.
 
How We Work
We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1. #LI-Remote

Little more about the team:

The Solution Architecture team sits at the intersection of technology, customer advocacy, and revenue, working Honeycomb’s most strategic opportunities. We partner with world-class engineering organizations to solve complex observability challenges and change how teams build and operate software. This is a team of hands-on technical leaders who want to shape major customer decisions, influence go-to-market strategy, and redefine what great technical selling looks like.

What you’ll do in the role:

  • Own the technical sales motion on a portfolio of mid-market to enterprise accounts across AMER, partnering closely with sales to drive deals forward. 
  • Lead discovery, solution design, and technical conversations that connect Honeycomb’s platform to real engineering and business priorities, from first call through close.
  • Drive the technical win. Define success criteria, run POCs, navigate competitive evaluations, and build stakeholder confidence with engineering teams and technical buyers.
  • Engage with engineering leaders, platform teams, and SRE organizations on observability best practices and AI-era workflows.
  • Translate complex customer environments into clear architectures and solution narratives that resonate with both hands-on practitioners and technical decision-makers.
  • Leverage AI tools to work efficiently and creatively while maintaining accuracy and reliability. Human-in-the-loop is a real thing!
  • Get hands-on when it matters. Instrument applications, troubleshoot technical blockers, and help customers prove outcomes in real environments.
  • Contribute to the team’s technical library: demos, solution frameworks, reference architectures, and repeatable assets that make the whole team more effective.
  • Deliver demos, workshops, and technical presentations that create conviction.
  • Collaborate across Sales, Product, Marketing, Field Engineering, and DevRel to strengthen the go-to-market motion and improve how we show up for customers.
  • Bring customer and field signals back into the company. Contribute to roadmap conversations and help shape how we demo and position the product.
  • Share what you know. Help onboard newer team members, document what works, and contribute to a culture of learning and continuous improvement.
  • Expected to cover some EMEA Customer calls 

What you’ll bring to the role:

  • Preference for CST and EST based candidates- you will be expected to work some EMEA calls
    5+ years of pre-sales, solution architecture, or customer-facing technical experience in B2B SaaS with a highly technical ICP, with a focus on enterprise or mid-market accounts.
  • A consistent track record of winning competitive, multi-stakeholder deals with technical buyers and navigating complex evaluation processes.
  • Experience selling into developer, platform, SRE, or engineering-led organizations , you earn technical credibility quickly and know how to bridge technical depth with business value.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to tailor your message from hands-on engineers to VP-level decision-makers.
  • Sharp solutioning skills: you whiteboard clearly, simplify complexity, and craft compelling technical strategies even in ambiguous situations.
  • Hands-on fluency across modern cloud environments, CSPs, containers, Kubernetes, distributed systems, and API-driven architectures.
  • Solid working knowledge of observability, distributed tracing, and OpenTelemetry. You understand how modern teams instrument, troubleshoot, and optimize complex systems.
  • Comfort navigating code and implementation details across common languages and frameworks , enough to guide instrumentation and validate technical approaches with customers.
  • Strong instincts for unblocking deals, reframing challenges, and finding practical paths forward when things get ambiguous.
  • Experience owning POCs and technical evaluations end-to-end: defining success criteria, managing risk, and driving to a clear outcome.
